def _handle_get_attachments(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_attachments:
        frappe.throw(_("Attachments not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)
    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    if not name:
        frappe.throw(_("?name= required for attachment listing"), frappe.ValidationError)
    files = frappe.get_all(
        "File",
        filters={"attached_to_doctype": cfg.primary_doctype, "attached_to_name": name},
        fields=["name", "file_name", "file_url", "file_size", "is_private", "creation"],
    )
    return {"attachments": [dict(f) for f in files]}


def _handle_download_attachment(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_attachments:
        frappe.throw(_("Attachments not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)
    filename = frappe.form_dict.get("_attachment")
    file_doc = frappe.get_all("File", filters={"file_name": filename}, fields=["*"], limit=1)
    if not file_doc:
        frappe.throw(_(f"File '{filename}' not found"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)
    f = file_doc[0]
    if f.get("is_private") and frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Authentication required to download private files"), frappe.AuthenticationError)
    import mimetypes
    content_type = mimetypes.guess_type(filename)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
    file_path = frappe.get_site_path("private" if f.get("is_private") else "public", "files", filename)
    try:
        # 18.29  Stream attachment from disk — no full-file memory buffer
        import os
        if not os.path.exists(file_path):
            frappe.throw(_(f"File '{filename}' not found on disk"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)
        frappe.response["type"] = "download"
        frappe.response["filename"] = filename
        frappe.response["content_type"] = content_type
        # Use wsgi.file_wrapper when available for zero-copy sendfile
        wsgi_wrapper = frappe.local.environ.get("wsgi.file_wrapper") if hasattr(frappe.local, "environ") else None
        if wsgi_wrapper:
            frappe.response["filecontent"] = wsgi_wrapper(open(file_path, "rb"), 65536)
        else:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as fp:
                frappe.response["filecontent"] = fp.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        frappe.throw(_(f"File '{filename}' not found on disk"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)
    return


def _handle_attachment_meta(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_attachments:
        frappe.throw(_("Attachments not enabled"), frappe.ValidationError)
    file_name = frappe.form_dict.get("_attachment_meta")
    files = frappe.get_all("File", filters={"name": file_name}, fields=["*"], limit=1)
    if not files:
        frappe.throw(_("File not found"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)
    return {"metadata": dict(files[0])}


# ===========================================================================
# Session context handler  (?_action=session_context)
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_session_context(cfg):
    """
    Returns the current user's profile plus any DocType fields from a linked
    record, all configured declaratively on the endpoint.

    FB API Endpoint fields used:
      session_context_link_doctype   — DocType to look up (e.g. "Employee")
      session_context_link_field     — field on that DocType whose value is the
                                       session user (default: "user_id")
      session_context_fields         — comma-separated fields to include from
                                       the linked record (blank = all)
      session_context_extra_doctypes — JSON array of additional lookups:
                                       [{"doctype":"X","link_field":"user","fields":"a,b"}]

    Example endpoint config:
      session_context_link_doctype = "Employee"
      session_context_link_field   = "user_id"
      session_context_fields       = "name,designation,department,company"

    Called as:
      GET /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.handle
          ?endpoint=<slug>&_action=session_context
    """
    user_email = frappe.session.user
    user_doc = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user_email)

    result: dict = {
        "user": {
            "email": user_email,
            "full_name": user_doc.full_name,
            "user_image": user_doc.user_image,
            "roles": frappe.get_roles(user_email),
        }
    }

    # Primary linked-record lookup
    link_doctype = cfg.get("session_context_link_doctype") or ""
    link_field = cfg.get("session_context_link_field") or "user_id"
    if link_doctype:
        record_name = frappe.get_cached_value(
            link_doctype, {link_field: user_email}, "name"
        )
        if record_name:
            try:
                linked_doc = frappe.get_cached_doc(link_doctype, record_name)
                raw_fields = cfg.get("session_context_fields") or ""
                if raw_fields.strip():
                    fields = [f.strip() for f in raw_fields.split(",") if f.strip()]
                    record_data = {f: linked_doc.get(f) for f in fields}
                else:
                    record_data = linked_doc.as_dict()
                result[link_doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_")] = record_data
            except Exception:
                pass
        else:
            result[link_doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_")] = None

    # Additional linked-record lookups
    extra_raw = cfg.get("session_context_extra_doctypes") or ""
    if extra_raw:
        try:
            extras = json.loads(extra_raw)
            for extra in extras:
                ex_doctype = extra.get("doctype", "")
                ex_link_field = extra.get("link_field", "user_id")
                ex_fields_raw = extra.get("fields", "")
                if not ex_doctype:
                    continue
                ex_name = frappe.get_cached_value(
                    ex_doctype, {ex_link_field: user_email}, "name"
                )
                if ex_name:
                    try:
                        ex_doc = frappe.get_cached_doc(ex_doctype, ex_name)
                        if ex_fields_raw:
                            ex_fields = [f.strip() for f in ex_fields_raw.split(",") if f.strip()]
                            ex_data = {f: ex_doc.get(f) for f in ex_fields}
                        else:
                            ex_data = ex_doc.as_dict()
                        result[ex_doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_")] = ex_data
                    except Exception:
                        result[ex_doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_")] = None
                else:
                    result[ex_doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_")] = None
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
            pass

    return {"success": True, "data": result}


# ===========================================================================
# Multi-doc import handler  (POST ?_action=multi_doc_import)
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_multi_doc_import(cfg):
    """
    Accepts a file (URL or multipart) plus metadata fields and creates one or
    more docs across one or more DocTypes — all configured declaratively.

    FB API Endpoint fields used:
      import_doc_map   — JSON object that defines what docs to create:
                         {
                           "primary": {
                             "doctype": "FB Import Job",
                             "field_map": {"fiscal_year":"fiscal_year","file":"file_url"},
                             "static_fields": {"status":"Pending"},
                             "enqueue_method": "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.importer.run_import",
                             "enqueue_queue": "long",
                             "enqueue_timeout": 7200,
                             "job_id_prefix": "fb_import"
                           },
                           "secondary": [
                             {
                               "doctype": "FB Import Log",
                               "field_map": {"parent_import":"$primary.name"},
                               "static_fields": {"log_type":"Info"}
                             }
                           ]
                         }

    Request body (JSON):
      {
        "file_url": "https://...",    // OR send multipart file
        "fiscal_year": "FY 2026",
        "division": "Joints",
        ...any additional fields the doc_map references...
      }

    Flow:
      1. Save uploaded file to Frappe Files (if multipart) → get file_url
      2. Merge request body with static_fields, resolve $primary.name references
      3. Insert primary doc
      4. Insert each secondary doc (can reference primary.name via $primary.name)
      5. Optionally enqueue background job for primary doc
      6. Return all created doc names

    Called as:
      POST /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.handle
           ?endpoint=<slug>&_action=multi_doc_import
    """
    import_doc_map_raw = cfg.get("import_doc_map") or ""
    if not import_doc_map_raw:
        frappe.throw(
            _("import_doc_map is not configured on this endpoint"),
            frappe.ValidationError,
        )

    try:
        import_doc_map: dict = json.loads(import_doc_map_raw)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
        frappe.throw(_("import_doc_map is not valid JSON"), frappe.ValidationError)

    body = _get_request_body()
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        body = {}

    # Handle multipart file upload → resolve to file_url
    file_url = body.get("file_url") or body.get("file") or ""
    if not file_url and hasattr(frappe.local, "request") and frappe.local.request.files:
        uploaded = frappe.local.request.files.get("file")
        if uploaded:
            fname = uploaded.filename
            content = uploaded.read()
            _validate_attachment(cfg, fname, len(content))
            file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "File",
                "file_name": fname,
                "content": content,
                "is_private": cfg.get("file_visibility") == "Private",
            })
            file_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            frappe.db.commit()
            file_url = file_doc.file_url
            body["file_url"] = file_url

    primary_cfg: dict = import_doc_map.get("primary", {})
    secondary_cfgs: list = import_doc_map.get("secondary", [])

    created: dict = {}

    # ── Create primary doc ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if primary_cfg:
        primary_doc = _build_import_doc(primary_cfg, body, ref={})
        primary_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        created["primary"] = {
            "doctype": primary_doc.doctype,
            "name": primary_doc.name,
        }

        # Enqueue background job if configured
        enqueue_method = primary_cfg.get("enqueue_method")
        if enqueue_method:
            job_id_prefix = primary_cfg.get("job_id_prefix", "fb_import")
            frappe.enqueue(
                method=enqueue_method,
                queue=primary_cfg.get("enqueue_queue", "long"),
                timeout=int(primary_cfg.get("enqueue_timeout", 7200)),
                import_name=primary_doc.name,
                job_id=f"{job_id_prefix}_{primary_doc.name}",
            )

    # ── Create secondary docs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ref = {"primary": created.get("primary", {})}
    secondary_results = []
    for sec_cfg in secondary_cfgs:
        sec_doc = _build_import_doc(sec_cfg, body, ref=ref)
        sec_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        secondary_results.append({
            "doctype": sec_doc.doctype,
            "name": sec_doc.name,
        })
    if secondary_results:
        created["secondary"] = secondary_results

    return {
        "success": True,
        "created": created,
        "file_url": file_url,
        "status": "queued" if primary_cfg.get("enqueue_method") else "created",
    }


def _build_import_doc(doc_cfg: dict, body: dict, ref: dict):
    """
    Build a frappe doc from a doc_map entry.
    field_map values starting with '$primary.' resolve from ref['primary'].
    """
    doctype = doc_cfg.get("doctype")
    if not doctype:
        frappe.throw(_("import_doc_map entry missing 'doctype'"), frappe.ValidationError)

    doc_data: dict = {"doctype": doctype}

    # static_fields applied first (lowest priority)
    for k, v in (doc_cfg.get("static_fields") or {}).items():
        doc_data[k] = v

    # field_map from request body (may override static_fields)
    for target_field, source_key in (doc_cfg.get("field_map") or {}).items():
        if isinstance(source_key, str) and source_key.startswith("$primary."):
            # Resolve from primary doc reference
            ref_key = source_key[len("$primary."):]
            doc_data[target_field] = ref.get("primary", {}).get(ref_key)
        elif source_key in body:
            doc_data[target_field] = body[source_key]

    return frappe.get_doc(doc_data)


# ===========================================================================
# POST handler
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_post(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_post:
        frappe.throw(_("POST not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)

    # Attachment upload
    if frappe.form_dict.get("_attachment_upload") == "1":
        return _handle_attachment_upload(cfg)

    # Bulk mode
    if frappe.form_dict.get("_bulk") == "1":
        return _handle_bulk_post(cfg)

    body = _get_request_body()
    body = _sanitize_body(cfg, body)
    body = _coerce_types(cfg, body)
    body = _apply_enum_map_request(cfg, body)
    _validate_json_schema(cfg, body)
    _validate_cross_field(cfg, body)

    required = [f.strip() for f in (cfg.post_required_fields or "").split(",") if f.strip()]
    missing = [f for f in required if f not in body]
    if missing:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}"), frappe.ValidationError)

    for f in [f.strip() for f in (cfg.post_ignore_fields or "").split(",") if f.strip()]:
        body.pop(f, None)

    body = _run_custom_logic_write(cfg, body, "POST")
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype

    doc_data = {"doctype": target_doctype, **body}

    # Nested child tables
    if cfg.nested_child_fields:
        try:
            child_map = json.loads(cfg.nested_child_fields)
            for field_key, child_doctype in child_map.items():
                if field_key in body and isinstance(body[field_key], list):
                    doc_data[field_key] = [{"doctype": child_doctype, **item} for item in body[field_key]]
        except Exception:
            pass

    doc = frappe.get_doc(doc_data)
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, "POST")
    _trigger_push_notification(cfg, doc, "POST")

    return {"success": True, "name": doc.name, "data": doc.as_dict()}


def _handle_bulk_post(cfg):
    body = _get_request_body()
    if not isinstance(body, list):
        frappe.throw(_("Bulk POST requires a JSON array body"), frappe.ValidationError)
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    success, failed = [], []

    # 18.30 — generator + single transaction context (no 1000-doc list in memory)
    def _items():
        for item in body:
            yield item

    frappe.db.begin()
    try:
        for item in _items():
            try:
                item = _sanitize_body(cfg, item)
                item = _coerce_types(cfg, item)
                doc = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": target_doctype, **item})
                doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                success.append(doc.name)
            except Exception as e:
                failed.append({"data": item, "error": str(e)})
        frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception:
        frappe.db.rollback()
        raise

    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    return {"success": success, "failed": failed, "total": len(body), "created": len(success)}


def _handle_attachment_upload(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_attachments:
        frappe.throw(_("Attachments not enabled"), frappe.ValidationError)

    doc_name = frappe.form_dict.get("docname") or frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    if not doc_name:
        frappe.throw(_("docname required for attachment upload"), frappe.ValidationError)

    # Base64 upload
    file_content_b64 = frappe.form_dict.get("file_content")
    file_name = frappe.form_dict.get("file_name")
    if file_content_b64 and file_name:
        _validate_attachment(cfg, file_name, len(base64.b64decode(file_content_b64)))
        file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "File",
            "file_name": file_name,
            "attached_to_doctype": cfg.primary_doctype,
            "attached_to_name": doc_name,
            "content": base64.b64decode(file_content_b64),
            "is_private": cfg.file_visibility == "Private",
        })
        file_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        _update_attached_field(cfg, doc_name, file_doc)
        thumb_url = _generate_thumbnail(file_doc)
        return {"success": True, "file_name": file_doc.file_name, "file_url": file_doc.file_url,
                "name": file_doc.name, "thumbnail_url": thumb_url}

    # Multipart upload
    if hasattr(frappe.local, "request") and frappe.local.request.files:
        uploaded = frappe.local.request.files.get("file")
        if not uploaded:
            frappe.throw(_("No file in request"), frappe.ValidationError)
        fname = uploaded.filename
        content = uploaded.read()
        _validate_attachment(cfg, fname, len(content))
        file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "File",
            "file_name": fname,
            "attached_to_doctype": cfg.primary_doctype,
            "attached_to_name": doc_name,
            "content": content,
            "is_private": cfg.file_visibility == "Private",
        })
        file_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        _update_attached_field(cfg, doc_name, file_doc)
        thumb_url = _generate_thumbnail(file_doc)
        return {"success": True, "file_name": file_doc.file_name, "file_url": file_doc.file_url,
                "name": file_doc.name, "thumbnail_url": thumb_url}

    frappe.throw(_("No file content provided"), frappe.ValidationError)


def _validate_attachment(cfg, filename: str, size_bytes: int):
    max_kb = cfg.max_file_size_kb or 10240
    if size_bytes > max_kb * 1024:
        frappe.throw(_(f"File exceeds maximum size of {max_kb} KB"), frappe.ValidationError)
    if cfg.allowed_extensions:
        allowed = [e.strip().lower().lstrip(".") for e in cfg.allowed_extensions.split(",")]
        ext = filename.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in filename else ""
        if ext not in allowed:
            frappe.throw(_(f"File type .{ext} not allowed. Allowed: {', '.join(allowed)}"), frappe.ValidationError)


def _update_attached_field(cfg, doc_name: str, file_doc):
    if not cfg.attached_to_field:
        return
    try:
        doc = frappe.get_doc(cfg.primary_doctype, doc_name)
        doc.set(cfg.attached_to_field, file_doc.file_url)
        doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass


# ===========================================================================
# PUT / PATCH handler
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_put_patch(cfg, method: str):
    if method == "PUT" and not cfg.enable_put:
        frappe.throw(_("PUT not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)
    if method == "PATCH" and not cfg.enable_patch:
        frappe.throw(_("PATCH not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)

    # Attachment patch (replace)
    if frappe.form_dict.get("_attachment_upload") == "1":
        return _handle_attachment_upload(cfg)

    # Bulk patch
    if frappe.form_dict.get("_bulk") == "1":
        return _handle_bulk_patch(cfg)

    body = _get_request_body()
    body = _sanitize_body(cfg, body)
    body = _coerce_types(cfg, body)
    body = _apply_enum_map_request(cfg, body)
    _validate_json_schema(cfg, body)
    _validate_cross_field(cfg, body)

    key_field = cfg.put_key_field or "name"
    record_id = body.get(key_field) or frappe.form_dict.get(key_field)
    if not record_id:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Key field '{key_field}' is required for update"), frappe.ValidationError)

    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    try:
        doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, record_id)
    except frappe.DoesNotExistError:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Record '{record_id}' not found"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

    body = _run_custom_logic_write(cfg, body, method)
    for field, value in body.items():
        if field not in (key_field, "doctype"):
            doc.set(field, value)

    doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, method)
    _trigger_push_notification(cfg, doc, method)

    return {"success": True, "name": doc.name, "data": doc.as_dict()}


def _handle_bulk_patch(cfg):
    body = _get_request_body()
    if not isinstance(body, list):
        frappe.throw(_("Bulk PATCH requires a JSON array body"), frappe.ValidationError)
    key_field = cfg.put_key_field or "name"
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    success, failed = [], []
    for item in body:
        record_id = item.get(key_field)
        if not record_id:
            failed.append({"data": item, "error": f"Missing key field: {key_field}"})
            continue
        try:
            doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, record_id)
            for field, value in item.items():
                if field not in (key_field, "doctype"):
                    doc.set(field, value)
            doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            success.append(doc.name)
        except Exception as e:
            failed.append({"data": item, "error": str(e)})
    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    return {"success": success, "failed": failed, "total": len(body), "updated": len(success)}


# ===========================================================================
# DELETE handler
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_delete(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_delete:
        frappe.throw(_("DELETE not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)

    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    if not name:
        frappe.throw(_("?name= required for DELETE"), frappe.ValidationError)

    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    try:
        doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, name)
    except frappe.DoesNotExistError:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Record '{name}' not found"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

    delete_mode = cfg.delete_mode or "Soft Delete"
    if delete_mode == "Hard Delete":
        frappe.delete_doc(target_doctype, name, ignore_permissions=True)
    else:
        soft_field = cfg.soft_delete_field or "disabled"
        soft_value = cfg.soft_delete_value or "1"
        doc.set(soft_field, soft_value)
        doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, "DELETE")
    return {"success": True, "name": name, "mode": delete_mode}


# ===========================================================================
# Doc action handlers
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_doc_action(cfg, action: str):
    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    if not name:
        frappe.throw(_(f"?name= required for {action}"), frappe.ValidationError)
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, name)

    if action == "submit":
        if not cfg.enable_put and not cfg.enable_patch:
            frappe.throw(_("Write access not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.PermissionError)
        doc.submit()
    elif action == "cancel":
        doc.cancel()
    elif action == "amend":
        amended = frappe.copy_doc(doc)
        amended.amended_from = doc.name
        amended.docstatus = 0
        amended.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"success": True, "amended_from": doc.name, "name": amended.name}

    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    return {"success": True, "name": doc.name, "docstatus": doc.docstatus}


def _handle_workflow(cfg):
    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    transition = frappe.form_dict.get("transition")
    if not name or not transition:
        frappe.throw(_("?name= and ?transition= required for workflow action"), frappe.ValidationError)
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    from frappe.model.workflow import apply_workflow
    doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, name)
    apply_workflow(doc, transition)
    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    return {"success": True, "name": doc.name, "workflow_state": doc.workflow_state}


def _handle_custom_method(cfg):
    method_name = frappe.form_dict.get("_method_name")
    name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
    if not method_name or not name:
        frappe.throw(_("?_method_name= and ?name= required"), frappe.ValidationError)

    allowed = [m.strip() for m in (getattr(cfg, "allowed_custom_methods", "") or "").split(",") if m.strip()]
    if allowed and method_name not in allowed:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Method '{method_name}' not in allowed_methods whitelist"), frappe.PermissionError)

    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, name)
    if not hasattr(doc, method_name):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Method '{method_name}' not found on {target_doctype}"), frappe.ValidationError)
    result = getattr(doc, method_name)()
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"success": True, "result": result}


def _handle_erasure(cfg):
    """Right-to-erasure: anonymize all records matching identity_field=value."""
    identity_field = frappe.form_dict.get("identity_field")
    identity_value = frappe.form_dict.get("value")
    if not identity_field or not identity_value:
        frappe.throw(_("?identity_field= and ?value= required for erasure"), frappe.ValidationError)
    if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Authentication required for erasure"), frappe.AuthenticationError)

    target_doctype = cfg.primary_doctype
    records = frappe.get_all(target_doctype, filters={identity_field: identity_value}, pluck="name")
    erased_hash = hashlib.sha256(identity_value.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    erased = []
    for rec_name in records:
        try:
            doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, rec_name)
            doc.set(identity_field, f"ERASED-{erased_hash}")
            doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            erased.append(rec_name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Webhook Log",
        "webhook_name": f"Erasure: {cfg.endpoint_slug}",
        "request_method": "ERASE",
        "status": "Success",
        "request_headers": json.dumps({"user": frappe.session.user, "identity_field": identity_field, "records_erased": len(erased)}),
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"erased": erased, "count": len(erased)}


# ===========================================================================
# JWT token issuance
# ===========================================================================
def _issue_jwt(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_jwt:
        frappe.throw(_("JWT not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)
    if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Authentication required to issue JWT"), frappe.AuthenticationError)

    try:
        import jwt as pyjwt
    except ImportError:
        frappe.throw(_("PyJWT not installed. Run: pip install PyJWT"), frappe.ValidationError)

    expiry = cfg.jwt_expiry_minutes or 60
    payload = {
        "sub": frappe.session.user,
        "endpoint": cfg.endpoint_slug,
        "roles": frappe.get_roles(frappe.session.user),
        "iat": int(time.time()),
        "exp": int(time.time()) + expiry * 60,
    }
    secret = frappe.conf.get("fb_jwt_secret", frappe.conf.get("secret_key", "fb_secret"))
    token = pyjwt.encode(payload, secret, algorithm="HS256")
    return {"access_token": token, "expires_in": expiry * 60, "token_type": "Bearer"}


# ===========================================================================
# Flow triggers
# ===========================================================================
def _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, method: str):
    flow_link = None
    if method == "POST" and cfg.on_create_flow:
        flow_link = cfg.on_create_flow
    elif method in ("PUT", "PATCH") and cfg.on_update_flow:
        flow_link = cfg.on_update_flow
    elif method == "DELETE" and cfg.on_update_flow:
        flow_link = cfg.on_update_flow
    if flow_link:
        try:
            frappe.enqueue(
                "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.run_flow",
                flow_name=flow_link,
                payload=doc.as_dict() if hasattr(doc, "as_dict") else {},
                queue="short",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    if cfg.post_chain_endpoint:
        try:
            frappe.enqueue(
                "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder._run_chained_endpoint",
                chained_slug=cfg.post_chain_endpoint,
                doc_dict=doc.as_dict() if hasattr(doc, "as_dict") else {},
                queue="short",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    _notify_webhook(cfg, method, doc)


def _trigger_read_flow(cfg):
    if not cfg.on_read_flow:
        return
    mode = cfg.on_read_flow_mode or "Every Call"
    if mode == "Every Call":
        try:
            frappe.enqueue(
                "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.run_flow",
                flow_name=cfg.on_read_flow,
                payload={"endpoint": cfg.endpoint_slug, "params": dict(frappe.form_dict)},
                queue="short",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass


def _notify_webhook(cfg, method: str, doc):
    if not cfg.notify_webhook_url:
        return
    notify_on = [m.strip().upper() for m in (cfg.notify_on or "").split(",") if m.strip()]
    if notify_on and method not in notify_on:
        return
    try:
        frappe.enqueue(
            "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder._send_webhook_notification",
            url=cfg.notify_webhook_url,
            method=method,
            endpoint=cfg.endpoint_slug,
            doc_name=getattr(doc, "name", ""),
            queue="short",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


def _send_webhook_notification(url: str, method: str, endpoint: str, doc_name: str):
    import requests
    try:
        requests.post(url, json={"method": method, "endpoint": endpoint, "name": doc_name}, timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _run_chained_endpoint(chained_slug: str, doc_dict: dict):
    pass  # chain resolved in custom_logic via results context


def _trigger_push_notification(cfg, doc, method: str):
    if not cfg.enable_push_notify or not cfg.push_notify_roles:
        return
    try:
        frappe.enqueue(
            "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder._send_push_notifications",
            roles=cfg.push_notify_roles,
            template=cfg.push_message_template or f"Record updated: {getattr(doc, 'name', '')}",
            doc_dict=doc.as_dict() if hasattr(doc, "as_dict") else {},
            queue="short",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


def _send_push_notifications(roles: str, template: str, doc_dict: dict):
    role_list = [r.strip() for r in roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
    users = set()
    for role in role_list:
        members = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"role": role, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="parent")
        users.update(members)

    devices = frappe.get_all("FB Push Device", filters={"user": ["in", list(users)]},
                              fields=["platform", "device_token", "user"])

    from frappe.utils.jinja import render_template
    try:
        message = render_template(template, {"doc": doc_dict})
    except Exception:
        message = template

    for device in devices:
        try:
            if device.platform == "Android":
                _send_fcm(device.device_token, message)
            elif device.platform == "iOS":
                _send_apns(device.device_token, message)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _send_fcm(token: str, message: str):
    fcm_key = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "fcm_server_key") or ""
    if not fcm_key:
        return
    import requests
    requests.post(
        "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send",
        json={"to": token, "notification": {"body": message, "title": "FlowBridge"}},
        headers={"Authorization": f"key={fcm_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        timeout=10,
    )


def _send_apns(token: str, message: str):
    pass  # APNs requires async HTTP/2 — integrate via apns2 library


# ===========================================================================
# Field / filter helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _resolve_fields(cfg) -> list:
    mode = cfg.fields_mode or "All Fields"
    if mode == "All Fields":
        return ["*"]
    if mode == "Selected Fields":
        selected = [r.fieldname for r in cfg.selected_fields if r.fieldname and r.include]
        return selected or ["*"]
    if mode == "All Fields Except":
        excluded = {r.fieldname for r in cfg.selected_fields if r.fieldname}
        meta = frappe.get_meta(cfg.primary_doctype)
        return [f.fieldname for f in meta.fields
                if f.fieldname not in excluded
                and f.fieldtype not in ("Section Break", "Column Break", "HTML", "Button")]
    return ["*"]


def _sparse_fields(cfg, base_fields: list) -> list:
    """?fields= override for sparse fieldsets."""
    raw = frappe.form_dict.get("fields", "")
    if not raw:
        return base_fields
    requested = [f.strip() for f in raw.split(",") if f.strip()]
    if base_fields == ["*"]:
        return requested
    allowed = set(base_fields)
    return [f for f in requested if f in allowed] or base_fields


def _apply_label_overrides(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    overrides = {r.fieldname: r.label_override for r in cfg.selected_fields if r.label_override}
    if not overrides:
        return row
    return {overrides.get(k, k): v for k, v in row.items()}


def _apply_label_overrides_list(cfg, results: list) -> list:
    overrides = {r.fieldname: r.label_override for r in cfg.selected_fields if r.label_override}
    if not overrides:
        return results
    return [{overrides.get(k, k): v for k, v in row.items()} for row in results]


def _build_filters(cfg) -> list:
    filters = []

    # Owner filter — record-level permission
    if cfg.owner_filter and frappe.session.user != "Guest":
        filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, "owner", "=", frappe.session.user])

    # Role scope
    scope = getattr(frappe.local, "_fb_scope", None)
    if scope == "Own":
        filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, "owner", "=", frappe.session.user])
    elif scope == "None":
        frappe.throw(_("You do not have access to any records"), frappe.PermissionError)

    # Default filters from child table
    for f in cfg.default_filters:
        value = f.value or ""
        if value.startswith("{") and value.endswith("}"):
            param_name = value[1:-1]
            value = frappe.form_dict.get(param_name, value)
        if f.allow_override:
            override_val = frappe.form_dict.get(f.fieldname)
            if override_val is not None:
                value = override_val
        filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, f.fieldname, f.operator, value])

    # Dynamic filters from ?filters={...}
    raw = frappe.form_dict.get("filters")
    if raw:
        try:
            dyn = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw
            locked = {f.fieldname for f in cfg.default_filters if not f.allow_override}
            if isinstance(dyn, dict):
                for k, v in dyn.items():
                    if k not in locked:
                        filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, k, "=", v])
            elif isinstance(dyn, list):
                for item in dyn:
                    if len(item) >= 3:
                        filters.append(item)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return filters


def _parse_facet_filters(cfg) -> list:
    """Parse ?filter[field][]=Value style multi-select facet filters."""
    filters = []
    if not hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
        return filters
    from urllib.parse import parse_qs
    qs = frappe.local.request.query_string.decode() if frappe.local.request.query_string else ""
    parsed = parse_qs(qs)
    for key, values in parsed.items():
        m = re.match(r"^filter\[(.+?)\]\[\]$", key)
        if m:
            field = m.group(1)
            if len(values) == 1:
                filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, field, "=", values[0]])
            else:
                filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, field, "in", values])
    return filters


def _parse_range_filters(cfg) -> list:
    """Parse ?range[field][min]=X&range[field][max]=Y filters."""
    filters = []
    if not hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
        return filters
    from urllib.parse import parse_qs
    qs = frappe.local.request.query_string.decode() if frappe.local.request.query_string else ""
    parsed = parse_qs(qs)
    range_data = {}
    for key, values in parsed.items():
        m = re.match(r"^range\[(.+?)\]\[(min|max|from|to)\]$", key)
        if m:
            field, bound = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            range_data.setdefault(field, {})[bound] = values[0]
    for field, bounds in range_data.items():
        lo = bounds.get("min") or bounds.get("from")
        hi = bounds.get("max") or bounds.get("to")
        if lo:
            filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, field, ">=", lo])
        if hi:
            filters.append([cfg.primary_doctype, field, "<=", hi])
    return filters


def _compute_facet(cfg, field: str, base_filters: list) -> dict:
    filter_str, filter_vals = _filters_to_sql(cfg.primary_doctype, base_filters)
    try:
        rows = frappe.db.sql(
            f"SELECT `{field}`, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `tab{cfg.primary_doctype}` {filter_str} GROUP BY `{field}` ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 50",
            filter_vals, as_dict=True,
        )
        return {r[field]: r["cnt"] for r in rows if r.get(field) is not None}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _filters_to_sql(doctype: str, filters: list):
    """Convert frappe-style filter list to a minimal WHERE clause for raw SQL."""
    if not filters:
        return "", []
    clauses, vals = [], []
    for f in filters:
        if len(f) >= 4:
            _, field, op, value = f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]
            if op.lower() == "in" and isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
                placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(value))
                clauses.append(f"`{field}` IN ({placeholders})")
                vals.extend(value)
            else:
                clauses.append(f"`{field}` {op} %s")
                vals.append(value)
    return "WHERE " + " AND ".join(clauses) if clauses else ("", [])


# ===========================================================================
# Deep join resolver (unlimited depth, DataLoader pattern)
# ===========================================================================
def _resolve_joins_deep(cfg, results: list) -> list:
    if not cfg.joined_doctypes or not results:
        return results

    visited_types = set()

    def _resolve_level(rows: list, join_configs, depth: int = 0):
        if not rows or not join_configs:
            return rows

        for join_cfg in join_configs:
            jdt = join_cfg.join_doctype
            join_type = join_cfg.join_type
            link_field = join_cfg.link_field
            parent_key = join_cfg.parent_key or "name"
            alias = join_cfg.alias or jdt.lower().replace(" ", "_")
            jfields = [f.strip() for f in (join_cfg.selected_fields or "").split(",") if f.strip()] or ["*"]
            prefix = join_cfg.field_prefix or ""

            # Circular reference guard
            type_key = (jdt, link_field, join_type)
            if type_key in visited_types:
                continue
            visited_types.add(type_key)

            # Collect all parent keys for batch fetch (DataLoader pattern)
            pk_vals = list({row.get(parent_key) for row in rows if row.get(parent_key)})
            if not pk_vals:
                for row in rows:
                    row[alias] = [] if join_type in ("Child Table", "Linked List") else None
                continue

            try:
                if join_type == "Child Table":
                    all_children = frappe.get_all(
                        jdt,
                        filters={"parent": ["in", pk_vals], "parentfield": link_field},
                        fields=jfields,
                    )
                    child_map = {}
                    for c in all_children:
                        child_map.setdefault(c.get("parent"), []).append(dict(c))
                    for row in rows:
                        children = child_map.get(row.get(parent_key), [])
                        if prefix:
                            children = [{f"{prefix}{k}": v for k, v in c.items()} for c in children]
                        row[alias] = children

                elif join_type == "Linked List":
                    all_linked = frappe.get_all(
                        jdt,
                        filters={link_field: ["in", pk_vals]},
                        fields=jfields,
                    )
                    linked_map = {}
                    for l in all_linked:
                        linked_map.setdefault(l.get(link_field), []).append(dict(l))
                    for row in rows:
                        items = linked_map.get(row.get(parent_key), [])
                        if prefix:
                            items = [{f"{prefix}{k}": v for k, v in i.items()} for i in items]
                        row[alias] = items

                elif join_type == "Linked Doc":
                    link_vals = list({row.get(link_field) for row in rows if row.get(link_field)})
                    if link_vals:
                        all_docs = frappe.get_all(jdt, filters={"name": ["in", link_vals]}, fields=jfields)
                        doc_map = {d["name"]: dict(d) for d in all_docs}
                    else:
                        doc_map = {}
                    for row in rows:
                        linked_name = row.get(link_field)
                        doc_data = doc_map.get(linked_name)
                        if doc_data and prefix:
                            doc_data = {f"{prefix}{k}": v for k, v in doc_data.items()}
                        row[alias] = doc_data

            except Exception:
                for row in rows:
                    row[alias] = [] if join_type in ("Child Table", "Linked List") else None

            # Recurse into sub_joins (unlimited depth)
            if join_cfg.sub_joins_json:
                try:
                    sub_join_defs = json.loads(join_cfg.sub_joins_json)
                    sub_join_cfgs = [_SubJoinConfig(s) for s in sub_join_defs]
                    child_rows = []
                    for row in rows:
                        val = row.get(alias)
                        if isinstance(val, list):
                            child_rows.extend(val)
                        elif isinstance(val, dict):
                            child_rows.append(val)
                    if child_rows:
                        _resolve_level(child_rows, sub_join_cfgs, depth + 1)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return rows

    return _resolve_level(results, cfg.joined_doctypes)


class _SubJoinConfig:
    """Lightweight stand-in for a Join child table row from sub_joins_json."""
    def __init__(self, d: dict):
        self.join_doctype = d.get("join_doctype", "")
        self.join_type = d.get("join_type", "Linked Doc")
        self.link_field = d.get("link_field", "")
        self.parent_key = d.get("parent_key", "name")
        self.alias = d.get("alias", "")
        self.selected_fields = d.get("selected_fields", "*")
        self.field_prefix = d.get("field_prefix", "")
        self.sub_joins_json = d.get("sub_joins_json", "")


# ===========================================================================
# Computed fields
# ===========================================================================
def _apply_computed_fields(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    for cf in cfg.computed_fields:
        try:
            local_ns = {**_SAFE_BUILTINS, "row": row, "doc": row}
            row[cf.field_name] = eval(cf.expression, {"__builtins__": {}}, local_ns)  # noqa: S307
        except Exception:
            action = cf.on_error or "Return None"
            if action == "Return None":
                row[cf.field_name] = None
            elif action == "Return 0":
                row[cf.field_name] = 0
            elif action == "Return Empty String":
                row[cf.field_name] = ""
    return row


# ===========================================================================
# Custom logic
# ===========================================================================
def _run_custom_logic_list(cfg, results: list) -> list:
    if not cfg.custom_logic:
        return results
    try:
        # 18.28 — use pre-compiled bytecode if available
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.cache_perf import get_compiled_logic, exec_compiled
        code = get_compiled_logic(cfg) or cfg.custom_logic
        ns = {**_EXEC_BUILTINS, "results": results, "request_data": dict(frappe.form_dict), "frappe": frappe}
        if isinstance(code, str):
            exec(code, ns)  # noqa: S102
        else:
            exec_compiled(code, ns)
        return ns.get("results", results)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "FB API Endpoint Custom Logic Error")
        return results


def _run_custom_logic_single(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    if not cfg.custom_logic:
        return row
    try:
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.cache_perf import get_compiled_logic, exec_compiled
        code = get_compiled_logic(cfg) or cfg.custom_logic
        ns = {**_EXEC_BUILTINS, "doc": row, "request_data": dict(frappe.form_dict), "frappe": frappe}
        if isinstance(code, str):
            exec(code, ns)  # noqa: S102
        else:
            exec_compiled(code, ns)
        return ns.get("doc", row)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "FB API Endpoint Custom Logic Error")
        return row


def _run_custom_logic_write(cfg, body: dict, method: str) -> dict:
    if not cfg.custom_logic:
        return body
    try:
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.cache_perf import get_compiled_logic, exec_compiled
        code = get_compiled_logic(cfg) or cfg.custom_logic
        ns = {**_EXEC_BUILTINS, "body": body, "method": method, "request_data": dict(frappe.form_dict), "frappe": frappe}
        if isinstance(code, str):
            exec(code, ns)  # noqa: S102
        else:
            exec_compiled(code, ns)
        return ns.get("body", body)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "FB API Endpoint Custom Logic Error")
        return body


# ===========================================================================
# Request body + sanitization
# ===========================================================================
def _get_request_body() -> dict:
    try:
        if hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
            raw = frappe.local.request.get_data(as_text=True)
            if raw:
                return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {k: v for k, v in frappe.form_dict.items() if k not in ("endpoint", "_method", "cmd")}


def _sanitize_body(cfg, body):
    if not cfg.sanitize_request:
        return body
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return body

    def _clean(v):
        if isinstance(v, str):
            v = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", v)
            v = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", v).strip()
        return v

    return {k: _clean(v) for k, v in body.items()}


def _coerce_types(cfg, body):
    if not cfg.auto_coerce or not isinstance(body, dict):
        return body
    result = {}
    for k, v in body.items():
        if isinstance(v, str):
            if v.lower() == "true":
                v = True
            elif v.lower() == "false":
                v = False
            else:
                try:
                    v = int(v)
                except ValueError:
                    try:
                        v = float(v)
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
        result[k] = v
    return result


def _validate_json_schema(cfg, body: dict):
    if not cfg.request_schema:
        return
    try:
        import jsonschema
        schema = json.loads(cfg.request_schema)
        errors = list(jsonschema.Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(body))
        if errors:
            msgs = [f"{e.path}: {e.message}" if e.path else e.message for e in errors]
            frappe.throw(_("Validation failed: " + "; ".join(msgs)), frappe.ValidationError)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    except frappe.ValidationError:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "FB API Endpoint Schema Validation Error")


def _validate_cross_field(cfg, body: dict):
    if not hasattr(cfg, "validation_rules") or not cfg.validation_rules:
        return
    for rule in cfg.validation_rules:
        try:
            cond = eval(rule.condition_expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, {**_SAFE_BUILTINS, "body": body})  # noqa: S307
            if cond:
                result = eval(rule.assert_expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, {**_SAFE_BUILTINS, "body": body})  # noqa: S307
                if not result:
                    frappe.throw(_(rule.error_message or "Validation failed"), frappe.ValidationError)
        except frappe.ValidationError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            pass


# ===========================================================================
# Response transformation
# ===========================================================================
def _mask_fields(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    if not cfg.pii_mask_fields:
        return row
    masked = {f.strip() for f in cfg.pii_mask_fields.split(",") if f.strip()}
    return {k: ("***" if k in masked else v) for k, v in row.items()}


def _apply_null_policy(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    policy = cfg.null_policy or "Keep"
    if policy == "Keep":
        return row
    if policy == "Omit":
        return {k: v for k, v in row.items() if v is not None}
    if policy == "Replace with default":
        return {k: (v if v is not None else "") for k, v in row.items()}
    return row


def _apply_date_format(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    fmt = cfg.date_format or "YYYY-MM-DD"
    if fmt == "YYYY-MM-DD":
        return row

    fmt_map = {
        "DD-MM-YYYY": "%d-%m-%Y",
        "MM/DD/YYYY": "%m/%d/%Y",
        "ISO 8601": None,  # keep as-is (Frappe already ISO)
    }
    py_fmt = fmt_map.get(fmt)
    if not py_fmt:
        return row

    result = {}
    for k, v in row.items():
        if isinstance(v, (date, datetime)):
            try:
                result[k] = v.strftime(py_fmt)
            except Exception:
                result[k] = v
        elif isinstance(v, str) and len(v) == 10 and v[4] == "-":
            try:
                result[k] = datetime.strptime(v, "%Y-%m-%d").strftime(py_fmt)
            except Exception:
                result[k] = v
        else:
            result[k] = v
    return result


def _apply_mobile_mode(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    if frappe.form_dict.get("_mobile") != "1":
        return row
    max_chars = cfg.mobile_text_truncate_chars or 500
    audit_fields = {"creation", "modified", "modified_by", "owner", "idx", "docstatus"}
    result = {}
    for k, v in row.items():
        if k in audit_fields:
            continue
        if v is None or v == "" or v == []:
            continue
        if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > max_chars:
            v = v[:max_chars] + "…"
        result[k] = v
    return result


# ===========================================================================
# CORS helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _cors_response(cfg):
    _add_cors_headers(cfg)
    return {}


def _add_cors_headers(cfg):
    if not cfg.cors_origins:
        return
    origins = cfg.cors_origins
    if hasattr(frappe.local, "response"):
        frappe.local.response["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origins
        frappe.local.response["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS"
        frappe.local.response["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] = "Content-Type, Authorization, X-FB-API-Key, X-FB-Signature, X-FB-Timestamp"


# ===========================================================================
# IP helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _get_client_ip() -> str:
    if not hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
        return "127.0.0.1"
    xff = frappe.local.request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For", "")
    if xff:
        return xff.split(",")[0].strip()
    return frappe.local.request.remote_addr or "127.0.0.1"


def _ip_matches(client_ip: str, entry: str) -> bool:
    if "/" in entry:
        try:
            import ipaddress
            return ipaddress.ip_address(client_ip) in ipaddress.ip_network(entry, strict=False)
        except Exception:
            return False
    return client_ip == entry

def _audit_log(cfg, method: str, slug: str, elapsed: float):
    try:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB Webhook Log",
            "webhook_name": f"API Endpoint: {slug}",
            "request_method": method,
            "status": "Success",
            "request_headers": json.dumps({"user": frappe.session.user}),
            "response_time_ms": round(elapsed * 1000, 2),
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass
