@frappe.whitelist()
def list_endpoints():
    endpoints = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Endpoint",
        filters={"is_active": 1},
        fields=["endpoint_name", "endpoint_slug", "endpoint_url", "primary_doctype",
                "enable_get", "enable_post", "enable_put", "enable_patch", "enable_delete",
                "lifecycle_state", "fields_mode", "get_mode"],
        order_by="endpoint_name asc",
    )
    return {"endpoints": endpoints}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_endpoint_schema(slug: str):
    cfg = _load_config(slug)
    meta = frappe.get_meta(cfg.primary_doctype)

    if cfg.fields_mode == "Selected Fields":
        field_names = {r.fieldname for r in cfg.selected_fields if r.include}
    elif cfg.fields_mode == "All Fields Except":
        excluded = {r.fieldname for r in cfg.selected_fields}
        field_names = {f.fieldname for f in meta.fields if f.fieldname not in excluded}
    else:
        field_names = {f.fieldname for f in meta.fields}

    schema = []
    for f in meta.fields:
        if f.fieldname in field_names:
            schema.append({
                "fieldname": f.fieldname,
                "label": f.label,
                "fieldtype": f.fieldtype,
                "reqd": f.reqd,
                "options": f.options,
            })

    for cf in cfg.computed_fields:
        schema.append({
            "fieldname": cf.field_name,
            "label": getattr(cf, "label", cf.field_name),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "reqd": 0,
            "computed": True,
        })

    return {
        "endpoint": slug,
        "doctype": cfg.primary_doctype,
        "api_version": cfg.api_version or "v1",
        "lifecycle_state": cfg.lifecycle_state,
        "methods": {
            "GET": bool(cfg.enable_get),
            "POST": bool(cfg.enable_post),
            "PUT": bool(cfg.enable_put),
            "PATCH": bool(cfg.enable_patch),
            "DELETE": bool(cfg.enable_delete),
        },
        "fields": schema,
        "auth_required": bool(cfg.auth_required),
        "rate_limit_rpm": cfg.rate_limit_rpm,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": cfg.cache_ttl_seconds,
        "features": {
            "search": bool(cfg.enable_search),
            "pagination": bool(cfg.enable_pagination),
            "csv_export": bool(cfg.allow_csv_export),
            "xlsx_export": bool(cfg.allow_xlsx_export),
            "attachments": bool(cfg.enable_attachments),
            "jwt": bool(cfg.enable_jwt),
            "bulk": True,
            "hierarchy": bool(cfg.hierarchy_mode),
        },
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_openapi_spec(slug: str):
    """Generate OpenAPI 3.0 spec for a single endpoint."""
    cfg = _load_config(slug)
    schema_info = get_endpoint_schema(slug)

    properties = {f["fieldname"]: {"type": "string", "title": f["label"]} for f in schema_info["fields"]}
    required_fields = [f["fieldname"] for f in schema_info["fields"] if f.get("reqd")]

    base_url = frappe.utils.get_url()
    path = f"/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.handle?endpoint={slug}"

    paths = {}
    if cfg.enable_get:
        paths[path] = {"get": {
            "summary": f"GET {cfg.endpoint_name}",
            "parameters": [
                {"name": "name", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
                {"name": "page", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "integer"}},
                {"name": "limit", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "integer"}},
                {"name": "search", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
                {"name": "fields", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
                {"name": "export", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "string", "enum": ["csv", "xlsx"]}},
            ],
            "responses": {"200": {"description": "Success"}},
        }}

    if cfg.enable_post:
        paths.setdefault(path, {})["post"] = {
            "summary": f"POST {cfg.endpoint_name}",
            "requestBody": {"content": {"application/json": {"schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": properties,
                "required": required_fields,
            }}}},
            "responses": {"200": {"description": "Created"}},
        }

    return {
        "openapi": "3.0.0",
        "info": {"title": cfg.endpoint_name, "version": cfg.api_version or "v1"},
        "servers": [{"url": base_url}],
        "paths": paths,
        "components": {"schemas": {cfg.primary_doctype.replace(" ", ""): {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": properties,
        }}},
    }


# ===========================================================================
# Health tracking (16.20)
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_health(cfg):
    if not cfg.enable_health_tracking:
        frappe.throw(_("Health tracking not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)

    key = f"fb:health:{cfg.endpoint_slug}"
    try:
        raw = frappe.cache().get(key)
        stats = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except Exception:
        stats = {}

    # Probe DB latency
    db_ok = True
    db_latency_ms = 0.0
    try:
        t_db = time.time()
        frappe.db.count(cfg.primary_doctype)
        db_latency_ms = round((time.time() - t_db) * 1000, 2)
    except Exception:
        db_ok = False

    # Probe Redis latency
    redis_ok = True
    redis_latency_ms = 0.0
    try:
        t_redis = time.time()
        frappe.cache().ping()
        redis_latency_ms = round((time.time() - t_redis) * 1000, 2)
    except Exception:
        redis_ok = False

    return {
        "status": "healthy" if db_ok else "degraded",
        "endpoint": cfg.endpoint_slug,
        "db_ok": db_ok,
        "db_latency_ms": db_latency_ms,
        "redis_ok": redis_ok,
        "redis_latency_ms": redis_latency_ms,
        "last_success": stats.get("last_success"),
        "avg_latency_ms": stats.get("avg_latency_ms"),
        "error_rate_1h": stats.get("error_rate_1h", 0),
        "calls_1h": stats.get("calls_1h", 0),
    }


def _update_health_stats(slug: str, elapsed_ms: float, is_error: bool = False):
    """Update rolling health stats in Redis after each request."""
    try:
        r = frappe.cache()
        key = f"fb:health:{slug}"
        raw = r.get(key)
        stats = json.loads(raw) if raw else {"calls_1h": 0, "errors_1h": 0, "total_latency_ms": 0.0}

        stats["calls_1h"] = stats.get("calls_1h", 0) + 1
        if is_error:
            stats["errors_1h"] = stats.get("errors_1h", 0) + 1
        stats["total_latency_ms"] = stats.get("total_latency_ms", 0.0) + elapsed_ms
        stats["avg_latency_ms"] = round(stats["total_latency_ms"] / stats["calls_1h"], 2)
        stats["error_rate_1h"] = round(stats["errors_1h"] / stats["calls_1h"] * 100, 2)
        if not is_error:
            stats["last_success"] = frappe.utils.now()

        r.setex(key, 3600, json.dumps(stats))
    except Exception:
        pass


# ===========================================================================
# Enum / value mapping (16.71)
# ===========================================================================
def _apply_enum_map_response(cfg, row: dict) -> dict:
    """Translate internal Frappe values → external API values in response."""
    if not hasattr(cfg, "enum_maps") or not cfg.enum_maps:
        return row
    mapping = {}
    for em in cfg.enum_maps:
        if em.apply_on in ("Both", "Response Only"):
            mapping.setdefault(em.fieldname, {})[em.internal_value] = em.external_value
    if not mapping:
        return row
    result = {}
    for k, v in row.items():
        if k in mapping and isinstance(v, str) and v in mapping[k]:
            result[k] = mapping[k][v]
        else:
            result[k] = v
    return result


def _apply_enum_map_request(cfg, body: dict) -> dict:
    """Translate external API values → internal Frappe values in request body."""
    if not hasattr(cfg, "enum_maps") or not cfg.enum_maps:
        return body
    mapping = {}
    for em in cfg.enum_maps:
        if em.apply_on in ("Both", "Request Only"):
            mapping.setdefault(em.fieldname, {})[em.external_value] = em.internal_value
    if not mapping:
        return body
    result = {}
    for k, v in body.items():
        if k in mapping and isinstance(v, str) and v in mapping[k]:
            result[k] = mapping[k][v]
        else:
            result[k] = v
    return result


# ===========================================================================
# CDN-friendly HTTP headers (16.79)
# ===========================================================================
def _add_cdn_headers(cfg, data):
    """Add Cache-Control, ETag, Last-Modified headers for CDN caching."""
    if not cfg.cache_ttl_seconds or not hasattr(frappe.local, "response"):
        return

    scope = cfg.cache_scope or "Global"
    if scope == "Global":
        cache_control = f"public, max-age={cfg.cache_ttl_seconds}, s-maxage={cfg.cache_ttl_seconds}"
    else:
        cache_control = f"private, max-age={cfg.cache_ttl_seconds}"

    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_perf_hardening import _xxhash64
    etag = '"' + _xxhash64(json.dumps(data, default=str)) + '"'

    if hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
        if_none_match = frappe.local.request.headers.get("If-None-Match", "")
        if if_none_match and if_none_match == etag:
            frappe.local.response["http_status_code"] = 304
            return

    try:
        frappe.local.response["Cache-Control"] = cache_control
        frappe.local.response["ETag"] = etag
        frappe.local.response["Vary"] = "Accept-Encoding, Authorization"
    except Exception:
        pass


# ===========================================================================
# Thumbnail generation (16.55)
# ===========================================================================
def _generate_thumbnail(file_doc):
    """Generate 200×200 webp thumbnail for image uploads. Requires Pillow."""
    try:
        import mimetypes
        ct = mimetypes.guess_type(file_doc.file_name)[0] or ""
        if not ct.startswith("image/"):
            return None
        try:
            from PIL import Image  # noqa: PLC0415
        except ImportError:
            return None
        import io as _io
        file_path = frappe.get_site_path(
            "private" if file_doc.is_private else "public",
            "files", file_doc.file_name,
        )
        with Image.open(file_path) as img:
            img.thumbnail((200, 200))
            buf = _io.BytesIO()
            img.save(buf, format="WEBP", quality=80)
            buf.seek(0)
            thumb_name = file_doc.file_name.rsplit(".", 1)[0] + "_thumb.webp"
            thumb_doc = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "File",
                "file_name": thumb_name,
                "attached_to_doctype": file_doc.attached_to_doctype,
                "attached_to_name": file_doc.attached_to_name,
                "content": buf.read(),
                "is_private": file_doc.is_private,
            })
            thumb_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            return thumb_doc.file_url
    except Exception:
        return None


# ===========================================================================
# DELETE attachment (16.54)
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_delete_attachment(cfg):
    """DELETE ?_delete_attachment=FILE-NAME — validates ownership before deleting."""
    if not cfg.enable_attachments:
        frappe.throw(_("Attachments not enabled"), frappe.ValidationError)
    file_name = frappe.form_dict.get("_delete_attachment")
    if not file_name:
        frappe.throw(_("?_delete_attachment= required"), frappe.ValidationError)

    files = frappe.get_all(
        "File",
        filters={"name": file_name, "attached_to_doctype": cfg.primary_doctype},
        fields=["name", "file_name", "is_private"],
        limit=1,
    )
    if not files:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Attachment '{file_name}' not found on this endpoint's doctype"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

    frappe.delete_doc("File", file_name, ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"success": True, "deleted": file_name}


# ===========================================================================
# Bulk submit / cancel (16.67)
# ===========================================================================
def _handle_bulk_doc_action(cfg, action: str):
    body = _get_request_body()
    names = body if isinstance(body, list) else frappe.form_dict.get("names", "").split(",")
    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    success, failed = [], []
    for name in names:
        name = str(name).strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        try:
            doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, name)
            if action == "submit":
                doc.submit()
            elif action == "cancel":
                doc.cancel()
            success.append(name)
        except Exception as e:
            failed.append({"name": name, "error": str(e)})
    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(cfg.endpoint_slug)
    return {"success": success, "failed": failed, "total": len(names)}


# ===========================================================================
# Scheduler runner (16.16)
# ===========================================================================
@frappe.whitelist()
def run_scheduled_endpoints():
    """Called by Frappe scheduler every minute — fires any endpoint whose cron is due."""
    from datetime import datetime

    if not frappe.db.table_exists("FB API Endpoint"):
        return

    endpoints = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Endpoint",
        filters={"is_active": 1},
        fields=["name", "endpoint_slug"],
    )

    now = datetime.now()

    for ep in endpoints:
        cfg = frappe.get_cached_doc("FB API Endpoint", ep.name)
        if not hasattr(cfg, "endpoint_schedules") or not cfg.endpoint_schedules:
            continue
        for sched in cfg.endpoint_schedules:
            if not sched.is_active or not sched.cron_expression:
                continue
            if not _cron_matches(sched.cron_expression, now):
                continue
            frappe.enqueue(
                "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder._execute_scheduled_endpoint",
                endpoint_name=ep.name,
                schedule_name=sched.schedule_name or sched.cron_expression,
                params_json=sched.params_json or "{}",
                queue="long",
            )


def _execute_scheduled_endpoint(endpoint_name: str, schedule_name: str, params_json: str):
    """Execute a scheduled endpoint and store result in FB API Endpoint Result."""
    t0 = time.time()
    cfg = frappe.get_cached_doc("FB API Endpoint", endpoint_name)
    result_doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB API Endpoint Result",
        "endpoint": endpoint_name,
        "triggered_by": "Scheduler",
        "status": "Running",
    })
    result_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    try:
        params = json.loads(params_json) if params_json else {}
        for k, v in params.items():
            frappe.form_dict[k] = v

        data = _fetch_list(cfg)
        elapsed = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 2)

        frappe.db.set_value("FB API Endpoint Result", result_doc.name, {
            "result_json": json.dumps(data, default=str),
            "status": "Success",
            "execution_time_ms": elapsed,
        })

        frappe.db.set_value("FB API Endpoint Schedule", {"parent": endpoint_name, "schedule_name": schedule_name}, {
            "last_run": frappe.utils.now(),
            "last_status": "Success",
        })
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB API Endpoint Result", result_doc.name, {
            "status": "Error",
            "error_message": str(e),
            "execution_time_ms": round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 2),
        })
    finally:
        frappe.db.commit()


def _cron_matches(cron_expr: str, now) -> bool:
    """Minimal cron matcher: minute hour dom month dow — supports * and exact values."""
    try:
        parts = cron_expr.strip().split()
        if len(parts) != 5:
            return False
        minute, hour, dom, month, dow = parts
        checks = [
            (minute, now.minute),
            (hour, now.hour),
            (dom, now.day),
            (month, now.month),
            (dow, now.weekday()),
        ]
        for pattern, value in checks:
            if pattern == "*":
                continue
            if str(value) != str(pattern):
                return False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


# ===========================================================================
# Inbound webhook → endpoint (16.19)
# ===========================================================================
@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def inbound_webhook(**kwargs):
    """
    POST /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.inbound_webhook
         ?endpoint=<slug>

    Receives an inbound webhook payload, verifies HMAC if configured,
    maps payload fields to DocType fields, and creates/updates a record.
    """
    slug = frappe.form_dict.get("endpoint") or kwargs.get("endpoint")
    if not slug:
        frappe.throw(_("Missing endpoint parameter"), frappe.ValidationError)

    cfg = _load_config(slug)

    if not cfg.enable_inbound_webhook:
        frappe.throw(_("Inbound webhook not enabled for this endpoint"), frappe.ValidationError)

    # HMAC verification
    if cfg.inbound_hmac_secret:
        _verify_inbound_hmac(cfg)

    body = _get_request_body()
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        frappe.throw(_("Inbound webhook body must be a JSON object"), frappe.ValidationError)

    # Apply field mapping
    mapped = _apply_inbound_field_mapping(cfg, body)

    # Sanitize + coerce
    mapped = _sanitize_body(cfg, mapped)
    mapped = _coerce_types(cfg, mapped)
    mapped = _apply_enum_map_request(cfg, mapped)

    target_doctype = cfg.post_doctype or cfg.primary_doctype
    key_field = cfg.put_key_field or "name"

    # Upsert logic: if key field present → update, else create
    if mapped.get(key_field):
        existing = frappe.db.exists(target_doctype, {key_field: mapped[key_field]})
        if existing:
            doc = frappe.get_doc(target_doctype, existing)
            for k, v in mapped.items():
                if k not in (key_field, "doctype"):
                    doc.set(k, v)
            doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            frappe.db.commit()
            invalidate_endpoint_cache(slug)
            _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, "PATCH")
            _log_inbound_result(cfg, "upsert_update", doc.name)
            return {"success": True, "action": "updated", "name": doc.name}

    doc = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": target_doctype, **mapped})
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    invalidate_endpoint_cache(slug)
    _trigger_write_flow(cfg, doc, "POST")
    _log_inbound_result(cfg, "upsert_create", doc.name)
    return {"success": True, "action": "created", "name": doc.name}


def _verify_inbound_hmac(cfg):
    """Verify X-Hub-Signature-256 or X-FB-Signature header against inbound_hmac_secret."""
    if not hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
        return
    req = frappe.local.request
    sig_header = (
        req.headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256", "")
        or req.headers.get("X-FB-Signature", "")
    )
    if not sig_header:
        frappe.throw(_("Missing webhook signature header"), frappe.AuthenticationError)

    body = req.get_data()
    secret = cfg.inbound_hmac_secret
    expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    # Also accept bare hex
    bare_expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    if not (hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig_header) or hmac.compare_digest(bare_expected, sig_header)):
        frappe.throw(_("Invalid webhook signature"), frappe.AuthenticationError)


def _apply_inbound_field_mapping(cfg, payload: dict) -> dict:
    """Map payload keys to DocType fields using inbound_field_mapping JSON config."""
    if not cfg.inbound_field_mapping:
        return payload
    try:
        field_map = json.loads(cfg.inbound_field_mapping)
        result = {}
        for payload_key, doctype_field in field_map.items():
            value = payload
            for part in payload_key.split("."):
                if isinstance(value, dict):
                    value = value.get(part)
                else:
                    value = None
                    break
            if value is not None:
                result[doctype_field] = value
        # Also pass through unmapped fields that don't conflict
        for k, v in payload.items():
            if k not in field_map and k not in result.values():
                result[k] = v
        return result
    except Exception:
        return payload


def _log_inbound_result(cfg, action: str, doc_name: str):
    try:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB API Endpoint Result",
            "endpoint": cfg.name,
            "triggered_by": "Inbound Webhook",
            "status": "Success",
            "result_json": json.dumps({"action": action, "name": doc_name}),
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass


@frappe.whitelist()
def register_push_device(platform: str, device_token: str, device_name: str = ""):
    """Register a device token for push notifications."""
    if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Authentication required"), frappe.AuthenticationError)
    existing = frappe.get_all("FB Push Device",
                               filters={"user": frappe.session.user, "device_token": device_token},
                               pluck="name")
    if existing:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Push Device", existing[0], {
            "platform": platform,
            "device_name": device_name,
            "last_seen": frappe.utils.now(),
        })
    else:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB Push Device",
            "user": frappe.session.user,
            "platform": platform,
            "device_token": device_token,
            "device_name": device_name,
            "last_seen": frappe.utils.now(),
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"success": True}


# ===========================================================================
# Localization — Phase 17-D (17.22–17.26)
# ===========================================================================

def _apply_localization(cfg, result):
    """Apply i18n, currency formatting, number formatting, timezone normalization."""
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        return result

    lang = _detect_lang()
    tz = _detect_timezone(cfg)
    currency_locale = cfg.get("currency_locale") or "System Default"
    number_locale = cfg.get("number_locale") or ""
    enable_i18n = cfg.get("enable_i18n")

    rows = result.get("data") if isinstance(result.get("data"), list) else None
    if rows:
        result["data"] = [_localize_row(cfg, r, lang, tz, currency_locale, number_locale, enable_i18n) for r in rows]
    elif isinstance(result, dict):
        result = _localize_row(cfg, result, lang, tz, currency_locale, number_locale, enable_i18n)

    # 17.26 RTL metadata
    if lang in ("ar", "he", "ur", "fa"):
        if isinstance(result, dict):
            result.setdefault("_meta", {})["direction"] = "rtl"
            result["_meta"]["locale"] = lang

    return result


def _localize_row(cfg, row: dict, lang: str, tz: str, currency_locale: str, number_locale: str, enable_i18n: bool) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(row, dict):
        return row
    out = {}
    for k, v in row.items():
        new_key = k
        # 17.22 Translate labels (keys) via Frappe i18n
        if enable_i18n and lang and lang != "en":
            try:
                new_key = frappe._(k, lang=lang) or k
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 17.25 Timezone normalization for datetime strings
        if tz and isinstance(v, str) and len(v) == 19 and v[10] == " ":
            try:
                v = _convert_tz(v, tz)
                out[f"{k}_tz_offset"] = tz
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 17.23 Currency formatting
        if currency_locale and currency_locale != "System Default" and isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            field_meta = _get_field_meta(cfg, k)
            if field_meta and field_meta.get("fieldtype") == "Currency":
                out[f"{k}_raw"] = v
                v = _format_currency(v, currency_locale)

        # 17.24 Number formatting
        if number_locale and isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            field_meta = _get_field_meta(cfg, k)
            if field_meta and field_meta.get("fieldtype") in ("Float", "Int", "Percent"):
                v = _format_number(v, number_locale)

        out[new_key] = v
    return out


def _detect_lang() -> str:
    try:
        accept = ""
        if hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
            accept = frappe.local.request.headers.get("Accept-Language", "")
        if accept:
            return accept.split(",")[0].split("-")[0].strip().lower()
        return frappe.local.lang or "en"
    except Exception:
        return "en"


def _detect_timezone(cfg) -> str:
    try:
        mode = cfg.get("response_timezone") or ""
        if mode == "From Request" and hasattr(frappe.local, "request"):
            return frappe.local.request.headers.get("X-Timezone", "") or ""
        return mode or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _convert_tz(dt_str: str, target_tz: str) -> str:
    import pytz
    from datetime import datetime
    server_tz = pytz.timezone(frappe.utils.get_time_zone())
    target = pytz.timezone(target_tz)
    dt = datetime.strptime(dt_str, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    dt_aware = server_tz.localize(dt)
    converted = dt_aware.astimezone(target)
    return converted.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def _format_currency(value: float, locale_str: str) -> str:
    try:
        import babel.numbers
        locale_map = {
            "en-IN": "en_IN", "en_IN": "en_IN",
            "en-US": "en_US", "en_US": "en_US",
            "de-DE": "de_DE", "de_DE": "de_DE",
        }
        locale = locale_map.get(locale_str, locale_str.replace("-", "_"))
        return babel.numbers.format_currency(value, "USD", locale=locale)
    except Exception:
        return str(value)


def _format_number(value: float, locale_str: str) -> str:
    try:
        import babel.numbers
        locale = locale_str.replace("-", "_")
        return babel.numbers.format_number(value, locale=locale)
    except Exception:
        return str(value)


def _get_field_meta(cfg, fieldname: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        meta = frappe.get_meta(cfg.primary_doctype)
        df = meta.get_field(fieldname)
        return {"fieldtype": df.fieldtype} if df else None
    except Exception:
        return None

def _handle_stats(cfg, stat_type: str) -> dict:
    if "System Manager" not in frappe.get_roles():
        frappe.throw(_("System Manager only"), frappe.PermissionError)

    if stat_type == "callers":
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_analytics import top_callers
        return {"data": top_callers(cfg.slug)}

    if stat_type == "dependencies":
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_analytics import endpoint_dependencies
        return endpoint_dependencies(cfg.slug)

    frappe.throw(_(f"Unknown stat type: {stat_type}"), frappe.ValidationError)

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_studio_stats() -> dict:
    today = frappe.utils.today()
    total = frappe.db.count("FB API Endpoint") or 0
    active = frappe.db.count("FB API Endpoint", {"is_active": 1}) or 0
    if frappe.db.table_exists("FB API Request Log"):
        calls_today = frappe.db.count("FB API Request Log", {"creation": [">=", today]})
        errors_today = frappe.db.count("FB API Request Log", {"creation": [">=", today], "status_code": [">=", 400]})
    else:
        calls_today = errors_today = 0
    return {
        "total_endpoints": total,
        "active_endpoints": active,
        "calls_today": calls_today,
        "errors_today": errors_today,
    }

# Phase 22-E — Edge Computing: Cloudflare Workers (22.18–22.20)
# CF Worker deployment, KV cache sync, edge JWT validation.

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import textwrap

import frappe
from frappe import _


def _cf_headers() -> dict:
    return {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {frappe.conf.get('cloudflare_api_token', '')}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }


def _cf_account() -> str:
    return frappe.conf.get("cloudflare_account_id", "")


# ── 22.18  Cloudflare Workers deployment ─────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def deploy_to_cf_workers(slug: str) -> dict:
    """
    Deploy a CF Worker script for this endpoint.
    The worker checks CF KV → on miss calls Rust gateway → stores in KV.
    Returns the CF worker URL.
    """
    import requests
    ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
    ttl = ep.cache_ttl_seconds or 300
    gateway_url = frappe.conf.get("flowbridge_gateway_url", "https://gateway.example.com")

    worker_script = _build_worker_script(slug, gateway_url, ttl)

    account = _cf_account()
    namespace_id = _ensure_kv_namespace(slug)

    url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/workers/scripts/{slug}-worker"
    form_data = {
        "metadata": json.dumps({
            "body_part": "script",
            "bindings": [{"type": "kv_namespace", "name": "CACHE", "namespace_id": namespace_id}],
        }),
        "script": worker_script,
    }
    resp = requests.put(url, data=form_data, headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {frappe.conf.get('cloudflare_api_token','')}",
    }, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()

    worker_url = f"https://{slug}-worker.{frappe.conf.get('cloudflare_subdomain','workers.dev')}"
    frappe.db.set_value("FB API Endpoint", slug, "cf_worker_url", worker_url)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"slug": slug, "worker_url": worker_url, "kv_namespace": namespace_id}


def _build_worker_script(slug: str, gateway_url: str, ttl: int) -> str:
    return textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        // FlowBridge CF Worker — {slug}
        // Phase 22-E (22.18)
        addEventListener('fetch', event => {{
          event.respondWith(handleRequest(event.request));
        }});

        async function handleRequest(request) {{
          const cacheKey = new URL(request.url).search || 'default';
          const cached = await CACHE.get(cacheKey);
          if (cached) {{
            return new Response(cached, {{
              headers: {{'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Cache': 'HIT', 'X-FlowBridge-Edge': '1'}}
            }});
          }}
          const origin = await fetch('{gateway_url}/fb/api/{slug}' + new URL(request.url).search, {{
            headers: Object.fromEntries(request.headers)
          }});
          const body = await origin.text();
          await CACHE.put(cacheKey, body, {{expirationTtl: {ttl}}});
          return new Response(body, {{
            status: origin.status,
            headers: {{'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Cache': 'MISS'}}
          }});
        }}
    """)


def _ensure_kv_namespace(slug: str) -> str:
    """Create or retrieve CF KV namespace for slug."""
    import requests
    account = _cf_account()
    ns_name = f"fb-cache-{slug}"
    list_url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/storage/kv/namespaces"
    resp = requests.get(list_url, headers=_cf_headers(), timeout=10)
    for ns in resp.json().get("result", []):
        if ns["title"] == ns_name:
            return ns["id"]
    create_resp = requests.post(list_url, json={"title": ns_name}, headers=_cf_headers(), timeout=10)
    return create_resp.json()["result"]["id"]


# ── 22.19  CF KV cache sync ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def purge_cf_kv(slug: str, key: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    On cache invalidation, purge CF KV entries for this endpoint.
    Called from cache invalidation hooks.
    """
    import requests
    namespace_id = frappe.db.get_value("FB API Endpoint", slug, "cf_kv_namespace_id")
    if not namespace_id:
        return {"skipped": True}

    account = _cf_account()
    if key:
        url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key}"
        resp = requests.delete(url, headers=_cf_headers(), timeout=10)
    else:
        # Bulk delete all keys for this slug prefix
        list_url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/keys"
        keys_resp = requests.get(list_url, headers=_cf_headers(), timeout=10)
        keys = [k["name"] for k in keys_resp.json().get("result", [])]
        if keys:
            del_url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk"
            resp = requests.delete(del_url, json=keys, headers=_cf_headers(), timeout=10)

    return {"purged": key or "all", "slug": slug}


# ── 22.20  Edge auth — CF Worker JWT validation ───────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def publish_public_key_to_cf_kv(slug: str) -> dict:
    """
    Store the JWT public key in CF KV so Workers can validate tokens locally.
    Zero-origin auth — Workers never call Frappe for token verification.
    """
    import requests
    public_key = frappe.conf.get("jwt_public_key", "")
    if not public_key:
        frappe.throw(_("jwt_public_key not configured in site_config.json"))

    namespace_id = frappe.db.get_value("FB API Endpoint", slug, "cf_kv_namespace_id")
    if not namespace_id:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Endpoint {slug} has no CF KV namespace — deploy first"))

    account = _cf_account()
    url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/jwt_public_key"
    resp = requests.put(url, data=public_key, headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {frappe.conf.get('cloudflare_api_token','')}",
        "Content-Type": "text/plain",
    }, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return {"published": True, "slug": slug}


def get_edge_auth_worker_snippet() -> str:
    """Return the JWT verification snippet to embed in CF Workers."""
    return textwrap.dedent("""\
        // Edge JWT verification — Phase 22-E (22.20)
        async function verifyJWT(request) {
          const authHeader = request.headers.get('Authorization') || '';
          const token = authHeader.replace('Bearer ', '');
          if (!token) return false;
          const pubKeyPem = await CACHE.get('jwt_public_key');
          if (!pubKeyPem) return false;
          try {
            const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
              'spki',
              pemToDer(pubKeyPem),
              { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' },
              false, ['verify']
            );
            const [header, payload, sig] = token.split('.');
            const data = new TextEncoder().encode(header + '.' + payload);
            const signature = base64UrlDecode(sig);
            return await crypto.subtle.verify('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', key, signature, data);
          } catch { return false; }
        }
    """)

# Phase 23 — No-Code Frontend Builder (23.1–23.20)
# Page generation, auto-pages, deployment, versioning, analytics.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import textwrap
from datetime import datetime

import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, today

# ── 23.1  FB Frontend Page helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_frontend_page(
    page_name: str,
    page_type: str = "Dashboard",
    slug: str = "",
    allowed_roles: str = "All",
    fb_api_endpoint: str = "",
) -> str:
    slug = slug or re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "-", page_name.lower())[:60].strip("-")
    if frappe.db.exists("FB Frontend Page", {"slug": slug}):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Page slug '{slug}' already exists"))
    page = frappe.new_doc("FB Frontend Page")
    page.page_name = page_name
    page.page_type = page_type
    page.slug = slug
    page.allowed_roles = allowed_roles
    page.fb_api_endpoint = fb_api_endpoint
    page.layout_json = json.dumps({"widgets": [], "version": 1})
    page.is_published = 0
    page.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return page.name


@frappe.whitelist()
def save_layout(page_name: str, layout_json: str) -> dict:
    """Save widget layout and append a version snapshot."""
    page = frappe.get_doc("FB Frontend Page", page_name)
    old_layout = page.layout_json
    page.layout_json = layout_json
    _append_page_version(page, old_layout)
    page.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"saved": True, "version": len(page.get("versions", []))}


def _append_page_version(page, layout_snapshot: str):
    page.append("versions", {
        "saved_at": now_datetime(),
        "saved_by": frappe.session.user,
        "layout_snapshot": layout_snapshot,
    })

    page = frappe.get_doc("FB Frontend Page", page_name)

        "page_name": page.page_name,
        "page_type": page.page_type,
        "slug": page.slug,
        "layout_json": page.layout_json,
        "is_published": page.is_published,
        "allowed_roles": page.allowed_roles,
    }


# ── 23.6  Widget ↔ endpoint wiring ───────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_endpoint_schema_for_widget(slug: str) -> dict:
    """Return field list + filter options for populating a widget's config UI."""
    ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
    meta = frappe.get_meta(ep.primary_doctype)
    fields = [
        {"fieldname": f.fieldname, "label": f.label or f.fieldname,
         "fieldtype": f.fieldtype, "options": f.options}
        for f in meta.fields
        if f.fieldtype not in ("Section Break", "Column Break", "Tab Break", "HTML", "Fold")
    ][:40]
    methods = [m.strip() for m in (ep.allowed_methods or "GET").split(",")]
    return {
        "slug": slug,
        "label": ep.label,
        "methods": methods,
        "fields": fields,
        "supports_realtime": bool(ep.get("enable_sse")),
        "cache_ttl": ep.cache_ttl_seconds or 0,
    }


# ── 23.7  Role-aware widget visibility check ─────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def get_page_for_user(slug: str) -> dict:
    """Return the page layout with widgets filtered to the current user's roles."""
    page = frappe.db.get_value(
        "FB Frontend Page", {"slug": slug, "is_published": 1},
        ["name", "page_name", "page_type", "layout_json", "allowed_roles"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    if not page:
        frappe.throw(_("Page not found or not published"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

    allowed = [r.strip() for r in (page.allowed_roles or "All").split(",")]
    if "All" not in allowed:
        user_roles = frappe.get_roles(frappe.session.user)
        if not any(r in user_roles for r in allowed):
            frappe.throw(_("Access denied"), frappe.PermissionError)

    layout = json.loads(page.layout_json or '{"widgets":[]}')
    user_roles = set(frappe.get_roles(frappe.session.user))

    # Filter widgets by visible_to_roles
    widgets = []
    for w in layout.get("widgets", []):
        vis_roles = w.get("visible_to_roles", [])
        if not vis_roles or "All" in vis_roles or user_roles.intersection(vis_roles):
            widgets.append(w)
    layout["widgets"] = widgets

    return {**page, "layout_json": json.dumps(layout)}


# ── 23.8  Auto list page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def auto_generate_list_page(slug: str) -> str:
    """Generate a complete list-page layout from a GET endpoint."""
    ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
    meta = frappe.get_meta(ep.primary_doctype)
    columns = [
        {"fieldname": f.fieldname, "label": f.label or f.fieldname}
        for f in meta.fields
        if f.fieldtype in ("Data", "Link", "Select", "Int", "Currency", "Date") and f.in_list_view
    ][:8] or [{"fieldname": "name", "label": "Name"}]

    layout = {
        "version": 1,
        "widgets": [
            {
                "id": "search-1", "type": "SearchBar",
                "endpoint": slug, "label": f"Search {ep.label or slug}",
                "col": 0, "row": 0, "w": 12, "h": 1,
            },
            {
                "id": "filter-1", "type": "FilterBar",
                "endpoint": slug, "label": "Filters",
                "col": 0, "row": 1, "w": 12, "h": 1,
            },
            {
                "id": "table-1", "type": "Table",
                "endpoint": slug, "label": ep.label or slug,
                "columns": columns,
                "paginate": True, "page_size": 20,
                "export_csv": True,
                "row_click_action": "detail",
                "col": 0, "row": 2, "w": 12, "h": 6,
            },
        ],
    }
    page_name = create_frontend_page(
        page_name=f"{ep.label or slug} — List",
        page_type="List",
        slug=f"{slug}-list",
        fb_api_endpoint=slug,
    )
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "layout_json", json.dumps(layout))
    frappe.db.commit()
    return page_name

# ── 23.11  Auto dashboard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def auto_generate_dashboard(endpoints_csv: str, dashboard_name: str = "Dashboard") -> str:
    """Generate a multi-endpoint dashboard with KPI cards + table widgets."""
    slugs = [s.strip() for s in endpoints_csv.split(",") if s.strip()]
    widgets = []
    row = 0
    col = 0

    for i, slug in enumerate(slugs[:6]):
        try:
            ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
        except Exception:
            continue
        widgets.append({
            "id": f"kpi-{i}", "type": "KPICard",
            "endpoint": slug, "label": ep.label or slug,
            "metric": "count", "col": col, "row": row, "w": 4, "h": 2,
            "enable_realtime": bool(ep.get("enable_sse")),
        })
        col = (col + 4) % 12
        if col == 0:
            row += 2

    # Add bar chart for first endpoint
    if slugs:
        widgets.append({
            "id": "chart-1", "type": "BarChart",
            "endpoint": slugs[0], "label": "Overview",
            "col": 0, "row": row, "w": 12, "h": 4,
        })
        row += 4

    # Recent records table for each endpoint
    for i, slug in enumerate(slugs[:3]):
        widgets.append({
            "id": f"table-{i}", "type": "Table",
            "endpoint": slug, "label": f"Recent — {slug}",
            "page_size": 5, "paginate": False,
            "col": 0 if i % 2 == 0 else 6, "row": row + (i // 2) * 4, "w": 6, "h": 4,
        })

    layout = {"version": 1, "widgets": widgets}
    page_name = create_frontend_page(
        page_name=dashboard_name,
        page_type="Dashboard",
        slug=re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "-", dashboard_name.lower()),
    )
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "layout_json", json.dumps(layout))
    frappe.db.commit()
    return page_name


# ── 23.16  Frappe web page deployment ────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def publish_page(page_name: str) -> dict:
    """Publish a page — makes it accessible at /fb-pages/{slug}."""
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "is_published", 1)
    frappe.db.commit()
    slug = frappe.db.get_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "slug")
    return {"published": True, "url": f"/fb-pages/{slug}"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def unpublish_page(page_name: str) -> dict:
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "is_published", 0)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"published": False}


@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def render_page_html(slug: str) -> str:
    """Return Jinja2-rendered HTML shell for a published page (React hydrates client-side)."""
    page = frappe.db.get_value(
        "FB Frontend Page",
        {"slug": slug, "is_published": 1},
        ["name", "page_name", "layout_json", "allowed_roles", "custom_domain"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    if not page:
        frappe.throw(_("Page not found"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

    layout_b64 = __import__("base64").b64encode(
        (page.layout_json or "{}").encode()
    ).decode()
    cdn = frappe.conf.get("flowbridge_cdn_url", "")
    return textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang="en">
        <head>
          <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
          <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
          <title>{page.page_name}</title>
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="{cdn}/assets/frappe_flowbridge/css/fb-pages.css"/>
        </head>
        <body>
          <div id="fb-root"
               data-page="{page.name}"
               data-layout="{layout_b64}">
          </div>
          <script src="{cdn}/assets/frappe_flowbridge/js/fb-pages.bundle.js"></script>
        </body>
        </html>
    """)


# ── 23.17  Embeddable widget script ─────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def get_embed_snippet(slug: str, api_key: str = "") -> str:
    """Return the HTML embed snippet for an external site."""
    origin = frappe.utils.get_url()
    return textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        <!-- FlowBridge Page Embed -->
        <script>
          (function() {{
            var s = document.createElement('script');
            s.src = '{origin}/assets/frappe_flowbridge/js/fb-embed.js';
            s.dataset.slug = '{slug}';
            s.dataset.apiKey = '{api_key}';
            document.currentScript.replaceWith(s);
          }})();
        </script>
        <fb-page slug="{slug}" api-key="{api_key}"></fb-page>
    """).strip()


# ── 23.18  Custom domain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def set_custom_domain(page_name: str, domain: str) -> dict:
    """Set custom domain on a page; Nginx vhost provisioning handled by ops."""
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "custom_domain", domain)
    frappe.db.commit()
    # Enqueue nginx vhost generation
    frappe.enqueue(
        "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_frontend._provision_nginx_vhost",
        page_name=page_name, domain=domain, queue="long",
    )
    return {"domain": domain, "status": "provisioning"}


def _provision_nginx_vhost(page_name: str, domain: str):
    """Write nginx vhost config for custom domain (runs as background job)."""
    slug = frappe.db.get_value("FB Frontend Page", page_name, "slug")
    origin = frappe.utils.get_url()
    conf = textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        server {{
            listen 80;
            server_name {domain};
            location / {{
                proxy_pass {origin}/fb-pages/{slug};
                proxy_set_header Host $host;
                proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
            }}
        }}
    """)
    try:
        vhost_path = f"/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/fb-{slug}.conf"
        with open(vhost_path, "w") as f:
            f.write(conf)
        import subprocess
        subprocess.run(["nginx", "-s", "reload"], check=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        frappe.log_error(str(exc), "Nginx vhost provisioning error")

    page = frappe.get_doc("FB Frontend Page", page_name)

# ── 23.20  Page access analytics ─────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def record_page_view(slug: str, session_id: str = "") -> dict:
    """Record a page view — called client-side on load."""
    frappe.enqueue(
        "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_frontend._write_page_view",
        slug=slug, session_id=session_id,
        queue="short", enqueue_after_commit=True,
    )
    return {"recorded": True}


def _write_page_view(slug: str, session_id: str):
    doc = frappe.new_doc("FB Page View")
    doc.page_slug = slug
    doc.session_id = session_id
    doc.viewed_at = now_datetime()
    doc.user = frappe.session.user if frappe.session.user != "Guest" else ""
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_page_analytics(slug: str, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    since = frappe.utils.add_to_date(None, days=-int(days))
    total_views = frappe.db.count("FB Page View", {"page_slug": slug, "viewed_at": [">", since]})
    unique_sessions = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM `tabFB Page View` WHERE page_slug=%s AND viewed_at > %s",
        (slug, since),
    )[0][0] or 0
    daily = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT DATE(viewed_at) as day, COUNT(*) as views FROM `tabFB Page View` "
        "WHERE page_slug=%s AND viewed_at > %s GROUP BY day ORDER BY day",
        (slug, since), as_dict=True,
    )
    return {"slug": slug, "total_views": total_views, "unique_sessions": unique_sessions, "daily": daily}

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/api_governance.py
# Phase 20 — API Governance & Lifecycle (20.1–20.20)
# Lifecycle state machine, consumer registry, change management, API catalog, compliance.

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import json
import re
from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Any

import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, today

# ── constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

LIFECYCLE_STATES = ["Draft", "In Review", "Published", "Deprecated", "Retired"]

VALID_TRANSITIONS: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    "Draft":      ["In Review", "Published"],   # direct publish allowed unless gate on
    "In Review":  ["Published", "Draft"],
    "Published":  ["Deprecated"],
    "Deprecated": ["Retired", "Published"],     # un-deprecate allowed
    "Retired":    [],
}

BREAKING_CHANGE_FIELDS = {
    "fields", "default_filters", "allowed_methods", "enable_auth",
    "auth_required_roles", "rate_limit_per_minute",
}


# ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _endpoint(slug: str):
    return frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)


def _diff(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    added, removed, changed = {}, {}, {}
    for k, v in new.items():
        if k not in old:
            added[k] = v
        elif old[k] != v:
            changed[k] = {"from": old[k], "to": v}
    for k in old:
        if k not in new:
            removed[k] = old[k]
    return {"added": added, "removed": removed, "changed": changed}


# ── 20.1  Lifecycle state machine ────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def transition_state(slug: str, new_state: str) -> dict:
    """
    Move endpoint to new_state. Enforces valid transition graph.
    Respects `require_review_before_publish` gate (20.18).
    """
    ep = _endpoint(slug)
    current = ep.get("lifecycle_state") or "Draft"

    allowed = VALID_TRANSITIONS.get(current, [])
    if new_state not in allowed:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Cannot transition from {current} to {new_state}."))

    settings = frappe.get_single("FlowBridge Settings")
    if (
        new_state == "Published"
        and current == "Draft"
        and getattr(settings, "require_review_before_publish", 0)
    ):
        frappe.throw(_("Review gate active: endpoint must pass 'In Review' before publishing."))

    ep.lifecycle_state = new_state
    if new_state == "Deprecated":
        ep.deprecated_at = now_datetime()
    if new_state == "Retired":
        ep.is_active = 0

    # Append changelog entry
    _append_changelog(ep, f"State changed from {current} to {new_state}", {})
    ep.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"slug": slug, "previous_state": current, "new_state": new_state}


# ── 20.2  Review workflow ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def submit_for_review(slug: str, notes: str = "") -> str:
    """Create FB API Review doc and transition endpoint to In Review."""
    transition_state(slug, "In Review")
    review = frappe.new_doc("FB API Review")
    review.endpoint = slug
    review.submitted_by = frappe.session.user
    review.notes = notes
    review.status = "Pending"
    review.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    _notify_reviewers(slug, review.name)
    return review.name


@frappe.whitelist()
def approve_review(review_name: str, comment: str = "") -> dict:
    review = frappe.get_doc("FB API Review", review_name)
    review.status = "Approved"
    review.reviewer = frappe.session.user
    review.reviewer_comment = comment
    review.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    result = transition_state(review.endpoint, "Published")
    _notify_submitter(review, "Approved")
    return result


@frappe.whitelist()
def reject_review(review_name: str, comment: str = "") -> dict:
    review = frappe.get_doc("FB API Review", review_name)
    review.status = "Rejected"
    review.reviewer = frappe.session.user
    review.reviewer_comment = comment
    review.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    transition_state(review.endpoint, "Draft")
    _notify_submitter(review, "Rejected")
    return {"review": review_name, "status": "Rejected"}


def _notify_reviewers(slug: str, review_name: str):
    reviewers = frappe.get_all(
        "Has Role",
        filters={"role": "FlowBridge Reviewer", "parenttype": "User"},
        fields=["parent"],
    )
    for r in reviewers:
        frappe.sendmail(
            recipients=[r.parent],
            subject=f"[FlowBridge] Review requested: {slug}",
            message=f"Endpoint <b>{slug}</b> has been submitted for review.<br>Review: {review_name}",
        )


def _notify_submitter(review, decision: str):
    try:
        frappe.sendmail(
            recipients=[review.submitted_by],
            subject=f"[FlowBridge] Review {decision}: {review.endpoint}",
            message=(
                f"Your endpoint <b>{review.endpoint}</b> has been <b>{decision}</b>.<br>"
                f"Reviewer comment: {review.reviewer_comment or '—'}"
            ),
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


# ── 20.3  Deprecation notice ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def deprecate_endpoint(slug: str, sunset_date: str, message: str = "") -> dict:
    """Mark endpoint as Deprecated with a sunset date and message."""
    ep = _endpoint(slug)
    ep.sunset_at = sunset_date
    ep.deprecation_message = message or f"Endpoint {slug} will be retired on {sunset_date}."
    ep.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    transition_state(slug, "Deprecated")
    _notify_consumers_deprecation(slug, sunset_date, message)
    return {"slug": slug, "sunset_at": sunset_date}


def _notify_consumers_deprecation(slug: str, sunset_date: str, message: str):
    consumers = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Consumer",
        filters={"subscribed_endpoints": ["like", f"%{slug}%"]},
        fields=["name", "contact_email"],
    )
    for c in consumers:
        try:
            frappe.sendmail(
                recipients=[c.contact_email],
                subject=f"[FlowBridge] Deprecation notice: {slug}",
                message=(
                    f"API endpoint <b>{slug}</b> is being deprecated.<br>"
                    f"Sunset date: <b>{sunset_date}</b><br>{message}"
                ),
            )
        except Exception:
            pass


# ── 20.4  Sunset enforcement ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def enforce_sunsets():
    """Scheduler: retire endpoints past their sunset date."""
    overdue = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Endpoint",
        filters={"lifecycle_state": "Deprecated", "sunset_at": ["<=", today()]},
        fields=["name"],
    )
    for ep in overdue:
        transition_state(ep.name, "Retired")


# ── 20.5  Draft testing token ────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_draft_token(slug: str, ttl_minutes: int = 60) -> dict:
    """Issue a time-limited token for testing Draft endpoints internally."""
    import hashlib
    import time
    token = hashlib.sha256(f"{slug}:{frappe.session.user}:{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
    r = frappe.cache()
    r.set(f"fb:draft_token:{token}", slug, ex=int(ttl_minutes) * 60)
    return {"token": token, "slug": slug, "ttl_minutes": ttl_minutes}


def validate_draft_token(token: str) -> str | None:
    """Return slug if token valid, else None."""
    r = frappe.cache()
    slug = r.get(f"fb:draft_token:{token}")
    return slug.decode() if isinstance(slug, bytes) else slug


# ── 20.6  FB API Consumer DocType helpers ────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def register_consumer(consumer_name: str, consumer_type: str, contact_email: str,
                       subscribed_endpoints: list | str = "") -> str:
    """Create a new FB API Consumer and return its name."""
    if isinstance(subscribed_endpoints, list):
        subscribed_endpoints = ",".join(subscribed_endpoints)
    doc = frappe.new_doc("FB API Consumer")
    doc.consumer_name = consumer_name
    doc.consumer_type = consumer_type
    doc.contact_email = contact_email
    doc.subscribed_endpoints = subscribed_endpoints
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return doc.name


# ── 20.7  Consumer impact analysis ───────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def consumer_impact(slug: str) -> dict:
    """List all consumers of an endpoint and their last-call date."""
    consumers = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Consumer",
        filters={"subscribed_endpoints": ["like", f"%{slug}%"]},
        fields=["name", "consumer_name", "consumer_type", "contact_email"],
    )
    result = []
    for c in consumers:
        last_call = frappe.db.get_value(
            "FB API Request Log",
            {"endpoint": slug, "consumer": c.name},
            "MAX(creation)",
        )
        result.append({**c, "last_call": last_call})
    return {"slug": slug, "consumers": result, "total": len(result)}


# ── 20.8  Consumer notification on breaking change ───────────────────────────

def _notify_consumers_breaking(slug: str, diff_json: dict):
    consumers = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Consumer",
        filters={"subscribed_endpoints": ["like", f"%{slug}%"]},
        fields=["name", "contact_email", "consumer_name"],
    )
    diff_html = f"<pre>{json.dumps(diff_json, indent=2)}</pre>"
    for c in consumers:
        try:
            frappe.sendmail(
                recipients=[c.contact_email],
                subject=f"[FlowBridge] Breaking change: {slug}",
                message=(
                    f"A breaking change was made to endpoint <b>{slug}</b>.<br>"
                    f"Please review the diff below and update your integration.<br>"
                    + diff_html
                ),
            )
        except Exception:
            pass


# ── 20.9  Consumer SLA tracking ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def check_consumer_slas():
    """Scheduler: per-consumer error rate > 1% creates FB Service Alert."""
    consumers = frappe.get_all("FB API Consumer", fields=["name", "consumer_name"])
    for c in consumers:
        since = frappe.utils.add_to_date(None, hours=-1)
        total = frappe.db.count("FB API Request Log", {"consumer": c.name, "creation": [">", since]})
        if not total:
            continue
        errors = frappe.db.count(
            "FB API Request Log",
            {"consumer": c.name, "creation": [">", since], "status_code": [">=", 500]},
        )
        if errors / total > 0.01:
            _create_service_alert(c.name, "Consumer SLA breach", f"Error rate {errors/total*100:.1f}%")


def _create_service_alert(ref: str, alert_type: str, message: str):
    if frappe.db.exists("FB Service Alert", {"reference": ref, "status": "Open"}):
        return
    doc = frappe.new_doc("FB Service Alert")
    doc.reference = ref
    doc.alert_type = alert_type
    doc.message = message
    doc.status = "Open"
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)


# ── 20.10  Endpoint changelog ────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _append_changelog(ep, summary: str, diff_json: dict):
    """Append a row to the FB API Endpoint Changelog child table."""
    ep.append("changelog", {
        "timestamp": now_datetime(),
        "changed_by": frappe.session.user,
        "change_summary": summary,
        "diff_json": json.dumps(diff_json),
    })

        "FB API Endpoint Changelog",

        fields=["name", "timestamp", "changed_by", "change_summary", "diff_json"],
        order_by="timestamp desc",
    )


# ── 20.11  Breaking change detection ────────────────────────────────────────

def detect_breaking_changes(old_doc_dict: dict, new_doc_dict: dict) -> bool:
    """Return True if changes include a breaking field change."""
    for field in BREAKING_CHANGE_FIELDS:
        old_val = old_doc_dict.get(field)
        new_val = new_doc_dict.get(field)
        if old_val != new_val:
            return True
    return False


# Called from FB API Endpoint `before_save` hook
def before_save_endpoint(doc, method=None):
    if doc.is_new():
        doc.lifecycle_state = doc.lifecycle_state or "Draft"
        return

    old = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", doc.name).as_dict()
    diff = _diff(
        {k: old.get(k) for k in BREAKING_CHANGE_FIELDS},
        {k: doc.get(k) for k in BREAKING_CHANGE_FIELDS},
    )
    is_breaking = bool(diff["removed"] or diff["changed"])
    doc.is_breaking = 1 if is_breaking else 0

    summary = "Breaking change" if is_breaking else "Config updated"
    _append_changelog(doc, summary, diff)

    if is_breaking:
        _notify_consumers_breaking(doc.name, diff)


# ── 20.12  Config diff viewer ────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def compare_changelog_versions(slug: str, version_a: str, version_b: str) -> dict:
    """Return diff between two changelog entries by their name."""
    def _parse(entry_name: str) -> dict:
        row = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint Changelog", entry_name)
        return json.loads(row.diff_json or "{}")

    diff_a = _parse(version_a)
    diff_b = _parse(version_b)
    return {"version_a": diff_a, "version_b": diff_b, "meta_diff": _diff(diff_a, diff_b)}


# ── 20.13  Rollback to previous config ───────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def rollback_to_version(slug: str, changelog_entry_name: str) -> dict:
    """Restore endpoint config from a changelog entry's diff snapshot."""
    entry = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint Changelog", changelog_entry_name)
    diff = json.loads(entry.diff_json or "{}")

    ep = _endpoint(slug)
    old_vals = {}
    # Reverse 'changed' and 'added' keys to restore prior values
    for field, change in diff.get("changed", {}).items():
        if hasattr(ep, field):
            old_vals[field] = ep.get(field)
            setattr(ep, field, change["from"])
    for field in diff.get("added", {}):
        if hasattr(ep, field):
            setattr(ep, field, None)
    for field, val in diff.get("removed", {}).items():
        if hasattr(ep, field):
            setattr(ep, field, val)

    _append_changelog(ep, f"Rolled back to version {changelog_entry_name}", old_vals)
    ep.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"slug": slug, "rolled_back_to": changelog_entry_name}


# ── 20.14  Internal API catalog ──────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_api_catalog(
    search: str = "",
    domain: str = "",
    state: str = "",
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 50,
) -> dict:
    """Return paginated endpoint catalog with health scores."""
    filters: dict = {}
    if domain:
        filters["api_domain"] = domain
    if state:
        filters["lifecycle_state"] = state
    if search:
        filters["name"] = ["like", f"%{search}%"]

    total = frappe.db.count("FB API Endpoint", filters)
    endpoints = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Endpoint",
        filters=filters,
        fields=[
            "name", "label", "lifecycle_state", "api_domain", "primary_doctype",
            "modified", "is_active", "owner_user",
        ],
        order_by="modified desc",
        limit_start=(int(page) - 1) * int(page_size),
        limit_page_length=int(page_size),
    )

    # Enrich with consumer count + call volume (last 24h)
    for ep in endpoints:
        ep["consumer_count"] = frappe.db.count(
            "FB API Consumer",
            {"subscribed_endpoints": ["like", f"%{ep.name}%"]},
        )
        since = frappe.utils.add_to_date(None, hours=-24)
        ep["calls_24h"] = frappe.db.count(
            "FB API Request Log",
            {"endpoint": ep.name, "creation": [">", since]},
        )
        errors = frappe.db.count(
            "FB API Request Log",
            {"endpoint": ep.name, "creation": [">", since], "status_code": [">=", 400]},
        )
        calls = ep["calls_24h"] or 1
        ep["health_score"] = round(max(0, 100 - (errors / calls) * 100), 1)

    return {"total": total, "page": int(page), "results": endpoints}


# ── 20.15  API domain grouping ───────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()

    """Return endpoint counts grouped by api_domain."""

        as_dict=True,
    )
    return {r.api_domain or "Uncategorized": r.cnt for r in rows}


# ── 20.16  API contract testing ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_contract_tests():
    """Scheduler: daily contract test runner."""
    contracts = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Contract",
        filters={"is_active": 1},
        fields=["name", "endpoint", "expected_request_json", "expected_response_schema"],
    )
    for contract in contracts:
        _run_single_contract(contract)


def _run_single_contract(contract: dict):
    import jsonschema
    try:
        ep = _endpoint(contract.endpoint)
        # Minimal internal test call
        request_body: dict = json.loads(contract.expected_request_json or "{}")
        # Simulate a read via frappe.db
        schema: dict = json.loads(contract.expected_response_schema or "{}")
        sample = frappe.get_all(
            ep.primary_doctype,
            fields=["name"],
            limit=1,
        )
        response_sample = sample[0] if sample else {}
        jsonschema.validate(response_sample, schema)
        frappe.db.set_value("FB API Contract", contract.name, "last_test_status", "Pass")
    except Exception as exc:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB API Contract", contract.name, "last_test_status", "Fail")
        _create_service_alert(contract.name, "Contract test failed", str(exc))

# ── 20.19  Audit export for governance ───────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def export_governance_report(from_date: str, to_date: str) -> str:
    """Return CSV string of all state transitions and breaking change events."""
    rows = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Endpoint Changelog",
        filters={"timestamp": ["between", [from_date, to_date + " 23:59:59"]]},
        fields=["parent", "timestamp", "changed_by", "change_summary", "diff_json"],
        order_by="timestamp asc",
    )

    # Include review decisions
    reviews = frappe.get_all(
        "FB API Review",
        filters={"creation": ["between", [from_date, to_date + " 23:59:59"]]},
        fields=["endpoint", "creation", "submitted_by", "reviewer", "status", "reviewer_comment"],
        order_by="creation asc",
    )

    buf = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buf)
    writer.writerow(["Type", "Endpoint", "Timestamp", "Actor", "Detail"])
    for r in rows:
        is_breaking = "breaking" in (r.change_summary or "").lower()
        writer.writerow([
            "Breaking Change" if is_breaking else "Config Change",
            r.parent, r.timestamp, r.changed_by, r.change_summary,
        ])
    for rv in reviews:
        writer.writerow([
            f"Review {rv.status}",
            rv.endpoint, rv.creation, rv.reviewer or rv.submitted_by,
            rv.reviewer_comment or "",
        ])
    return buf.getvalue()

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/api_graphql.py
# Phase 22-A — GraphQL Gateway (22.1–22.6)
# Auto-generated schema, mutations, subscriptions, DataLoader, GraphiQL, persisted queries.

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import textwrap
from typing import Any

import frappe
from frappe import _

# ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_FRAPPE_TO_GQL = {
    "Data": "String", "Small Text": "String", "Text": "String", "Text Editor": "String",
    "Long Text": "String", "Code": "String", "Link": "String", "Dynamic Link": "String",
    "Select": "String", "Read Only": "String", "Password": "String",
    "Int": "Int", "Float": "Float", "Currency": "Float", "Percent": "Float",
    "Check": "Boolean",
    "Date": "String", "Datetime": "String", "Time": "String",
}

_SKIP_TYPES = {"Section Break", "Column Break", "Tab Break", "HTML", "Fold", "Table",
               "Table MultiSelect", "Attach", "Attach Image", "Signature", "Geolocation"}


def _gql_type_name(slug: str) -> str:
    return "".join(w.capitalize() for w in re.split(r"[-_]", slug))


def _field_gql_type(frappe_type: str) -> str:
    return _FRAPPE_TO_GQL.get(frappe_type, "String")


# ── 22.1  Auto-generated GraphQL schema ──────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_graphql_schema(slug: str | None = None) -> str:
    """
    Build a GraphQL SDL schema string for one or all enabled endpoints.
    Returns the full schema as a string.
    """
    if slug:
        endpoints = [frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)]
    else:
        eps = frappe.get_all(
            "FB API Endpoint",
            filters={"is_active": 1, "enable_graphql": 1},
            fields=["name"],
        )
        endpoints = [frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", e.name) for e in eps]

    type_defs: list[str] = []
    query_fields: list[str] = []
    mutation_fields: list[str] = []
    subscription_fields: list[str] = []

    for ep in endpoints:
        type_name = _gql_type_name(ep.name)
        fields_json: list = json.loads(ep.fields or "[]") if isinstance(ep.fields, str) else (ep.fields or [])
        if not fields_json:
            try:
                meta = frappe.get_meta(ep.primary_doctype)
                fields_json = [
                    {"fieldname": f.fieldname, "fieldtype": f.fieldtype}
                    for f in meta.fields
                    if f.fieldtype not in _SKIP_TYPES
                ][:20]
            except Exception:
                fields_json = [{"fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Data"}]

        gql_fields = "\n".join(
            f"  {f['fieldname']}: {_field_gql_type(f.get('fieldtype','Data'))}"
            for f in fields_json
            if f.get("fieldname") and f.get("fieldtype") not in _SKIP_TYPES
        )
        type_defs.append(f"type {type_name} {{\n{gql_fields}\n}}")

        methods = [m.strip() for m in (ep.allowed_methods or "GET").split(",")]
        if "GET" in methods:
            query_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_list(limit: Int, offset: Int, filters: String): [{type_name}]"
            )
            query_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_get(name: String!): {type_name}"
            )
        if "POST" in methods:
            mutation_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_create(data: String!): {type_name}"
            )
        if "PATCH" in methods:
            mutation_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_update(name: String!, data: String!): {type_name}"
            )
        if "DELETE" in methods:
            mutation_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_delete(name: String!): Boolean"
            )
        if ep.get("enable_sse"):
            subscription_fields.append(
                f"  {ep.name.replace('-','_')}_updated: {type_name}"
            )

    parts = "\n\n".join(type_defs)
    if query_fields:
        parts += "\n\ntype Query {\n" + "\n".join(query_fields) + "\n}"
    if mutation_fields:
        parts += "\n\ntype Mutation {\n" + "\n".join(mutation_fields) + "\n}"
    if subscription_fields:
        parts += "\n\ntype Subscription {\n" + "\n".join(subscription_fields) + "\n}"

    return parts


# ── 22.2  GraphQL query + mutation executor ───────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def graphql_execute(query: str, variables: str = "{}", operation_name: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    Execute a GraphQL query/mutation.  Parsed manually for lightweight operation
    (avoids heavy graphql-core dependency on hot path).
    Persisted query support: if query starts with 'sha256:', look up in Redis (22.6).
    """
    r = frappe.cache()

    # 22.6 — persisted query lookup
    if query.startswith("sha256:"):
        digest = query[7:]
        stored = r.get(f"fb:pq:{digest}")
        if not stored:
            return {"errors": [{"message": "Persisted query not found"}]}
        query = stored.decode() if isinstance(stored, bytes) else stored

    vars_dict: dict = json.loads(variables) if variables else {}
    op = _detect_operation(query)

    if op == "query":
        return _execute_query(query, vars_dict)
    elif op == "mutation":
        return _execute_mutation(query, vars_dict)
    else:
        return {"errors": [{"message": f"Unsupported operation: {op}"}]}


def _detect_operation(query: str) -> str:
    q = query.strip().lower()
    if q.startswith("mutation"):
        return "mutation"
    if q.startswith("subscription"):
        return "subscription"
    return "query"


def _execute_query(query: str, variables: dict) -> dict:
    """Route a GraphQL query to the appropriate FB API Endpoint handler."""
    # Extract first field name from selection set
    m = re.search(r'\{\s*(\w+)', query)
    if not m:
        return {"errors": [{"message": "Cannot parse query field"}]}
    field = m.group(1)
    slug = field.replace("_list", "").replace("_get", "").replace("_", "-")

    try:
        ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
    except Exception:
        return {"errors": [{"message": f"No endpoint found for field: {field}"}]}

    is_single = "_get" in field
    limit = variables.get("limit", 20)
    offset = variables.get("offset", 0)
    name_filter = variables.get("name")

    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.batch_loader import BatchLoader
    loader = BatchLoader()

    if is_single and name_filter:
        rows = frappe.get_all(ep.primary_doctype, filters={"name": name_filter}, limit=1)
    else:
        filters: dict = {}
        if variables.get("filters"):
            try:
                filters = json.loads(variables["filters"])
            except Exception:
                pass
        rows = frappe.get_all(ep.primary_doctype, filters=filters, limit=int(limit), start=int(offset))

    return {"data": {field: rows[0] if is_single else rows}}


def _execute_mutation(query: str, variables: dict) -> dict:
    """Route a GraphQL mutation to create/update/delete."""
    m = re.search(r'mutation\s*\{?\s*(\w+)', query, re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        return {"errors": [{"message": "Cannot parse mutation field"}]}
    field = m.group(1)

    if "_create" in field:
        slug = field.replace("_create", "").replace("_", "-")
        data: dict = json.loads(variables.get("data", "{}"))
        ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
        data["doctype"] = ep.primary_doctype
        doc = frappe.get_doc(data)
        doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"data": {field: doc.as_dict()}}
    elif "_update" in field:
        slug = field.replace("_update", "").replace("_", "-")
        ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
        name = variables.get("name")
        data = json.loads(variables.get("data", "{}"))
        frappe.db.set_value(ep.primary_doctype, name, data)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"data": {field: {"name": name, **data}}}
    elif "_delete" in field:
        slug = field.replace("_delete", "").replace("_", "-")
        ep = frappe.get_doc("FB API Endpoint", slug)
        name = variables.get("name")
        frappe.delete_doc(ep.primary_doctype, name, ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"data": {field: True}}

    return {"errors": [{"message": f"Unknown mutation: {field}"}]}


# ── 22.3  GraphQL subscriptions ───────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def graphql_subscribe(slug: str, api_key: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    Register a GraphQL subscription via Phase 17 Redis pub/sub.
    Returns a channel token the client polls (WS handled in Rust rt.rs).
    """
    token = hashlib.sha256(f"{slug}:{api_key}:{frappe.utils.now()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    frappe.cache().set(f"fb:gql_sub:{token}", slug, ex=3600)
    return {"token": token, "channel": f"fb:rt:{slug}"}

# ── 22.6  Persisted queries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def register_persisted_query(query: str) -> dict:
    """Store a query string under its SHA-256 hash. Client sends 'sha256:<hash>' thereafter."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256(query.encode()).hexdigest()
    frappe.cache().set(f"fb:pq:{digest}", query, ex=86400 * 30)
    return {"hash": digest, "key": f"sha256:{digest}"}

# Phase 22-B — gRPC Support (22.7–22.10)

from __future__ import annotations

import json

_PB_TYPE_MAP = {
