# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.1 — X12 EDI Parser
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR = "~"
X12_ELEMENT_SEPARATOR = "*"
X12_SUBELEMENT_SEPARATOR = ":"

SUPPORTED_X12_TRANSACTIONS = {
    "850": "Purchase Order",
    "810": "Invoice",
    "856": "Advance Ship Notice",
    "940": "Warehouse Shipping Order",
    "997": "Functional Acknowledgment",
}


def parse_x12(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse a raw X12 EDI string into a structured dict."""
    raw = raw.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "")
    segments = [s.strip() for s in raw.split(X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR) if s.strip()]

    result = {"envelopes": [], "_raw_segments": len(segments)}
    current_isa = None
    current_gs = None
    current_st = None
    current_transaction_segments: list[list[str]] = []

    for seg in segments:
        elements = seg.split(X12_ELEMENT_SEPARATOR)
        tag = elements[0].upper()

        if tag == "ISA":
            current_isa = {
                "sender_qualifier": elements[5] if len(elements) > 5 else "",
                "sender_id": elements[6].strip() if len(elements) > 6 else "",
                "receiver_qualifier": elements[7] if len(elements) > 7 else "",
                "receiver_id": elements[8].strip() if len(elements) > 8 else "",
                "date": elements[9] if len(elements) > 9 else "",
                "time": elements[10] if len(elements) > 10 else "",
                "control_number": elements[13] if len(elements) > 13 else "",
                "groups": [],
            }
            result["envelopes"].append(current_isa)

        elif tag == "GS" and current_isa is not None:
            current_gs = {
                "functional_id": elements[1] if len(elements) > 1 else "",
                "sender_id": elements[2] if len(elements) > 2 else "",
                "receiver_id": elements[3] if len(elements) > 3 else "",
                "date": elements[4] if len(elements) > 4 else "",
                "control_number": elements[6] if len(elements) > 6 else "",
                "transaction_set": elements[7] if len(elements) > 7 else "",
                "transactions": [],
            }
            current_isa["groups"].append(current_gs)

        elif tag == "ST" and current_gs is not None:
            current_st = {
                "transaction_id": elements[1] if len(elements) > 1 else "",
                "control_number": elements[2] if len(elements) > 2 else "",
                "segments": [],
            }
            current_transaction_segments = []
            current_gs["transactions"].append(current_st)

        elif tag == "SE" and current_st is not None:
            current_st["segment_count"] = elements[1] if len(elements) > 1 else ""
            current_st["segments"] = current_transaction_segments
            # Parse known transaction types
            txn_type = current_st.get("transaction_id", "")
            if txn_type == "850":
                current_st["parsed"] = _parse_x12_850(current_transaction_segments)
            elif txn_type == "810":
                current_st["parsed"] = _parse_x12_810(current_transaction_segments)
            elif txn_type == "856":
                current_st["parsed"] = _parse_x12_856(current_transaction_segments)
            elif txn_type == "997":
                current_st["parsed"] = _parse_x12_997(current_transaction_segments)
            current_st = None

        elif current_st is not None:
            current_transaction_segments.append(elements)

    return result


def _parse_x12_850(segments: list) -> dict:
    """Parse X12 850 Purchase Order into ERPNext-friendly dict."""
    po = {"order_number": "", "order_date": "", "vendor": "", "line_items": [], "total": 0.0}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BEG":
            po["order_number"] = elems[3] if len(elems) > 3 else ""
            po["order_date"] = elems[5] if len(elems) > 5 else ""
        elif tag == "N1" and len(elems) > 2 and elems[1] == "SE":
            po["vendor"] = elems[2]
        elif tag == "PO1":
            item = {
                "line_number": elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "",
                "quantity": float(elems[2]) if len(elems) > 2 and elems[2] else 0,
                "uom": elems[3] if len(elems) > 3 else "EA",
                "unit_price": float(elems[4]) if len(elems) > 4 and elems[4] else 0,
                "item_code": elems[7] if len(elems) > 7 else "",
            }
            po["line_items"].append(item)
            po["total"] += item["quantity"] * item["unit_price"]
    return po


def _parse_x12_810(segments: list) -> dict:
    """Parse X12 810 Invoice."""
    inv = {"invoice_number": "", "invoice_date": "", "po_number": "", "line_items": [], "total": 0.0}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BIG":
            inv["invoice_date"] = elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else ""
            inv["invoice_number"] = elems[2] if len(elems) > 2 else ""
            inv["po_number"] = elems[4] if len(elems) > 4 else ""
        elif tag == "IT1":
            item = {
                "quantity": float(elems[2]) if len(elems) > 2 and elems[2] else 0,
                "uom": elems[3] if len(elems) > 3 else "EA",
                "unit_price": float(elems[4]) if len(elems) > 4 and elems[4] else 0,
                "item_code": elems[7] if len(elems) > 7 else "",
            }
            inv["line_items"].append(item)
            inv["total"] += item["quantity"] * item["unit_price"]
    return inv


def _parse_x12_856(segments: list) -> dict:
    """Parse X12 856 Advance Ship Notice."""
    asn = {"shipment_id": "", "ship_date": "", "carrier": "", "tracking": "", "packages": []}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BSN":
            asn["shipment_id"] = elems[2] if len(elems) > 2 else ""
            asn["ship_date"] = elems[3] if len(elems) > 3 else ""
        elif tag == "TD5":
            asn["carrier"] = elems[3] if len(elems) > 3 else ""
        elif tag == "REF" and len(elems) > 2 and elems[1] == "CN":
            asn["tracking"] = elems[2]
    return asn


def _parse_x12_997(segments: list) -> dict:
    """Parse 997 Functional Acknowledgment."""
    ack = {"accepted": True, "error_codes": [], "ack_code": "A"}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "AK9":
            ack["ack_code"] = elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "A"
            ack["accepted"] = ack["ack_code"] == "A"
        elif tag == "IK5":
            ack["ack_code"] = elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "A"
            ack["accepted"] = ack["ack_code"] == "A"
        elif tag == "IK4" and len(elems) > 3:
            ack["error_codes"].append(elems[3])
    return ack


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.2 — EDIFACT Parser
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

EDIFACT_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR = "'"
EDIFACT_ELEMENT_SEPARATOR = "+"
EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR = ":"

SUPPORTED_EDIFACT_MESSAGES = {
    "ORDERS": "Purchase Order",
    "INVOIC": "Invoice",
    "DESADV": "Despatch Advice",
    "APERAK": "Application Error Acknowledgment",
}


def parse_edifact(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse EDIFACT interchange into structured dict."""
    raw = raw.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "")
    segments = [s.strip() for s in raw.split(EDIFACT_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR) if s.strip()]

    result = {"interchange": {}, "messages": []}
    current_message: dict | None = None
    current_segments: list[list[str]] = []

    for seg in segments:
        elements = seg.split(EDIFACT_ELEMENT_SEPARATOR)
        tag = elements[0].upper()

        if tag == "UNB":
            result["interchange"] = {
                "syntax": elements[1].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)[0] if len(elements) > 1 else "",
                "sender": elements[2].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)[0] if len(elements) > 2 else "",
                "recipient": elements[3].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)[0] if len(elements) > 3 else "",
                "date": elements[4].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)[0] if len(elements) > 4 else "",
                "control_ref": elements[5] if len(elements) > 5 else "",
            }

        elif tag == "UNH":
            msg_type = ""
            if len(elements) > 2:
                parts = elements[2].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
                msg_type = parts[0] if parts else ""
            current_message = {
                "reference": elements[1] if len(elements) > 1 else "",
                "type": msg_type,
                "segments": [],
                "parsed": {},
            }
            current_segments = []
            result["messages"].append(current_message)

        elif tag == "UNT" and current_message is not None:
            current_message["segments"] = current_segments
            msg_type = current_message.get("type", "")
            if msg_type == "ORDERS":
                current_message["parsed"] = _parse_edifact_orders(current_segments)
            elif msg_type == "INVOIC":
                current_message["parsed"] = _parse_edifact_invoic(current_segments)
            elif msg_type == "DESADV":
                current_message["parsed"] = _parse_edifact_desadv(current_segments)
            current_message = None

        elif current_message is not None:
            current_segments.append(elements)

    return result


def _parse_edifact_orders(segments: list) -> dict:
    order = {"order_number": "", "order_date": "", "buyer": "", "supplier": "", "line_items": []}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BGM":
            order["order_number"] = elems[2] if len(elems) > 2 else ""
        elif tag == "DTM" and len(elems) > 1:
            parts = elems[1].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
            if parts[0] == "137" and len(parts) > 1:
                order["order_date"] = parts[1]
        elif tag == "NAD":
            qualifier = elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else ""
            name = elems[4] if len(elems) > 4 else ""
            if qualifier == "BY":
                order["buyer"] = name
            elif qualifier == "SU":
                order["supplier"] = name
        elif tag == "LIN":
            item: dict = {"line": elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "", "item_code": ""}
            if len(elems) > 3:
                parts = elems[3].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
                item["item_code"] = parts[0] if parts else ""
            order["line_items"].append(item)
        elif tag == "QTY" and order["line_items"]:
            parts = (elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "").split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
            if len(parts) > 1:
                try:
                    order["line_items"][-1]["quantity"] = float(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        elif tag == "PRI" and order["line_items"]:
            parts = (elems[1] if len(elems) > 1 else "").split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
            if len(parts) > 1:
                try:
                    order["line_items"][-1]["unit_price"] = float(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    return order


def _parse_edifact_invoic(segments: list) -> dict:
    inv = {"invoice_number": "", "invoice_date": "", "line_items": [], "total": 0.0}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BGM":
            inv["invoice_number"] = elems[2] if len(elems) > 2 else ""
        elif tag == "MOA" and len(elems) > 1:
            parts = elems[1].split(EDIFACT_COMPONENT_SEPARATOR)
            if len(parts) > 1 and parts[0] == "9":
                try:
                    inv["total"] = float(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    return inv


def _parse_edifact_desadv(segments: list) -> dict:
    adv = {"despatch_id": "", "ship_date": "", "packages": []}
    for elems in segments:
        tag = elems[0].upper()
        if tag == "BGM":
            adv["despatch_id"] = elems[2] if len(elems) > 2 else ""
    return adv


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.3 — EDI Serializer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def serialize_to_x12_850(po_doc: dict, sender_id: str, receiver_id: str) -> str:
    """Serialize an ERPNext PO-like dict to X12 850."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%y%m%d")
    time_str = now.strftime("%H%M")
    ctrl = now.strftime("%d%H%M")

    items = po_doc.get("items", [])
    item_segs = []
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        item_segs.append(
            f"PO1*{i}*{item.get('qty', 0)}*EA*{item.get('rate', 0)}**IN*{item.get('item_code', '')}"
        )

    lines = [
        f"ISA*00*          *00*          *01*{sender_id:<15}*01*{receiver_id:<15}*{date_str}*{time_str}*^*00501*{ctrl}*0*P*:",
        f"GS*PO*{sender_id}*{receiver_id}*{date_str}*{time_str}*{ctrl}*X*005010",
        f"ST*850*{ctrl}",
        f"BEG*00*NE*{po_doc.get('name', '')}**{date_str}",
        *item_segs,
        f"CTT*{len(items)}",
        f"SE*{4 + len(items)}*{ctrl}",
        f"GE*1*{ctrl}",
        f"IEA*1*{ctrl}",
    ]
    return (X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR + "\n").join(lines) + X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR


def serialize_to_x12_856(dn_doc: dict, sender_id: str, receiver_id: str) -> str:
    """Serialize a Delivery Note to X12 856 ASN."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%y%m%d")
    time_str = now.strftime("%H%M")
    ctrl = now.strftime("%d%H%M")

    lines = [
        f"ISA*00*          *00*          *01*{sender_id:<15}*01*{receiver_id:<15}*{date_str}*{time_str}*^*00501*{ctrl}*0*P*:",
        f"GS*SH*{sender_id}*{receiver_id}*{date_str}*{time_str}*{ctrl}*X*005010",
        f"ST*856*{ctrl}",
        f"BSN*00*{dn_doc.get('name', '')}*{date_str}*{time_str}*0002",
        f"HL*1**S",
        f"TD5***{dn_doc.get('carrier', 'CARRIER')}",
        f"SE*5*{ctrl}",
        f"GE*1*{ctrl}",
        f"IEA*1*{ctrl}",
    ]
    return (X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR + "\n").join(lines) + X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR


def serialize_to_x12_810(invoice_doc: dict, sender_id: str, receiver_id: str) -> str:
    """Serialize Sales Invoice to X12 810."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%y%m%d")
    ctrl = now.strftime("%d%H%M")

    items = invoice_doc.get("items", [])
    item_segs = []
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        item_segs.append(
            f"IT1*{i}*{item.get('qty', 0)}*EA*{item.get('rate', 0)}**IN*{item.get('item_code', '')}"
        )

    lines = [
        f"ISA*00*          *00*          *01*{sender_id:<15}*01*{receiver_id:<15}*{date_str}*0000*^*00501*{ctrl}*0*P*:",
        f"GS*IN*{sender_id}*{receiver_id}*{date_str}*0000*{ctrl}*X*005010",
        f"ST*810*{ctrl}",
        f"BIG*{date_str}*{invoice_doc.get('name', '')}**{invoice_doc.get('po_no', '')}",
        *item_segs,
        f"TDS*{int((invoice_doc.get('grand_total', 0)) * 100)}",
        f"SE*{4 + len(items)}*{ctrl}",
        f"GE*1*{ctrl}",
        f"IEA*1*{ctrl}",
    ]
    return (X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR + "\n").join(lines) + X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR


def serialize_to_edifact_orders(po_doc: dict, sender: str, recipient: str) -> str:
    """Serialize ERPNext PO to EDIFACT ORDERS."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    time_str = now.strftime("%H%M")
    ctrl = now.strftime("%d%H%M")

    items = po_doc.get("items", [])
    item_segs = []
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        item_segs.extend([
            f"LIN+{i}++{item.get('item_code', '')}:SA",
            f"QTY+21:{item.get('qty', 0)}:PCE",
            f"PRI+AAA:{item.get('rate', 0)}:CA",
        ])

    lines = [
        f"UNB+UNOC:3+{sender}:14+{recipient}:14+{date_str}:{time_str}+{ctrl}'",
        f"UNH+1+ORDERS:D:96A:UN:EAN008'",
        f"BGM+220+{po_doc.get('name', '')}+9'",
        f"DTM+137:{date_str}:102'",
        f"NAD+BY+++{po_doc.get('company', '')}++++++IN'",
        f"NAD+SU+++{po_doc.get('supplier', '')}++++++IN'",
        *item_segs,
        f"UNT+{6 + len(item_segs)}+1'",
        f"UNZ+1+{ctrl}'",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.4 & 11.5 — AS2 Engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def as2_send(trading_partner_name: str, edi_content: str,
             content_type: str = "application/edi-x12") -> dict:
    """Send EDI document via AS2 to a trading partner."""
    partner = frappe.get_doc("FB EDI Trading Partner", trading_partner_name)
    if not partner:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Trading partner '{trading_partner_name}' not found"))

    message_id = f"<{datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}.{trading_partner_name}@flowbridge>"
    payload = edi_content.encode()

    # Sign with sender private key (if configured)
    signed_payload = _sign_as2_message(payload, partner)

    # Encrypt with recipient public key (if configured)
    final_payload = _encrypt_as2_message(signed_payload, partner)

    import urllib.request
    headers = {
        "AS2-From": partner.as2_sender_id or "flowbridge",
        "AS2-To": partner.as2_receiver_id or trading_partner_name,
        "AS2-Version": "1.2",
        "Message-ID": message_id,
        "MIME-Version": "1.0",
        "Content-Type": content_type,
        "Subject": "EDI Document",
        "Disposition-Notification-To": partner.as2_mdn_url or "",
    }

    req = urllib.request.Request(
        partner.as2_endpoint_url,
        data=final_payload,
        headers=headers,
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            mdn_body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            status = "sent"
    except Exception as e:
        mdn_body = str(e)
        status = "error"

    _log_edi_event(trading_partner_name, "send", message_id, status, edi_content[:500])

    return {
        "message_id": message_id,
        "status": status,
        "mdn": mdn_body[:1000],
    }


@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def as2_receive():
    """Receive an AS2 inbound message and parse the EDI content."""
    body = frappe.request.get_data()
    headers = frappe.request.headers

    as2_from = headers.get("AS2-From", "")
    message_id = headers.get("Message-ID", "")
    content_type = headers.get("Content-Type", "")

    # Find trading partner
    partner_name = frappe.db.get_value("FB EDI Trading Partner",
                                        {"as2_receiver_id": as2_from}, "name")

    # Decrypt + verify (if partner configured)
    decrypted = _decrypt_as2_message(body)
    edi_text = decrypted.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    # Detect format and parse
    if "ISA*" in edi_text:
        parsed = parse_x12(edi_text)
        fmt = "X12"
    elif "UNB+" in edi_text:
        parsed = parse_edifact(edi_text)
        fmt = "EDIFACT"
    else:
        parsed = {}
        fmt = "unknown"

    _log_edi_event(partner_name or as2_from, "receive", message_id, "received",
                   edi_text[:500], fmt=fmt, parsed=parsed)

    # Route to a flow if trading partner has inbound flow configured
    if partner_name:
        partner = frappe.get_doc("FB EDI Trading Partner", partner_name)
        if partner.inbound_flow:
            try:
                from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import trigger_flow
                trigger_flow(partner.inbound_flow, {
                    "edi_format": fmt,
                    "edi_content": edi_text,
                    "parsed": parsed,
                    "as2_from": as2_from,
                    "message_id": message_id,
                })
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(f"AS2 inbound flow trigger failed: {e}")

    # Send synchronous MDN
    mdn = _build_mdn(message_id, as2_from, "processed")
    frappe.response["type"] = "text"
    frappe.response["result"] = mdn
    return mdn


def _sign_as2_message(payload: bytes, partner) -> bytes:
    private_key_pem = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB EDI Trading Partner", partner.name, "private_key_pem"
    ) if hasattr(partner, "private_key_pem") and partner.private_key_pem else ""
    if not private_key_pem:
        return payload
    try:
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import padding
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization
        key = serialization.load_pem_private_key(private_key_pem.encode(), password=None)
        sig = key.sign(payload, padding.PKCS1v15(), hashes.SHA256())
        return payload + b"\r\n--sig--\r\n" + sig
    except Exception:
        return payload


def _encrypt_as2_message(payload: bytes, partner) -> bytes:
    # Stub — real AS2 uses S/MIME CMS encryption; return payload unencrypted if no cert
    return payload


def _decrypt_as2_message(payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    # Strip signature separator if present
    if b"\r\n--sig--\r\n" in payload:
        return payload.split(b"\r\n--sig--\r\n")[0]
    return payload


def _build_mdn(original_message_id: str, as2_from: str, disposition: str) -> str:
    return textwrap.dedent(f"""
        MIME-Version: 1.0
        Content-Type: multipart/report; report-type=disposition-notification

        --boundary
        Content-Type: text/plain

        The EDI document was {disposition}.

        --boundary
        Content-Type: message/disposition-notification

        Original-Message-ID: {original_message_id}
        Final-Recipient: rfc822; {as2_from}
        Disposition: automatic-action/MDN-sent-automatically; {disposition}

        --boundary--
    """).strip()

# 11.8 — Trading Partner Management

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_trading_partner(name: str, as2_sender_id: str, as2_receiver_id: str,
                            as2_endpoint_url: str, as2_mdn_url: str = "",
                            inbound_flow: str = "", outbound_format: str = "X12") -> dict:
    if frappe.db.exists("FB EDI Trading Partner", name):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Trading partner '{name}' already exists"))
    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB EDI Trading Partner",
        "partner_name": name,
        "as2_sender_id": as2_sender_id,
        "as2_receiver_id": as2_receiver_id,
        "as2_endpoint_url": as2_endpoint_url,
        "as2_mdn_url": as2_mdn_url,
        "inbound_flow": inbound_flow,
        "outbound_format": outbound_format,
        "is_active": 1,
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"name": doc.name, "status": "created"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_trading_partners(active_only: bool = True) -> list:
    filters = {"is_active": 1} if active_only else {}
    return frappe.get_all("FB EDI Trading Partner",
                          filters=filters,
                          fields=["name", "partner_name", "as2_sender_id",
                                  "as2_receiver_id", "outbound_format", "is_active"])


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_trading_partner_stats(partner_name: str) -> dict:
    sent = frappe.db.count("FB EDI Audit Log",
                            {"trading_partner": partner_name, "direction": "send"})
    received = frappe.db.count("FB EDI Audit Log",
                                {"trading_partner": partner_name, "direction": "receive"})
    errors = frappe.db.count("FB EDI Audit Log",
                              {"trading_partner": partner_name, "status": "error"})
    return {"partner": partner_name, "sent": sent, "received": received, "errors": errors}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.9 — 997 Functional Acknowledgment
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_997(original_x12: str, sender_id: str, receiver_id: str,
                 accepted: bool = True) -> str:
    """Auto-generate a 997 FA for a received X12 document."""
    parsed = parse_x12(original_x12)
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%y%m%d")
    time_str = now.strftime("%H%M")
    ctrl = now.strftime("%d%H%M")

    isa_ctrl = ""
    gs_ctrl = ""
    txn_id = ""
    for env in parsed.get("envelopes", []):
        isa_ctrl = env.get("control_number", ctrl)
        for grp in env.get("groups", []):
            gs_ctrl = grp.get("control_number", ctrl)
            for txn in grp.get("transactions", []):
                txn_id = txn.get("transaction_id", "")

    ack_code = "A" if accepted else "R"

    lines = [
        f"ISA*00*          *00*          *01*{sender_id:<15}*01*{receiver_id:<15}*{date_str}*{time_str}*^*00501*{ctrl}*0*P*:",
        f"GS*FA*{sender_id}*{receiver_id}*{date_str}*{time_str}*{ctrl}*X*005010",
        f"ST*997*{ctrl}",
        f"AK1*{txn_id}*{gs_ctrl}",
        f"AK9*{ack_code}*1*1*{'1' if accepted else '0'}",
        f"SE*4*{ctrl}",
        f"GE*1*{ctrl}",
        f"IEA*1*{isa_ctrl}",
    ]
    return (X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR + "\n").join(lines) + X12_SEGMENT_TERMINATOR


@frappe.whitelist()
def send_997(trading_partner_name: str, original_x12: str) -> dict:
    """Generate and send a 997 FA to a trading partner."""
    partner = frappe.get_doc("FB EDI Trading Partner", trading_partner_name)
    fa = generate_997(original_x12, partner.as2_sender_id, partner.as2_receiver_id)
    return as2_send(trading_partner_name, fa)

@frappe.whitelist()
def install_edi_flow(flow_key: str) -> dict:
    if flow_key not in PRE_BUILT_EDI_FLOWS:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Unknown EDI flow key: {flow_key}. Options: {list(PRE_BUILT_EDI_FLOWS.keys())}"))
    flow_def = PRE_BUILT_EDI_FLOWS[flow_key]
    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import import_flow
    return import_flow({"version": "flowbridge/v1", **flow_def}, overwrite=False)


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_edi_flows() -> list:
    return [{"key": k, "flow_name": v["flow_name"], "description": v["description"]}
            for k, v in PRE_BUILT_EDI_FLOWS.items()]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.14 — EDI Compliance Dashboard
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_edi_compliance_dashboard(partner_name: str = "", days: int = 30) -> dict:
    since = frappe.utils.add_days(now_datetime(), -days)
    filters = {"creation": [">", since]}
    if partner_name:
        filters["trading_partner"] = partner_name

    logs = frappe.get_all("FB EDI Audit Log", filters=filters,
                          fields=["trading_partner", "direction", "status",
                                  "message_type", "creation"])

    by_partner: dict = {}
    for log in logs:
        p = log["trading_partner"]
        if p not in by_partner:
            by_partner[p] = {"sent": 0, "received": 0, "errors": 0, "acked": 0}
        if log["direction"] == "send":
            by_partner[p]["sent"] += 1
        elif log["direction"] == "receive":
            by_partner[p]["received"] += 1
        if log["status"] == "error":
            by_partner[p]["errors"] += 1
        elif log["status"] == "acked":
            by_partner[p]["acked"] += 1

    total = len(logs)
    errors = sum(1 for l in logs if l["status"] == "error")

    return {
        "period_days": days,
        "total_documents": total,
        "total_errors": errors,
        "error_rate_pct": round(errors / total * 100, 1) if total else 0,
        "by_partner": by_partner,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.15 — EDI Audit Trail (hash-chained)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _log_edi_event(trading_partner: str, direction: str, message_id: str,
                   status: str, content_preview: str,
                   fmt: str = "X12", parsed: dict | None = None):
    """Write a hash-chained audit log entry for tamper detection."""
    # Get previous entry hash for chain
    last = frappe.db.get_value("FB EDI Audit Log",
                               {"trading_partner": trading_partner},
                               "entry_hash",
                               order_by="creation desc")
    prev_hash = last or "0" * 64

    payload_str = json.dumps({
        "trading_partner": trading_partner,
        "direction": direction,
        "message_id": message_id,
        "status": status,
        "content_preview": content_preview,
        "ts": str(now_datetime()),
        "prev_hash": prev_hash,
    }, sort_keys=True)
    entry_hash = hashlib.sha256(payload_str.encode()).hexdigest()

    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB EDI Audit Log",
        "trading_partner": trading_partner,
        "direction": direction,
        "message_id": message_id,
        "message_type": fmt,
        "status": status,
        "content_preview": content_preview[:500],
        "prev_hash": prev_hash,
        "entry_hash": entry_hash,
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)


@frappe.whitelist()
def verify_edi_audit_chain(partner_name: str = "", limit: int = 100) -> dict:
    """Verify the hash chain integrity of EDI audit logs."""
    filters = {}
    if partner_name:
        filters["trading_partner"] = partner_name
    logs = frappe.get_all("FB EDI Audit Log", filters=filters,
                          fields=["name", "trading_partner", "direction", "message_id",
                                  "status", "content_preview", "prev_hash", "entry_hash",
                                  "creation"],
                          order_by="creation asc", limit=limit)
    violations = []
    prev_hash = "0" * 64
    for log in logs:
        if log["prev_hash"] != prev_hash:
            violations.append({"entry": log["name"], "expected": prev_hash,
                                "found": log["prev_hash"]})
        prev_hash = log["entry_hash"]

    return {"total": len(logs), "violations": violations, "integrity": len(violations) == 0}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.16 — ICEGATE Connector (India Customs)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def icegate_submit_shipping_bill(export_doc: dict | str) -> dict:
    """Submit a Shipping Bill to ICEGATE (India Customs)."""
    if isinstance(export_doc, str):
        export_doc = json.loads(export_doc)

    # ICEGATE REST API — sandbox endpoint
    sandbox = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "icegate_use_sandbox") or True
    base_url = "https://www.icegate.gov.in/ws" if not sandbox else "https://sbtest.icegate.gov.in/ws"

    payload = {
        "IeCode": export_doc.get("iec_code", ""),
        "SBNo": export_doc.get("shipping_bill_no", ""),
        "SBDate": export_doc.get("shipping_bill_date", ""),
        "PortCode": export_doc.get("port_code", "INBOM4"),
        "InvoiceNo": export_doc.get("invoice_no", ""),
        "InvoiceDate": export_doc.get("invoice_date", ""),
        "TotalFobValueInINR": export_doc.get("fob_value_inr", 0),
        "Currency": export_doc.get("currency", "INR"),
        "ExchangeRate": export_doc.get("exchange_rate", 1),
    }

    import urllib.request
    token = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "icegate_api_token") or ""
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base_url}/shippingbill",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json",
                 "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read())
            return {"status": "submitted", "response": result}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}


@frappe.whitelist()
def icegate_get_sb_status(shipping_bill_no: str, port_code: str) -> dict:
    """Get Shipping Bill status from ICEGATE."""
    import urllib.request
    sandbox = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "icegate_use_sandbox") or True
    base_url = "https://www.icegate.gov.in/ws" if not sandbox else "https://sbtest.icegate.gov.in/ws"
    token = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "icegate_api_token") or ""
    url = f"{base_url}/shippingbill/status?sb_no={shipping_bill_no}&port_code={port_code}"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read())
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

    """Parse raw EDI and return structured result for the Studio UI."""
    raw_edi = cstr(raw_edi).strip()

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/etl.py
"""
FlowBridge ETL Pipeline Builder — Phase 5, items 5.6–5.9
Extract → Transform → Load pipeline with BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift,
Postgres targets. Reverse ETL (warehouse → ERPNext) included.
"""
import json
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.6 — Extract
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_etl_pipeline(name: str, source_type: str, source_config: str = "{}",
                        transform_steps: str = "[]", destination_type: str = "erpnext",
                        destination_config: str = "{}", schedule: str = "daily") -> dict:
    """Create or update an ETL pipeline definition."""
    cfg_src = json.loads(source_config) if isinstance(source_config, str) else source_config
    cfg_dst = json.loads(destination_config) if isinstance(destination_config, str) else destination_config
    steps = json.loads(transform_steps) if isinstance(transform_steps, str) else transform_steps

    if frappe.db.exists("FB ETL Pipeline", name):
        frappe.db.set_value("FB ETL Pipeline", name, {
            "source_type": source_type,
            "source_config_json": json.dumps(cfg_src),
            "transform_steps_json": json.dumps(steps),
            "destination_type": destination_type,
            "destination_config_json": json.dumps(cfg_dst),
            "schedule": schedule,
        })
    else:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB ETL Pipeline",
            "pipeline_name": name,
            "source_type": source_type,
            "source_config_json": json.dumps(cfg_src),
            "transform_steps_json": json.dumps(steps),
            "destination_type": destination_type,
            "destination_config_json": json.dumps(cfg_dst),
            "schedule": schedule,
            "is_active": 1,
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"created": True, "name": name}


@frappe.whitelist()
def run_etl_pipeline(pipeline_name: str, dry_run: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Execute an ETL pipeline synchronously (for small datasets) or enqueue."""
    pipeline = frappe.get_doc("FB ETL Pipeline", pipeline_name)
    if int(dry_run):
        rows = _extract(pipeline)
        transformed = _transform(rows, pipeline)
        return {"dry_run": True, "extracted": len(rows), "transformed_sample": transformed[:3]}

    run_doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB ETL Run",
        "pipeline": pipeline_name,
        "status": "Running",
        "started_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    run_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    frappe.enqueue(
        "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.etl._run_pipeline_async",
        pipeline_name=pipeline_name,
        run_name=run_doc.name,
        queue="long",
        timeout=3600,
    )
    return {"run": run_doc.name, "status": "Running"}


def _run_pipeline_async(pipeline_name: str, run_name: str):
    try:
        pipeline = frappe.get_doc("FB ETL Pipeline", pipeline_name)
        rows = _extract(pipeline)
        transformed = _transform(rows, pipeline)
        loaded = _load(transformed, pipeline)
        frappe.db.set_value("FB ETL Run", run_name, {
            "status": "Success",
            "completed_at": now_datetime(),
            "rows_extracted": len(rows),
            "rows_loaded": loaded,
        })
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB ETL Run", run_name, {
            "status": "Failed",
            "completed_at": now_datetime(),
            "error": str(e)[:500],
        })
        frappe.log_error(str(e), f"ETL Pipeline {pipeline_name}")
    frappe.db.commit()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract implementations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _extract(pipeline) -> list:
    cfg = json.loads(pipeline.source_config_json or "{}")
    src = pipeline.source_type

    if src == "erpnext":
        return _extract_erpnext(cfg)
    elif src == "connector":
        return _extract_connector(cfg)
    elif src == "sql":
        return _extract_sql(cfg)
    elif src == "csv":
        return _extract_csv(cfg)
    elif src == "json_api":
        return _extract_json_api(cfg)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown source type: {src}")


def _extract_erpnext(cfg: dict) -> list:
    doctype = cfg.get("doctype")
    filters = cfg.get("filters", {})
    fields = cfg.get("fields", ["*"])
    limit = cfg.get("limit", 10000)
    return frappe.get_all(doctype, filters=filters, fields=fields, limit=limit, as_list=False)


def _extract_connector(cfg: dict) -> list:
    import requests
    connector_name = cfg.get("connector")
    endpoint_name = cfg.get("endpoint")
    connector = frappe.get_doc("FB Connector", connector_name)
    endpoint = next((e for e in connector.endpoints if e.endpoint_name == endpoint_name), None)
    if not endpoint:
        raise ValueError(f"Endpoint {endpoint_name} not found on {connector_name}")
    resp = requests.request(
        endpoint.method or "GET",
        connector.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/" + endpoint.path.lstrip("/"),
        timeout=60,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return data
    return data.get(cfg.get("data_key", "data"), [data])


def _extract_sql(cfg: dict) -> list:
    query = cfg.get("query", "")
    if not query:
        return []
    rows = frappe.db.sql(query, as_dict=True)
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def _extract_csv(cfg: dict) -> list:
    import csv, io
    content = cfg.get("content", "")
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(content))
    return list(reader)


def _extract_json_api(cfg: dict) -> list:
    import requests
    resp = requests.get(cfg.get("url"), headers=cfg.get("headers", {}), timeout=60)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    key = cfg.get("data_key", "")
    if key and isinstance(data, dict):
        data = data.get(key, [])
    return data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.7 — Transform
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _transform(rows: list, pipeline) -> list:
    steps = json.loads(pipeline.transform_steps_json or "[]")
    for step in steps:
        op = step.get("op", "")
        if op == "rename":
            rows = _tf_rename(rows, step.get("mapping", {}))
        elif op == "filter":
            rows = _tf_filter(rows, step.get("field"), step.get("value"), step.get("operator", "eq"))
        elif op == "add_field":
            rows = _tf_add_field(rows, step.get("field"), step.get("expr"))
        elif op == "drop_fields":
            rows = _tf_drop_fields(rows, step.get("fields", []))
        elif op == "cast":
            rows = _tf_cast(rows, step.get("field"), step.get("to_type"))
        elif op == "flatten":
            rows = _tf_flatten(rows, step.get("field"), step.get("prefix", ""))
        elif op == "deduplicate":
            rows = _tf_deduplicate(rows, step.get("key"))
        elif op == "mask_pii":
            rows = _tf_mask_pii(rows)
    return rows


def _tf_rename(rows, mapping: dict) -> list:
    return [{mapping.get(k, k): v for k, v in r.items()} for r in rows]


def _tf_filter(rows, field, value, operator) -> list:
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        rv = r.get(field)
        if operator == "eq" and rv == value:
            out.append(r)
        elif operator == "neq" and rv != value:
            out.append(r)
        elif operator == "gt" and rv > value:
            out.append(r)
        elif operator == "lt" and rv < value:
            out.append(r)
        elif operator == "contains" and value in str(rv or ""):
            out.append(r)
    return out


def _tf_add_field(rows, field, expr) -> list:
    import jinja2
    env = jinja2.Environment()
    tmpl = env.from_string(str(expr or ""))
    return [{**r, field: tmpl.render(**r)} for r in rows]


def _tf_drop_fields(rows, fields: list) -> list:
    return [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in fields} for r in rows]


def _tf_cast(rows, field, to_type) -> list:
    casters = {"int": int, "float": float, "str": str, "bool": bool}
    fn = casters.get(to_type, str)
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        try:
            out.append({**r, field: fn(r[field])})
        except Exception:
            out.append(r)
    return out


def _tf_flatten(rows, field, prefix) -> list:
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        nested = r.pop(field, {}) or {}
        if isinstance(nested, dict):
            for k, v in nested.items():
                r[f"{prefix}{k}" if prefix else k] = v
        result.append(r)
    return result


def _tf_deduplicate(rows, key) -> list:
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        k = r.get(key)
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            out.append(r)
    return out


def _tf_mask_pii(rows) -> list:
    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.compliance import mask_pii_in_dict
    return [mask_pii_in_dict(r) for r in rows]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.8 — Load (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _load(rows: list, pipeline) -> int:
    cfg = json.loads(pipeline.destination_config_json or "{}")
    dst = pipeline.destination_type

    if dst == "erpnext":
        return _load_erpnext(rows, cfg)
    elif dst == "bigquery":
        return _load_bigquery(rows, cfg)
    elif dst == "snowflake":
        return _load_snowflake(rows, cfg)
    elif dst == "redshift":
        return _load_redshift(rows, cfg)
    elif dst == "postgres":
        return _load_postgres(rows, cfg)
    elif dst == "connector":
        return _load_connector(rows, cfg)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown destination type: {dst}")


def _load_erpnext(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    doctype = cfg.get("doctype")
    id_field = cfg.get("id_field", "name")
    loaded = 0
    for row in rows:
        try:
            if id_field in row and frappe.db.exists(doctype, row[id_field]):
                frappe.db.set_value(doctype, row[id_field], row)
            else:
                doc = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": doctype, **row})
                doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            loaded += 1
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(str(e), f"ETL Load ERPNext {doctype}")
    frappe.db.commit()
    return loaded


def _load_bigquery(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    try:
        from google.cloud import bigquery
        client = bigquery.Client(project=cfg.get("project"))
        table_id = f"{cfg.get('dataset')}.{cfg.get('table')}"
        errors = client.insert_rows_json(table_id, rows)
        if errors:
            frappe.log_error(str(errors), "ETL BigQuery Load")
        return len(rows) - len(errors)
    except ImportError:
        frappe.log_error("google-cloud-bigquery not installed", "ETL BigQuery")
        return 0


def _load_snowflake(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    try:
        import snowflake.connector
        conn = snowflake.connector.connect(
            account=cfg.get("account"),
            user=cfg.get("user"),
            password=cfg.get("password"),
            warehouse=cfg.get("warehouse"),
            database=cfg.get("database"),
            schema=cfg.get("schema", "PUBLIC"),
        )
        cur = conn.cursor()
        table = cfg.get("table")
        if rows:
            cols = list(rows[0].keys())
            placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(cols))
            col_str = ", ".join(cols)
            sql = f"INSERT INTO {table} ({col_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            cur.executemany(sql, [[r.get(c) for c in cols] for r in rows])
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        return len(rows)
    except ImportError:
        frappe.log_error("snowflake-connector-python not installed", "ETL Snowflake")
        return 0


def _load_redshift(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    # Redshift uses psycopg2 (same as postgres)
    return _load_postgres(rows, {**cfg, "_redshift": True})


def _load_postgres(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    try:
        import psycopg2, psycopg2.extras
        conn = psycopg2.connect(
            host=cfg.get("host", "localhost"),
            port=cfg.get("port", 5432),
            dbname=cfg.get("database"),
            user=cfg.get("user"),
            password=cfg.get("password"),
        )
        cur = conn.cursor()
        table = cfg.get("table")
        if rows:
            cols = list(rows[0].keys())
            col_str = ", ".join(cols)
            placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(cols))
            sql = f"INSERT INTO {table} ({col_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            psycopg2.extras.execute_batch(cur, sql, [[r.get(c) for c in cols] for r in rows])
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        return len(rows)
    except ImportError:
        frappe.log_error("psycopg2 not installed", "ETL Postgres")
        return 0


def _load_connector(rows: list, cfg: dict) -> int:
    import requests
    url = cfg.get("url", "")
    headers = cfg.get("headers", {})
    loaded = 0
    for row in rows:
        try:
            resp = requests.post(url, json=row, headers=headers, timeout=30)
            if resp.ok:
                loaded += 1
        except Exception:
            pass
    return loaded


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.9 — Reverse ETL (warehouse → ERPNext)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def run_reverse_etl(source_type: str, source_config: str = "{}",
                    target_doctype: str = "", field_mapping: str = "{}",
                    id_field: str = "name") -> dict:
    """
    Pull data from a warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres, Redshift)
    and upsert into an ERPNext DocType.
    """
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    cfg = json.loads(source_config) if isinstance(source_config, str) else source_config
    mapping = json.loads(field_mapping) if isinstance(field_mapping, str) else field_mapping

    rows = _extract_warehouse(source_type, cfg)
    loaded = 0
    errors = []
    for row in rows:
        mapped = {mapping.get(k, k): v for k, v in row.items()} if mapping else row
        try:
            if id_field in mapped and frappe.db.exists(target_doctype, mapped[id_field]):
                frappe.db.set_value(target_doctype, mapped[id_field], mapped)
            else:
                doc = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": target_doctype, **mapped})
                doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            loaded += 1
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append(str(e)[:200])
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"loaded": loaded, "errors": errors[:10], "total": len(rows)}


def _extract_warehouse(source_type: str, cfg: dict) -> list:
    if source_type == "postgres":
        return _extract_from_pg(cfg)
    elif source_type == "bigquery":
        return _extract_from_bq(cfg)
    elif source_type == "snowflake":
        return _extract_from_snowflake(cfg)
    elif source_type == "sql":
        return _extract_sql(cfg)
    return []


def _extract_from_pg(cfg: dict) -> list:
    try:
        import psycopg2, psycopg2.extras
        conn = psycopg2.connect(
            host=cfg.get("host", "localhost"), port=cfg.get("port", 5432),
            dbname=cfg.get("database"), user=cfg.get("user"), password=cfg.get("password"),
        )
        cur = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=psycopg2.extras.RealDictCursor)
        cur.execute(cfg.get("query", f"SELECT * FROM {cfg.get('table')} LIMIT 10000"))
        rows = [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
        conn.close()
        return rows
    except ImportError:
        return []


def _extract_from_bq(cfg: dict) -> list:
    try:
        from google.cloud import bigquery
        client = bigquery.Client(project=cfg.get("project"))
        query = cfg.get("query", f"SELECT * FROM `{cfg.get('dataset')}.{cfg.get('table')}` LIMIT 10000")
        return [dict(row) for row in client.query(query).result()]
    except ImportError:
        return []


def _extract_from_snowflake(cfg: dict) -> list:
    try:
        import snowflake.connector
        conn = snowflake.connector.connect(
            account=cfg.get("account"), user=cfg.get("user"), password=cfg.get("password"),
            warehouse=cfg.get("warehouse"), database=cfg.get("database"), schema=cfg.get("schema", "PUBLIC"),
        )
        cur = conn.cursor(snowflake.connector.DictCursor)
        cur.execute(cfg.get("query", f"SELECT * FROM {cfg.get('table')} LIMIT 10000"))
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return rows
    except ImportError:
        return []

@frappe.whitelist()
def list_etl_runs(pipeline_name: str = "", limit: int = 20) -> list:
    filters = {}
    if pipeline_name:
        filters["pipeline"] = pipeline_name
    return frappe.get_all(
        "FB ETL Run",
        filters=filters,
        fields=["name", "pipeline", "status", "started_at", "completed_at",
                "rows_extracted", "rows_loaded", "error"],
        order_by="started_at desc",
        limit=int(limit),
    )


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_etl_pipelines() -> list:
    return frappe.get_all(
        "FB ETL Pipeline",
        fields=["pipeline_name", "source_type", "destination_type", "schedule", "is_active"],
        order_by="pipeline_name",
    )


def run_scheduled_etl_pipelines():
    """Scheduler: run all active daily pipelines."""
    pipelines = frappe.get_all("FB ETL Pipeline", filters={"is_active": 1, "schedule": "daily"},
                               fields=["pipeline_name"])
    for p in pipelines:
        try:
            run_etl_pipeline(p.pipeline_name)
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(str(e), f"ETL Scheduler {p.pipeline_name}")

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/event_queue.py
"""
FlowBridge Durable Event Queue — Phase 5, items 5.17–5.20

5.17 — Durable Event Queue: persist-first (MariaDB record before Redis enqueue)
5.18 — Dead Letter Queue: management API (list, requeue, purge, inspect)
5.19 — Event replay from history (replay a time range or specific event IDs)
5.20 — Out-of-order event handling (sequence-number based ordering + gap buffer)

Architecture:
  - Every event written to FB Event record (MariaDB) BEFORE Redis enqueue
  - Redis LPUSH is best-effort; if Redis down, scheduler drains from MariaDB
  - DLQ: events that exhausted retries land in FB Event with status=dead
  - Replay: re-enqueue FB Event records by filter (time, flow, status)
  - Out-of-order: events carry sequence_number; gap buffer holds events
    whose predecessors haven't arrived yet (configurable max_gap_wait_seconds)
"""
import json
import uuid
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, get_datetime, add_to_date


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

QUEUE_KEY = "fb:queue:flow_runs"
DLQ_KEY = "fb:dlq:flow_runs"
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
GAP_BUFFER_KEY_PREFIX = "fb:ooo:buffer:"   # out-of-order buffer per flow
SEQ_CURSOR_KEY_PREFIX = "fb:ooo:seq:"      # last delivered sequence per flow


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.17 — Durable Event Queue (persist-first)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def enqueue_event(flow_name: str, payload: str = "{}",
                  trigger: str = "manual",
                  event_id: str = "",
                  sequence_number: int = 0,
                  dedup_window_seconds: int = 300) -> dict:
    """
    Persist-first enqueue: write FB Event to MariaDB, then push to Redis.
    Returns the event record name.
    """
    payload_dict = json.loads(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
    event_id = event_id or str(uuid.uuid4())

    # Deduplication check
    r = frappe.cache()
    dedup_key = f"fb:dedup:{event_id}"
    if dedup_window_seconds > 0:
        if not r.set(dedup_key, "1", nx=True, ex=int(dedup_window_seconds)):
            return {"status": "duplicate", "event_id": event_id}

    # Step 1: Persist to MariaDB (durable record)
    event_doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Event",
        "event_id": event_id,
        "flow_name": flow_name,
        "trigger": trigger,
        "payload_json": json.dumps(payload_dict),
        "status": "queued",
        "attempt": 0,
        "sequence_number": int(sequence_number),
        "enqueued_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    event_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    # Step 2: Push to Redis (best-effort)
    message = json.dumps({
        "event_name": event_doc.name,
        "flow_name": flow_name,
        "trigger": trigger,
        "attempt": 1,
        "sequence_number": int(sequence_number),
        "enqueued_at": event_doc.enqueued_at.isoformat() if hasattr(event_doc.enqueued_at, "isoformat") else str(event_doc.enqueued_at),
    })
    try:
        r.lpush(QUEUE_KEY, message)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.logger().warning(f"[EventQueue] Redis push failed (will drain from DB): {e}")

    return {"status": "queued", "event_name": event_doc.name, "event_id": event_id}


def drain_pending_to_redis(limit: int = 100):
    """
    Scheduled recovery: re-push any 'queued' events not yet in Redis.
    Called by hourly scheduler to recover from Redis restarts.
    """
    cutoff = add_to_date(now_datetime(), minutes=-2)
    pending = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Event",
        filters=[
            ["status", "=", "queued"],
            ["enqueued_at", "<", cutoff],
        ],
        fields=["name", "flow_name", "trigger", "sequence_number", "enqueued_at"],
        limit=limit,
        order_by="enqueued_at asc",
    )
    r = frappe.cache()
    pushed = 0
    for ev in pending:
        message = json.dumps({
            "event_name": ev.name,
            "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
            "trigger": ev.trigger,
            "attempt": 1,
            "sequence_number": ev.sequence_number or 0,
        })
        try:
            r.lpush(QUEUE_KEY, message)
            pushed += 1
        except Exception:
            break
    return pushed


def mark_event_processing(event_name: str, attempt: int = 1):
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", event_name, {
        "status": "processing",
        "attempt": attempt,
        "processing_started_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    frappe.db.commit()


def mark_event_done(event_name: str, run_name: str = ""):
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", event_name, {
        "status": "done",
        "run_name": run_name,
        "completed_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    frappe.db.commit()


def mark_event_failed(event_name: str, error: str, attempt: int = 1):
    """On failure: increment attempt; move to DLQ if max attempts exceeded."""
    if attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", event_name, {
            "status": "dead",
            "error": error[:1000],
            "attempt": attempt,
            "completed_at": now_datetime(),
        })
        # Push to Redis DLQ for visibility
        try:
            ev = frappe.db.get_value("FB Event", event_name,
                                     ["flow_name", "trigger", "sequence_number"], as_dict=True)
            frappe.cache().lpush(DLQ_KEY, json.dumps({
                "event_name": event_name,
                "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
                "trigger": ev.trigger,
                "error": error[:200],
                "attempt": attempt,
            }))
        except Exception:
            pass
    else:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", event_name, {
            "status": "queued",
            "error": error[:1000],
            "attempt": attempt,
        })
    frappe.db.commit()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.18 — Dead Letter Queue management
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def list_dlq(limit: int = 50, flow_name: str = "") -> dict:
    """List dead events (exhausted retries)."""
    filters = [["status", "=", "dead"]]
    if flow_name:
        filters.append(["flow_name", "=", flow_name])

    events = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Event",
        filters=filters,
        fields=["name", "event_id", "flow_name", "trigger", "attempt",
                "error", "enqueued_at", "completed_at"],
        limit=int(limit),
        order_by="completed_at desc",
    )
    redis_depth = 0
    try:
        redis_depth = frappe.cache().llen(DLQ_KEY)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {
        "events": events,
        "total": len(events),
        "redis_dlq_depth": redis_depth,
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def requeue_from_dlq(event_name: str = "", flow_name: str = "",
                      limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    """
    Move dead events back to 'queued' status and re-push to Redis.
    Specify event_name for single event, or flow_name + limit for bulk.
    """
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])

    filters = [["status", "=", "dead"]]
    if event_name:
        filters.append(["name", "=", event_name])
    elif flow_name:
        filters.append(["flow_name", "=", flow_name])

    events = frappe.get_all("FB Event", filters=filters,
                             fields=["name", "flow_name", "trigger", "sequence_number"],
                             limit=int(limit))
    requeued = []
    r = frappe.cache()
    for ev in events:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", ev.name, {
            "status": "queued",
            "attempt": 0,
            "error": None,
            "enqueued_at": now_datetime(),
        })
        message = json.dumps({
            "event_name": ev.name,
            "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
            "trigger": ev.trigger,
            "attempt": 1,
            "sequence_number": ev.sequence_number or 0,
        })
        try:
            r.lpush(QUEUE_KEY, message)
        except Exception:
            pass
        requeued.append(ev.name)

    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"requeued": requeued, "count": len(requeued)}


@frappe.whitelist()
def purge_dlq(flow_name: str = "", older_than_days: int = 7) -> dict:
    """Permanently delete dead events older than N days."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])

    cutoff = add_to_date(now_datetime(), days=-int(older_than_days))
    filters = [["status", "=", "dead"], ["completed_at", "<", cutoff]]
    if flow_name:
        filters.append(["flow_name", "=", flow_name])

    events = frappe.get_all("FB Event", filters=filters, fields=["name"], limit=1000)
    count = 0
    for ev in events:
        frappe.delete_doc("FB Event", ev.name, ignore_permissions=True)
        count += 1

    # Clear Redis DLQ
    try:
        frappe.cache().delete(DLQ_KEY)
    except Exception:
        pass

    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"purged": count, "older_than_days": older_than_days}


@frappe.whitelist()
def inspect_event(event_name: str) -> dict:
    """Return full event details including payload."""
    ev = frappe.get_doc("FB Event", event_name)
    return {
        "name": ev.name,
        "event_id": ev.event_id,
        "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
        "trigger": ev.trigger,
        "status": ev.status,
        "attempt": ev.attempt,
        "sequence_number": ev.sequence_number,
        "error": ev.error,
        "run_name": ev.run_name,
        "enqueued_at": str(ev.enqueued_at),
        "completed_at": str(ev.completed_at) if ev.completed_at else None,
        "payload": json.loads(ev.payload_json or "{}"),
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_queue_stats() -> dict:
    """Return queue depths and status breakdown."""
    r = frappe.cache()
    stats = {}
    try:
        stats["redis_queue_depth"] = r.llen(QUEUE_KEY)
        stats["redis_dlq_depth"] = r.llen(DLQ_KEY)
    except Exception:
        stats["redis_queue_depth"] = -1
        stats["redis_dlq_depth"] = -1

    for status in ("queued", "processing", "done", "dead"):
        stats[f"db_{status}"] = frappe.db.count("FB Event", {"status": status})

    return stats


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.19 — Event replay from history
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def replay_events(flow_name: str = "", from_time: str = "", to_time: str = "",
                   event_names: str = "[]", statuses: str = '["done","dead"]') -> dict:
    """
    Re-enqueue historical events for replay.
    event_names: JSON array of specific event names (takes priority over time range).
    statuses: JSON array of statuses to replay from (default: done + dead).
    """
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])

    names_list = json.loads(event_names) if isinstance(event_names, str) else event_names
    status_list = json.loads(statuses) if isinstance(statuses, str) else statuses

    if names_list:
        events = frappe.get_all(
            "FB Event",
            filters=[["name", "in", names_list]],
            fields=["name", "flow_name", "trigger", "sequence_number", "payload_json"],
        )
    else:
        filters = [["status", "in", status_list]]
        if flow_name:
            filters.append(["flow_name", "=", flow_name])
        if from_time:
            filters.append(["enqueued_at", ">=", from_time])
        if to_time:
            filters.append(["enqueued_at", "<=", to_time])
        events = frappe.get_all(
            "FB Event",
            filters=filters,
            fields=["name", "flow_name", "trigger", "sequence_number", "payload_json"],
            limit=500,
            order_by="enqueued_at asc",
        )

    replayed = []
    r = frappe.cache()
    for ev in events:
        # Create a new replay event (don't mutate the original)
        replay_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        new_event = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB Event",
            "event_id": replay_id,
            "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
            "trigger": "replay",
            "payload_json": ev.payload_json,
            "status": "queued",
            "attempt": 0,
            "sequence_number": ev.sequence_number or 0,
            "enqueued_at": now_datetime(),
            "replayed_from": ev.name,
        })
        new_event.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        message = json.dumps({
            "event_name": new_event.name,
            "flow_name": ev.flow_name,
            "trigger": "replay",
            "attempt": 1,
            "replayed_from": ev.name,
        })
        try:
            r.lpush(QUEUE_KEY, message)
        except Exception:
            pass
        replayed.append(new_event.name)

    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"replayed": len(replayed), "event_names": replayed[:50]}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.20 — Out-of-order event handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def handle_event_with_sequence(flow_name: str, event_name: str,
                                 sequence_number: int,
                                 max_gap_wait_seconds: int = 30) -> dict:
    """
    Out-of-order handler: buffer events whose predecessors haven't arrived.
    Delivers events in sequence order; holds gaps for up to max_gap_wait_seconds.

    Returns: {"action": "delivered"|"buffered"|"gap_timeout_flush"}
    """
    seq = int(sequence_number)
    r = frappe.cache()
    cursor_key = f"{SEQ_CURSOR_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}"
    buffer_key = f"{GAP_BUFFER_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}"

    # Get last delivered sequence (default 0 = nothing delivered yet)
    last_delivered = int(r.get(cursor_key) or 0)
    expected_next = last_delivered + 1

    if seq == expected_next:
        # In-order: deliver immediately and check buffer for consecutive events
        _deliver_event(event_name, flow_name)
        r.set(cursor_key, seq, ex=86400)
        return {"action": "delivered", "sequence": seq, **_flush_buffer(flow_name, seq, r, cursor_key, buffer_key)}

    if seq < expected_next:
        # Duplicate / already processed
        return {"action": "duplicate", "sequence": seq, "expected": expected_next}

    # seq > expected_next: gap detected — buffer this event
    buffer_entry = json.dumps({
        "event_name": event_name,
        "sequence_number": seq,
        "buffered_at": now_datetime().isoformat(),
    })
    r.hset(buffer_key, str(seq), buffer_entry)
    r.expire(buffer_key, 3600)

    # Check if the gap has been waiting too long — flush buffer in order if so
    oldest_gap_key = f"fb:ooo:gap_start:{flow_name}"
    if not r.exists(oldest_gap_key):
        r.set(oldest_gap_key, now_datetime().isoformat(), ex=int(max_gap_wait_seconds) + 10)
    else:
        gap_start_str = r.get(oldest_gap_key)
        if gap_start_str:
            try:
                gap_start = get_datetime(gap_start_str.decode() if isinstance(gap_start_str, bytes) else gap_start_str)
                elapsed = (now_datetime() - gap_start).total_seconds()
                if elapsed >= int(max_gap_wait_seconds):
                    # Force-flush: deliver all buffered events in order, skipping missing gaps
                    flushed = _force_flush_buffer(flow_name, r, cursor_key, buffer_key)
                    r.delete(oldest_gap_key)
                    return {"action": "gap_timeout_flush", "flushed": flushed, "sequence": seq}
            except Exception:
                pass

    return {"action": "buffered", "sequence": seq, "gap_at": expected_next}


def _deliver_event(event_name: str, flow_name: str):
    """Trigger the flow for this event."""
    try:
        ev = frappe.db.get_value("FB Event", event_name,
                                  ["payload_json", "trigger"], as_dict=True)
        if ev:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import trigger_flow
            trigger_flow(flow_name=flow_name, payload=ev.payload_json or "{}")
            frappe.db.set_value("FB Event", event_name, "status", "processing")
            frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.logger().error(f"[EventQueue] deliver_event failed {event_name}: {e}")


def _flush_buffer(flow_name: str, just_delivered: int, r, cursor_key: str, buffer_key: str) -> dict:
    """After delivering seq N, check if N+1 is buffered and deliver it too (cascade)."""
    delivered = []
    current = just_delivered
    while True:
        next_seq = current + 1
        entry_raw = r.hget(buffer_key, str(next_seq))
        if not entry_raw:
            break
        entry = json.loads(entry_raw)
        _deliver_event(entry["event_name"], flow_name)
        r.hdel(buffer_key, str(next_seq))
        r.set(cursor_key, next_seq, ex=86400)
        delivered.append(next_seq)
        current = next_seq
    return {"cascaded_deliveries": delivered}


def _force_flush_buffer(flow_name: str, r, cursor_key: str, buffer_key: str) -> list:
    """Deliver all buffered events in ascending sequence order, ignoring gaps."""
    all_entries = r.hgetall(buffer_key)
    if not all_entries:
        return []

    sorted_entries = sorted(
        ((int(k), json.loads(v)) for k, v in all_entries.items()),
        key=lambda x: x[0],
    )
    flushed = []
    for seq, entry in sorted_entries:
        _deliver_event(entry["event_name"], flow_name)
        r.hdel(buffer_key, str(seq))
        r.set(cursor_key, seq, ex=86400)
        flushed.append(seq)
    return flushed


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_ooo_buffer_status(flow_name: str) -> dict:
    """Return current out-of-order buffer contents for a flow."""
    r = frappe.cache()
    buffer_key = f"{GAP_BUFFER_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}"
    cursor_key = f"{SEQ_CURSOR_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}"

    last_delivered = int(r.get(cursor_key) or 0)
    buffer = r.hgetall(buffer_key)
    buffered_seqs = sorted([int(k) for k in buffer.keys()]) if buffer else []

    return {
        "flow_name": flow_name,
        "last_delivered_sequence": last_delivered,
        "buffered_sequences": buffered_seqs,
        "buffer_depth": len(buffered_seqs),
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def reset_sequence_cursor(flow_name: str, sequence: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Reset the sequence cursor for a flow (e.g. after a replay)."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    r = frappe.cache()
    r.set(f"{SEQ_CURSOR_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}", int(sequence), ex=86400)
    r.delete(f"{GAP_BUFFER_KEY_PREFIX}{flow_name}")
    return {"flow_name": flow_name, "sequence_reset_to": int(sequence)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Scheduler hooks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def recover_queue():
    """Hourly: push any stuck 'queued' FB Events back to Redis."""
    pushed = drain_pending_to_redis(limit=200)
    if pushed:
        frappe.logger().info(f"[EventQueue] Recovered {pushed} stuck events to Redis")

# 12.1 — India Account Aggregator (AA) Connector
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def aa_initiate_consent(customer_id: str, account_types: list | str,
                        purpose: str = "STATEMENT", duration_days: int = 30) -> dict:
    """Initiate AA consent request for a customer."""
    if isinstance(account_types, str):
        account_types = json.loads(account_types)

    aa_id = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "aa_entity_id") or ""
    api_key = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "aa_api_key") or ""
    base_url = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "aa_base_url") \
               or "https://api.onemoney.in/v2"

    from_date = now_datetime().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    to_date = add_days(now_datetime(), duration_days).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") \
        if hasattr(add_days(now_datetime(), duration_days), 'strftime') \
        else str(add_days(from_date, duration_days))

    payload = {
        "ver": "1.0",
        "timestamp": now_datetime().isoformat(),
        "txnid": frappe.generate_hash(length=16),
        "ConsentDetail": {
            "consentStart": from_date,
            "consentExpiry": to_date,
            "consentMode": "VIEW",
            "fetchType": "PERIODIC",
            "consentTypes": ["TRANSACTIONS", "SUMMARY"],
            "fiTypes": account_types,
            "DataConsumer": {"id": aa_id},
            "Customer": {"id": customer_id},
            "Purpose": {"code": purpose},
        },
    }

    import urllib.request
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base_url}/consent",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "client_api_key": api_key},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read())
        consent_handle = result.get("ConsentHandle", "")
        # Store consent handle
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB AA Consent",
            "customer_id": customer_id,
            "consent_handle": consent_handle,
            "status": "Pending",
            "initiated_at": now_datetime(),
            "expires_at": to_date,
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"consent_handle": consent_handle, "status": "pending"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}


@frappe.whitelist()
def aa_fetch_statements(consent_handle: str, from_date: str = "",
                        to_date: str = "") -> dict:
    """Fetch bank statements using an approved AA consent."""
    api_key = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "aa_api_key") or ""
    base_url = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "aa_base_url") \
               or "https://api.onemoney.in/v2"

    if not from_date:
        from_date = add_days(now_datetime(), -30).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") \
            if hasattr(add_days(now_datetime(), -30), 'strftime') else str(add_days(str(getdate()), -30))
    if not to_date:
        to_date = getdate().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if hasattr(getdate(), 'strftime') else str(getdate())

    import urllib.request
    payload = {
        "ver": "1.0",
        "timestamp": now_datetime().isoformat(),
        "txnid": frappe.generate_hash(length=16),
        "FIDataRange": {"from": from_date, "to": to_date},
        "Consent": {"handle": consent_handle},
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base_url}/fidata",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "client_api_key": api_key},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read())
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.2 — RazorpayX Bank Connector
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _razorpayx_request(method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    import urllib.request
    import base64
    key_id = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", "razorpayx_key_id"
    ) or frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "razorpayx_key_id") or ""
    key_secret = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", "razorpayx_key_secret"
    ) or ""
    auth = base64.b64encode(f"{key_id}:{key_secret}".encode()).decode()
    url = f"https://api.razorpay.com/v1/{path}"
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Basic {auth}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method=method,
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read())


@frappe.whitelist()
def razorpayx_get_balance(account_number: str) -> dict:
    return _razorpayx_request("GET", f"banking/accounts/{account_number}/balance")


@frappe.whitelist()
def razorpayx_get_transactions(account_number: str, from_timestamp: int = 0,
                                to_timestamp: int = 0) -> dict:
    qs = f"account_number={account_number}"
    if from_timestamp:
        qs += f"&from={from_timestamp}"
    if to_timestamp:
        qs += f"&to={to_timestamp}"
    return _razorpayx_request("GET", f"transactions?{qs}")


@frappe.whitelist()
def razorpayx_initiate_payout(
    account_number: str, amount_paise: int,
    beneficiary_name: str, beneficiary_account: str,
    ifsc: str, mode: str = "NEFT", purpose: str = "VENDOR",
    reference_id: str = ""
) -> dict:
    payload = {
        "account_number": account_number,
        "amount": amount_paise,
        "currency": "INR",
        "mode": mode,
        "purpose": purpose,
        "fund_account": {
            "account_type": "bank_account",
            "bank_account": {
                "name": beneficiary_name,
                "ifsc": ifsc,
                "account_number": beneficiary_account,
            },
            "contact": {"name": beneficiary_name, "type": "vendor"},
        },
        "reference_id": reference_id or frappe.generate_hash(length=12),
    }
    return _razorpayx_request("POST", "payouts", payload)
