# 12.3 — HDFC SmartHub Connector
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def hdfc_get_account_statement(account_number: str, from_date: str, to_date: str) -> dict:
    import urllib.request
    client_id = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "hdfc_client_id") or ""
    client_secret = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", "hdfc_client_secret"
    ) or ""
    token_url = "https://developer.hdfcbank.com/oauth2/token"
    # Fetch OAuth token
    import urllib.parse
    token_data = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "client_credentials",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "client_secret": client_secret,
        "scope": "account:read",
    }).encode()
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(token_url, data=token_data,
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
                                     method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            token_resp = json.loads(resp.read())
        access_token = token_resp.get("access_token", "")

        stmt_url = (
            f"https://developer.hdfcbank.com/v1/accounts/{account_number}/transactions"
            f"?fromDate={from_date}&toDate={to_date}"
        )
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(
            stmt_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=15) as resp2:
            return json.loads(resp2.read())
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.4 — SWIFT MT940/MT942 Parser
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_mt940(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse SWIFT MT940 bank statement into structured transactions."""
    statement = {
        "account": "", "opening_balance": 0.0, "closing_balance": 0.0,
        "currency": "INR", "transactions": [],
    }
    lines = raw.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
    i = 0
    current_txn: dict | None = None

    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]

        if line.startswith(":25:"):
            statement["account"] = line[4:].strip()

        elif line.startswith(":60F:") or line.startswith(":60M:"):
            # Opening balance: C/D + date + currency + amount
            content = line[5:]
            m = re.match(r"([CD])(\d{6})([A-Z]{3})([\d,]+)", content)
            if m:
                statement["currency"] = m.group(3)
                amt = float(m.group(4).replace(",", "."))
                statement["opening_balance"] = amt if m.group(1) == "C" else -amt

        elif line.startswith(":62F:") or line.startswith(":62M:"):
            content = line[5:]
            m = re.match(r"([CD])(\d{6})([A-Z]{3})([\d,]+)", content)
            if m:
                amt = float(m.group(4).replace(",", "."))
                statement["closing_balance"] = amt if m.group(1) == "C" else -amt

        elif line.startswith(":61:"):
            # Transaction record
            content = line[4:]
            m = re.match(r"(\d{6})(\d{4})?([CD])([\d,]+)([A-Z])(\S+)", content)
            if m:
                current_txn = {
                    "date": m.group(1),
                    "debit_credit": m.group(3),
                    "amount": float(m.group(4).replace(",", ".")),
                    "transaction_type": m.group(5),
                    "reference": m.group(6),
                    "description": "",
                    "utr": "",
                }
                if m.group(3) == "D":
                    current_txn["amount"] = -current_txn["amount"]
                statement["transactions"].append(current_txn)

        elif line.startswith(":86:") and current_txn is not None:
            desc = line[4:].strip()
            current_txn["description"] = desc
            # Extract UTR if present
            utr_m = re.search(r"UTR[:/](\S+)", desc)
            if utr_m:
                current_txn["utr"] = utr_m.group(1)
            current_txn = None

        i += 1

    return statement


@frappe.whitelist()
def import_mt940_statement(file_content: str, bank_account: str) -> dict:
    """Parse MT940 and create Bank Transaction records in ERPNext."""
    parsed = parse_mt940(file_content)
    created = 0
    skipped = 0
    for txn in parsed.get("transactions", []):
        # Check for duplicate by reference
        date_raw = txn["date"]
        try:
            txn_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(date_raw, "%y%m%d").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            txn_date = str(getdate())

        if frappe.db.exists("Bank Transaction",
                             {"reference_number": txn["reference"],
                              "bank_account": bank_account}):
            skipped += 1
            continue

        doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Bank Transaction",
            "date": txn_date,
            "bank_account": bank_account,
            "deposit": txn["amount"] if txn["amount"] > 0 else 0,
            "withdrawal": abs(txn["amount"]) if txn["amount"] < 0 else 0,
            "description": txn.get("description", ""),
            "reference_number": txn.get("utr") or txn.get("reference", ""),
            "currency": parsed.get("currency", "INR"),
        })
        doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        created += 1

    frappe.db.commit()
    return {
        "account": parsed.get("account"),
        "transactions_parsed": len(parsed["transactions"]),
        "created": created,
        "skipped": skipped,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.5–12.8 — Auto-Reconciliation Engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def run_auto_reconciliation(bank_account: str, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    """Run the auto-reconciliation engine against unreconciled bank transactions."""
    since = add_days(str(getdate()), -days)
    unmatched_txns = frappe.get_all(
        "Bank Transaction",
        filters={"bank_account": bank_account, "status": "Unreconciled",
                 "date": [">", since]},
        fields=["name", "date", "deposit", "withdrawal", "description",
                "reference_number", "currency"],
        limit=500,
    )

    results = {"exact_matched": 0, "fuzzy_matched": 0, "split_matched": 0,
               "unmatched": 0, "review_queue": []}

    for txn in unmatched_txns:
        amount = txn["deposit"] or -txn["withdrawal"]
        result = _try_exact_match(txn, amount)
        if result:
            results["exact_matched"] += 1
            continue

        result = _try_fuzzy_match(txn, amount)
        if result:
            results["fuzzy_matched"] += 1
            continue

        result = _try_bulk_split_match(txn, amount)
        if result:
            results["split_matched"] += 1
            continue

        # 12.8 — Add to human review queue
        _create_reconciliation_review(txn, amount)
        results["review_queue"].append(txn["name"])
        results["unmatched"] += 1

    return results


def _try_exact_match(txn: dict, amount: float) -> bool:
    """Try exact amount + reference match against Payment Entry."""
    ref = txn.get("reference_number", "")
    if ref:
        pe = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Payment Entry",
            {"reference_no": ref, "status": "Draft"},
            ["name", "paid_amount"],
            as_dict=True,
        )
        if pe and abs(flt(pe.paid_amount) - abs(amount)) < 0.01:
            _apply_reconciliation(txn["name"], pe["name"], "exact")
            return True

    # Try amount-only exact match (within ±0.50 INR rounding)
    pes = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={"paid_amount": ["between", [abs(amount) - 0.5, abs(amount) + 0.5]],
                 "status": "Draft"},
        fields=["name", "paid_amount", "reference_no"],
        limit=1,
    )
    if pes:
        _apply_reconciliation(txn["name"], pes[0]["name"], "exact_amount")
        return True
    return False


def _try_fuzzy_match(txn: dict, amount: float) -> bool:
    """Fuzzy match by description similarity + amount proximity."""
    desc = txn.get("description", "").lower()
    candidates = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={"paid_amount": ["between", [abs(amount) * 0.95, abs(amount) * 1.05]],
                 "status": "Draft"},
        fields=["name", "remarks", "party"],
        limit=10,
    )
    best_score = 0.0
    best_name = ""
    for cand in candidates:
        cand_text = ((cand.get("remarks") or "") + " " + (cand.get("party") or "")).lower()
        try:
            from rapidfuzz import fuzz
            score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(desc, cand_text) / 100.0
        except ImportError:
            import difflib
            score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, desc, cand_text).ratio()
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_name = cand["name"]

    if best_score >= 0.7 and best_name:
        _apply_reconciliation(txn["name"], best_name, "fuzzy")
        return True
    return False


def _try_bulk_split_match(txn: dict, amount: float) -> bool:
    """Try matching one bank transaction against multiple payment entries (bulk payment split)."""
    target = abs(amount)
    candidates = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={"paid_amount": ["<", target], "status": "Draft"},
        fields=["name", "paid_amount"],
        order_by="paid_amount desc",
        limit=20,
    )
    selected = []
    running = 0.0
    for cand in candidates:
        if running + flt(cand.paid_amount) <= target + 0.5:
            selected.append(cand)
            running += flt(cand.paid_amount)
        if abs(running - target) < 0.5:
            break

    if abs(running - target) < 0.5 and len(selected) > 1:
        for pe in selected:
            _apply_reconciliation(txn["name"], pe["name"], "split")
        return True
    return False


def _apply_reconciliation(bank_txn_name: str, payment_entry_name: str, method: str):
    frappe.db.set_value("Bank Transaction", bank_txn_name, {
        "status": "Reconciled",
        "payment_entry": payment_entry_name,
        "reconciliation_method": method,
        "reconciled_at": now_datetime(),
    })


def _create_reconciliation_review(txn: dict, amount: float):
    if frappe.db.exists("FB Reconciliation Review", {"bank_transaction": txn["name"]}):
        return
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Reconciliation Review",
        "bank_transaction": txn["name"],
        "amount": amount,
        "description": txn.get("description", ""),
        "reference": txn.get("reference_number", ""),
        "status": "Pending",
        "created_at": now_datetime(),
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_reconciliation_reviews(status: str = "Pending") -> list:
    return frappe.get_all("FB Reconciliation Review",
                          filters={"status": status},
                          fields=["name", "bank_transaction", "amount",
                                  "description", "reference", "created_at"],
                          order_by="created_at desc", limit=50)


@frappe.whitelist()
def approve_reconciliation(review_name: str, payment_entry_name: str) -> dict:
    review = frappe.get_doc("FB Reconciliation Review", review_name)
    _apply_reconciliation(review.bank_transaction, payment_entry_name, "manual")
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Reconciliation Review", review_name, {
        "status": "Resolved",
        "resolved_by": frappe.session.user,
        "resolved_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"status": "resolved"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.9–12.12 — Payment Automation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PAYMENT_SAFETY_LIMITS = {
    "max_single_payment_inr": 500_000,
    "max_daily_total_inr": 5_000_000,
    "require_dual_approval_above_inr": 100_000,
}


@frappe.whitelist()
def evaluate_payment_rules(payment_entry_name: str) -> dict:
    """Evaluate safety rules before initiating an automated payment."""
    pe = frappe.get_doc("Payment Entry", payment_entry_name)
    amount = flt(pe.paid_amount)
    limits = PAYMENT_SAFETY_LIMITS

    checks = {
        "within_single_limit": amount <= limits["max_single_payment_inr"],
        "requires_dual_approval": amount > limits["require_dual_approval_above_inr"],
    }

    # Check daily total
    today_total = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) as total
        FROM `tabPayment Entry`
        WHERE payment_type='Pay'
        AND DATE(creation) = CURDATE()
        AND docstatus = 1
    """)[0][0] or 0
    checks["within_daily_limit"] = (today_total + amount) <= limits["max_daily_total_inr"]
    checks["can_auto_pay"] = all([
        checks["within_single_limit"],
        checks["within_daily_limit"],
        not checks["requires_dual_approval"],
    ])

    return {
        "payment_entry": payment_entry_name,
        "amount": amount,
        "checks": checks,
        "daily_total_so_far": today_total,
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def initiate_auto_payment(payment_entry_name: str, bank_account: str) -> dict:
    """Auto-pay a vendor via RazorpayX after passing safety checks."""
    evaluation = evaluate_payment_rules(payment_entry_name)
    if not evaluation["checks"].get("can_auto_pay"):
        return {"status": "blocked", "reason": evaluation["checks"]}

    pe = frappe.get_doc("Payment Entry", payment_entry_name)
    bank_details = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Bank Account", {"account_name": pe.party},
        ["bank_account_no", "branch_code"], as_dict=True
    ) or {}

    result = razorpayx_initiate_payout(
        account_number=bank_account,
        amount_paise=int(flt(pe.paid_amount) * 100),
        beneficiary_name=pe.party,
        beneficiary_account=bank_details.get("bank_account_no", ""),
        ifsc=bank_details.get("branch_code", ""),
        mode="NEFT",
        purpose="VENDOR",
        reference_id=payment_entry_name,
    )

    if result.get("id"):
        frappe.db.set_value("Payment Entry", payment_entry_name, {
            "reference_no": result.get("id"),
            "clearance_date": now_datetime(),
        })
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"status": "initiated", "payout_id": result.get("id")}

    return {"status": "error", "response": result}


@frappe.whitelist()
def record_utr_on_payment_entry(payment_entry_name: str, utr: str) -> dict:
    """12.12 — Record UTR number on a Payment Entry after RazorpayX confirmation."""
    frappe.db.set_value("Payment Entry", payment_entry_name, {
        "reference_no": utr,
        "clearance_date": now_datetime(),
    })
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"payment_entry": payment_entry_name, "utr": utr, "status": "recorded"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def razorpayx_payout_webhook():
    """12.10 — RazorpayX webhook: update Payment Entry status on payout completion."""
    body = frappe.request.get_data()
    data = json.loads(body)
    entity = data.get("payload", {}).get("payout", {}).get("entity", {})
    payout_id = entity.get("id", "")
    status = entity.get("status", "")
    utr = entity.get("utr", "")

    if payout_id and status in ("processed", "reversed"):
        pe_name = frappe.db.get_value("Payment Entry",
                                       {"reference_no": payout_id}, "name")
        if pe_name and utr:
            record_utr_on_payment_entry(pe_name, utr)

    return {"status": "ok"}

# 12.13–12.15 — GST Automation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_gstr1(company: str, month: int, year: int) -> dict:
    """Generate GSTR-1 JSON in NIC schema v1.3 format."""
    from_date = f"{year}-{month:02d}-01"
    import calendar
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    to_date = f"{year}-{month:02d}-{last_day}"

    gstin = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "gstin") or ""
    if not gstin:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Company '{company}' does not have GSTIN configured"))

    # Fetch submitted Sales Invoices for the period
    invoices = frappe.get_all(
        "Sales Invoice",
        filters={"company": company, "posting_date": ["between", [from_date, to_date]],
                 "docstatus": 1},
        fields=["name", "customer_gstin", "posting_date", "grand_total",
                "base_grand_total", "taxes_and_charges", "place_of_supply"],
    )

    b2b_entries = []
    b2c_entries = []
    for inv in invoices:
        tax_details = _get_invoice_tax_breakdown(inv["name"])
        if inv.get("customer_gstin"):
            b2b_entries.append({
                "ctin": inv["customer_gstin"],
                "inv": [{
                    "inum": inv["name"],
                    "idt": str(inv["posting_date"]),
                    "val": flt(inv["base_grand_total"], 2),
                    "pos": (inv.get("place_of_supply") or "")[:2],
                    "rchrg": "N",
                    "itms": tax_details,
                }],
            })
        else:
            b2c_entries.append({
                "sply_ty": "INTRA",
                "pos": "27",
                "typ": "OE",
                "txval": flt(inv["base_grand_total"] / 1.18, 2),
                "iamt": 0,
                "camt": flt(inv["base_grand_total"] * 0.09 / 1.18, 2),
                "samt": flt(inv["base_grand_total"] * 0.09 / 1.18, 2),
            })

    gstr1 = {
        "gstin": gstin,
        "fp": f"{month:02d}{year}",
        "gt": sum(flt(i["base_grand_total"]) for i in invoices),
        "cur_gt": sum(flt(i["base_grand_total"]) for i in invoices),
        "b2b": b2b_entries,
        "b2cs": b2c_entries,
        "b2cl": [],
        "cdnr": [],
        "cdnur": [],
        "exp": [],
        "at": [],
        "atadj": [],
        "nil": [],
        "exemp": [],
        "hsn": _generate_hsn_summary(invoices),
        "docs": [],
    }

    # Save generated GSTR-1
    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB GST Return",
        "company": company,
        "return_type": "GSTR-1",
        "month": month,
        "year": year,
        "gstin": gstin,
        "status": "Generated",
        "payload_json": json.dumps(gstr1),
        "generated_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    return {"name": doc.name, "gstin": gstin, "period": f"{month:02d}/{year}",
            "b2b_count": len(b2b_entries), "b2c_count": len(b2c_entries)}


def _get_invoice_tax_breakdown(invoice_name: str) -> list:
    taxes = frappe.get_all("Sales Taxes and Charges",
                           filters={"parent": invoice_name},
                           fields=["account_head", "tax_amount", "rate"])
    items = []
    for tax in taxes:
        items.append({
            "itm_det": {
                "txval": 0,
                "rt": flt(tax.get("rate", 0), 2),
                "iamt": 0,
                "camt": flt(tax.get("tax_amount", 0) / 2, 2),
                "samt": flt(tax.get("tax_amount", 0) / 2, 2),
                "csamt": 0,
            }
        })
    return items or [{"itm_det": {"txval": 0, "rt": 18, "iamt": 0,
                                   "camt": 0, "samt": 0, "csamt": 0}}]


def _generate_hsn_summary(invoices: list) -> list:
    return []  # Simplified — production would aggregate HSN-wise totals


@frappe.whitelist()
def upload_gstr1_to_portal(gst_return_name: str) -> dict:
    """Upload GSTR-1 to GST Portal via NIC API and store ARN."""
    ret = frappe.get_doc("FB GST Return", gst_return_name)
    if ret.return_type != "GSTR-1":
        frappe.throw(_("Not a GSTR-1 return"))

    gstin = ret.gstin
    auth_token = _gst_auth_token(gstin)
    payload = json.loads(ret.payload_json)

    import urllib.request
    sandbox = frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "gst_use_sandbox") or True
    base_url = "https://api.gst.gov.in/commonapi" if not sandbox \
        else "https://sandbox.gst.gov.in/commonapi"
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base_url}/v1.1/returns/gstr1",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json",
                 "auth-token": auth_token, "gstin": gstin},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read())
        arn = result.get("arn", "")
        frappe.db.set_value("FB GST Return", gst_return_name, {
            "status": "Filed",
            "arn": arn,
            "filed_at": now_datetime(),
        })
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"arn": arn, "status": "filed"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}


def _gst_auth_token(gstin: str) -> str:
    return frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", "gst_auth_token"
    ) or frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "gst_auth_token") or ""


@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_gstr3b(company: str, month: int, year: int) -> dict:
    """Generate GSTR-3B with net tax payable calculation."""
    gstin = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "gstin") or ""
    import calendar
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    from_date = f"{year}-{month:02d}-01"
    to_date = f"{year}-{month:02d}-{last_day}"

    # Output tax (from Sales Invoices)
    output_tax = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tc.tax_amount), 0) as total
        FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
        JOIN `tabSales Taxes and Charges` tc ON tc.parent = si.name
        WHERE si.company = %s AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND si.docstatus = 1
    """, (company, from_date, to_date))[0][0] or 0

    # Input tax credit (from Purchase Invoices)
    input_credit = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tc.tax_amount), 0) as total
        FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
        JOIN `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges` tc ON tc.parent = pi.name
        WHERE pi.company = %s AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND pi.docstatus = 1
    """, (company, from_date, to_date))[0][0] or 0

    net_payable = max(0, flt(output_tax) - flt(input_credit))

    gstr3b = {
        "gstin": gstin,
        "fp": f"{month:02d}{year}",
        "ret_period": f"{month:02d}{year}",
        "inward_sup": {"isup_details": [{"ty": "GST", "intra": 0, "inter": 0}]},
        "sup_details": {
            "osup_det": {"txval": 0, "iamt": 0,
                         "camt": flt(output_tax / 2, 2),
                         "samt": flt(output_tax / 2, 2), "csamt": 0},
        },
        "itc_elg": {
            "itc_avl": [{"ty": "IMPG", "iamt": 0,
                          "camt": flt(input_credit / 2, 2),
                          "samt": flt(input_credit / 2, 2), "csamt": 0}],
        },
        "intr_ltfee": {"intr_details": {"camt": 0, "samt": 0}},
        "tax_pay": {
            "camt": flt(net_payable / 2, 2),
            "samt": flt(net_payable / 2, 2),
        },
    }

    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB GST Return",
        "company": company,
        "return_type": "GSTR-3B",
        "month": month,
        "year": year,
        "gstin": gstin,
        "status": "Generated",
        "payload_json": json.dumps(gstr3b),
        "net_tax_payable": net_payable,
        "generated_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    return {"name": doc.name, "output_tax": flt(output_tax, 2),
            "input_credit": flt(input_credit, 2), "net_payable": flt(net_payable, 2)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.16–12.18 — TDS Engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TDS_SECTIONS = {
    "194C": {"threshold": 30000, "single_threshold": 30000,
             "annual_threshold": 100000, "rate_individual": 1.0, "rate_company": 2.0,
             "description": "Contractor / Sub-contractor"},
    "194J": {"threshold": 30000, "annual_threshold": 30000,
             "rate_individual": 10.0, "rate_company": 10.0,
             "description": "Professional / Technical Services"},
    "194H": {"threshold": 15000, "annual_threshold": 15000,
             "rate_individual": 5.0, "rate_company": 5.0,
             "description": "Commission / Brokerage"},
}


@frappe.whitelist()
def check_tds_applicability(vendor: str, amount: float,
                             section: str = "194C") -> dict:
    """Check if TDS must be deducted for a vendor payment."""
    if section not in TDS_SECTIONS:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Unknown TDS section: {section}"))

    sec = TDS_SECTIONS[section]
    # Get YTD payments to this vendor
    ytd = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) as ytd
        FROM `tabPayment Entry`
        WHERE party = %s AND payment_type = 'Pay'
        AND YEAR(posting_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
        AND docstatus = 1
    """, (vendor,))[0][0] or 0

    ytd_total = flt(ytd) + flt(amount)
    single_exceeds = flt(amount) > sec.get("single_threshold", 0)
    annual_exceeds = ytd_total > sec.get("annual_threshold", 0)
    tds_applicable = single_exceeds or annual_exceeds

    vendor_type = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", vendor, "supplier_type") or "Individual"
    rate = sec["rate_company"] if vendor_type == "Company" else sec["rate_individual"]
    tds_amount = flt(amount) * rate / 100 if tds_applicable else 0

    return {
        "vendor": vendor,
        "section": section,
        "amount": flt(amount),
        "ytd_payments": flt(ytd),
        "tds_applicable": tds_applicable,
        "tds_rate_pct": rate,
        "tds_amount": flt(tds_amount, 2),
        "net_payable": flt(amount - tds_amount, 2),
        "reason": ("Single payment exceeds threshold" if single_exceeds
                   else "Annual threshold exceeded" if annual_exceeds else "Below threshold"),
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_form_26q(company: str, quarter: int, year: int) -> dict:
    """Generate Form 26Q (TDS return) in FVU-compatible format."""
    quarter_months = {1: (4, 6), 2: (7, 9), 3: (10, 12), 4: (1, 3)}
    m_start, m_end = quarter_months[quarter]
    if quarter == 4:
        from_date = f"{year}-01-01"
        to_date = f"{year}-03-31"
    else:
        from_date = f"{year}-{m_start:02d}-01"
        import calendar
        last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, m_end)[1]
        to_date = f"{year}-{m_end:02d}-{last_day}"

    tan = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "tan") or ""
    gstin = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "gstin") or ""

    deductions = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={"company": company, "payment_type": "Pay", "docstatus": 1,
                 "posting_date": ["between", [from_date, to_date]],
                 "tds_amount": [">", 0]},
        fields=["name", "party", "paid_amount", "tds_amount",
                "tds_section", "posting_date", "reference_no"],
    )

    # Build FVU-format text (simplified 26Q format)
    lines = [f"FORM 26Q|Quarter {quarter}|{year}|TAN:{tan}|Company:{company}"]
    for d in deductions:
        vendor_pan = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", d["party"], "pan") or "PANNOTAVBL"
        lines.append(
            f"{d['name']}|{d['party']}|{vendor_pan}|{d['paid_amount']}|"
            f"{d['tds_amount']}|{d['posting_date']}|{d.get('tds_section', '194C')}"
        )

    content = "\n".join(lines)
    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB TDS Return",
        "company": company,
        "return_type": "26Q",
        "quarter": quarter,
        "year": year,
        "tan": tan,
        "status": "Generated",
        "payload_text": content,
        "total_deductions": sum(flt(d.get("tds_amount", 0)) for d in deductions),
        "generated_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    return {"name": doc.name, "deduction_count": len(deductions),
            "total_tds": doc.total_deductions}


@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_and_email_form_16a(vendor: str, company: str, year: int) -> dict:
    """Generate Form 16A and email to vendor."""
    tan = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "tan") or ""
    vendor_pan = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", vendor, "pan") or ""
    vendor_email = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", vendor, "email_id") or ""

    deductions = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={"company": company, "party": vendor, "payment_type": "Pay",
                 "docstatus": 1, "tds_amount": [">", 0],
                 "posting_date": ["between", [f"{year}-04-01", f"{year+1}-03-31"]]},
        fields=["name", "paid_amount", "tds_amount", "posting_date", "tds_section"],
    )

    total_paid = sum(flt(d.get("paid_amount", 0)) for d in deductions)
    total_tds = sum(flt(d.get("tds_amount", 0)) for d in deductions)

    form_16a_html = f"""
<h2>Form 16A — TDS Certificate</h2>
<p><strong>Deductor:</strong> {company} | TAN: {tan}</p>
<p><strong>Deductee:</strong> {vendor} | PAN: {vendor_pan}</p>
<p><strong>Assessment Year:</strong> {year}-{year+1}</p>
<table border="1">
  <tr><th>Date</th><th>Amount Paid</th><th>TDS Deducted</th><th>Section</th></tr>
  {''.join(f"<tr><td>{d['posting_date']}</td><td>₹{d['paid_amount']:,.2f}</td><td>₹{d['tds_amount']:,.2f}</td><td>{d.get('tds_section','194C')}</td></tr>" for d in deductions)}
</table>
<p><strong>Total Amount Paid: ₹{total_paid:,.2f}</strong></p>
<p><strong>Total TDS: ₹{total_tds:,.2f}</strong></p>
"""
    if vendor_email:
        try:
            frappe.sendmail(
                recipients=[vendor_email],
                subject=f"Form 16A — TDS Certificate for FY {year}-{year+1}",
                message=form_16a_html,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    return {"vendor": vendor, "total_paid": total_paid, "total_tds": total_tds,
            "email_sent": bool(vendor_email)}

@frappe.whitelist()
def fetch_rbi_forex_rates() -> dict:
    """Fetch RBI reference rates and update ERPNext Currency Exchange."""
    import urllib.request
    try:
        url = "https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/PortalUser.aspx"  # RBI RSS/XML feed
        # Use a more reliable forex API endpoint
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/INR",
            headers={"User-Agent": "FlowBridge/1.0"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read())
    except Exception:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "Could not fetch rates"}

    rates = data.get("rates", {})
    today = str(getdate())
    updated = 0
    for currency, rate in rates.items():
        if currency == "INR":
            continue
        inr_per_unit = 1.0 / rate if rate else 0
        if not frappe.db.exists("Currency Exchange",
                                 {"from_currency": currency, "to_currency": "INR",
                                  "date": today}):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Currency Exchange",
                "from_currency": currency,
                "to_currency": "INR",
                "exchange_rate": flt(inr_per_unit, 4),
                "date": today,
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            updated += 1

    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"status": "updated", "currencies_updated": updated, "date": today}


@frappe.whitelist()
def run_fcy_revaluation(company: str, revaluation_date: str = "") -> dict:
    """Month-end FCY invoice revaluation per Ind AS 21 — create JE for exchange differences."""
    if not revaluation_date:
        revaluation_date = str(getdate())

    foreign_invoices = frappe.get_all(
        "Sales Invoice",
        filters={"company": company, "currency": ["!=", "INR"], "docstatus": 1,
                 "outstanding_amount": [">", 0]},
        fields=["name", "currency", "outstanding_amount", "conversion_rate"],
        limit=200,
    )

    je_entries = []
    for inv in foreign_invoices:
        current_rate = flt(frappe.db.get_value(
            "Currency Exchange",
            {"from_currency": inv["currency"], "to_currency": "INR",
             "date": revaluation_date},
            "exchange_rate"
        ) or inv["conversion_rate"])
        original_rate = flt(inv["conversion_rate"])
        if abs(current_rate - original_rate) < 0.0001:
            continue
        outstanding_inr_original = flt(inv["outstanding_amount"]) * original_rate
        outstanding_inr_current = flt(inv["outstanding_amount"]) * current_rate
        diff = outstanding_inr_current - outstanding_inr_original

        if abs(diff) > 0.01:
            je_entries.append({
                "invoice": inv["name"],
                "currency": inv["currency"],
                "original_rate": original_rate,
                "current_rate": current_rate,
                "exchange_difference": flt(diff, 2),
            })

    if je_entries:
        je = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Journal Entry",
            "voucher_type": "Exchange Rate Revaluation",
            "posting_date": revaluation_date,
            "company": company,
            "remark": f"FCY Revaluation as per Ind AS 21 — {revaluation_date}",
            "accounts": [
                {"account": frappe.db.get_value("Company", company,
                                                 "exchange_gain_loss_account") or "Exchange Gain/Loss - FB",
                 "debit_in_account_currency": 0,
                 "credit_in_account_currency": max(0, sum(e["exchange_difference"] for e in je_entries)),
                 "debit": max(0, -sum(e["exchange_difference"] for e in je_entries)),
                 "credit": max(0, sum(e["exchange_difference"] for e in je_entries)),
                 }
            ],
        })
        je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"revaluation_date": revaluation_date,
                "invoices_revalued": len(je_entries),
                "journal_entry": je.name,
                "total_difference": flt(sum(e["exchange_difference"] for e in je_entries), 2)}

    return {"revaluation_date": revaluation_date, "invoices_revalued": 0,
            "message": "No exchange differences to record"}

@frappe.whitelist()
def check_forward_contract_maturities() -> list:
    """Alert for forward contracts maturing in next 7 days."""
    alert_date = add_days(str(getdate()), 7)
    contracts = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Forward Contract",
        filters={"status": "Active", "maturity_date": ["<=", alert_date]},
        fields=["name", "currency", "amount", "contracted_rate", "maturity_date", "bank"],
    )
    if contracts:
        managers = frappe.get_all("Has Role",
                                   filters={"role": "System Manager"},
                                   fields=["parent"])
        emails = [m["parent"] for m in managers if "@" in m.get("parent", "")]
        if emails:
            try:
                items_html = "".join(
                    "<li>{} — {} {:,.0f} @ {} — matures {}</li>".format(
                        c["name"], c["currency"], c["amount"], c["contracted_rate"], c["maturity_date"]
                    )
                    for c in contracts
                )
                frappe.sendmail(
                    recipients=emails,
                    subject=f"Forward Contract Maturity Alert — {len(contracts)} contract(s)",
                    message=f"<p>The following forward contracts mature within 7 days:</p><ul>{items_html}</ul>",
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
    return contracts

# 12.22 — Cash Flow Forecaster
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def forecast_cash_flow(company: str, forecast_days: int = 30) -> dict:
    """30-day cash flow projection using historical collection rates."""
    # Outstanding receivables
    receivables = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT outstanding_amount, due_date
        FROM `tabSales Invoice`
        WHERE company = %s AND docstatus = 1 AND outstanding_amount > 0
        ORDER BY due_date
        LIMIT 1000
    """, (company,), as_dict=True)

    # Historical collection rate (paid within 30 days)
    total_invoices = frappe.db.count("Sales Invoice",
                                      {"company": company, "docstatus": 1})
    paid_on_time = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSales Invoice`
        WHERE company = %s AND docstatus = 1
        AND outstanding_amount = 0
        AND DATEDIFF(payment_schedule, due_date) <= 30
    """, (company,))[0][0] or 0
    collection_rate = (paid_on_time / max(total_invoices, 1)) * 100

    # Outstanding payables (outflows)
    payables = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT outstanding_amount, due_date
        FROM `tabPurchase Invoice`
        WHERE company = %s AND docstatus = 1 AND outstanding_amount > 0
        ORDER BY due_date
        LIMIT 1000
    """, (company,), as_dict=True)

    # Build daily forecast
    today = getdate()
    daily = {}
    for i in range(forecast_days):
        day = str(add_days(str(today), i))
        daily[day] = {"inflow": 0.0, "outflow": 0.0}

    for rec in receivables:
        due = str(rec["due_date"])
        if due in daily:
            daily[due]["inflow"] += flt(rec["outstanding_amount"]) * collection_rate / 100

    for pay in payables:
        due = str(pay["due_date"])
        if due in daily:
            daily[due]["outflow"] += flt(pay["outstanding_amount"])

    # Cumulative projection
    running = flt(frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT COALESCE(balance,0) FROM tabAccount WHERE company=%s "
        "AND account_type='Bank and Cash' LIMIT 1", (company,)
    )[0][0] if frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT COALESCE(balance,0) FROM tabAccount WHERE company=%s "
        "AND account_type='Bank and Cash' LIMIT 1", (company,)
    ) else 0)

    projections = []
    for day, flows in sorted(daily.items()):
        running += flows["inflow"] - flows["outflow"]
        projections.append({
            "date": day,
            "inflow": flt(flows["inflow"], 2),
            "outflow": flt(flows["outflow"], 2),
            "cumulative_balance": flt(running, 2),
        })

    return {
        "company": company,
        "forecast_days": forecast_days,
        "collection_rate_pct": flt(collection_rate, 1),
        "projections": projections,
        "generated_at": str(now_datetime()),
    }

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_finance_dashboard(company: str) -> dict:
    """Unified finance dashboard combining reconciliation, GST, TDS, and forex data."""
    today = str(getdate())
    month = getdate().month
    year = getdate().year

    # Reconciliation stats
    unreconciled = frappe.db.count("Bank Transaction",
                                    {"status": "Unreconciled",
                                     "date": [">", add_days(today, -30)]})
    pending_reviews = frappe.db.count("FB Reconciliation Review", {"status": "Pending"})

    # GST filings
    gstr1_filed = frappe.db.exists("FB GST Return",
                                    {"company": company, "return_type": "GSTR-1",
                                     "month": month, "year": year, "status": "Filed"})

    # TDS
    tds_this_month = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tds_amount), 0)
        FROM `tabPayment Entry`
        WHERE company = %s AND MONTH(posting_date) = %s
        AND YEAR(posting_date) = %s AND docstatus = 1
    """, (company, month, year))[0][0] or 0

    # Forex — active forward contracts
    active_contracts = frappe.db.count("FB Forward Contract",
                                        {"company": company, "status": "Active"})
    maturing_soon = frappe.db.count("FB Forward Contract",
                                     {"company": company, "status": "Active",
                                      "maturity_date": ["<=", add_days(today, 7)]})

    return {
        "company": company,
        "reconciliation": {
            "unreconciled_transactions": unreconciled,
            "pending_reviews": pending_reviews,
        },
        "gst": {
            "gstr1_filed_this_month": bool(gstr1_filed),
            "period": f"{month:02d}/{year}",
        },
        "tds": {
            "tds_deducted_this_month": flt(tds_this_month, 2),
        },
        "forex": {
            "active_forward_contracts": active_contracts,
            "maturing_in_7_days": maturing_soon,
        },
    }

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/flow.py
import frappe
import json
import hmac
import hashlib
from frappe import _


@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True, methods=["POST"])
def webhook(flow_name: str):
	"""
	Inbound webhook endpoint for flow triggering.
	URL: /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.webhook?flow_name=<name>
	"""
	flow = _get_active_flow(flow_name, "Webhook")

	raw_body = frappe.request.data
	headers = dict(frappe.request.headers)

	# HMAC verification
	hmac_status = "Not Required"
	if flow.webhook_secret:
		sig_header = headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256") or headers.get("X-Signature") or ""
		expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(
			flow.get_password("webhook_secret").encode(),
			raw_body,
			hashlib.sha256,
		).hexdigest()
		if not hmac.compare_digest(sig_header, expected):
			_log_webhook(flow_name, headers, raw_body, "Rejected (HMAC)", hmac_valid="Invalid")
			frappe.throw(_("Invalid webhook signature"), frappe.AuthenticationError)
		hmac_status = "Valid"

	# Replay protection (6.54) — nonce + timestamp in Redis
	_check_replay(headers, raw_body, flow_name)

	try:
		payload = json.loads(raw_body or "{}")
	except json.JSONDecodeError:
		payload = {"_raw": raw_body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}

	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
	run_name = enqueue_flow_run(flow_name, payload, trigger="webhook")

	log = _log_webhook(flow_name, headers, raw_body, "Queued", hmac_valid=hmac_status, run_name=run_name)

	return {"status": "queued", "run": run_name}


@frappe.whitelist()
def trigger(flow_name: str, payload: str = "{}"):
	"""Manually trigger a flow. Requires login."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	flow = _get_active_flow(flow_name)
	payload_dict = json.loads(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
	run_name = enqueue_flow_run(flow_name, payload_dict, trigger="manual")
	return {"status": "queued", "run": run_name}

@frappe.whitelist()
def suggest_field_mappings(source_fields: str, target_doctype: str, top_n: int = 3):
	"""
	Return AI-suggested field mappings from source_fields → target_doctype fields.

	source_fields: JSON array of field name strings (e.g. from an API response)
	target_doctype: Name of a Frappe DocType whose fields are the targets
	"""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.field_mapper_ai import suggest_mappings

	src = json.loads(source_fields) if isinstance(source_fields, str) else source_fields

	# Get target doctype fields (skip system fields and section/column breaks)
	meta = frappe.get_meta(target_doctype)
	skip_types = {"Section Break", "Column Break", "HTML", "Heading", "Button", "Fold", "Tab Break"}
	skip_fields = {"name", "owner", "creation", "modified", "modified_by", "docstatus",
	               "parent", "parentfield", "parenttype", "idx", "doctype"}
	tgt = [
		f.fieldname for f in meta.fields
		if f.fieldtype not in skip_types and f.fieldname not in skip_fields
	]

	suggestions = suggest_mappings(src, tgt, top_n=int(top_n))

	# Only return target fields that have at least one suggestion
	return {k: v for k, v in suggestions.items() if v}


@frappe.whitelist()
def auto_create_field_mapping(
	mapping_name: str,
	source_connector: str,
	target_doctype: str,
	source_fields: str,
):
	"""
	Create or update an FB Field Mapping document with AI-suggested rules.
	Existing rules are replaced only if mapping_name doesn't yet exist.
	"""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.field_mapper_ai import suggest_mapping_rules

	src = json.loads(source_fields) if isinstance(source_fields, str) else source_fields
	meta = frappe.get_meta(target_doctype)
	skip_types = {"Section Break", "Column Break", "HTML", "Heading", "Button", "Fold", "Tab Break"}
	skip_fields = {"name", "owner", "creation", "modified", "modified_by", "docstatus",
	               "parent", "parentfield", "parenttype", "idx", "doctype"}
	tgt = [f.fieldname for f in meta.fields if f.fieldtype not in skip_types and f.fieldname not in skip_fields]

	rules = suggest_mapping_rules(src, tgt)

	if frappe.db.exists("FB Field Mapping", mapping_name):
		doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Field Mapping", mapping_name)
	else:
		doc = frappe.new_doc("FB Field Mapping")
		doc.mapping_name = mapping_name
		doc.source_connector = source_connector
		doc.target_doctype = target_doctype

	doc.set("mapping_rules", [
		{
			"source_path": r["source_path"],
			"target_field": r["target_field"],
			"transform": r.get("transform", "none"),
		}
		for r in rules
	])
	doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	return {"mapping": doc.name, "rules_created": len(rules)}


def _check_replay(headers: dict, raw_body: bytes, flow_name: str):
	"""
	Replay protection (6.54): reject requests with a nonce seen in the last 5 minutes,
	or with a timestamp more than 5 minutes stale.
	Uses X-Webhook-Nonce and X-Webhook-Timestamp headers.
	"""
	import time
	nonce = headers.get("X-Webhook-Nonce") or headers.get("X-Hub-Nonce")
	ts_header = headers.get("X-Webhook-Timestamp") or headers.get("X-Hub-Timestamp")

	if not nonce and not ts_header:
		return  # No replay headers — skip check (backwards compatible)

	# Timestamp staleness check (5-minute window)
	if ts_header:
		try:
			sent_ts = float(ts_header)
			drift = abs(time.time() - sent_ts)
			if drift > 300:
				frappe.throw(_("Webhook timestamp is too old or in the future (drift: {0}s).").format(int(drift)),
				             frappe.AuthenticationError)
		except (ValueError, TypeError):
			pass

	# Nonce uniqueness check via Redis
	if nonce:
		try:
			import redis as redis_lib
			r = redis_lib.from_url(frappe.conf.get("redis_cache") or "redis://localhost:6379")
			key = f"fb:webhook:nonce:{flow_name}:{nonce}"
			if not r.set(key, "1", nx=True, ex=300):
				frappe.throw(_("Duplicate webhook delivery detected (nonce reuse)."),
				             frappe.AuthenticationError)
		except frappe.AuthenticationError:
			raise
		except Exception:
			pass  # Redis unavailable — allow through


def _get_active_flow(flow_name: str, trigger_type: str | None = None):
	flow = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow", flow_name)
	if flow.status != "Active":
		frappe.throw(_("Flow is not active"), frappe.DoesNotExistError)
	if trigger_type and flow.trigger_type != trigger_type:
		frappe.throw(_(f"Flow trigger type is '{flow.trigger_type}', expected '{trigger_type}'"))
	return flow


def _log_webhook(flow_name, headers, raw_body, status, hmac_valid="Not Required", run_name=None):
	try:
		body_str = raw_body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if isinstance(raw_body, bytes) else str(raw_body)
		log = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "FB Webhook Log",
			"received_at": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
			"flow": flow_name,
			"source_ip": frappe.request.remote_addr,
			"status": status,
			"flow_run": run_name,
			"hmac_valid": hmac_valid,
			"method": frappe.request.method,
			"path": frappe.request.path,
			"request_headers": json.dumps(dict(headers), default=str)[:2000],
			"request_body": body_str[:5000],
			"response_status": 200,
		})
		log.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
		frappe.db.commit()
		return log.name
	except Exception:
		pass

# DLQ management

@frappe.whitelist()
def list_dlq_messages(limit: int = 50) -> list:
	"""Return up to `limit` messages from the Dead Letter Queue."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.redis_queue import get_redis, DLQ_KEY
	r = get_redis()
	raw = r.lrange(DLQ_KEY, 0, int(limit) - 1)
	messages = []
	for item in raw:
		try:
			messages.append(json.loads(item))
		except Exception:
			messages.append({"raw": item.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")})
	return messages


@frappe.whitelist()
def reprocess_dlq_message(run_name: str) -> str:
	"""
	Re-enqueue a failed run from the DLQ.
	Resets the run status to Queued and re-pushes to the worker queue.
	"""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.redis_queue import get_redis, DLQ_KEY
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import execute_flow_run

	run = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow Run", run_name)
	run.db_set("status", "Queued")
	run.db_set("error_message", "")

	# Remove from DLQ (best-effort: remove first matching entry)
	r = get_redis()
	all_msgs = r.lrange(DLQ_KEY, 0, -1)
	for msg in all_msgs:
		try:
			data = json.loads(msg)
			if data.get("run_name") == run_name:
				r.lrem(DLQ_KEY, 1, msg)
				break
		except Exception:
			pass

	frappe.enqueue(
		"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner.execute_flow_run",
		run_name=run_name,
		queue="short",
		timeout=600,
	)
	return run_name


@frappe.whitelist()
def purge_dlq() -> int:
	"""Delete all messages from the DLQ. Returns count removed."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.redis_queue import get_redis, DLQ_KEY
	r = get_redis()
	count = r.llen(DLQ_KEY)
	r.delete(DLQ_KEY)
	return count

@frappe.whitelist()
def replay_run(run_name: str) -> str:
	"""
	Replay a completed (or failed) run with the same payload on the same flow.
	Returns the new run name.
	"""
	orig = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow Run", run_name)
	payload = json.loads(orig.trigger_payload or "{}")
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
	new_run = enqueue_flow_run(orig.flow, payload, trigger=f"replay:{orig.name}")
	return new_run

@frappe.whitelist()
def export_flow(flow_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Export a flow as a portable JSON document (schema: flowbridge/v1)."""
	flow = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow", flow_name)
	return {
		"schema": "flowbridge/v1",
		"type": "Flow",
		"name": flow.flow_name,
		"trigger_type": flow.trigger_type,
		"nodes": [
			{
				"node_id": n.node_id,
				"node_type": n.node_type,
				"node_name": n.node_name,
				"connector": n.connector,
				"endpoint": n.endpoint,
				"field_mapping": n.field_mapping,
				"config_json": json.loads(n.config_json or "{}"),
				"next_node_id": n.next_node_id,
				"true_next_node_id": n.true_next_node_id,
				"false_next_node_id": n.false_next_node_id,
				"on_error": n.on_error,
				"retry_count": n.retry_count,
				"retry_delay_seconds": n.retry_delay_seconds,
				"position_x": n.position_x,
				"position_y": n.position_y,
			}
			for n in flow.nodes
		],
		"settings": {
			"max_concurrent_runs": flow.max_concurrent_runs,
			"timeout_seconds": flow.timeout_seconds,
			"dlq_enabled": flow.dlq_enabled,
		},
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def import_flow(flow_json: str | dict, overwrite: bool = False) -> str:
	"""
	Import a flow from a flowbridge/v1 JSON document.
	Returns the flow name.
	"""
	if isinstance(flow_json, str):
		data = json.loads(flow_json)
	else:
		data = flow_json

	if data.get("schema") != "flowbridge/v1" or data.get("type") != "Flow":
		frappe.throw("Invalid flow schema — expected flowbridge/v1 Flow document")

	flow_name = data["name"]

	if frappe.db.exists("FB Flow", flow_name):
		if not overwrite:
			frappe.throw(f"Flow '{flow_name}' already exists. Pass overwrite=true to replace.")
		flow = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow", flow_name)
		flow.nodes = []
	else:
		flow = frappe.new_doc("FB Flow")
		flow.flow_name = flow_name

	flow.trigger_type = data.get("trigger_type", "Manual")
	flow.status = "Draft"

	settings = data.get("settings", {})
	flow.max_concurrent_runs = settings.get("max_concurrent_runs") or 5
	flow.timeout_seconds = settings.get("timeout_seconds") or 300
	flow.dlq_enabled = settings.get("dlq_enabled", 0)

	for n in data.get("nodes", []):
		flow.append("nodes", {
			"node_id": n["node_id"],
			"node_type": n["node_type"],
			"node_name": n.get("node_name", ""),
			"connector": n.get("connector", ""),
			"endpoint": n.get("endpoint", ""),
			"field_mapping": n.get("field_mapping", ""),
			"config_json": json.dumps(n.get("config_json", {})),
			"next_node_id": n.get("next_node_id", ""),
			"true_next_node_id": n.get("true_next_node_id", ""),
			"false_next_node_id": n.get("false_next_node_id", ""),
			"on_error": n.get("on_error", "stop"),
			"retry_count": n.get("retry_count", 3),
			"retry_delay_seconds": n.get("retry_delay_seconds", 2),
			"position_x": n.get("position_x", 0),
			"position_y": n.get("position_y", 0),
		})

	flow.flags.ignore_links = True
	flow.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
	if frappe.db.exists("FB Flow", flow_name):
		flow.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	else:
		flow.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

	return flow_name

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_api_key(key_name: str, scopes: str = "", rate_limit_rpm: int = 60,
                   rate_limit_daily: int = 10000, allowed_flows: str = "",

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True, methods=["POST"])
def run_flow_with_api_key(flow_name: str):
	"""
	Execute a flow via API key authentication.
	Header: Authorization: Bearer fbk_<key>
	Body: JSON payload
	"""
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.doctype.fb_api_key.fb_api_key import FBAPIKey

	# Extract Bearer token
	auth_header = frappe.request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
	if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
		frappe.throw("Missing Authorization: Bearer <api_key> header", frappe.AuthenticationError)
	raw_key = auth_header[7:].strip()

	api_key = FBAPIKey.authenticate(raw_key)
	if not api_key:
		frappe.throw("Invalid or expired API key", frappe.AuthenticationError)

	client_ip = frappe.request.remote_addr
	if not api_key.is_ip_allowed(client_ip):
		frappe.throw(f"IP {client_ip} not in allowlist for this API key", frappe.AuthenticationError)

	if not api_key.is_flow_allowed(flow_name):
		frappe.throw(f"Flow '{flow_name}' not permitted for this API key", frappe.PermissionError)

	if not api_key.has_scope("flows:run"):
		frappe.throw("API key missing scope: flows:run", frappe.PermissionError)

	try:
		payload = frappe.request.json or {}
	except Exception:
		payload = {}

	flow = _get_active_flow(flow_name)
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
	run_name = enqueue_flow_run(flow_name, payload, trigger=f"api_key:{api_key.key_prefix}")

	return {"run": run_name, "flow": flow_name, "status": "queued"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_transforms() -> dict:
	"""Return all available transform names grouped by category."""
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.transforms import TRANSFORM_REGISTRY
	all_names = sorted(TRANSFORM_REGISTRY.keys())
	crypto = [n for n in all_names if any(n.startswith(p) for p in ("hmac", "sha", "md5", "base64", "aes", "url_en", "url_de"))]
	regex  = [n for n in all_names if n.startswith("regex") or n == "slug"]
	arrays = [n for n in all_names if n.startswith("array") or n in ("json_to_array", "array_to_json")]
	return {"crypto": crypto, "regex": regex, "array": arrays}

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/flow_governance.py
"""
FlowBridge Flow Governance — Phase 6.13–6.14
RBAC enforcement on flow execution and a review/approval workflow before
a flow can go Active.
"""
import frappe
from frappe import _


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RBAC helpers — called by runner before executing a flow
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def check_flow_access(flow_name: str, user: str = None):
	"""
	Raise PermissionError if the current user does not have access to the flow.
	Flows with blank allowed_roles are open to all FlowBridge users.
	"""
	user = user or frappe.session.user
	if user == "Administrator":
		return

	allowed_roles_raw = frappe.db.get_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "allowed_roles") or ""
	if not allowed_roles_raw.strip():
		return  # Open to all

	allowed = [r.strip() for r in allowed_roles_raw.split(",") if r.strip()]
	user_roles = frappe.get_roles(user)
	if not any(r in user_roles for r in allowed):
		frappe.throw(
			_("You do not have permission to execute flow '{0}'.").format(flow_name),
			frappe.PermissionError,
		)


@frappe.whitelist()
def set_flow_roles(flow_name: str, roles: str):
	"""Set allowed_roles on a flow. roles is a comma-separated string."""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "allowed_roles", roles)
	frappe.db.commit()
	return {"flow": flow_name, "allowed_roles": roles}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_accessible_flows(user: str = None):
	"""Return flows the current user can access."""
	user = user or frappe.session.user
	user_roles = set(frappe.get_roles(user))
	all_flows = frappe.get_all(
		"FB Flow",
		fields=["name", "flow_name", "status", "trigger_type", "allowed_roles", "review_status"],
	)
	result = []
	for f in all_flows:
		raw = (f.allowed_roles or "").strip()
		if not raw:
			result.append(f)
			continue
		allowed = {r.strip() for r in raw.split(",") if r.strip()}
		if user_roles & allowed or "Administrator" in user_roles:
			result.append(f)
	return result

@frappe.whitelist()
def submit_for_review(flow_name: str, notes: str = ""):
	"""
	Submit a Draft flow for review.
	Sets review_status = 'Pending Review' and notifies reviewers.
	"""
	flow = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow", flow_name)
	if flow.status not in ("Draft",):
		frappe.throw(_("Only Draft flows can be submitted for review."))

	frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow_name, {
		"review_status": "Pending Review",
		"owner_user": frappe.session.user,
	})
	frappe.db.commit()

	_notify_reviewers(flow, notes)
	_log_audit(flow_name, "submitted_for_review", f"Submitted by {frappe.session.user}. Notes: {notes[:200]}")

	return {"review_status": "Pending Review"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def approve_flow(flow_name: str, notes: str = ""):
	"""
	Approve a flow — sets review_status='Approved' and activates the flow.
	Requires System Manager or FlowBridge Developer role.
	"""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	review_status = frappe.db.get_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "review_status")
	if review_status != "Pending Review":
		frappe.throw(_("Flow is not pending review."))

	frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow_name, {
		"review_status": "Approved",
		"status": "Active",
		"is_active": 1,
	})
	frappe.db.commit()
	_log_audit(flow_name, "approved", f"Approved by {frappe.session.user}. Notes: {notes[:200]}")
	return {"review_status": "Approved", "status": "Active"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def reject_flow(flow_name: str, reason: str = ""):
	"""Reject a flow review submission. Flow stays Draft."""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "review_status", "Rejected")
	frappe.db.commit()
	_log_audit(flow_name, "rejected", f"Rejected by {frappe.session.user}. Reason: {reason[:200]}")

	# Notify owner
	owner = frappe.db.get_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "owner_user")
	if owner and owner != "Administrator":
		try:
			frappe.sendmail(
				recipients=[owner],
				subject=f"[FlowBridge] Flow '{flow_name}' review rejected",
				message=f"<p>Your flow <strong>{flow_name}</strong> was rejected.</p>"
				        f"<p><strong>Reason:</strong> {reason or 'No reason provided.'}</p>",
			)
		except Exception:
			pass

	return {"review_status": "Rejected"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_pending_reviews():
	"""Return all flows pending review — for the approver dashboard."""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	return frappe.get_all(
		"FB Flow",
		filters={"review_status": "Pending Review"},
		fields=["name", "flow_name", "owner_user", "trigger_type", "creation"],
	)


def _notify_reviewers(flow, notes: str):
	reviewers = frappe.get_all(
		"Has Role",
		filters={"role": ["in", ["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"]]},
		fields=["parent"],
		distinct=True,
	)
	emails = [frappe.db.get_value("User", r.parent, "email") for r in reviewers if r.parent != "Administrator"]
	emails = [e for e in emails if e]
	if not emails:
		return
	try:
		frappe.sendmail(
			recipients=emails,
			subject=f"[FlowBridge] Flow '{flow.flow_name}' needs review",
			message=(
				f"<p><strong>{frappe.session.user}</strong> submitted flow "
				f"<strong>{flow.flow_name}</strong> for review.</p>"
				f"<p><em>{notes or 'No notes provided.'}</em></p>"
			),
		)
	except Exception:
		pass


def _log_audit(flow_name: str, action: str, detail: str):
	try:
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.audit import log_event
		log_event(
			doctype="FB Flow",
			docname=flow_name,
			action=action,
			detail=detail,
			user=frappe.session.user,
		)
	except Exception:
		pass

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/gateway.py
"""
FlowBridge API Gateway — Phase 4.1 / 4.2 / 4.11–4.14
Exposes Custom REST APIs (FB Custom API), enforces governance policies,
and auto-generates OpenAPI 3.0 + AsyncAPI specs.
"""
import json
import time
import frappe
from frappe import _


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request handler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def handle():
	"""
	Single dispatch endpoint for all FB Custom APIs.
	Client sends:  POST /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.gateway.handle
	               with header  X-FB-Path: /orders
	               or query     ?_path=/orders
	"""
	req = frappe.request
	path = (req.headers.get("X-FB-Path") or frappe.form_dict.get("_path") or "").strip()
	method = req.method.upper()

	# OPTIONS preflight
	if method == "OPTIONS":
		frappe.response["type"] = "json"
		frappe.response["message"] = {}
		return

	if not path:
		frappe.throw(_("Missing path. Pass X-FB-Path header or ?_path= query param."), frappe.ValidationError)

	api_doc = _resolve(path, method)
	if not api_doc:
		frappe.throw(_("No active Custom API registered for {} {}").format(method, path), frappe.DoesNotExistError)

	# Auth check
	api_key_name = ""
	if api_doc.auth_required:
		raw_key = (req.headers.get("Authorization") or "").removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
		if not raw_key:
			frappe.throw(_("API key required. Pass Authorization: Bearer <key>"), frappe.AuthenticationError)
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.doctype.fb_api_key.fb_api_key import FBAPIKey
		key_doc = FBAPIKey.authenticate(raw_key)
		if not key_doc:
			frappe.throw(_("Invalid or expired API key"), frappe.AuthenticationError)
		api_key_name = key_doc.name

	# Rate limit
	if api_doc.rate_limit_rpm:
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.rate_limiter import check_rate_limit
		if not check_rate_limit(f"custom_api:{api_doc.name}", api_doc.rate_limit_rpm):
			frappe.throw(_("Rate limit exceeded"), frappe.ValidationError)

	# Subscription quota check (4.17)
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.governance import check_subscription_limit
	if not check_subscription_limit(api_key_name):
		frappe.throw(_("Monthly API quota exceeded. Please upgrade your subscription."), frappe.ValidationError)

	# Build payload from request body + path params
	payload = {}
	try:
		body = req.get_data(as_text=True)
		if body:
			payload = json.loads(body)
	except Exception:
		payload = dict(frappe.form_dict)

	path_vars = _extract_path_vars(api_doc.path, path)
	payload.update(path_vars)

	# Governance: IP, roles, size, header injection, CORS (4.11–4.13)
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.governance import enforce, post_process
	payload = enforce(api_doc, payload, req)

	t0 = time.time()
	flow_run = ""
	error_msg = ""
	result = {}
	try:
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import run_flow
		result = run_flow(api_doc.flow, payload, trigger="custom_api") or {}
		flow_run = result.pop("_run_name", "")
	except Exception as e:
		error_msg = str(e)
		frappe.throw(error_msg)
	finally:
		duration_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.governance import _get_client_ip
		result = post_process(api_doc, result, api_key_name,
		                      _get_client_ip(req), duration_ms, flow_run, error_msg)

	frappe.response["type"] = "json"
	frappe.response["message"] = result


def _resolve(path: str, method: str):
	"""Find the matching FB Custom API for the given path + method."""
	apis = frappe.get_all("FB Custom API", filters={"is_active": 1, "method": method},
	                      fields=["name", "path", "flow", "auth_required", "rate_limit_rpm"])
	# Exact match first
	for a in apis:
		if a.path == path:
			return frappe.get_doc("FB Custom API", a.name)
	# Parameterised match (/orders/{id} vs /orders/123)
	for a in apis:
		if _path_matches(a.path, path):
			return frappe.get_doc("FB Custom API", a.name)
	return None


def _path_matches(template: str, actual: str) -> bool:
	t_parts = template.strip("/").split("/")
	a_parts = actual.strip("/").split("/")
	if len(t_parts) != len(a_parts):
		return False
	return all(t.startswith("{") or t == a for t, a in zip(t_parts, a_parts))


def _extract_path_vars(template: str, actual: str) -> dict:
	t_parts = template.strip("/").split("/")
	a_parts = actual.strip("/").split("/")
	return {t[1:-1]: a for t, a in zip(t_parts, a_parts) if t.startswith("{") and t.endswith("}")}

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def openapi_spec():
	"""Return the OpenAPI 3.0 spec for all active FB Custom APIs."""
	site = frappe.utils.get_url()
	apis = frappe.get_all("FB Custom API", filters={"is_active": 1},
	                      fields=["api_name", "method", "path", "description",
	                              "auth_required", "request_schema", "response_schema"])

	paths = {}
	for api in apis:
		path_key = api.path
		method_key = api.method.lower()
		op = {
			"operationId": api.api_name.replace(" ", "_"),
			"summary": api.api_name,
			"description": api.description or "",
			"tags": ["FlowBridge"],
		}

		if api.auth_required:
			op["security"] = [{"BearerAuth": []}]

		# Request body
		if api.method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH"):
			req_schema = _parse_schema(api.request_schema)
			op["requestBody"] = {
				"required": True,
				"content": {"application/json": {"schema": req_schema}},
			}

		# Response
		resp_schema = _parse_schema(api.response_schema)
		op["responses"] = {
			"200": {
				"description": "Success",
				"content": {"application/json": {"schema": resp_schema}},
			},
			"401": {"description": "Unauthorized — API key missing or invalid"},
			"429": {"description": "Rate limit exceeded"},
		}

		if path_key not in paths:
			paths[path_key] = {}
		paths[path_key][method_key] = op

	spec = {
		"openapi": "3.0.3",
		"info": {
			"title": "FlowBridge Custom API",
			"version": "1.0.0",
			"description": "Auto-generated from FB Custom API records. Powered by FlowBridge.",
			"contact": {"name": "FlowBridge", "url": site},
		},
		"servers": [{"url": site + "/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.gateway.handle"}],
		"components": {
			"securitySchemes": {
				"BearerAuth": {"type": "http", "scheme": "bearer", "bearerFormat": "FlowBridge API Key (fbk_...)"},
			}
		},
		"paths": paths,
	}

	frappe.response["type"] = "json"
	frappe.response["message"] = spec


@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def asyncapi_spec():
	"""
	Return an AsyncAPI 2.6 spec describing all event-driven FB Flows
	(webhook trigger and DocType event trigger types).
	"""
	site = frappe.utils.get_url()
	flows = frappe.get_all("FB Flow",
	                       filters={"trigger_type": ["in", ["Webhook", "DocType Event", "Schedule"]], "status": "Active"},
	                       fields=["flow_name", "trigger_type", "trigger_config", "description"])

	channels = {}
	for flow in flows:
		cfg = {}
		try:
			cfg = json.loads(flow.trigger_config or "{}")
		except Exception:
			pass

		if flow.trigger_type == "Webhook":
			channel_key = f"webhook/{flow.flow_name.lower().replace(' ', '-')}"
			channels[channel_key] = {
				"description": flow.description or flow.flow_name,
				"subscribe": {
					"operationId": f"on_{flow.flow_name.replace(' ', '_')}",
					"summary": f"Triggered when a webhook is sent to flow '{flow.flow_name}'",
					"message": {
						"payload": {"type": "object", "description": "Webhook payload — any JSON object"},
					},
				},
			}
		elif flow.trigger_type == "DocType Event":
			doctype = cfg.get("doctype", "Any DocType")
			event = cfg.get("event", "on_submit")
			channel_key = f"erp/{doctype.lower().replace(' ', '_')}/{event}"
			channels[channel_key] = {
				"description": f"Triggered on {event} of {doctype}",
				"subscribe": {
					"operationId": f"on_{doctype.replace(' ', '_')}_{event}_{flow.flow_name.replace(' ', '_')}",
					"summary": f"{doctype} → {event} triggers flow '{flow.flow_name}'",
					"message": {
						"payload": {
							"type": "object",
							"properties": {
								"doctype": {"type": "string", "const": doctype},
								"name": {"type": "string"},
								"event": {"type": "string", "const": event},
							},
						},
					},
				},
			}

	spec = {
		"asyncapi": "2.6.0",
		"info": {
			"title": "FlowBridge Event Streams",
			"version": "1.0.0",
			"description": "Auto-generated AsyncAPI spec for all active event-driven FlowBridge flows.",
			"contact": {"name": "FlowBridge", "url": site},
		},
		"servers": {
			"flowbridge": {
				"url": site,
				"protocol": "https",
				"description": "FlowBridge webhook gateway",
			}
		},
		"channels": channels,
	}

	frappe.response["type"] = "json"
	frappe.response["message"] = spec


def _parse_schema(raw: str) -> dict:
	if not raw:
		return {"type": "object"}
	try:
		return json.loads(raw)
	except Exception:
		return {"type": "object"}

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/github_actions.py
"""
FlowBridge GitHub Actions Integration — Phase 6, item 6.31

Provides:
  1. Webhook receiver — GitHub Actions workflow events trigger FB Flows
  2. Workflow dispatch — FB Flows can trigger GitHub Actions workflows
  3. YAML generator — generate a ready-to-use .github/workflows/flowbridge.yml
  4. Status sync — write flow run outcome back to GitHub commit status API
"""
import json
import hmac
import hashlib
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. GitHub Actions webhook receiver
# POST /api/method/...github_actions.receive_github_event
# GitHub sends: X-Hub-Signature-256, X-GitHub-Event, payload body
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def receive_github_event() -> dict:
    """
    Receive a GitHub Actions webhook event and trigger the mapped FB Flow.
    Configure this URL in GitHub repo Settings → Webhooks.
    """
    import frappe.request as req_module

    try:
        body = frappe.request.get_data()
        headers = frappe.request.headers
    except Exception:
        body = b""
        headers = {}

    event_type = headers.get("X-GitHub-Event") or headers.get("x-github-event") or "push"
    delivery_id = headers.get("X-GitHub-Delivery") or ""
    sig_header = headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256") or headers.get("x-hub-signature-256") or ""

    # Look up the matching GitHub connector config
    connectors = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Connector",
        filters={"connector_type": "GitHub", "is_active": 1},
        fields=["name", "webhook_secret"],
        limit=5,
    )

    verified = False
    for conn in connectors:
        secret = conn.get("webhook_secret") or ""
        if secret and sig_header:
            expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(
                secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256
            ).hexdigest()
            if hmac.compare_digest(sig_header, expected):
                verified = True
                break

    if connectors and not verified and sig_header:
        frappe.local.response.http_status_code = 401
        return {"error": "Invalid webhook signature"}

    try:
        payload = json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        payload = {}

    # Find flows mapped to this GitHub event type
    mappings = frappe.get_all(
        "FB GitHub Flow Mapping",
        filters={"github_event": event_type, "is_active": 1},
        fields=["flow_name", "filter_expression"],
    )

    triggered = []
    for mapping in mappings:
        # Optional filter expression (Jinja2 evaluated against payload)
        if mapping.filter_expression:
            try:
                from jinja2 import Environment
                env = Environment()
                result = env.from_string(mapping.filter_expression).render(payload=payload)
                if result.strip().lower() in ("false", "0", ""):
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import trigger_flow
            run = trigger_flow(
                flow_name=mapping.flow_name,
                payload=json.dumps({
                    "github_event": event_type,
                    "delivery_id": delivery_id,
                    **payload,
                }),
            )
            triggered.append({"flow": mapping.flow_name, "run": run.get("run_name", "")})
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.logger().error(f"[GitHub] Failed to trigger {mapping.flow_name}: {e}")

    return {
        "event": event_type,
        "delivery_id": delivery_id,
        "flows_triggered": len(triggered),
        "runs": triggered,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Workflow dispatch — trigger a GitHub Actions workflow from a Flow
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def dispatch_github_workflow(repo: str, workflow_id: str,
                              ref: str = "main", inputs: str = "{}",
                              connector_name: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    Trigger a GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch event from FlowBridge.
    repo: "owner/repo"
    workflow_id: workflow file name or ID
    ref: branch or tag
    inputs: JSON dict of workflow inputs
    connector_name: FB Connector with GitHub token in credentials
    """
    import requests as _req

    inputs_dict = json.loads(inputs) if isinstance(inputs, str) else inputs

    token = _get_github_token(connector_name)
    if not token:
        return {"error": "No GitHub token found. Configure an FB Connector with type=GitHub."}

    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/dispatches"
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
    }
    body = {"ref": ref}
    if inputs_dict:
        body["inputs"] = inputs_dict

    try:
        resp = _req.post(url, json=body, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        return {
            "status_code": resp.status_code,
            "ok": resp.status_code == 204,
            "repo": repo,
            "workflow": workflow_id,
            "ref": ref,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        return {"error": str(e), "ok": False}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Write commit status back to GitHub
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def set_commit_status(repo: str, sha: str, state: str,
                       description: str = "", context: str = "flowbridge",
                       connector_name: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    POST a commit status (pending/success/failure/error) to GitHub.
    Called by flows to report integration test results, deployment outcomes, etc.
    state: "pending" | "success" | "failure" | "error"
    """
    import requests as _req

    token = _get_github_token(connector_name)
    if not token:
        return {"error": "No GitHub token found"}

    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/statuses/{sha}"
    payload = {
        "state": state,
        "description": description[:140],
        "context": context,
    }
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
    }
    try:
        resp = _req.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        return {"status_code": resp.status_code, "ok": resp.status_code == 201,
                "sha": sha, "state": state}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"error": str(e), "ok": False}

# 4. YAML workflow generator
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def generate_workflow_yaml(flow_name: str, trigger_events: str = '["push"]',
                            site_url: str = "", api_key: str = "") -> str:
    """
    Generate a GitHub Actions workflow YAML that calls FlowBridge when triggered.
    Returns the YAML string — save as .github/workflows/flowbridge-{flow}.yml
    """
    events = json.loads(trigger_events) if isinstance(trigger_events, str) else trigger_events
    site = site_url or frappe.utils.get_url()
    flow_slug = flow_name.lower().replace(" ", "-").replace("_", "-")

    on_block = "\n".join([f"  {ev}:" for ev in events])
    events_single = ", ".join(events)

    yaml = f"""# FlowBridge — auto-generated GitHub Actions workflow
# Triggers flow '{flow_name}' on: {events_single}
# Generated: {now_datetime().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}

name: FlowBridge — {flow_name}

on:
{on_block}

jobs:
  trigger-flow:
    name: Trigger FlowBridge Flow
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Trigger '{flow_name}'
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST \\
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{{{ secrets.FLOWBRIDGE_API_KEY }}}}" \\
            -d '{{
              "flow_name": "{flow_name}",
              "payload": {{
                "github_event": "${{{{ github.event_name }}}}",
                "ref": "${{{{ github.ref }}}}",
                "sha": "${{{{ github.sha }}}}",
                "repository": "${{{{ github.repository }}}}",
                "actor": "${{{{ github.actor }}}}"
              }}
            }}' \\
            {site}/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.trigger_flow

      - name: Check flow result
        run: echo "Flow triggered successfully"
"""
    return yaml
