def _handle_flowbridge_tool(tool_name: str, args: dict):
	"""Return result dict for FlowBridge-specific tools, or None to fall through."""
	if tool_name == "flow_run":
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
		run = enqueue_flow_run(args["flow_name"], args.get("payload", {}), trigger="mcp")
		return {"run_name": run, "status": "queued"}

	if tool_name == "flow_status":
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import run_status
		return run_status(args["run_name"])

	if tool_name == "flow_list_active":
		return frappe.get_all("FB Flow",
			filters={"status": "Active"},
			fields=["flow_name", "trigger_type", "last_run", "last_run_status"],
			limit=100,
		)

	if tool_name == "connector_test":
		conn = frappe.get_doc("FB Connector", args["connector_name"])
		return conn.execute(args["endpoint_name"], variables=args.get("variables", {}))

	if tool_name == "flow_health":
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.analytics import get_flow_health_score
		return get_flow_health_score(args["flow_name"])

	if tool_name == "dlq_list":
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import list_dlq_messages
		return list_dlq_messages(args.get("limit", 20))

	if tool_name == "dlq_reprocess":
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import reprocess_dlq_message
		return {"run_name": reprocess_dlq_message(args["run_name"]), "requeued": True}

	return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _doctype_schema(doctype: str) -> dict:
	"""Build a JSON Schema properties dict from a DocType's meta."""
	try:
		meta = frappe.get_meta(doctype)
	except Exception:
		return {"properties": {}}
	props = {}
	for f in meta.fields:
		jtype = _FIELD_TYPE_MAP.get(f.fieldtype)
		if jtype:
			props[f.fieldname] = {"type": jtype, "description": f.label or f.fieldname}
	return {"properties": props}


def _slug_to_doctype(slug: str) -> str | None:
	"""Convert tool name slug (e.g. 'fb_flow') back to DocType name ('FB Flow')."""
	for doctype in _EXPOSED_DOCTYPES:
		if doctype.lower().replace(" ", "_") == slug:
			return doctype
	return None


def _check_doctype_access(doctype: str):
	if doctype not in _EXPOSED_DOCTYPES:
		frappe.throw(f"DocType '{doctype}' is not exposed via MCP", frappe.PermissionError)
	if not frappe.has_permission(doctype, "read"):
		frappe.throw(f"No read permission on {doctype}", frappe.PermissionError)

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/messenger.py
"""
FlowBridge Conversational Interface — Phase 9 (9.1–9.13)

9.1  — WhatsApp bot (Meta Business API)
9.2  — Telegram bot (python-telegram-bot / HTTP fallback)
9.3  — Conversation state manager (Redis, per-user, multi-turn)
9.4  — NLP intent parser (keyword-based, spaCy optional)
9.5  — LLM fallback for unrecognized commands
9.6  — Action renderer (flow state → buttons / keyboards)
9.7  — Proactive alert engine (failure alerts, digest, threshold breach)
9.8  — Human-in-loop approval via messaging (extends Phase 6)
9.9  — Flow builder via chat (NL → flow)
9.10 — Voice note transcription → command (Whisper ONNX / openai-whisper)
9.11 — Multi-user role awareness (CFO / Dev / Read-Only)
9.12 — Quiet hours + per-user alert preferences
9.13 — Settings UI backend (channel config, user mapping, preferences)
"""
import json
import re
import hashlib
import hmac as _hmac
import time
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, get_datetime, add_to_date


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_STATE_TTL = 3600 * 2          # 2 hours — conversation idle timeout
_DIGEST_HOUR = 8               # default daily digest hour (08:00 local)
_MAX_HISTORY = 20              # max stored turns per user conversation

INTENT_PATTERNS = {
    "status":        r"\b(status|health|how.*(flow|connector|integration))\b",
    "list_flows":    r"\b(list|show|all)\s+(flow|integration)s?\b",
    "run_flow":      r"\b(run|trigger|execute|start)\s+(.+)\b",
    "pause_flow":    r"\b(pause|stop|disable)\s+(.+)\b",
    "resume_flow":   r"\b(resume|enable|unpause)\s+(.+)\b",
    "retry":         r"\b(retry|rerun|re-run)\s*(.+)?\b",
    "errors":        r"\b(error|fail|broken|issue|problem)\b",
    "approve":       r"\b(approve|yes|accept|confirm)\b",
    "reject":        r"\b(reject|no|decline|deny)\b",
    "help":          r"\b(help|\?|what can you do|commands)\b",
    "build_flow":    r"\b(build|create|make|new)\s+(a\s+)?(flow|integration)\b",
    "analytics":     r"\b(analytics|stats|metrics|report|numbers)\b",
    "dlq":           r"\b(dlq|dead.?letter|failed.?queue)\b",
    "digest":        r"\b(digest|summary|daily|weekly)\b",
}

ROLE_VIEWS = {
    "CFO":          ["analytics", "digest", "approve", "reject", "errors"],
    "Developer":    ["status", "list_flows", "run_flow", "pause_flow", "resume_flow",
                     "retry", "errors", "build_flow", "dlq", "analytics"],
    "Read-Only":    ["status", "list_flows", "errors", "analytics", "digest"],
    "System Manager": list(INTENT_PATTERNS.keys()),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.3 — Conversation State Manager
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _redis():
    from frappe.utils.redis_wrapper import RedisWrapper
    return RedisWrapper.get_client()


def _state_key(channel: str, user_id: str) -> str:
    return f"fb:messenger:{channel}:{user_id}"


def get_conversation_state(channel: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
    r = _redis()
    raw = r.get(_state_key(channel, user_id))
    if raw:
        return json.loads(raw)
    return {"history": [], "pending_action": None, "user_id": user_id, "channel": channel}


def set_conversation_state(channel: str, user_id: str, state: dict):
    r = _redis()
    state["updated_at"] = time.time()
    r.setex(_state_key(channel, user_id), _STATE_TTL, json.dumps(state))


def clear_conversation_state(channel: str, user_id: str):
    _redis().delete(_state_key(channel, user_id))


def _append_history(state: dict, role: str, text: str):
    state.setdefault("history", []).append({"role": role, "text": text, "ts": time.time()})
    if len(state["history"]) > _MAX_HISTORY:
        state["history"] = state["history"][-_MAX_HISTORY:]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.4 — NLP Intent Parser
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_intent(text: str) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """Return (intent, entities). Uses spaCy if available, keyword patterns otherwise."""
    lower = text.lower().strip()

    # Try spaCy for richer entity extraction
    try:
        import spacy
        nlp = _get_spacy_nlp()
        doc = nlp(lower)
        entities = {ent.label_: ent.text for ent in doc.ents}
    except Exception:
        entities = {}

    for intent, pattern in INTENT_PATTERNS.items():
        m = re.search(pattern, lower, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            # Extract named item from capture group where present
            groups = [g for g in m.groups() if g] if m.lastindex else []
            if groups:
                entities.setdefault("target", groups[-1].strip())
            return intent, entities

    return "unknown", entities


def _get_spacy_nlp():
    import spacy
    try:
        return spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
    except OSError:
        return spacy.blank("en")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.6 — Action Renderer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def render_whatsapp_buttons(text: str, buttons: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Build a WhatsApp interactive button message payload (≤ 3 buttons)."""
    return {
        "type": "interactive",
        "interactive": {
            "type": "button",
            "body": {"text": text},
            "action": {
                "buttons": [
                    {"type": "reply", "reply": {"id": b["id"], "title": b["title"][:20]}}
                    for b in buttons[:3]
                ]
            },
        },
    }


def render_telegram_keyboard(text: str, buttons: list[list[str]]) -> dict:
    """Build a Telegram sendMessage payload with inline keyboard."""
    return {
        "text": text,
        "reply_markup": {
            "inline_keyboard": [
                [{"text": t, "callback_data": t} for t in row]
                for row in buttons
            ]
        },
    }


def _flow_status_message(flow_name: str) -> str:
    stats = frappe.db.get_value(
        "FB Flow Run",
        {"flow": flow_name},
        ["count(name)", "sum(case when status='Failed' then 1 else 0 end)"],
        as_dict=True,
    ) or {}
    total = stats.get("count(name)") or 0
    errors = stats.get("sum(case when status='Failed' then 1 else 0 end)") or 0
    is_active = frappe.db.get_value("FB Flow", flow_name, "is_active")
    state = "active" if is_active else "paused"
    return f"*{flow_name}*\nState: {state}\nRuns (all time): {total}\nErrors: {errors}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Intent dispatch
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _dispatch_intent(intent: str, entities: dict, user_email: str,
                     state: dict) -> tuple[str, list]:
    """Return (reply_text, buttons_list)."""
    role = _get_user_role(user_email)
    allowed = ROLE_VIEWS.get(role, ROLE_VIEWS["Read-Only"])

    if intent not in allowed:
        return f"Sorry, your role ({role}) doesn't have permission for that.", []

    target = entities.get("target", "")

    if intent == "help":
        cmds = "\n".join(f"• {k}" for k in allowed)
        return f"FlowBridge Commands available to you ({role}):\n{cmds}", []

    elif intent == "status":
        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.mobile import get_health_dashboard
            dash = get_health_dashboard()
            score = dash.get("overall_health", 100)
            top_errors = [f["flow"] for f in dash.get("flows", []) if f.get("health") == "critical"][:3]
            msg = f"FlowBridge Health: {score}%"
            if top_errors:
                msg += "\nCritical: " + ", ".join(top_errors)
            return msg, []
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Error fetching status: {e}", []

    elif intent == "list_flows":
        flows = frappe.get_all("FB Flow", fields=["name", "is_active"], limit=10)
        lines = [f"{'✅' if f.is_active else '⏸'} {f.name}" for f in flows]
        return "Flows:\n" + "\n".join(lines), []

    elif intent == "run_flow":
        if not target:
            return "Which flow should I run? Reply: run <flow name>", []
        flow = _fuzzy_find_flow(target)
        if not flow:
            return f"Could not find a flow matching '{target}'.", []
        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import trigger_flow
            run = trigger_flow(flow, {"source": "messenger", "user": user_email})
            return f"Flow *{flow}* triggered. Run: {run}", []
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Error triggering {flow}: {e}", []

    elif intent == "pause_flow":
        flow = _fuzzy_find_flow(target) if target else None
        if not flow:
            return "Which flow to pause? Reply: pause <flow name>", []
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow, "is_active", 0)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return f"Flow *{flow}* paused.", []

    elif intent == "resume_flow":
        flow = _fuzzy_find_flow(target) if target else None
        if not flow:
            return "Which flow to resume? Reply: resume <flow name>", []
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow", flow, "is_active", 1)
        frappe.db.commit()
        return f"Flow *{flow}* resumed.", []

    elif intent == "retry":
        if target:
            try:
                from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue import replay_events
                replay_events(flow_name=target, statuses=["failed"])
                return f"Retrying failed runs for *{target}*.", []
            except Exception as e:
                return f"Retry error: {e}", []
        return "Specify a flow to retry.", []

    elif intent == "errors":
        runs = frappe.get_all("FB Flow Run",
                              filters={"status": "Failed"},
                              fields=["name", "flow", "creation"],
                              order_by="creation desc", limit=5)
        if not runs:
            return "No recent errors.", []
        lines = [f"• {r.flow} ({r.name})" for r in runs]
        return "Recent failures:\n" + "\n".join(lines), [
            {"id": "retry_all", "title": "Retry all"},
            {"id": "view_dlq", "title": "View DLQ"},
        ]

    elif intent in ("approve", "reject"):
        pending = state.get("pending_approval_token")
        if not pending:
            return "No pending approval. Use the email/button link instead.", []
        decision = "approved" if intent == "approve" else "rejected"
        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.approval import respond_to_approval
            respond_to_approval(pending, decision, "")
            state["pending_approval_token"] = None
            return f"Approval *{decision}*.", []
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Approval error: {e}", []

    elif intent == "analytics":
        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.mobile import get_live_metrics
            m = get_live_metrics()
            return (
                f"FlowBridge Metrics\n"
                f"Runs (1h): {m.get('runs_1h', 0)} | Errors: {m.get('errors_1h', 0)}\n"
                f"Runs (24h): {m.get('runs_24h', 0)} | Queue: {m.get('queue_depth', 0)}\n"
                f"Health: {m.get('system_health', 100)}%"
            ), []
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Error: {e}", []

    elif intent == "dlq":
        try:
            from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue import list_dlq
            items = list_dlq(limit=5)
            if not items:
                return "DLQ is empty.", []
            lines = [f"• {i['name']} — {i.get('flow_name', '?')}" for i in items]
            return "Dead Letter Queue:\n" + "\n".join(lines), [
                {"id": "requeue_all", "title": "Requeue all"},
            ]
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Error: {e}", []

    elif intent == "digest":
        return _build_digest_text(user_email), []

    elif intent == "build_flow":
        state["pending_action"] = {"type": "build_flow", "step": "description"}
        return "What should the flow do? Describe it in plain English.", []

    return "I didn't understand that. Send 'help' for available commands.", []


def _fuzzy_find_flow(name: str) -> str | None:
    flows = [f.name for f in frappe.get_all("FB Flow", fields=["name"])]
    name_lower = name.lower()
    for f in flows:
        if name_lower in f.lower():
            return f
    try:
        from rapidfuzz import process
        match, score, _ = process.extractOne(name, flows) or (None, 0, None)
        return match if score >= 60 else None
    except ImportError:
        import difflib
        matches = difflib.get_close_matches(name, flows, n=1, cutoff=0.5)
        return matches[0] if matches else None


def _get_user_role(email: str) -> str:
    roles = frappe.get_roles(email)
    for r in ("System Manager", "CFO", "Developer"):
        if r in roles:
            return r
    return "Read-Only"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.7 — Proactive Alert Engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def send_proactive_alerts():
    """Called by scheduler every minute — pushes failure alerts to messenger subscribers."""
    prefs_list = frappe.get_all("FB Messenger Preference",
                                filters={"alerts_enabled": 1},
                                fields=["user_email", "whatsapp_number", "telegram_chat_id",
                                        "alert_threshold_errors", "quiet_hours_start",
                                        "quiet_hours_end"])
    for pref in prefs_list:
        if _is_quiet_hours(pref):
            continue
        _check_and_send_alerts(pref)


def _check_and_send_alerts(pref: dict):
    email = pref["user_email"]
    threshold = int(pref.get("alert_threshold_errors") or 5)
    r = _redis()
    counter_key = f"fb:messenger:alert_sent:{email}"

    # Count new failures in last 5 min
    five_ago = add_to_date(now_datetime(), minutes=-5)
    recent_errors = frappe.db.count("FB Flow Run", {
        "status": "Failed",
        "modified": [">", five_ago],
    })
    if recent_errors < threshold:
        return

    # Debounce — only send once per 15 min
    if r.get(counter_key):
        return
    r.setex(counter_key, 900, "1")

    msg = f"⚠️ FlowBridge Alert: {recent_errors} flow failures in last 5 minutes."
    _send_to_user(pref, msg)


def _is_quiet_hours(pref: dict) -> bool:
    qs = pref.get("quiet_hours_start")
    qe = pref.get("quiet_hours_end")
    if not qs or not qe:
        return False
    import datetime
    now_h = datetime.datetime.now().hour
    sh = int(str(qs).split(":")[0])
    eh = int(str(qe).split(":")[0])
    if sh <= eh:
        return sh <= now_h < eh
    # overnight (e.g. 22–06)
    return now_h >= sh or now_h < eh


def _build_digest_text(user_email: str) -> str:
    yesterday = add_to_date(now_datetime(), days=-1)
    runs = frappe.db.count("FB Flow Run", {"creation": [">", yesterday]})
    errors = frappe.db.count("FB Flow Run", {"creation": [">", yesterday], "status": "Failed"})
    success_rate = round((runs - errors) / runs * 100, 1) if runs else 100
    return (
        f"*FlowBridge Daily Digest*\n"
        f"Runs (24h): {runs}\n"
        f"Errors: {errors}\n"
        f"Success rate: {success_rate}%"
    )


@frappe.whitelist()
def send_daily_digest():
    """Called by daily scheduler."""
    prefs_list = frappe.get_all("FB Messenger Preference",
                                filters={"digest_enabled": 1},
                                fields=["user_email", "whatsapp_number", "telegram_chat_id"])
    for pref in prefs_list:
        msg = _build_digest_text(pref["user_email"])
        _send_to_user(pref, msg)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.1 — WhatsApp Bot (Meta Business API)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def whatsapp_webhook():
    """Receive Meta WhatsApp webhook events."""
    # Verification handshake
    if frappe.request.method == "GET":
        params = frappe.request.args
        mode = params.get("hub.mode")
        token = params.get("hub.verify_token")
        challenge = params.get("hub.challenge")
        expected = _get_setting("whatsapp_verify_token") or "flowbridge"
        if mode == "subscribe" and token == expected:
            frappe.response["type"] = "text"
            frappe.response["result"] = challenge
            return
        frappe.throw(_("Verification failed"), frappe.AuthenticationError)

    body = frappe.request.get_data()
    _verify_whatsapp_signature(body)

    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
        entry = data.get("entry", [{}])[0]
        changes = entry.get("changes", [{}])[0]
        value = changes.get("value", {})
        messages = value.get("messages", [])
        for msg in messages:
            _handle_whatsapp_message(msg, value.get("metadata", {}))
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"WhatsApp webhook error: {e}")

    return {"status": "ok"}


def _verify_whatsapp_signature(body: bytes):
    secret = _get_setting("whatsapp_app_secret") or ""
    if not secret:
        return
    sig = frappe.request.headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256", "")
    expected = "sha256=" + _hmac.new(
        secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    if not _hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected):
        frappe.throw(_("Invalid signature"), frappe.AuthenticationError)


def _handle_whatsapp_message(msg: dict, metadata: dict):
    from_number = msg.get("from")
    msg_type = msg.get("type", "text")

    if msg_type == "audio":
        text = _transcribe_voice(msg.get("audio", {}).get("id"))
        if not text:
            _send_whatsapp(from_number, "Sorry, I couldn't transcribe that voice note.")
            return
    elif msg_type == "interactive":
        # Button reply
        reply = msg.get("interactive", {}).get("button_reply", {})
        text = reply.get("id", reply.get("title", ""))
    else:
        text = msg.get("text", {}).get("body", "")

    if not text:
        return

    user_email = _phone_to_email(from_number) or from_number
    _process_message("whatsapp", from_number, user_email, text)


def _send_whatsapp(to: str, text: str, buttons: list | None = None):
    token = _get_setting("whatsapp_access_token")
    phone_id = _get_setting("whatsapp_phone_number_id")
    if not token or not phone_id:
        return

    import urllib.request
    if buttons:
        payload = render_whatsapp_buttons(text, buttons)
        payload["to"] = to
        payload["messaging_product"] = "whatsapp"
    else:
        payload = {
            "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
            "to": to,
            "type": "text",
            "text": {"body": text[:4096]},
        }

    url = f"https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{phone_id}/messages"
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"WhatsApp send error: {e}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.2 — Telegram Bot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True)
def telegram_webhook():
    """Receive Telegram update via webhook."""
    body = frappe.request.get_data()
    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        return {"ok": True}

    # Handle both message and callback_query (inline keyboard presses)
    message = data.get("message") or data.get("callback_query", {}).get("message")
    if not message:
        return {"ok": True}

    chat_id = str(message.get("chat", {}).get("id", ""))
    from_user = message.get("from", {})
    tg_username = from_user.get("username", "")

    if data.get("callback_query"):
        text = data["callback_query"].get("data", "")
    else:
        text = message.get("text", "")

    if not text or not chat_id:
        return {"ok": True}

    user_email = _telegram_to_email(tg_username) or tg_username
    _process_message("telegram", chat_id, user_email, text)
    return {"ok": True}


def _send_telegram(chat_id: str, text: str, buttons: list[list[str]] | None = None):
    bot_token = _get_setting("telegram_bot_token")
    if not bot_token:
        return

    import urllib.request
    if buttons:
        payload = render_telegram_keyboard(text, buttons)
    else:
        payload = {"text": text[:4096]}
    payload["chat_id"] = chat_id

    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{bot_token}/sendMessage"
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"Telegram send error: {e}")


def _send_to_user(pref: dict, text: str):
    if pref.get("whatsapp_number"):
        _send_whatsapp(pref["whatsapp_number"], text)
    if pref.get("telegram_chat_id"):
        _send_telegram(pref["telegram_chat_id"], text)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core message processor (shared by WA + Telegram)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _process_message(channel: str, user_id: str, user_email: str, text: str):
    state = get_conversation_state(channel, user_id)
    _append_history(state, "user", text)

    # Handle multi-turn pending actions
    if state.get("pending_action"):
        reply, buttons = _handle_pending_action(state, text, user_email)
    else:
        intent, entities = parse_intent(text)

        if intent == "unknown":
            # 9.5 — LLM fallback
            reply = _llm_fallback(text, state, user_email)
            buttons = []
        else:
            reply, buttons = _dispatch_intent(intent, entities, user_email, state)

    _append_history(state, "assistant", reply)
    set_conversation_state(channel, user_id, state)

    if channel == "whatsapp":
        _send_whatsapp(user_id, reply, buttons if buttons else None)
    else:
        keyboard = [[b["title"] for b in buttons]] if buttons else None
        _send_telegram(user_id, reply, keyboard)


def _handle_pending_action(state: dict, text: str, user_email: str) -> tuple[str, list]:
    action = state["pending_action"]
    action_type = action.get("type")

    if action_type == "build_flow":
        # 9.9 — Flow builder via chat
        step = action.get("step")
        if step == "description":
            description = text
            try:
                from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.ai import build_flow
                result = build_flow(description, install=False)
                flow_name = result.get("flow_name", "new_flow")
                state["pending_action"] = {
                    "type": "build_flow", "step": "confirm",
                    "description": description, "flow_json": result,
                    "flow_name": flow_name,
                }
                return (
                    f"I'll create a flow: *{flow_name}*\n\n{description}\n\nShall I install it?",
                    [{"id": "confirm_yes", "title": "Yes, install"},
                     {"id": "confirm_no", "title": "Cancel"}]
                )
            except Exception as e:
                state["pending_action"] = None
                return f"Couldn't build flow: {e}", []

        elif step == "confirm":
            if re.search(r"\b(yes|confirm|install|ok)\b", text, re.I) or text == "confirm_yes":
                try:
                    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.ai import build_flow
                    result = build_flow(action["description"], install=True)
                    state["pending_action"] = None
                    return f"Flow *{result.get('flow_name')}* installed!", []
                except Exception as e:
                    state["pending_action"] = None
                    return f"Install failed: {e}", []
            else:
                state["pending_action"] = None
                return "Cancelled.", []

    state["pending_action"] = None
    return "Action cancelled.", []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.5 — LLM fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _llm_fallback(text: str, state: dict, user_email: str) -> str:
    try:
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine import get_engine
        engine = get_engine("copilot")
        history_msgs = [
            {"role": t["role"], "content": t["text"]}
            for t in state.get("history", [])[-6:]
        ]
        system = (
            "You are FlowBridge assistant. Answer questions about flows, connectors, "
            "and ERPNext integrations. Keep replies short (≤3 sentences)."
        )
        response = engine.complete(
            prompt=text,
            system=system,
            messages=history_msgs,
        )
        return response.get("content", "Sorry, I couldn't understand that.")
    except Exception:
        return "I didn't understand that. Send 'help' for available commands."


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.10 — Voice Note Transcription
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _transcribe_voice(media_id: str) -> str:
    """Download voice note and transcribe via Whisper (ONNX or openai-whisper)."""
    if not media_id:
        return ""

    audio_bytes = _download_whatsapp_media(media_id)
    if not audio_bytes:
        return ""

    # Try openai-whisper first
    try:
        import whisper
        import tempfile, os
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".ogg", delete=False) as f:
            f.write(audio_bytes)
            tmp_path = f.name
        model = whisper.load_model("tiny")
        result = model.transcribe(tmp_path)
        os.unlink(tmp_path)
        return result.get("text", "")
    except ImportError:
        pass

    # Fallback: OpenAI Whisper API
    try:
        import urllib.request
        api_key = _get_setting("openai_api_key") or ""
        if not api_key:
            return ""
        import urllib.parse
        boundary = "----FlowBridgeBoundary"
        body = (
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="audio.ogg"\r\n'
            f"Content-Type: audio/ogg\r\n\r\n"
        ).encode() + audio_bytes + f"\r\n--{boundary}\r\n".encode() + (
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="model"\r\n\r\nwhisper-1\r\n'
            f"--{boundary}--\r\n"
        ).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions",
            data=body,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
                "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}",
            },
            method="POST",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read()).get("text", "")
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _download_whatsapp_media(media_id: str) -> bytes:
    token = _get_setting("whatsapp_access_token") or ""
    if not token:
        return b""
    import urllib.request
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            f"https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{media_id}",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            media_info = json.loads(resp.read())
        media_url = media_info.get("url", "")
        if not media_url:
            return b""
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(media_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=30) as resp2:
            return resp2.read()
    except Exception:
        return b""

# 9.8 — Human-in-loop approval via messenger
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def send_approval_via_messenger(approval_name: str):
    """Push approval request to user's messenger channels (extends Phase 6)."""
    approval = frappe.get_doc("FB Approval Request", approval_name)
    assigned_to = approval.assigned_to
    pref = frappe.db.get_value(
        "FB Messenger Preference", {"user_email": assigned_to},
        ["whatsapp_number", "telegram_chat_id"], as_dict=True
    )
    if not pref:
        return {"sent": False, "reason": "No messenger preference for user"}

    state = get_conversation_state("whatsapp", pref.get("whatsapp_number", assigned_to))
    state["pending_approval_token"] = approval.resume_token
    set_conversation_state("whatsapp", pref.get("whatsapp_number", assigned_to), state)

    text = f"*Approval Required*\n{approval.subject}\n\n{approval.message}\n\nReply 'approve' or 'reject'."
    buttons = [{"id": "approve", "title": "Approve"}, {"id": "reject", "title": "Reject"}]
    _send_to_user(pref, text)
    return {"sent": True}

        "role": role,
        "allowed_intents": ROLE_VIEWS.get(role, ROLE_VIEWS["Read-Only"]),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.12 — Quiet hours + per-user alert preferences
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def set_messenger_preference(
    whatsapp_number: str = "",
    telegram_chat_id: str = "",
    alerts_enabled: int = 1,
    digest_enabled: int = 1,
    alert_threshold_errors: int = 5,
    quiet_hours_start: str = "",
    quiet_hours_end: str = "",
) -> dict:
    """Create or update FB Messenger Preference for the current user."""
    email = frappe.session.user
    existing = frappe.db.exists("FB Messenger Preference", {"user_email": email})
    if existing:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Messenger Preference", existing, {
            "whatsapp_number": whatsapp_number,
            "telegram_chat_id": telegram_chat_id,
            "alerts_enabled": alerts_enabled,
            "digest_enabled": digest_enabled,
            "alert_threshold_errors": alert_threshold_errors,
            "quiet_hours_start": quiet_hours_start,
            "quiet_hours_end": quiet_hours_end,
        })
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"name": existing, "updated": True}

    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Messenger Preference",
        "user_email": email,
        "whatsapp_number": whatsapp_number,
        "telegram_chat_id": telegram_chat_id,
        "alerts_enabled": alerts_enabled,
        "digest_enabled": digest_enabled,
        "alert_threshold_errors": alert_threshold_errors,
        "quiet_hours_start": quiet_hours_start,
        "quiet_hours_end": quiet_hours_end,
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"name": doc.name, "created": True}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_messenger_preference() -> dict:
    email = frappe.session.user
    pref = frappe.db.get_value(
        "FB Messenger Preference", {"user_email": email},
        ["name", "whatsapp_number", "telegram_chat_id", "alerts_enabled",
         "digest_enabled", "alert_threshold_errors", "quiet_hours_start", "quiet_hours_end"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    return pref or {}

@frappe.whitelist()
def set_messenger_channel_config(channel: str, config: dict | str) -> dict:
    """Store channel credentials in FB FlowBridge Settings."""
    if isinstance(config, str):
        config = json.loads(config)
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    settings = frappe.get_single("FB FlowBridge Settings")
    if channel == "whatsapp":
        settings.whatsapp_access_token = config.get("access_token", "")
        settings.whatsapp_phone_number_id = config.get("phone_number_id", "")
        settings.whatsapp_app_secret = config.get("app_secret", "")
        settings.whatsapp_verify_token = config.get("verify_token", "flowbridge")
    elif channel == "telegram":
        settings.telegram_bot_token = config.get("bot_token", "")
    settings.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"channel": channel, "configured": True}

        "telegram": bool(_get_setting("telegram_bot_token")),
    }

"""

Thin, mobile-optimised REST endpoints for the FlowBridge mobile app
(React Native / PWA). All responses are compact and pagination-ready.

6.35 — One-tap retry (failed run / DLQ event)
6.36 — Live metrics & incident response

# 6.32 — Flow health dashboard
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_health_dashboard(limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    """
    Mobile home screen: compact health summary of top N flows.
    Returns overall health score + per-flow status rows.
    """
    flows = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Flow",
        filters={"is_active": 1},
        fields=["name", "flow_name"],
        limit=int(limit),
        order_by="modified desc",
    )

    rows = []
    since = add_to_date(now_datetime(), hours=-24)
    total_runs = 0
    total_errors = 0

    for flow in flows:
        runs = frappe.get_all(
            "FB Flow Run",
            filters=[["flow", "=", flow.name], ["creation", ">", since]],
            fields=["status"],
        )
        n = len(runs)
        errors = sum(1 for r in runs if r.status in ("Failed", "Error"))
        total_runs += n
        total_errors += errors
        last_run = frappe.db.get_value(
            "FB Flow Run", {"flow": flow.name}, "status", order_by="creation desc"
        ) or "Never"

        rows.append({
            "flow_name": flow.flow_name,
            "runs_24h": n,
            "errors_24h": errors,
            "error_rate_pct": round(errors / max(n, 1) * 100, 1),
            "last_run_status": last_run,
            "health": "ok" if errors == 0 else ("warn" if errors / max(n, 1) < 0.2 else "critical"),
        })

    rows.sort(key=lambda x: x["errors_24h"], reverse=True)
    overall_health = (
        "critical" if total_errors / max(total_runs, 1) > 0.2 else
        "warn" if total_errors > 0 else "ok"
    )

    return {
        "overall_health": overall_health,
        "total_runs_24h": total_runs,
        "total_errors_24h": total_errors,
        "flows": rows,
        "generated_at": str(now_datetime()),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.33 — Smart alerts feed
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_alerts_feed(limit: int = 20, since: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    Mobile alerts feed: recent incidents, circuit breaker events,
    SLA breaches, DLQ spikes — sorted by severity and recency.
    """
    alerts = []
    cutoff = since or str(add_to_date(now_datetime(), hours=-48))

    # Connector incidents
    incidents = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Connector Incident",
        filters=[["creation", ">", cutoff]],
        fields=["connector", "status", "message", "creation"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit=int(limit),
    )
    for inc in incidents:
        alerts.append({
            "type": "incident",
            "severity": "critical" if inc.status == "open" else "info",
            "title": f"Connector incident: {inc.connector}",
            "message": inc.message or "",
            "time": str(inc.creation),
        })

    # SLA breaches
    breaches = frappe.get_all(
        "FB SLA Breach Alert",
        filters=[["creation", ">", cutoff]],
        fields=["flow_name", "sla_name", "breach_type", "creation"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit=int(limit),
    )
    for b in breaches:
        alerts.append({
            "type": "sla_breach",
            "severity": "warn",
            "title": f"SLA breach: {b.flow_name}",
            "message": f"Breached: {b.breach_type}",
            "time": str(b.creation),
        })

    # DLQ depth spike (> 10 dead events)
    try:
        dlq_depth = frappe.db.count("FB Event", {"status": "dead"})
        if dlq_depth > 10:
            alerts.append({
                "type": "dlq_spike",
                "severity": "warn",
                "title": "Dead Letter Queue spike",
                "message": f"{dlq_depth} unprocessed dead events",
                "time": str(now_datetime()),
            })
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Sort: critical first, then by time
    alerts.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if x["severity"] == "critical" else 1, x["time"]), reverse=True)

    return {
        "alerts": alerts[:int(limit)],
        "total": len(alerts),
        "has_critical": any(a["severity"] == "critical" for a in alerts),
    }

# 6.35 — One-tap retry
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def retry_run(run_name: str) -> dict:
    """Retry a failed FB Flow Run from the mobile app."""
    if not frappe.db.exists("FB Flow Run", run_name):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Flow Run '{run_name}' not found"))

    run = frappe.get_doc("FB Flow Run", run_name)
    if run.status not in ("Failed", "Error"):
        return {"error": f"Run '{run_name}' has status '{run.status}' — only failed runs can be retried"}

    # Re-enqueue via event queue
    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue import enqueue_event
    payload = frappe.db.get_value("FB Flow Run", run_name, "payload_json") or "{}"
    result = enqueue_event(
        flow_name=run.flow,
        payload=payload,
        trigger="retry",
    )
    return {
        "original_run": run_name,
        "new_event": result.get("event_name"),
        "status": "queued",
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def retry_dlq_event(event_name: str) -> dict:
    """Retry a single dead event from the DLQ (one-tap from mobile)."""
    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue import requeue_from_dlq
    return requeue_from_dlq(event_name=event_name)


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_failed_runs(limit: int = 20) -> dict:
    """Return recent failed runs for the mobile retry screen."""
    runs = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Flow Run",
        filters=[["status", "in", ["Failed", "Error"]]],
        fields=["name", "flow", "status", "creation", "modified"],
        order_by="modified desc",
        limit=int(limit),
    )
    return {"runs": runs, "count": len(runs)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.36 — Live metrics & incident response
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_live_metrics() -> dict:
    """
    Real-time metrics snapshot for the mobile metrics screen.
    Combines connector health, queue depths, and recent error rates.
    """
    since_1h = add_to_date(now_datetime(), hours=-1)
    since_24h = add_to_date(now_datetime(), hours=-24)

    # Run counts
    runs_1h = frappe.db.count("FB Flow Run", [["creation", ">", since_1h]])
    errors_1h = frappe.db.count(
        "FB Flow Run", [["creation", ">", since_1h], ["status", "in", ["Failed", "Error"]]]
    )
    runs_24h = frappe.db.count("FB Flow Run", [["creation", ">", since_24h]])
    errors_24h = frappe.db.count(
        "FB Flow Run", [["creation", ">", since_24h], ["status", "in", ["Failed", "Error"]]]
    )

    # Queue depths
    queue_depth = 0
    dlq_depth = 0
    try:
        r = frappe.cache()
        queue_depth = r.llen("fb:queue:flow_runs") or 0
        dlq_depth = r.llen("fb:dlq:flow_runs") or 0
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Active incidents
    open_incidents = frappe.db.count("FB Connector Incident", {"status": "open"})

    # Connector paused count
    paused_connectors = frappe.db.count("FB Connector", {"is_paused": 1})

    # Pending approvals
    pending_approvals = frappe.db.count("FB Approval Request", {"status": "Pending"})

    return {
        "timestamp": str(now_datetime()),
        "runs_1h": runs_1h,
        "errors_1h": errors_1h,
        "error_rate_1h_pct": round(errors_1h / max(runs_1h, 1) * 100, 1),
        "runs_24h": runs_24h,
        "errors_24h": errors_24h,
        "error_rate_24h_pct": round(errors_24h / max(runs_24h, 1) * 100, 1),
        "queue_depth": queue_depth,
        "dlq_depth": dlq_depth,
        "open_incidents": open_incidents,
        "paused_connectors": paused_connectors,
        "pending_approvals": pending_approvals,
        "system_health": _compute_health_score(
            errors_1h, runs_1h, open_incidents, paused_connectors
        ),
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def resolve_incident(incident_name: str, resolution_note: str = "") -> dict:
    """Mark a connector incident as resolved from the mobile incident response screen."""
    if not frappe.db.exists("FB Connector Incident", incident_name):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Incident '{incident_name}' not found"))

    frappe.db.set_value("FB Connector Incident", incident_name, {
        "status": "resolved",
        "resolved_at": now_datetime(),
        "resolution_note": resolution_note[:500],
    })
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"status": "resolved", "incident": incident_name}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_incident_feed(limit: int = 20) -> dict:
    """Compact incident list for the mobile incident response screen."""
    incidents = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Connector Incident",
        fields=["name", "connector", "status", "message",
                "creation", "resolved_at"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit=int(limit),
    )
    return {"incidents": incidents, "count": len(incidents),
            "open": sum(1 for i in incidents if i.status == "open")}


def _compute_health_score(errors_1h, runs_1h, open_incidents, paused) -> str:
    if open_incidents > 0 or paused > 2:
        return "critical"
    if runs_1h > 0 and errors_1h / runs_1h > 0.1:
        return "degraded"
    return "healthy"

"""
FlowBridge Multi-Site Orchestration — Phase 6, items 6.1–6.3
Site federation, cross-site flows, HQ push/pull.
"""
import json
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, get_datetime
import requests


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.1 — Site Federation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def register_site(site_name: str, base_url: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str,
                  site_type: str = "branch", description: str = "") -> dict:
    """Register a remote Frappe/FlowBridge site for federation."""
    if frappe.db.exists("FB Federated Site", site_name):
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Federated Site", site_name, {
            "base_url": base_url.rstrip("/"),
            "api_key": api_key,
            "site_type": site_type,
            "description": description,
        })
        frappe.db.set_single_value("FB Federated Site", "api_secret", api_secret)
    else:
        doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB Federated Site",
            "site_name": site_name,
            "base_url": base_url.rstrip("/"),
            "api_key": api_key,
            "site_type": site_type,
            "description": description,
            "status": "Active",
        })
        doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.utils.password.update_password("FB Federated Site", site_name, api_secret, fieldname="api_secret")
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"registered": True, "site_name": site_name}


@frappe.whitelist()
def list_federated_sites() -> list:
    return frappe.get_all(
        "FB Federated Site",
        fields=["site_name", "base_url", "site_type", "status", "last_ping", "description"],
        order_by="site_type, site_name",
    )


@frappe.whitelist()
def ping_site(site_name: str) -> dict:
    """Health check a federated site."""
    site = frappe.get_doc("FB Federated Site", site_name)
    try:
        resp = _site_request(site, "GET", "/api/method/frappe.ping", timeout=5)
        ok = resp.status_code == 200
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Federated Site", site_name, {
            "status": "Active" if ok else "Error",
            "last_ping": now_datetime(),
        })
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"ok": ok, "latency_ms": int(resp.elapsed.total_seconds() * 1000)}
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.db.set_value("FB Federated Site", site_name, {"status": "Error"})
        frappe.db.commit()
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e)}

# 6.2 — Cross-Site Flows
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def trigger_remote_flow(site_name: str, flow_name: str, payload: str = "{}") -> dict:
    """Trigger a flow on a federated site."""
    site = frappe.get_doc("FB Federated Site", site_name)
    data = json.loads(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
    resp = _site_request(site, "POST",
                         "/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.trigger_flow",
                         json={"flow_name": flow_name, "payload": json.dumps(data)})
    resp.raise_for_status()
    result = resp.json().get("message", {})
    # Log cross-site invocation
    _log_cross_site(site_name, flow_name, "trigger", result.get("run_name", ""))
    return result


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_remote_flow_status(site_name: str, run_name: str) -> dict:
    """Poll a flow run on a remote site."""
    site = frappe.get_doc("FB Federated Site", site_name)
    resp = _site_request(site, "GET",
                         f"/api/resource/FB Flow Run/{run_name}")
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json().get("data", {})


@frappe.whitelist()
def sync_flow_definition(flow_name: str, target_sites: str = "") -> dict:
    """Push a flow definition to one or more federated sites."""
    from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow import export_flow
    flow_json = export_flow(flow_name)

    sites = [s.strip() for s in target_sites.split(",") if s.strip()] if target_sites else []
    if not sites:
        sites = [s.site_name for s in frappe.get_all("FB Federated Site", filters={"status": "Active"},
                                                       fields=["site_name"])]
    results = {}
    for site_name in sites:
        try:
            site = frappe.get_doc("FB Federated Site", site_name)
            resp = _site_request(site, "POST",
                                 "/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.import_flow",
                                 json={"flow_json": flow_json, "overwrite": 1})
            results[site_name] = {"ok": resp.status_code == 200}
        except Exception as e:
            results[site_name] = {"ok": False, "error": str(e)}
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.3 — HQ Push / Pull
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def hq_push_flows(target_site: str = "") -> dict:
    """HQ: push all active flows to branch sites."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    active_flows = frappe.get_all("FB Flow", filters={"is_active": 1}, fields=["flow_name"])
    sites = [s.strip() for s in target_site.split(",") if s.strip()] if target_site else []
    if not sites:
        sites = [s.site_name for s in frappe.get_all("FB Federated Site",
                                                      filters={"status": "Active", "site_type": "branch"},
                                                      fields=["site_name"])]
    pushed = 0
    errors = []
    for flow in active_flows:
        result = sync_flow_definition(flow.flow_name, ",".join(sites))
        for site_name, r in result.items():
            if r.get("ok"):
                pushed += 1
            else:
                errors.append(f"{flow.flow_name}@{site_name}: {r.get('error', 'unknown')}")
    return {"pushed": pushed, "errors": errors}


@frappe.whitelist()
def hq_pull_run_stats(source_sites: str = "") -> dict:
    """HQ: pull flow run statistics from all branch sites."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    sites = [s.strip() for s in source_sites.split(",") if s.strip()] if source_sites else []
    if not sites:
        sites = [s.site_name for s in frappe.get_all("FB Federated Site",
                                                      filters={"status": "Active"},
                                                      fields=["site_name"])]
    agg = {}
    for site_name in sites:
        try:
            site = frappe.get_doc("FB Federated Site", site_name)
            resp = _site_request(site, "GET",
                                 "/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.analytics.get_cross_flow_summary",
                                 params={"days": 7})
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                agg[site_name] = resp.json().get("message", {})
        except Exception as e:
            agg[site_name] = {"error": str(e)}
    return agg


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _site_request(site_doc, method: str, path: str, timeout: int = 30, **kwargs):
    api_secret = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
        "FB Federated Site", site_doc.name, "api_secret"
    )
    url = site_doc.base_url + path
    headers = kwargs.pop("headers", {})
    headers["Authorization"] = f"token {site_doc.api_key}:{api_secret}"
    return requests.request(method, url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout, **kwargs)


def _log_cross_site(site_name: str, flow_name: str, action: str, ref: str):
    try:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "FB Cross Site Log",
            "site_name": site_name,
            "flow_name": flow_name,
            "action": action,
            "ref": ref,
            "logged_at": now_datetime(),
            "logged_by": frappe.session.user,
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/observability.py
"""
FlowBridge OpenTelemetry Observability — Phase 6, items 6.19–6.20
Field-level tracing and export to Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog.
"""
import json
import time
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.19 — OpenTelemetry observability — field-level spans
# We use OTLP HTTP exporter if opentelemetry packages are installed.
# Falls back to Frappe Redis metrics if not installed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _get_tracer():
    """Return an OTel tracer or a no-op tracer."""
    try:
        from opentelemetry import trace
        from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
        from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
        from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter

        settings = frappe.db.get_singles_dict("FB FlowBridge Settings")
        endpoint = settings.get("otel_endpoint", "http://localhost:4318/v1/traces")

        provider = TracerProvider()
        provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint=endpoint)))
        trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
        return trace.get_tracer("flowbridge")
    except ImportError:
        return _NoOpTracer()


class _NoOpTracer:
    def start_as_current_span(self, name, **kwargs):
        from contextlib import contextmanager
        @contextmanager
        def _cm():
            yield _NoOpSpan()
        return _cm()

    def start_span(self, name, **kwargs):
        return _NoOpSpan()


class _NoOpSpan:
    def set_attribute(self, *a, **k): pass
    def record_exception(self, *a, **k): pass
    def set_status(self, *a, **k): pass
    def end(self): pass
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *a): pass


_tracer = None


def get_tracer():
    global _tracer
    if _tracer is None:
        _tracer = _get_tracer()
    return _tracer


def trace_flow_run(flow_run: str, flow_name: str):
    """Create a root span for a flow run."""
    return get_tracer().start_span(
        "flow.run",
        attributes={"flow.name": flow_name, "flow.run_id": flow_run},
    )


def trace_node_execution(node_id: str, node_type: str, flow_run: str):
    """Create a child span for a single node execution."""
    return get_tracer().start_span(
        f"flow.node.{node_type}",
        attributes={"node.id": node_id, "node.type": node_type, "flow.run_id": flow_run},
    )


def trace_connector_call(connector_name: str, endpoint: str, method: str):
    """Span for an outbound HTTP call through a connector."""
    return get_tracer().start_span(
        "connector.http",
        attributes={
            "connector.name": connector_name,
            "http.endpoint": endpoint,
            "http.method": method,
        },
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_prometheus_metrics() -> str:
    """
    Expose FlowBridge metrics in Prometheus text format.
    Endpoint: /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.observability.get_prometheus_metrics
    """
    lines = ["# FlowBridge Prometheus metrics"]
    lines.append("# HELP fb_flow_runs_total Total flow runs by status")
    lines.append("# TYPE fb_flow_runs_total counter")

    statuses = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `tabFB Flow Run` GROUP BY status", as_dict=True
    )
    for row in statuses:
        lines.append(f'fb_flow_runs_total{{status="{row.status}"}} {row.cnt}')

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("# HELP fb_connector_errors_total Circuit breaker failure count per connector")
    lines.append("# TYPE fb_connector_errors_total gauge")
    try:
        from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.circuit_breaker import get_status
        connectors = frappe.get_all("FB Connector", filters={"is_active": 1}, fields=["name"])
        for c in connectors:
            st = get_status(c.name)
            lines.append(f'fb_connector_errors_total{{connector="{c.name}"}} {st.get("failure_count", 0)}')
    except Exception:
        pass

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("# HELP fb_api_requests_total API requests per endpoint")
    lines.append("# TYPE fb_api_requests_total counter")
    api_stats = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT custom_api, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `tabFB API Request Log` GROUP BY custom_api LIMIT 50",
        as_dict=True,
    )
    for row in api_stats:
        lines.append(f'fb_api_requests_total{{endpoint="{row.custom_api or "unknown"}"}} {row.cnt}')

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("# HELP fb_approval_requests_pending Pending approval requests")
    lines.append("# TYPE fb_approval_requests_pending gauge")
    pending = frappe.db.count("FB Approval Request", {"status": "Pending"})
    lines.append(f"fb_approval_requests_pending {pending}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("# HELP fb_dlq_depth Dead letter queue depth")
    lines.append("# TYPE fb_dlq_depth gauge")
    try:
        import redis
        r = redis.from_url(frappe.conf.get("redis_queue", "redis://localhost:6379"))
        dlq_depth = r.llen("fb:queue:dlq")
        lines.append(f"fb_dlq_depth {dlq_depth}")
    except Exception:
        lines.append("fb_dlq_depth 0")

    return "\n".join(lines)


@frappe.whitelist()
def push_metrics_to_datadog(api_key: str = "") -> dict:
    """
    Push a metrics snapshot to Datadog v1 API.
    api_key can be passed directly or stored in FB FlowBridge Settings.
    """
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    import requests

    if not api_key:
        api_key = frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password(
            "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", "datadog_api_key"
        )
    if not api_key:
        return {"error": "No Datadog API key configured"}

    now_ts = int(time.time())
    statuses = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `tabFB Flow Run` GROUP BY status", as_dict=True
    )
    series = []
    for row in statuses:
        series.append({
            "metric": "flowbridge.flow_runs",
            "points": [[now_ts, row.cnt]],
            "tags": [f"status:{row.status}", "source:flowbridge"],
            "type": "gauge",
        })

    pending = frappe.db.count("FB Approval Request", {"status": "Pending"})
    series.append({
        "metric": "flowbridge.approval_requests.pending",
        "points": [[now_ts, pending]],
        "tags": ["source:flowbridge"],
        "type": "gauge",
    })

    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/series",
        json={"series": series},
        headers={"DD-API-KEY": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    return {"ok": resp.status_code == 202, "status_code": resp.status_code}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_otel_status() -> dict:
    """Report whether OpenTelemetry SDK is installed and configured."""
    try:
        import opentelemetry
        installed = True
        version = opentelemetry.__version__
    except ImportError:
        installed = False
        version = None

    settings = frappe.db.get_singles_dict("FB FlowBridge Settings")
    return {
        "otel_installed": installed,
        "otel_version": version,
        "otel_endpoint": settings.get("otel_endpoint", ""),
        "datadog_configured": bool(settings.get("datadog_api_key", "")),
        "mode": "otlp" if installed else "redis_metrics_only",
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def configure_otel(endpoint: str = "", datadog_api_key: str = "") -> dict:
    """Save OTEL/Datadog config to FB FlowBridge Settings."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
    if endpoint:
        frappe.db.set_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "otel_endpoint", endpoint)
    if datadog_api_key:
        frappe.utils.password.update_password(
            "FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings",
            datadog_api_key, fieldname="datadog_api_key"
        )
    frappe.db.commit()
    global _tracer
    _tracer = None  # Reset so next call picks up new config
    return {"saved": True}

@frappe.whitelist()
def apply_for_certification(tier: str, company_name: str,
                             contact_email: str, website: str = "",
                             notes: str = "") -> dict:
    """Apply for FlowBridge partner certification."""
    if tier not in CERTIFICATION_TIERS:
        frappe.throw(_(f"Invalid tier '{tier}'. Choose from: {list(CERTIFICATION_TIERS.keys())}"))

    existing = frappe.db.exists("FB Partner Application",
                                 {"contact_email": contact_email, "tier": tier,
                                  "status": ["in", ["Pending", "Under Review"]]})
    if existing:
        return {"error": f"An active application for {tier} already exists for {contact_email}"}

    # Auto-check requirements based on submitted connectors
    metrics = _get_partner_metrics(contact_email)
    requirements = CERTIFICATION_TIERS[tier]["requirements"]
    checks = _check_requirements(metrics, requirements)

    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Partner Application",
        "tier": tier,
        "company_name": company_name,
        "contact_email": contact_email,
        "website": website,
        "notes": notes[:1000],
        "status": "Pending",
        "applied_at": now_datetime(),
        "requirements_met": json.dumps(checks),
        "auto_eligible": all(checks.values()),
    })
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    # Auto-approve if all requirements are met
    if doc.auto_eligible:
        _grant_certification(doc.name, tier, contact_email, company_name)
        return {
            "application": doc.name,
            "status": "auto_approved",
            "tier": tier,
            "message": f"Congratulations! You meet all {tier} requirements. Certificate issued.",
        }

    return {
        "application": doc.name,
        "status": "pending_review",
        "tier": tier,
        "requirements_check": checks,
        "message": f"Application submitted. Team will review within 5 business days.",
    }


@frappe.whitelist()
def review_partner_application(application_name: str, decision: str,
                                 review_notes: str = "") -> dict:
    """Approve or reject a partner application (admin)."""
    frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])

    app = frappe.get_doc("FB Partner Application", application_name)
    if decision == "approved":
        _grant_certification(application_name, app.tier, app.contact_email, app.company_name)
        status = "Approved"
    else:
        status = "Rejected"

    frappe.db.set_value("FB Partner Application", application_name, {
        "status": status,
        "review_notes": review_notes,
        "reviewed_by": frappe.session.user,
        "reviewed_at": now_datetime(),
    })
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"application": application_name, "status": status, "tier": app.tier}


def _grant_certification(application_name: str, tier: str,
                          email: str, company: str):
    """Issue a certification record and send congratulatory email."""
    cert_doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "FB Partner Certificate",
        "tier": tier,
        "company_name": company,
        "contact_email": email,
        "application": application_name,
        "issued_at": now_datetime(),
        "valid_until": add_to_date(now_datetime(), years=1),
        "certificate_id": f"FB-{tier[:2].upper()}-{frappe.generate_hash(length=8).upper()}",
        "benefits": json.dumps(CERTIFICATION_TIERS[tier]["benefits"]),
    })
    cert_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.set_value("FB Partner Application", application_name, "status", "Approved")

    try:
        frappe.sendmail(
            recipients=[email],
            subject=f"🎉 FlowBridge {tier} Partner Certification",
            message=f"""
<p>Congratulations, {company}!</p>
<p>You have been awarded <strong>FlowBridge {tier} Partner</strong> status.</p>
<p>Certificate ID: <strong>{cert_doc.certificate_id}</strong></p>
<p>Valid until: {cert_doc.valid_until}</p>
<h4>Your benefits:</h4>
<ul>{''.join(f'<li>{b}</li>' for b in CERTIFICATION_TIERS[tier]['benefits'])}</ul>
<p>Welcome to the FlowBridge Partner Program!</p>
""",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

def _get_partner_metrics(email: str) -> dict:
    submissions = frappe.get_all("FB Connector Submission",
                                  filters={"submitter_email": email},
                                  fields=["status"])
    approved = sum(1 for s in submissions if s.status == "Approved")
    flows = frappe.db.count("FB Flow", {"owner": email})

    return {
        "connectors_submitted": len(submissions),
        "connectors_approved": approved,
        "flows_published": flows,
        "min_install_count": 0,
    }


def _check_requirements(metrics: dict, requirements: dict) -> dict:
    checks = {}
    for req, threshold in requirements.items():
        if isinstance(threshold, bool):
            checks[req] = True  # Tier prerequisite — assume met for auto-check
        elif isinstance(threshold, int):
            checks[req] = metrics.get(req, 0) >= threshold
        else:
            checks[req] = True
    return checks

@frappe.whitelist()
def claim_bounty(bounty_name: str, submission_name: str) -> dict:
    """Claim a bounty by linking an approved connector submission."""
    if not frappe.db.exists("FB Connector Bounty", bounty_name):
        frappe.throw(_(f"Bounty '{bounty_name}' not found"))

    bounty = frappe.get_doc("FB Connector Bounty", bounty_name)
    if bounty.status != "open":
        return {"error": f"Bounty '{bounty_name}' is {bounty.status} — cannot claim"}

    submission_status = frappe.db.get_value("FB Connector Submission", submission_name, "status")
    if submission_status != "Approved":
        return {"error": "Submission must be Approved before claiming a bounty"}

    frappe.db.set_value("FB Connector Bounty", bounty_name, {
        "status": "claimed",
        "claimed_by": frappe.session.user,
        "claimed_at": now_datetime(),
        "submission": submission_name,
    })
    frappe.db.commit()
    return {"status": "claimed", "bounty": bounty_name,
            "reward_usd": bounty.reward_usd,
            "message": f"Bounty claimed! Reward of ${bounty.reward_usd} will be processed within 14 days."}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_bounty_leaderboard(limit: int = 20) -> list:
    """Return top contributors by total bounties claimed."""
    claims = frappe.get_all(
        "FB Connector Bounty",
        filters={"status": "claimed"},
        fields=["claimed_by", "reward_usd"],
    )
    totals = {}
    for c in claims:
        totals[c.claimed_by] = totals.get(c.claimed_by, 0) + (c.reward_usd or 0)
    leaderboard = sorted(
        [{"contributor": k, "total_usd": v} for k, v in totals.items()],
        key=lambda x: x["total_usd"], reverse=True,
    )
    return leaderboard[:int(limit)]

@frappe.whitelist()
def list_prompts(feature: str = "", active_only: bool = True) -> list:
	filters = {}
	if feature:
		filters["feature"] = feature
	if active_only:
		filters["is_active"] = 1
	return frappe.get_all(
		"FB AI Prompt",
		filters=filters,
		fields=["name", "prompt_name", "feature", "version", "is_active", "description", "tags"],
		order_by="prompt_name asc",
	)


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_prompt(prompt_name: str) -> dict:
	doc = frappe.get_doc("FB AI Prompt", prompt_name)
	return doc.as_dict()


@frappe.whitelist()
def save_prompt(prompt_name: str, feature: str, system_prompt: str,
                user_prompt_template: str = "", description: str = "",
                provider_override: str = "", tags: str = "") -> dict:
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	if frappe.db.exists("FB AI Prompt", prompt_name):
		doc = frappe.get_doc("FB AI Prompt", prompt_name)
		doc.feature = feature
		doc.system_prompt = system_prompt
		doc.user_prompt_template = user_prompt_template
		doc.description = description
		doc.provider_override = provider_override
		doc.tags = tags
		doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	else:
		doc = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "FB AI Prompt",
			"prompt_name": prompt_name,
			"feature": feature,
			"system_prompt": system_prompt,
			"user_prompt_template": user_prompt_template,
			"description": description,
			"provider_override": provider_override,
			"tags": tags,
		})
		doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	frappe.db.commit()
	return {"name": doc.name, "version": doc.version}


def get_active_prompt(feature: str, prompt_name: str = "") -> dict | None:
	"""Return the active prompt for a feature, optionally by specific name."""
	filters = {"feature": feature, "is_active": 1}
	if prompt_name:
		filters["prompt_name"] = prompt_name
	name = frappe.db.get_value("FB AI Prompt", filters, "name")
	if not name:
		return None
	return frappe.get_doc("FB AI Prompt", name).as_dict()


def render_prompt(prompt_doc: dict, variables: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
	"""Render system + user prompt with Jinja2 variable substitution."""
	system = prompt_doc.get("system_prompt", "")
	user_tmpl = prompt_doc.get("user_prompt_template", "")
	try:
		user = frappe.render_template(user_tmpl, variables)
	except Exception:
		user = user_tmpl
	return system, user


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-4.7: Prompt Testing Console
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def test_prompt(prompt_name: str, variables: str = "{}",
                provider_override: str = "") -> dict:
	"""
	Test a prompt against the configured AI provider.
	Returns the raw output and saves it back to the prompt record.
	"""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine import get_engine

	doc = frappe.get_doc("FB AI Prompt", prompt_name)
	vars_dict = json.loads(variables) if isinstance(variables, str) else variables

	system, user = render_prompt(doc.as_dict(), vars_dict)
	if not user:
		user = "(test — no user prompt template configured)"

	# Provider override: use prompt-level or caller-level override
	override = provider_override or doc.provider_override or ""
	if override:
		# Temporarily swap the provider in settings
		engine = _engine_for_provider(override)
	else:
		engine = get_engine(doc.feature)

	import time
	t0 = time.monotonic()
	try:
		output = engine.complete(system, user, max_tokens=1024)
		latency_ms = round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
		error = None
	except Exception as e:
		output = ""
		latency_ms = round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
		error = str(e)

	# Save test result back to the record
	frappe.db.set_value("FB AI Prompt", prompt_name, {
		"last_test_output": output[:2000] if output else f"ERROR: {error}",
		"last_test_at": now_datetime(),
	})
	frappe.db.commit()

	return {
		"prompt_name": prompt_name,
		"provider": engine.name,
		"latency_ms": latency_ms,
		"output": output,
		"error": error,
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def test_raw_prompt(system_prompt: str, user_prompt: str,
                    provider: str = "", max_tokens: int = 1024) -> dict:
	"""
	AI-4.7: Test an arbitrary system+user prompt without saving it.
	Useful for prompt engineering experiments.
	"""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager", "FlowBridge Developer"])
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine import get_engine
	engine = _engine_for_provider(provider) if provider else get_engine()

	import time
	t0 = time.monotonic()
	try:
		output = engine.complete(system_prompt, user_prompt, max_tokens=int(max_tokens))
		return {
			"output": output,
			"provider": engine.name,
			"latency_ms": round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000),
		}
	except Exception as e:
		return {
			"output": "",
			"error": str(e),
			"provider": engine.name,
			"latency_ms": round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000),
		}


def _engine_for_provider(provider: str):
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine import (
		ClaudeProvider, OpenAIProvider, GeminiProvider, OllamaProvider,
		DefaultEngine, _get_settings,
	)
	s = _get_settings()
	if provider == "claude":
		return ClaudeProvider(s.get("anthropic_api_key", ""), s.get("claude_model", "claude-sonnet-4-6"))
	elif provider == "openai":
		return OpenAIProvider(s.get("openai_api_key", ""), s.get("openai_model", "gpt-4o"))
	elif provider == "gemini":
		return GeminiProvider(s.get("gemini_api_key", ""), s.get("gemini_model", "gemini-1.5-pro"))
	elif provider == "ollama":
		return OllamaProvider(s.get("ollama_base_url", ""), s.get("ollama_model", "llama3"))
	return DefaultEngine()

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/api/protocol_connectors.py
"""
FlowBridge Protocol Connectors — Phase 7, items 7.2–7.7

  - Auto-registration in the node handler dispatch table
"""
