import frappe
import json
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Browse & Search (2.3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def list_packages(
	package_type: str = "",
	category: str = "",
	pricing_model: str = "",
	search: str = "",
	sort_by: str = "install_count",
	page: int = 1,
	page_size: int = 20,
) -> dict:
	filters = {"status": "Published"}
	if package_type:
		filters["package_type"] = package_type
	if category:
		filters["category"] = category
	if pricing_model:
		filters["pricing_model"] = pricing_model

	order_map = {
		"install_count": "install_count desc",
		"rating": "rating_average desc",
		"newest": "creation desc",
		"price_asc": "price_inr asc",
	}
	order = order_map.get(sort_by, "install_count desc")

	fields = [
		"package_name", "title", "package_type", "short_description",
		"developer", "pricing_model", "price_inr", "subscription_price_inr",
		"install_count", "rating_average", "rating_count",
		"category", "tags", "icon_url", "is_featured", "is_verified",
		"latest_version",
	]

	all_pkgs = frappe.get_all("FB Marketplace Package", filters=filters,
		fields=fields, order_by=order)

	# Text search (DB-side LIKE not used to allow cross-field search)
	if search:
		q = search.lower()
		all_pkgs = [p for p in all_pkgs if
			q in (p.title or "").lower() or
			q in (p.short_description or "").lower() or
			q in (p.tags or "").lower() or
			q in (p.developer or "").lower()]

	total = len(all_pkgs)
	start = (int(page) - 1) * int(page_size)
	packages = all_pkgs[start: start + int(page_size)]

	return {"packages": packages, "total": total, "page": int(page), "page_size": int(page_size)}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_package(package_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Full package detail including versions, reviews, and Q&A summary."""
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)
	if pkg.status != "Published":
		frappe.only_for("System Manager")

	versions = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
		filters={"package": package_name, "status": ["in", ["Active", "Deprecated"]]},
		fields=["version", "status", "is_latest", "published_at", "changelog", "breaking_change", "download_count"],
		order_by="published_at desc")

	reviews = frappe.get_all("FB Package Review",
		filters={"package": package_name, "status": "Approved"},
		fields=["reviewer", "rating", "title", "body", "helpful_count", "creation"],
		order_by="helpful_count desc", limit=10)

	qa_count = frappe.db.count("FB QA Post", {"package": package_name})

	dev = frappe.get_doc("FB Developer Profile", pkg.developer)

	is_installed = bool(frappe.db.exists("FB Installed Package", {
		"package": package_name, "status": "Active",
		"installed_by": frappe.session.user,
	}))

	return {
		"package": pkg.as_dict(),
		"versions": versions,
		"reviews": reviews,
		"qa_count": qa_count,
		"developer": {
			"name": dev.developer_name,
			"display_name": dev.display_name,
			"avatar_url": dev.avatar_url,
			"is_verified": dev.is_verified,
			"total_installs": dev.total_installs,
			"rating_average": dev.rating_average,
		},
		"is_installed": is_installed,
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_version_diff(package_name: str, version_a: str, version_b: str) -> dict:
	"""Return structural diff between two versions (2.19)."""
	ver_b = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
		filters={"package": package_name, "version": version_b},
		limit=1, pluck="name")
	if not ver_b:
		frappe.throw(f"Version {version_b} not found")
	doc_b = frappe.get_doc("FB Package Version", ver_b[0])

	ver_a = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
		filters={"package": package_name, "version": version_a},
		limit=1, pluck="name")
	if not ver_a:
		frappe.throw(f"Version {version_a} not found")

	return doc_b.diff_against(ver_a[0])


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# One-click install / uninstall (2.4)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def install_package(package_name: str, version: str = "") -> dict:
	"""Install a free package or initiate paid install flow."""
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)
	if pkg.pricing_model != "Free":
		frappe.throw("Paid packages must be installed via the payment flow. Use /marketplace/checkout.")

	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.marketplace.installer import PackageInstaller
	installer = PackageInstaller(package_name, version or None)
	installed_name = installer.install()
	return {"status": "installed", "installed": installed_name}


@frappe.whitelist()
def uninstall_package(installed_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Uninstall a package and remove its flows/connectors."""
	installed = frappe.get_doc("FB Installed Package", installed_name)
	if installed.installed_by != frappe.session.user:
		frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	installed.uninstall()
	return {"status": "uninstalled"}


@frappe.whitelist()
def rollback_version(installed_name: str, target_version: str) -> dict:
	"""Roll back an installed package to a specific older version (2.20)."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	installed = frappe.get_doc("FB Installed Package", installed_name)

	ver = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
		filters={"package": installed.package, "version": target_version},
		limit=1, pluck="name")
	if not ver:
		frappe.throw(f"Version {target_version} not found for package")

	ver_doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Package Version", ver[0])
	content = json.loads(ver_doc.content_json)

	installed.uninstall()

	installer = PackageInstaller.__new__(PackageInstaller)
	installer.package = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", installed.package)
	installer.version_doc = ver_doc
	installer.installed_flows = []
	installer.installed_connectors = []

	pkg_type = content.get("type", "flow")
	if pkg_type == "flow":
		installer._install_flow(content)
	elif pkg_type == "connector":
		installer._install_connector(content)
	else:
		installer._install_bundle(content)

	installed.db_set("version_installed", target_version)
	installed.db_set("status", "Active")
	installed.db_set("installed_flow_names", json.dumps(installer.installed_flows))
	installed.db_set("installed_connector_names", json.dumps(installer.installed_connectors))
	return {"status": "rolled_back", "version": target_version}

from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.marketplace.installer import PackageInstaller


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Publishing portal (2.2)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def publish_package(
	package_name: str,
	version: str,
	content_json: str,
	changelog: str = "",
	breaking_change: int = 0,
	migration_guide: str = "",
) -> dict:
	"""
	Create a new FB Package Version and submit it.
	If no package exists, the caller should create one first via frappe.db.insert.
	"""
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)

	# Verify the caller is the developer
	dev = frappe.db.get_value("FB Developer Profile", {"email": frappe.session.user})
	if not frappe.session.user == "Administrator" and pkg.developer != dev:
		frappe.throw("Only the package developer can publish new versions")

	ver = frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "FB Package Version",
		"package": package_name,
		"version": version,
		"content_json": content_json,
		"changelog": changelog,
		"breaking_change": int(breaking_change),
		"migration_guide": migration_guide,
		"status": "Draft",
	})
	ver.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	ver._publish()
	frappe.db.commit()

	# Auto-submit for review if package is not yet published
	if pkg.status == "Draft":
		pkg.submit_for_review()

	return {"version_name": ver.name, "package_status": pkg.reload().status}


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_developer_dashboard(developer_name: str = "") -> dict:
	"""Developer revenue + package stats dashboard (2.9)."""
	if not developer_name:
		developer_name = frappe.db.get_value("FB Developer Profile", {"email": frappe.session.user})
	if not developer_name:
		return {"developer": None, "packages": [], "revenue_by_month": [], "payouts": []}

	frappe.only_for("System Manager") if frappe.session.user != frappe.db.get_value(
		"FB Developer Profile", developer_name, "email") else None

	dev = frappe.get_doc("FB Developer Profile", developer_name)
	packages = frappe.get_all("FB Marketplace Package",
		filters={"developer": developer_name},
		fields=["package_name", "title", "status", "install_count", "active_installs",
		        "rating_average", "rating_count", "revenue_total", "pricing_model", "latest_version"])

	# Revenue by month (last 6)
	revenue_by_month = frappe.db.sql("""
		SELECT DATE_FORMAT(installed_at, '%%Y-%%m') as month,
		       SUM(amount_paid) as revenue,
		       COUNT(*) as installs
		FROM `tabFB Installed Package`
		WHERE package IN (
			SELECT package_name FROM `tabFB Marketplace Package` WHERE developer = %s
		)
		AND status IN ('Active', 'Expired')
		AND installed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
		GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
	""", developer_name, as_dict=True)

	payouts = frappe.get_all("FB Payout Request",
		filters={"developer": developer_name},
		fields=["name", "amount", "net_amount", "status", "requested_at", "processed_at"],
		order_by="requested_at desc", limit=10)

	return {
		"developer": dev.as_dict(),
		"packages": packages,
		"revenue_by_month": revenue_by_month,
		"payouts": payouts,
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def request_payout(developer_name: str, amount: float) -> dict:
	"""Create a payout request for the developer (2.10)."""
	dev = frappe.get_doc("FB Developer Profile", developer_name)
	if (dev.pending_payout or 0) < amount:
		frappe.throw(f"Requested amount ₹{amount} exceeds pending payout ₹{dev.pending_payout or 0}")
	if amount < 100:
		frappe.throw("Minimum payout is ₹100")

	req = frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "FB Payout Request",
		"developer": developer_name,
		"amount": amount,
	})
	req.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	frappe.db.commit()
	return {"payout_request": req.name, "net_amount": req.net_amount}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-install config wizard (2.5)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_config_requirements(installed_name: str) -> dict:
	"""
	Return the list of credentials / config values the user must supply
	after installing a package (post-install wizard).
	"""
	installed = frappe.get_doc("FB Installed Package", installed_name)
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", installed.package)

	# Find flows that reference connectors without credentials configured
	flows = json.loads(installed.installed_flow_names or "[]")
	connectors = json.loads(installed.installed_connector_names or "[]")

	missing_credentials = []
	for cname in connectors:
		if frappe.db.exists("FB Connector", cname):
			cred = frappe.db.get_value("FB Connector", cname, "credential")
			if not cred:
				missing_credentials.append({
					"connector": cname,
					"message": f"Connector '{cname}' needs a credential. Create an FB Credential and link it.",
				})

	required_connectors = [c.strip() for c in (pkg.required_connectors or "").split(",") if c.strip()]
	unmet_connectors = [c for c in required_connectors if not frappe.db.exists("FB Connector", c)]

	return {
		"installed": installed_name,
		"missing_credentials": missing_credentials,
		"unmet_connectors": unmet_connectors,
		"is_configured": not missing_credentials and not unmet_connectors,
		"installed_flows": flows,
		"installed_connectors": connectors,
	}

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/marketplace/installer.py
"""
FlowBridge Marketplace — One-click install engine (2.4 + 2.5).

Install flow:
  1. Verify payment (free / paid / subscription)
  2. Fetch FB Package Version content_json
  3. Parse package type (flow / connector / bundle)
  4. Import content — create FB Flow / FB Connector records
  5. Run post-install config wizard (collect required credential names)
  6. Create FB Installed Package record
  7. Fire after_install hooks (increment counters, etc.)
"""

import frappe
import json
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


class PackageInstaller:
	def __init__(self, package_name: str, version: str | None = None):
		self.package = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)
		self.version_name = version
		self.version_doc = None
		self.installed_flows = []
		self.installed_connectors = []

	# ------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Public entry point
	# ------------------------------------------------------------------

	def install(self, razorpay_payment_id: str | None = None, subscription_id: str | None = None) -> str:
		"""
		Install the package. Returns the FB Installed Package name.
		Raises frappe.ValidationError on failure.
		"""
		self._load_version()
		self._check_not_already_installed()
		self._verify_payment(razorpay_payment_id, subscription_id)

		content = json.loads(self.version_doc.content_json)
		pkg_type = content.get("type", self.package.package_type.lower())

		if pkg_type == "flow":
			self._install_flow(content)
		elif pkg_type == "connector":
			self._install_connector(content)
		elif pkg_type == "bundle":
			self._install_bundle(content)
		else:
			frappe.throw(f"Unknown package type: {pkg_type}")

		installed = self._create_installed_record(razorpay_payment_id, subscription_id)
		self._fire_post_install(installed, razorpay_payment_id)
		self.version_doc.record_download()
		return installed.name

	# ------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Installation helpers
	# ------------------------------------------------------------------

	def _load_version(self):
		if self.version_name:
			self.version_doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Package Version", self.version_name)
		else:
			versions = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
				filters={"package": self.package.name, "status": "Active", "is_latest": 1},
				limit=1, pluck="name")
			if not versions:
				frappe.throw(f"No active version found for package '{self.package.name}'")
			self.version_doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Package Version", versions[0])

	def _check_not_already_installed(self):
		existing = frappe.db.exists("FB Installed Package", {
			"package": self.package.name,
			"status": "Active",
		})
		if existing:
			frappe.throw(f"Package '{self.package.title}' is already installed. Uninstall first to reinstall.")

	def _verify_payment(self, payment_id: str | None, subscription_id: str | None):
		model = self.package.pricing_model
		if model == "Free":
			return
		if model == "One-time" and not payment_id:
			frappe.throw("Payment required. Please complete payment before installing.")
		if model == "Subscription" and not subscription_id:
			frappe.throw("Active subscription required. Please subscribe before installing.")

	def _install_flow(self, content: dict):
		"""Create FB Flow from package content."""
		flow_name = content.get("name") or self.package.package_name
		# Avoid name collision
		if frappe.db.exists("FB Flow", flow_name):
			flow_name = f"{flow_name}-{frappe.generate_hash(length=4)}"

		flow = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "FB Flow",
			"flow_name": flow_name,
			"status": "Paused",
			"trigger_type": content.get("trigger_type", "Manual"),
			"nodes": content.get("nodes", []),
			"description": content.get("description", ""),
		})
		flow.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
		self.installed_flows.append(flow.name)

	def _install_connector(self, content: dict):
		"""Create FB Connector from package content."""
		connector_name = content.get("name") or self.package.package_name
		if frappe.db.exists("FB Connector", connector_name):
			connector_name = f"{connector_name}-{frappe.generate_hash(length=4)}"

		connector = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "FB Connector",
			"connector_name": connector_name,
			"base_url": content.get("base_url", ""),
			"category": content.get("category", ""),
			"is_active": 1,
			"endpoints": content.get("endpoints", []),
		})
		connector.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
		self.installed_connectors.append(connector.name)

	def _install_bundle(self, content: dict):
		"""Install a bundle — a list of flows and/or connectors."""
		for item in content.get("flows", []):
			self._install_flow(item)
		for item in content.get("connectors", []):
			self._install_connector(item)

	def _create_installed_record(self, payment_id, subscription_id) -> "frappe.Document":
		payment_status = "Free"
		amount_paid = 0
		if payment_id:
			payment_status = "Paid"
			amount_paid = self.package.price_inr or 0
		elif subscription_id:
			payment_status = "Paid"
			amount_paid = self.package.subscription_price_inr or 0

		doc = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "FB Installed Package",
			"package": self.package.name,
			"version_installed": self.version_doc.version,
			"status": "Active",
			"installed_at": now_datetime(),
			"installed_by": frappe.session.user,
			"payment_status": payment_status,
			"razorpay_payment_id": payment_id or "",
			"subscription_id": subscription_id or "",
			"amount_paid": amount_paid,
			"installed_flow_names": json.dumps(self.installed_flows),
			"installed_connector_names": json.dumps(self.installed_connectors),
			"latest_version": self.version_doc.version,
		})
		doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
		frappe.db.commit()
		return doc

	def _fire_post_install(self, installed, payment_id):
		self.package.record_install()
		if payment_id and self.package.price_inr:
			self.package.record_revenue(self.package.price_inr)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Update engine (2.13)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

class PackageUpdater:
	def __init__(self, installed_name: str):
		self.installed = frappe.get_doc("FB Installed Package", installed_name)

	def update(self) -> bool:
		"""
		Update an installed package to the latest version.
		Returns True if updated, False if already at latest.
		"""
		pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", self.installed.package)
		if pkg.latest_version == self.installed.version_installed:
			return False

		latest_ver = frappe.get_all("FB Package Version",
			filters={"package": pkg.name, "status": "Active", "is_latest": 1},
			limit=1, pluck="name")
		if not latest_ver:
			return False

		ver_doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Package Version", latest_ver[0])
		content = json.loads(ver_doc.content_json)

		# Check for breaking change — skip auto-update
		if ver_doc.breaking_change and self.installed.auto_update:
			self.installed.db_set("update_available", 1)
			self.installed.db_set("latest_version", pkg.latest_version)
			return False

		installer = PackageInstaller(pkg.name, ver_doc.name)
		installer._load_version()
		# Uninstall old content, install new
		self.installed.uninstall()
		installer._install_bundle(content) if content.get("type") == "bundle" else (
			installer._install_flow(content) if content.get("type") == "flow"
			else installer._install_connector(content)
		)
		self.installed.db_set("version_installed", ver_doc.version)
		self.installed.db_set("status", "Active")
		self.installed.db_set("update_available", 0)
		self.installed.db_set("installed_flow_names", json.dumps(installer.installed_flows))
		self.installed.db_set("installed_connector_names", json.dumps(installer.installed_connectors))
		ver_doc.record_download()
		return True


def check_all_updates():
	"""Scheduled task — check every installed package for available updates."""
	packages = frappe.get_all("FB Installed Package",
		filters={"status": "Active"},
		pluck="name")
	for name in packages:
		try:
			installed = frappe.get_doc("FB Installed Package", name)
			installed.check_for_update()
		except Exception:
			frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), f"Update check failed: {name}")

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/marketplace/payments.py
"""
FlowBridge Marketplace — Razorpay payment integration (2.6 + 2.7).

One-time payments: create Razorpay Order → verify payment signature → install.
Subscriptions:     create Razorpay Plan (if needed) → create Subscription → install on first charge.
"""

import frappe
import hmac
import hashlib
import json
import requests
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


def _rzp_creds() -> tuple[str, str]:
	"""Return (key_id, key_secret) from FlowBridge Settings or site config."""
	key_id = frappe.conf.get("razorpay_key_id") or frappe.db.get_single_value("FB Settings", "razorpay_key_id") or ""
	key_secret = frappe.conf.get("razorpay_key_secret") or frappe.db.get_single_value("FB Settings", "razorpay_key_secret") or ""
	if not key_id or not key_secret:
		frappe.throw("Razorpay credentials are not configured. Set razorpay_key_id and razorpay_key_secret in site config or FB Settings.")
	return key_id, key_secret


def _rzp_post(endpoint: str, data: dict) -> dict:
	key_id, key_secret = _rzp_creds()
	resp = requests.post(
		f"https://api.razorpay.com/v1{endpoint}",
		json=data,
		auth=(key_id, key_secret),
		timeout=15,
	)
	resp.raise_for_status()
	return resp.json()


def _rzp_get(endpoint: str) -> dict:
	key_id, key_secret = _rzp_creds()
	resp = requests.get(
		f"https://api.razorpay.com/v1{endpoint}",
		auth=(key_id, key_secret),
		timeout=15,
	)
	resp.raise_for_status()
	return resp.json()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# One-time payment (2.6)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_order(package_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Create a Razorpay order for a one-time purchase. Returns order details for checkout."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)
	if pkg.pricing_model != "One-time":
		frappe.throw("This package does not support one-time payment")

	amount_paise = int((pkg.price_inr or 0) * 100)
	order = _rzp_post("/orders", {
		"amount": amount_paise,
		"currency": "INR",
		"receipt": f"fb-pkg-{pkg.package_name}-{frappe.generate_hash(length=8)}",
		"notes": {
			"package": pkg.package_name,
			"buyer": frappe.session.user,
		},
	})
	return {
		"order_id": order["id"],
		"amount": amount_paise,
		"currency": "INR",
		"package_name": pkg.package_name,
		"title": pkg.title,
		"key_id": _rzp_creds()[0],
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def verify_payment_and_install(
	package_name: str,
	razorpay_order_id: str,
	razorpay_payment_id: str,
	razorpay_signature: str,
) -> dict:
	"""Verify Razorpay signature and trigger install. Called after checkout."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")

	# Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature
	_, key_secret = _rzp_creds()
	expected = hmac.new(
		key_secret.encode(),
		f"{razorpay_order_id}|{razorpay_payment_id}".encode(),
		hashlib.sha256,
	).hexdigest()
	if not hmac.compare_digest(razorpay_signature, expected):
		frappe.throw("Payment signature verification failed", frappe.AuthenticationError)

	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.marketplace.installer import PackageInstaller
	installer = PackageInstaller(package_name)
	installed_name = installer.install(razorpay_payment_id=razorpay_payment_id)

	return {"status": "installed", "installed": installed_name}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subscriptions (2.7)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

@frappe.whitelist()
def create_or_get_plan(package_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Create Razorpay Plan for a subscription package (idempotent)."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", package_name)
	if pkg.pricing_model != "Subscription":
		frappe.throw("This package is not a subscription package")

	if pkg.razorpay_plan_id:
		return {"plan_id": pkg.razorpay_plan_id, "existing": True}

	interval_map = {"monthly": {"period": "monthly", "interval": 1},
	                "yearly":  {"period": "yearly",  "interval": 1}}
	iv = interval_map.get(pkg.subscription_interval or "monthly", {"period": "monthly", "interval": 1})

	plan = _rzp_post("/plans", {
		"period": iv["period"],
		"interval": iv["interval"],
		"item": {
			"name": pkg.title,
			"amount": int((pkg.subscription_price_inr or 0) * 100),
			"currency": "INR",
			"description": pkg.short_description or "",
		},
		"notes": {"package": pkg.package_name},
	})

	frappe.db.set_value("FB Marketplace Package", package_name, "razorpay_plan_id", plan["id"])
	return {"plan_id": plan["id"], "existing": False}


@frappe.whitelist()
def create_subscription(package_name: str) -> dict:
	"""Create a Razorpay Subscription for the current user. Returns subscription details for checkout."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	plan = create_or_get_plan(package_name)
	sub = _rzp_post("/subscriptions", {
		"plan_id": plan["plan_id"],
		"total_count": 12,
		"quantity": 1,
		"notes": {"package": package_name, "buyer": frappe.session.user},
	})
	return {
		"subscription_id": sub["id"],
		"status": sub["status"],
		"package_name": package_name,
		"key_id": _rzp_creds()[0],
	}


@frappe.whitelist()
def activate_subscription(package_name: str, subscription_id: str, razorpay_payment_id: str, razorpay_signature: str) -> dict:
	"""Verify subscription payment signature and install."""
	frappe.only_for("System Manager")
	_, key_secret = _rzp_creds()
	expected = hmac.new(
		key_secret.encode(),
		f"{subscription_id}|{razorpay_payment_id}".encode(),
		hashlib.sha256,
	).hexdigest()
	if not hmac.compare_digest(razorpay_signature, expected):
		frappe.throw("Subscription signature verification failed", frappe.AuthenticationError)

	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.marketplace.installer import PackageInstaller
	installer = PackageInstaller(package_name)
	installed_name = installer.install(subscription_id=subscription_id)
	return {"status": "subscribed", "installed": installed_name}


@frappe.whitelist(allow_guest=True, methods=["POST"])
def razorpay_webhook():
	"""
	Razorpay webhook endpoint for subscription lifecycle events.
	URL: /api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.marketplace.payments.razorpay_webhook
	"""
	raw = frappe.request.data
	sig = frappe.request.headers.get("X-Razorpay-Signature", "")

	webhook_secret = frappe.conf.get("razorpay_webhook_secret") or ""
	if webhook_secret:
		expected = hmac.new(webhook_secret.encode(), raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
		if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected):
			frappe.throw("Webhook signature invalid", frappe.AuthenticationError)

	event = json.loads(raw)
	_handle_webhook_event(event)
	return {"status": "ok"}


def _handle_webhook_event(event: dict):
	ev_type = event.get("event")
	payload = event.get("payload", {})

	if ev_type == "subscription.charged":
		sub_id = payload.get("subscription", {}).get("entity", {}).get("id")
		if sub_id:
			installed = frappe.db.get_value("FB Installed Package",
				{"subscription_id": sub_id, "status": "Active"}, "name")
			if installed:
				amount = payload.get("payment", {}).get("entity", {}).get("amount", 0) / 100
				pkg_name = frappe.db.get_value("FB Installed Package", installed, "package")
				pkg = frappe.get_doc("FB Marketplace Package", pkg_name)
				pkg.record_revenue(amount)

	elif ev_type == "subscription.cancelled":
		sub_id = payload.get("subscription", {}).get("entity", {}).get("id")
		if sub_id:
			installed = frappe.db.get_value("FB Installed Package",
				{"subscription_id": sub_id}, "name")
			if installed:
				frappe.db.set_value("FB Installed Package", installed, "status", "Cancelled")
				pkg_name = frappe.db.get_value("FB Installed Package", installed, "package")
				frappe.db.sql(
					"UPDATE `tabFB Marketplace Package` SET active_installs = GREATEST(0, active_installs - 1) WHERE name = %s",
					pkg_name,
				)

function runHealthCheck(page) {
	$("#fb-provider-status").html('<span style="color:#888">Running health checks…</span>');
	frappe.call({
		method: "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine.health_check_all_providers",
		callback(r) {
			const results = r.message || {};
			let html = '<table class="table table-bordered" style="font-size:12px"><thead><tr>'
				+ '<th>Provider</th><th>Status</th><th>Latency (ms)</th><th>Model</th><th>Error</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
			for (const [provider, data] of Object.entries(results)) {
				const ok = data.ok;
				const badge = ok
					? '<span style="color:green;font-weight:600">✓ OK</span>'
					: '<span style="color:red;font-weight:600">✗ Error</span>';
				html += `<tr>
					<td><b>${provider}</b></td>
					<td>${badge}</td>
					<td>${data.latency_ms ?? "—"}</td>
					<td style="font-size:11px;color:#666">${data.model ?? ""}</td>
					<td style="font-size:11px;color:#c00">${data.error ?? ""}</td>
				</tr>`;
			}
			html += "</tbody></table>";
			$("#fb-provider-status").html(html);
		},
	});
}

function loadFeatureTable() {
	const features = [
		["flow_builder", "Flow Builder"],
		["field_mapper", "Field Mapper"],
		["copilot", "Copilot"],
		["agents", "AI Agents"],
		["error_explainer", "Error Explainer"],
		["analytics", "Analytics Copilot"],
	];
	frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", "ai_provider").then(globalProvider => {
		let html = '<table class="table table-bordered" style="font-size:12px"><thead>'
			+ '<tr><th>Feature</th><th>Active Provider</th><th>Override</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
		const fetches = features.map(([key, label]) =>
			frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", `feature_provider_${key}`)
				.then(override => ({ key, label, override, global: globalProvider || "default" }))
		);
		Promise.all(fetches).then(rows => {
			rows.forEach(({ label, override, global: gp }) => {
				const active = override || gp || "default";
				html += `<tr>
					<td>${label}</td>
					<td><b>${active}</b></td>
					<td style="color:#888">${override ? override : "<em>uses global</em>"}</td>
				</tr>`;
			});
			html += "</tbody></table>";
			html += `<p style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:8px">
				Global provider: <b>${globalProvider || "default"}</b> &nbsp;|&nbsp;
				<a href="/app/fb-flowbridge-settings">Edit in Settings →</a>
			</p>`;
			$("#fb-feature-table").html(html);
		});
	});
}

function viewCostReport(page) {
	$("#fb-cost-report").html('<span style="color:#888">Loading…</span>');
	frappe.call({
		method: "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.ai_engine.get_ai_cost_report",
		args: { days: 7 },
		callback(r) {
			const rows = r.message || [];
			if (!rows.length) {
				$("#fb-cost-report").html("<em>No cost data yet.</em>");
				return;
			}
			let html = '<table class="table table-bordered" style="font-size:12px"><thead>'
				+ '<tr><th>Date</th><th>Provider</th><th>Calls</th><th>Input Tokens</th><th>Output Tokens</th><th>Cost (USD)</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
			rows.forEach(r => {
				html += `<tr>
					<td>${r.date}</td>
					<td>${r.provider}</td>
					<td>${r.calls}</td>
					<td>${r.input_tokens.toLocaleString()}</td>
					<td>${r.output_tokens.toLocaleString()}</td>
					<td>$${r.cost_usd.toFixed(4)}</td>
				</tr>`;
			});
			html += "</tbody></table>";
			$("#fb-cost-report").html(html);
		},
	});
}

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/page/flowbridge_connector_builder/flowbridge_connector_builder.js
frappe.pages["flowbridge-connector-builder"].on_page_load = function (wrapper) {
	const page = frappe.ui.make_app_page({
		parent: wrapper,
		title: "Connector Builder",
		single_column: true,
	});

	page.add_inner_button(__("New Connector"), () => frappe.new_doc("FB Connector"));
	page.add_inner_button(__("All Connectors"), () => frappe.set_route("List", "FB Connector"));

	$(page.body).html(`
		<div style="padding:24px;">
			<div id="fb-connector-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px;">
				<div style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:13px;">Loading connectors…</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	`);

	frappe.db.get_list("FB Connector", {
		fields: ["name", "connector_name", "category", "is_active", "description"],
		order_by: "modified desc",
		limit: 30,
	}).then(rows => {
		if (!rows.length) {
			$("#fb-connector-grid").html('<em style="color:#9ca3af;">No connectors yet. <a href="#" onclick="frappe.new_doc(\'FB Connector\');return false;">Create one →</a></em>');
			return;
		}
		$("#fb-connector-grid").html(rows.map(r => `
			<div onclick="frappe.set_route('Form','FB Connector','${r.name}')"
				style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:10px;padding:18px;cursor:pointer;"
				onmouseover="this.style.boxShadow='0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1)'" onmouseout="this.style.boxShadow='none'">
				<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
					<span style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;">${r.connector_name}</span>
					${r.is_active ? '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#16a34a;font-weight:600;">● Active</span>' : '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;">○ Inactive</span>'}
				</div>
				<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:8px;">${r.description || r.category || ""}</div>
				<span style="font-size:11px;background:#f3f4f6;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;">${r.category || "Custom"}</span>
			</div>`).join(""));
	}).catch(() => {
		$("#fb-connector-grid").html('<em style="color:#9ca3af;">FB Connector DocType not found.</em>');
	});
};

				</div>

					Enter a slug like <code>auth-me</code> or click <b>Test →</b> from the table below.
				</div>
				<div id="fb-dev-result" style="background:#0f172a;color:#e2e8f0;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-family:monospace;min-height:60px;white-space:pre-wrap;">
					Response will appear here…
				</div>
			</div>

			<div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:20px;">
				<h5 style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px;">Published Endpoints</h5>
				<div id="fb-dev-endpoints" style="font-size:13px;color:#9ca3af;">Loading…</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	`);

	$("#fb-base-url").text(window.location.origin + "/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.handle?endpoint=");
	$("#fb-to-studio").on("click", () => { frappe.set_route("flowbridge-studio"); return false; });

	// Run button — defined inside on_page_load so it's always in scope
	$("#fb-dev-run").on("click", function () {
		let raw = $("#fb-dev-slug").val().trim();
		if (!raw) { frappe.msgprint("Enter an endpoint slug first"); return; }

		if (raw.startsWith("http")) {
			try { raw = new URL(raw).searchParams.get("endpoint") || raw; } catch(e) {}
		}

		const method = $("#fb-dev-method").val();
		const url = `/api/method/frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder.handle?endpoint=${encodeURIComponent(raw)}`;

		$("#fb-dev-result").text("Running…");

		fetch(url, {
			method: method,
			headers: {
				"Accept": "application/json",
				"X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": frappe.csrf_token || "",
			},
		})
		.then(async res => {
			const text = await res.text();
			let parsed;
			try { parsed = JSON.parse(text); } catch(e) { parsed = text; }
			const display = typeof parsed === "object" ? JSON.stringify(parsed?.message ?? parsed, null, 2) : parsed;
			$("#fb-dev-result").text("HTTP " + res.status + "\n\n" + display);
		})
		.catch(err => {
			$("#fb-dev-result").text("Network error: " + err.message);
		});
	});

	frappe.db.get_list("FB API Endpoint", {
		fields: ["endpoint_name", "endpoint_slug", "is_active", "lifecycle_state", "enable_get", "enable_post", "auth_required"],
		filters: { is_active: 1 },
		order_by: "endpoint_name asc",
		limit: 50,
	}).then(rows => {
		if (!rows.length) { $("#fb-dev-endpoints").html("<em>No active endpoints.</em>"); return; }
		let html = `<table class="table" style="font-size:12px;"><thead><tr>
			<th>Name</th><th>Slug</th><th>Methods</th><th>Auth</th><th></th>
		</tr></thead><tbody>`;
		rows.forEach(r => {
			const methods = ["GET","POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"].filter(m => r["enable_" + m.toLowerCase()]).join(", ");
			html += `<tr>
				<td><b>${r.endpoint_name}</b></td>
				<td style="font-family:monospace;color:#6366f1;">${r.endpoint_slug}</td>
				<td>${methods || "—"}</td>
				<td>${r.auth_required ? "🔒 Required" : "🔓 Public"}</td>
				<td><a href="#" class="fb-test-link" data-slug="${r.endpoint_slug}" style="font-size:11px;">Test →</a></td>
			</tr>`;
		});
		html += "</tbody></table>";
		$("#fb-dev-endpoints").html(html);

		// Delegate click on Test → links
		$("#fb-dev-endpoints").on("click", ".fb-test-link", function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			$("#fb-dev-slug").val($(this).data("slug"));
			$("#fb-dev-run").trigger("click");
		});
	});
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  FlowCanvas class
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class FlowCanvas {
	constructor(mountEl, data, opts = {}) {
		this.mount    = mountEl;
		this.opts     = opts;
		this.pan      = { x: 60, y: 60 };
		this.zoom     = 1;
		this.dirty    = false;
		this.selected = null;          // selected node
		this.dragging = null;          // { node, ox, oy }
		this.panning  = false;
		this.panStart = null;
		this.connecting = null;        // { fromNode, handle, sx, sy }
		this._mouse   = { x: 0, y: 0 };
		this._history = [];            // undo stack
		this._currentFlow = opts.flowName || null;

		this.nodes = (data.nodes || []).map(n => this._hydrateNode(n));
		// Build edge map from node fields + config_json._edges
		this.edges = this._extractEdges(this.nodes);
	}

	// ── hydrate a raw DB node into canvas node ────────────────────────────────
	_hydrateNode(n) {
		const def = FB_NODE_TYPES[n.node_type] || FB_NODE_TYPES.action;
		// Parse extra edges from config_json._edges
		let extraEdges = {};
		try { extraEdges = JSON.parse(n.config_json || "{}") ._edges || {}; } catch(e){}
		return {
			...n,
			x: n.position_x ?? 80,
			y: n.position_y ?? 80,
			w: 210,
			h: 76,
			def,
			extraEdges,
		};
	}

	// ── Auto-spread nodes that share a position (e.g., (0,0)) ─────────────────
	_autoSpreadStacked() {
		const groups = {};
		this.nodes.forEach(n => {
			const key = `${Math.round(n.x)}_${Math.round(n.y)}`;
			(groups[key] = groups[key] || []).push(n);
		});
		Object.values(groups).forEach(grp => {
			if (grp.length <= 1) return;
			grp.forEach((n, i) => {
				const col = i % 4, row = Math.floor(i / 4);
				n.x = n.x + col * 260;
				n.y = n.y + row * 130;
			});
		});
	}

	// ── Simple left-to-right auto-layout (Sugiyama-lite) ──────────────────────
	autoLayout() {
		if (!this.nodes.length) return;
		this._snapshot();

		const byId = Object.fromEntries(this.nodes.map(n => [n.node_id, n]));
		const incoming = {}; this.nodes.forEach(n => incoming[n.node_id] = 0);
		this.edges.forEach(e => { if (byId[e.toId]) incoming[e.toId]++; });

		// Roots = nodes with no incoming edges
		const roots = this.nodes.filter(n => incoming[n.node_id] === 0);
		const visited = new Set();
		const ranks = {};                    // node_id → depth
		const queue = roots.map(n => ({ n, d: 0 }));
		while (queue.length) {
			const { n, d } = queue.shift();
			if (visited.has(n.node_id)) continue;
			visited.add(n.node_id);
			ranks[n.node_id] = Math.max(ranks[n.node_id] || 0, d);
			this.edges.filter(e => e.fromId === n.node_id).forEach(e => {
				if (byId[e.toId]) queue.push({ n: byId[e.toId], d: d+1 });
			});
		}
		// Orphans get rank 0
		this.nodes.forEach(n => { if (ranks[n.node_id] === undefined) ranks[n.node_id] = 0; });

		// Group by rank, distribute Y
		const byRank = {};
		this.nodes.forEach(n => { (byRank[ranks[n.node_id]] = byRank[ranks[n.node_id]] || []).push(n); });
		Object.entries(byRank).forEach(([rank, items]) => {
			items.forEach((n, i) => {
				n.x = 80 + parseInt(rank) * 290;
				n.y = 80 + i * 130;
			});
		});

		this.dirty = true;
		this._renderAll();
		this._fitToScreen();
	}

	// ── extract all edges as a flat list {id, fromId, handle, toId} ──────────
	_extractEdges(nodes) {
		const edges = [];
		const push = (fromId, handle, toId) => {
			if (toId) edges.push({ id: `${fromId}__${handle}__${toId}`, fromId, handle, toId });
		};
		nodes.forEach(n => {
			push(n.node_id, "success",  n.next_node_id);
			push(n.node_id, "true",     n.true_next_node_id);
			push(n.node_id, "false",    n.false_next_node_id);
			Object.entries(n.extraEdges || {}).forEach(([h, t]) => push(n.node_id, h, t));
		});
		return edges;
	}

	// ── sync edges back into node fields ──────────────────────────────────────
	_applyEdgesToNodes() {
		const byFrom = {};
		this.edges.forEach(e => {
			if (!byFrom[e.fromId]) byFrom[e.fromId] = {};
			byFrom[e.fromId][e.handle] = e.toId;
		});
		this.nodes.forEach(n => {
			const m = byFrom[n.node_id] || {};
			n.next_node_id       = m.success  || m.output  || "";
			n.true_next_node_id  = m.true     || m.approved|| "";
			n.false_next_node_id = m.false    || m.rejected|| "";
			// Extra handles
			const extra = {};
			Object.entries(m).forEach(([h, t]) => {
				if (!["success","output","true","approved","false","rejected"].includes(h)) extra[h] = t;
			});
			n.extraEdges = extra;
		});
	}

	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	//  RENDER
	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	render() {
		this.mount.innerHTML = "";
		this.mount.style.cssText =
			"position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;height:100%;user-select:none;font-family:inherit;";

		this._buildPalette();
		this._buildCanvasArea();
		this._buildPropertiesPanel();
		this._buildToolbar();
		this._buildMinimap();
		this._bindEvents();
		this._renderAll();
	}

	// ── Left palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_buildPalette() {
		this.palette = document.createElement("div");
		this.palette.style.cssText =
			"width:220px;min-width:220px;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0;"
			+"overflow-y:auto;z-index:40;flex-shrink:0;";

		// Search
		const searchWrap = document.createElement("div");
		searchWrap.style.cssText = "padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;";
		searchWrap.innerHTML = `<input id="fb-palette-search" type="text" placeholder="🔍  Search nodes…"
			style="width:100%;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:12px;outline:none;">`;
		this.palette.appendChild(searchWrap);

		// Groups
		const groups = {};
		Object.entries(FB_NODE_TYPES).forEach(([type, def]) => {
			if (!groups[def.cat]) groups[def.cat] = [];
			groups[def.cat].push({ type, ...def });
		});

		this._paletteGroups = {};
		Object.entries(groups).forEach(([cat, items]) => {
			const grp = document.createElement("div");
			grp.innerHTML = `
				<div class="fb-cat-header" style="padding:8px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
					color:#94a3b8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;cursor:pointer;
					display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
					${cat}<span class="fb-cat-arrow">▾</span>
				</div>
				<div class="fb-cat-body">
					${items.map(n => `
						<div class="fb-palette-item" draggable="true" data-type="${n.type}"
							style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 14px;
							font-size:12px;cursor:grab;border-bottom:1px solid #f8fafc;
							transition:background .1s;"
							onmouseover="this.style.background='#f8fafc'"
							onmouseout="this.style.background=''">
							<span style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:${n.color}22;
								display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;">${n.icon}</span>
							<span style="color:#374151;font-weight:500;">${n.label}</span>
						</div>`).join("")}
				</div>`;
			grp.querySelector(".fb-cat-header").onclick = () => {
				const body = grp.querySelector(".fb-cat-body");
				const arrow = grp.querySelector(".fb-cat-arrow");
				const visible = body.style.display !== "none";
				body.style.display = visible ? "none" : "";
				arrow.textContent = visible ? "▸" : "▾";
			};
			this._paletteGroups[cat] = grp;
			this.palette.appendChild(grp);
		});

		// Search filter
		this.palette.querySelector("#fb-palette-search").oninput = (e) => {
			const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
			this.palette.querySelectorAll(".fb-palette-item").forEach(el => {
				el.style.display = el.dataset.type.includes(q) || el.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q) ? "" : "none";
			});
		};

		// Palette drag start
		this.palette.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => {
			const item = e.target.closest(".fb-palette-item");
			if (item) e.dataTransfer.setData("fb-node-type", item.dataset.type);
		});

		this.mount.appendChild(this.palette);
	}

	// ── Canvas area ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_buildCanvasArea() {
		this.canvasWrap = document.createElement("div");
		this.canvasWrap.style.cssText = "flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;";

		// Dot-grid background
		this.canvasWrap.style.backgroundImage =
			"radial-gradient(circle, #cbd5e1 1px, transparent 1px)";
		this.canvasWrap.style.backgroundSize = "24px 24px";

		// SVG edges layer
		this.svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
		this.svg.style.cssText =
			"position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;";
		this.canvasWrap.appendChild(this.svg);

		// Node layer
		this.nodeLayer = document.createElement("div");
		this.nodeLayer.style.cssText = "position:absolute;top:0;left:0;transform-origin:0 0;";
		this.canvasWrap.appendChild(this.nodeLayer);

		// Drop target for palette drag
		this.canvasWrap.addEventListener("dragover", e => e.preventDefault());
		this.canvasWrap.addEventListener("drop", e => {
			const type = e.dataTransfer.getData("fb-node-type");
			if (!type) return;
			const rect = this.canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
			const x = (e.clientX - rect.left - this.pan.x) / this.zoom;
			const y = (e.clientY - rect.top  - this.pan.y) / this.zoom;
			this._addNode(type, x, y);
		});

		this.mount.appendChild(this.canvasWrap);
	}

	// ── Properties panel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_buildPropertiesPanel() {
		this.panel = document.createElement("div");
		this.panel.style.cssText =
			"width:0;min-width:0;background:#fff;border-left:1px solid #e2e8f0;"
			+"overflow-y:auto;z-index:40;flex-shrink:0;transition:width .2s;";
		this.mount.appendChild(this.panel);
	}

	_openPanel(node) {
		this.selected = node;
		this.panel.style.width = "280px";
		this.panel.style.minWidth = "280px";
		const def = node.def;
		const outEdges = this.edges.filter(e => e.fromId === node.node_id);
		const inEdges  = this.edges.filter(e => e.toId   === node.node_id);

		this.panel.innerHTML = `
			<div style="padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;
				display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
				background:${def.color}0d;">
				<div>
					<span style="font-size:16px;margin-right:6px;">${def.icon}</span>
					<span style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:#1e293b;">
						${node.node_name || node.node_id}</span>
				</div>
				<button id="fb-pnl-close" style="border:none;background:none;
					font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1;">×</button>
			</div>
			<div style="padding:14px;font-size:12px;">
				<div style="margin-bottom:12px;">
					<span style="background:${def.color};color:#fff;padding:2px 9px;
						border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">${def.label}</span>
					<span style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b;padding:2px 9px;
						border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;margin-left:4px;">${def.cat}</span>
				</div>

				${_pf("Node ID",   node.node_id)}
				${node.connector ? _pf("Connector", node.connector) : ""}
				${node.endpoint  ? _pf("Endpoint",  node.endpoint)  : ""}
				${_pf("On Error",  node.on_error  || "stop")}
				${node.retry_count ? _pf("Retries", node.retry_count) : ""}

				${_typeConfigSummary(node)}

				<div style="margin:12px 0 6px;font-weight:700;color:#374151;">Outgoing</div>
				${outEdges.length ? outEdges.map(e => `
					<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">
						<span style="background:${FB_HANDLE_COLORS[e.handle]||"#64748b"};
							color:#fff;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;">${e.handle}</span>
						<span style="font-family:monospace;color:#6366f1;">→ ${e.toId}</span>
						<button class="fb-del-edge" data-edge="${e.id}"
							style="border:none;background:none;color:#ef4444;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;
							margin-left:auto;">×</button>
					</div>`).join("") : `<div style="color:#94a3b8;">No outgoing connections</div>`}

				<div style="margin:12px 0 6px;font-weight:700;color:#374151;">Incoming</div>
				${inEdges.length ? inEdges.map(e => `
					<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">
						<span style="font-family:monospace;color:#6366f1;">${e.fromId}</span>
						<span style="background:${FB_HANDLE_COLORS[e.handle]||"#64748b"};
							color:#fff;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;">${e.handle}</span>
					</div>`).join("") : `<div style="color:#94a3b8;">No incoming connections</div>`}

				<hr style="margin:14px 0;border:none;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
				<button id="fb-pnl-edit" class="btn btn-xs btn-primary"
					style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px;">✏ Edit in Form</button>
				<button id="fb-pnl-dup" class="btn btn-xs btn-default"
					style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px;">⊕ Duplicate</button>
				<button id="fb-pnl-del" class="btn btn-xs btn-danger"
					style="width:100%;">🗑 Delete Node</button>
			</div>`;

		this.panel.querySelector("#fb-pnl-close").onclick = () => this._closePanel();
		this.panel.querySelector("#fb-pnl-edit").onclick  = () => this._editNodeDialog(node);
		this.panel.querySelector("#fb-pnl-dup").onclick   = () => this._duplicateNode(node);
		this.panel.querySelector("#fb-pnl-del").onclick   = () => this._deleteNode(node);
		this.panel.querySelectorAll(".fb-del-edge").forEach(btn => {
			btn.onclick = () => {
				this.edges = this.edges.filter(e => e.id !== btn.dataset.edge);
				this._applyEdgesToNodes();
				this.dirty = true;
				this._renderAll();
				this._openPanel(node); // refresh panel
			};
		});
	}

	_closePanel() {
		this.selected = null;
		this.panel.style.width = "0";
		this.panel.style.minWidth = "0";
		this._renderNodes(); // deselect highlight
	}

	// ── Floating toolbar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_buildToolbar() {
		const tb = document.createElement("div");
		tb.style.cssText =
			"position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:100;"
			+"background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:5px 10px;"
			+"display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08);";
		tb.innerHTML = `
			<button id="fb-t-save"     class="btn btn-xs btn-primary"  title="Save (Ctrl+S)">💾 Save</button>
			<button id="fb-t-undo"     class="btn btn-xs btn-default"  title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)">↩</button>
			<span style="width:1px;height:18px;background:#e2e8f0;"></span>
			<button id="fb-t-autolayout" class="btn btn-xs btn-default" title="Auto Layout">⫹⫺ Layout</button>
			<button id="fb-t-fit"      class="btn btn-xs btn-default"  title="Fit to screen">⤢ Fit</button>
			<span style="width:1px;height:18px;background:#e2e8f0;"></span>
			<button id="fb-t-zi"       class="btn btn-xs btn-default">+</button>
			<span id="fb-t-zlbl" style="font-size:11px;color:#64748b;min-width:34px;text-align:center;">
				${Math.round(this.zoom*100)}%</span>
			<button id="fb-t-zo"       class="btn btn-xs btn-default">−</button>
		`;
		this.canvasWrap.appendChild(tb);
		this._zoomLabel = tb.querySelector("#fb-t-zlbl");

		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-save").onclick       = () => this._save();
		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-undo").onclick       = () => this._undo();
		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-autolayout").onclick = () => this.autoLayout();
		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-fit").onclick        = () => this._fitToScreen();
		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-zi").onclick         = () => this._setZoom(this.zoom + 0.1);
		tb.querySelector("#fb-t-zo").onclick         = () => this._setZoom(this.zoom - 0.1);
	}

	// ── Minimap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_buildMinimap() {
		this.minimap = document.createElement("canvas");
		this.minimap.width = 160; this.minimap.height = 100;
		this.minimap.style.cssText =
			"position:absolute;bottom:14px;right:14px;z-index:60;"
			+"background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;opacity:.92;";
		this.canvasWrap.appendChild(this.minimap);
	}

	_drawMinimap() {
		if (!this.nodes.length) return;
		const ctx = this.minimap.getContext("2d");
		const W = 160, H = 100, pad = 8;
		ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

		const xs = this.nodes.map(n => n.x), ys = this.nodes.map(n => n.y);
		const mnX = Math.min(...xs)-20, mxX = Math.max(...xs)+230;
		const mnY = Math.min(...ys)-20, mxY = Math.max(...ys)+100;
		const sc = Math.min((W-pad*2)/(mxX-mnX||1),(H-pad*2)/(mxY-mnY||1));

		const tx = n => pad + (n.x-mnX)*sc;
		const ty = n => pad + (n.y-mnY)*sc;

		// edges
		this.edges.forEach(e => {
			const src = this.nodes.find(n => n.node_id === e.fromId);
			const dst = this.nodes.find(n => n.node_id === e.toId);
			if (!src || !dst) return;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#cbd5e1"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
			ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx(src)+10, ty(src)+6);
			ctx.lineTo(tx(dst), ty(dst)+6); ctx.stroke();
		});
		// nodes
		this.nodes.forEach(n => {
			ctx.fillStyle = n.def.color + "cc";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(tx(n), ty(n), Math.max(n.w*sc,14), Math.max(n.h*sc,8), 3);
			ctx.fill();
		});
		// viewport indicator
		const vx = -this.pan.x/this.zoom, vy = -this.pan.y/this.zoom;
		const vw = this.canvasWrap.offsetWidth/this.zoom;
		const vh = this.canvasWrap.offsetHeight/this.zoom;
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#6366f1"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		ctx.strokeRect(pad+(vx-mnX)*sc, pad+(vy-mnY)*sc, vw*sc, vh*sc);
	}

	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	//  NODE RENDERING
	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	_renderAll() {
		this._renderNodes();
		this._renderEdges();
		this._drawMinimap();
	}

	_renderNodes() {
		this.nodeLayer.innerHTML = "";
		this.nodes.forEach(n => this.nodeLayer.appendChild(this._makeNode(n)));
	}

	_makeNode(node) {
		const def = node.def;
		const sel = this.selected && this.selected.node_id === node.node_id;
		const outputs = [...def.outputs, ...(def.errors ? ["error"] : [])];

		const el = document.createElement("div");
		el.dataset.nodeId = node.node_id;
		el.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:${node.x}px;top:${node.y}px;
			width:${node.w}px;background:#fff;
			border:2px solid ${sel ? "#6366f1" : "#e2e8f0"};border-radius:10px;
			box-shadow:${sel ? "0 0 0 3px #6366f133,0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1)"
				             : "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06)"};
			cursor:grab;transition:box-shadow .15s;z-index:${sel?5:1};`;

		// Header
		el.innerHTML = `
			<div style="background:${def.color};border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;
				padding:5px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">
				<span style="font-size:14px;">${def.icon}</span>
				<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
					text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;">${def.label}</span>
			</div>
			<div style="padding:7px 10px;">
				<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#1e293b;
					white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:170px;">
					${node.node_name || node.node_id}
				</div>
				${node.connector
					? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px;">⚡ ${node.connector}</div>`
					: `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:2px;">${def.cat}</div>`}
			</div>`;

		// ── Input handle (left) ──
		if (def.inputs.length > 0) {
			const h = this._makeHandle("in", null, "#64748b");
			h.style.left = "-8px";
			h.style.top  = "50%";
			h.style.transform = "translateY(-50%)";
			h.title = "input";
			el.appendChild(h);
		}

		// ── Output handles (right side, distributed) ──
		const outOnly  = outputs.filter(o => o !== "error");
		const errOnly  = outputs.filter(o => o === "error");
		const allOut   = [...outOnly, ...errOnly];
		const step     = 100 / (allOut.length + 1);

		allOut.forEach((handle, i) => {
			const isErr = handle === "error";
			const col   = FB_HANDLE_COLORS[handle] || "#64748b";
			const h     = this._makeHandle("out", handle, col);
			h.style.right  = "-9px";
			h.style.top    = `${step * (i+1)}%`;
			h.style.transform = "translateY(-50%)";
			h.title = handle;

			// Label bubble
			const lbl = document.createElement("span");
			lbl.textContent = _handleLabel(handle);
			lbl.style.cssText =
				`position:absolute;right:8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
				font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:${col};white-space:nowrap;
				pointer-events:none;`;
			h.appendChild(lbl);

			el.appendChild(h);
		});

		// ── Drag node ──
		el.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
			if (e.target.classList.contains("fb-h")) return;
			e.stopPropagation();
			this._snapshot();
			this.dragging = {
				node,
				ox: e.clientX - node.x * this.zoom,
				oy: e.clientY - node.y * this.zoom,
			};
			el.style.zIndex = 20;
			el.style.cursor = "grabbing";
			this.selected = node;
			this._openPanel(node);
			this._renderNodes();
		});

		// ── Start connection from output handle ──
		el.querySelectorAll(".fb-h-out").forEach(h => {
			h.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				const handle = h.dataset.handle;
				// compute handle screen position
				const nr = el.getBoundingClientRect();
				const hr = h.getBoundingClientRect();
				const cx = this.canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
				this.connecting = {
					fromNode: node,
					handle,
					sx: (hr.left + hr.width/2  - cx.left - this.pan.x) / this.zoom,
					sy: (hr.top  + hr.height/2 - cx.top  - this.pan.y) / this.zoom,
				};
			});
		});

		return el;
	}

	_makeHandle(dir, handle, color) {
		const h = document.createElement("div");
		h.className = `fb-h fb-h-${dir}`;
		if (handle) h.dataset.handle = handle;
		h.style.cssText =
			`position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;
			background:${dir === "in" ? "#fff" : color};
			border:2px solid ${color};cursor:crosshair;z-index:3;
			display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;`;
		return h;
	}

	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	//  EDGE RENDERING
	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	_renderEdges() {
		while (this.svg.firstChild) this.svg.removeChild(this.svg.firstChild);

		// Arrow-head markers
		const defs = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","defs");
		Object.entries(FB_HANDLE_COLORS).forEach(([name, col]) => {
			defs.appendChild(_arrowMarker(name, col));
		});
		defs.appendChild(_arrowMarker("default","#94a3b8"));
		this.svg.appendChild(defs);

		const nodeMap = Object.fromEntries(this.nodes.map(n => [n.node_id, n]));

		// Draw edges
		this.edges.forEach(edge => {
			const src = nodeMap[edge.fromId], dst = nodeMap[edge.toId];
			if (!src || !dst) return;
			const [sx, sy] = this._handlePos(src, "out", edge.handle);
			const [ex, ey] = this._handlePos(dst, "in",  "input");
			const col = FB_HANDLE_COLORS[edge.handle] || "#94a3b8";
			this._drawBezier(sx, sy, ex, ey, col, edge.handle, false, edge.id);
		});

		// In-progress connection wire
		if (this.connecting) {
			const [sx,sy] = [this.connecting.sx, this.connecting.sy];
			const ex = (this._mouse.x - this.pan.x) / this.zoom;
			const ey = (this._mouse.y - this.pan.y) / this.zoom;
			this._drawBezier(sx, sy, ex, ey, "#94a3b8", null, true);
		}
	}

	// Get canvas-space coords of a handle
	_handlePos(node, dir, handle) {
		if (dir === "in") {
			return [node.x, node.y + node.h / 2];
		}
		const def = node.def;
		const outputs = [...def.outputs, ...(def.errors ? ["error"] : [])];
		const idx = outputs.indexOf(handle);
		const step = node.h / (outputs.length + 1);
		const y = node.y + (idx >= 0 ? step * (idx+1) : node.h/2);
		return [node.x + node.w, y];
	}

	_drawBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, handle, dashed = false, edgeId = null) {
		const z = this.zoom, px = this.pan.x, py = this.pan.y;
		const ax = x1*z+px, ay = y1*z+py;
		const bx = x2*z+px, by = y2*z+py;
		const cp  = Math.max(Math.abs(bx-ax)*0.5, 60*z);

		const d = `M${ax},${ay} C${ax+cp},${ay} ${bx-cp},${by} ${bx},${by}`;

		const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");
		path.setAttribute("d", d);
		path.setAttribute("fill","none");
		path.setAttribute("stroke", col);
		path.setAttribute("stroke-width", dashed ? 1.5 : 2);
		if (dashed) path.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","5 4");
		if (handle) path.setAttribute("marker-end",`url(#arrow-${handle})`);

		// Invisible wider hit area for clicking edge — uses edge ID
		if (edgeId) {
			const hit = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path");
			hit.setAttribute("d", d);
			hit.setAttribute("stroke","transparent");
			hit.setAttribute("stroke-width","16");
			hit.setAttribute("fill","none");
			hit.style.cursor = "pointer";
			hit.style.pointerEvents = "stroke";
			hit.addEventListener("click", e => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				frappe.confirm(`Delete "${handle}" edge?`, () => {
					this.edges = this.edges.filter(ed => ed.id !== edgeId);
					this._applyEdgesToNodes();
					this.dirty = true;
					this._renderAll();
					if (this.selected) this._openPanel(this.selected);
				});
			});
			this.svg.appendChild(hit);
		}
		this.svg.appendChild(path);

		// Edge label midpoint
		if (handle && !dashed) {
			const mx = (ax+bx)/2, my = (ay+by)/2;
			const lbl = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","text");
			lbl.setAttribute("x", mx); lbl.setAttribute("y", my-5);
			lbl.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle");
			lbl.setAttribute("font-size","10"); lbl.setAttribute("fill", col);
			lbl.setAttribute("font-weight","700");
			lbl.style.pointerEvents = "none";
			lbl.textContent = _handleLabel(handle);
			this.svg.appendChild(lbl);
		}
	}

	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	//  EVENT BINDING
	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	_bindEvents() {
		const cw = this.canvasWrap;

		cw.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
			const r = cw.getBoundingClientRect();
			this._mouse = { x: e.clientX-r.left, y: e.clientY-r.top };

			if (this.dragging) {
				const { node, ox, oy } = this.dragging;
				node.x = (e.clientX - ox) / this.zoom;
				node.y = (e.clientY - oy) / this.zoom;
				const el = this.nodeLayer.querySelector(`[data-node-id="${node.node_id}"]`);
				if (el) { el.style.left = node.x+"px"; el.style.top = node.y+"px"; }
				this._renderEdges(); this._drawMinimap();
				this.dirty = true;
			} else if (this.panning) {
				this.pan.x += e.clientX - this.panStart.x;
				this.pan.y += e.clientY - this.panStart.y;
				this.panStart = { x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY };
				this._applyTransform(); this._renderEdges();
			} else if (this.connecting) {
				this._renderEdges();
			}
		});

		cw.addEventListener("mouseup", e => {
			if (this.dragging) {
				const el = this.nodeLayer.querySelector(`[data-node-id="${this.dragging.node.node_id}"]`);
				if (el) el.style.cursor = "grab";
				this.dragging = null;
			}
			this.panning = false;
			cw.style.cursor = "";

			if (this.connecting) {
				const r = cw.getBoundingClientRect();
				const mx = (e.clientX-r.left-this.pan.x)/this.zoom;
				const my = (e.clientY-r.top -this.pan.y)/this.zoom;
				// Find node whose input handle we dropped on
				const target = this.nodes.find(n =>
					n !== this.connecting.fromNode &&
					n.def.inputs.length > 0 &&
					mx >= n.x - 18 && mx <= n.x + 18 &&
					my >= n.y && my <= n.y + n.h
				);
				if (target) this._addEdge(this.connecting.fromNode, this.connecting.handle, target);
				this.connecting = null;
				this._renderEdges();
			}
		});

		cw.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
			if (e.target === cw || e.target === this.svg || e.target === this.nodeLayer
				|| e.target.tagName === "svg") {
				if (e.button === 1 || e.altKey || e.button === 0) {
					this.panning = true;
					this.panStart = { x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY };
					cw.style.cursor = "grabbing";
					e.preventDefault();
				}
				// Deselect
				if (e.button === 0 && !e.altKey) this._closePanel();
			}
		});

		cw.addEventListener("wheel", e => {
			e.preventDefault();
			const r = cw.getBoundingClientRect();
			const mx = e.clientX-r.left, my = e.clientY-r.top;
			const nz = Math.min(2, Math.max(0.15, this.zoom + (e.deltaY>0 ? -0.08 : 0.08)));
			this.pan.x = mx - (mx-this.pan.x)*(nz/this.zoom);
			this.pan.y = my - (my-this.pan.y)*(nz/this.zoom);
			this.zoom  = nz;
			this._applyTransform(); this._renderEdges();
			if (this._zoomLabel) this._zoomLabel.textContent = Math.round(this.zoom*100)+"%";
		}, { passive:false });

		document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
			if (!this.mount.isConnected) return;
			if ((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && e.key==="s") { e.preventDefault(); this._save(); }
			if ((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && e.key==="z") { e.preventDefault(); this._undo(); }
			if (e.key==="Escape") { this.connecting=null; this._renderEdges(); this._closePanel(); }
			if ((e.key==="Delete"||e.key==="Backspace") && this.selected
				&& !["INPUT","TEXTAREA","SELECT"].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) {
				this._deleteNode(this.selected);
			}
		});
	}

	_applyTransform() {
		this.nodeLayer.style.transform =
			`translate(${this.pan.x}px,${this.pan.y}px) scale(${this.zoom})`;
	}

	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	//  ACTIONS
	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	_addEdge(fromNode, handle, toNode) {
		// Remove existing edge for same handle on same source
		this.edges = this.edges.filter(e => !(e.fromId===fromNode.node_id && e.handle===handle));
		const id = `${fromNode.node_id}__${handle}__${toNode.node_id}`;
		this.edges.push({ id, fromId:fromNode.node_id, handle, toId:toNode.node_id });
		this._applyEdgesToNodes();
		this.dirty = true;
		this._renderAll();
		frappe.show_alert({ message:`Connected: ${handle}`, indicator:"green" });
	}

	async _addNode(type, x, y) {
		const def = FB_NODE_TYPES[type] || FB_NODE_TYPES.action;
		const nodeId = "n_" + Date.now();
		const name   = def.label + " " + nodeId.slice(-4);

		if (!this._currentFlow) {
			frappe.msgprint("Select a flow first"); return;
		}
		try {
			const r = await frappe.call({
				method: "frappe.client.insert",
				args: { doc: {
					doctype: "FB Flow Node",
					parenttype: "FB Flow", parentfield: "nodes", parent: this._currentFlow,
					node_id: nodeId, node_name: name, node_type: type,
					position_x: Math.round(x), position_y: Math.round(y),
				}},
			});
			const n = this._hydrateNode({
				...r.message,
				node_id: nodeId, node_name: name, node_type: type,
				position_x: Math.round(x), position_y: Math.round(y),
			});
			this.nodes.push(n);
			this.selected = n;
			this._renderAll();
			this._openPanel(n);
			frappe.show_alert({ message:"Node added — opening config", indicator:"green" });

			// Auto-open edit dialog if node type has required config
			if ((FB_NODE_SCHEMA[type] || []).some(f => f.reqd)) {
				setTimeout(() => this._editNodeDialog(n), 300);
			}
		} catch(err) {
			frappe.msgprint("Could not add node: " + (err.message||err));
		}
	}

	_deleteNode(node) {
		frappe.confirm(`Delete node "${node.node_name || node.node_id}"?`, () => {
			frappe.db.delete_doc("FB Flow Node", node.name).then(() => {
				this.nodes = this.nodes.filter(n => n.name !== node.name);
				this.edges = this.edges.filter(e => e.fromId!==node.node_id && e.toId!==node.node_id);
				this._applyEdgesToNodes();
				this._closePanel();
				this._renderAll();
			});
		});
	}

	_duplicateNode(node) {
		const nx = node.x + 40, ny = node.y + 40;
		this._addNode(node.node_type, nx, ny);
	}

	_editNodeDialog(node) {
		// Parse current config_json to seed type-specific fields
		let cfg = {};
		try { cfg = JSON.parse(node.config_json || "{}"); } catch(e){}

		// Build dialog fields: standard + per-type schema (with depends_on)
		const fields = [
			{ label: "Name",      fieldname: "node_name", fieldtype: "Data",
				default: node.node_name || node.node_id, reqd: 1 },
			{ label: "Type",      fieldname: "node_type", fieldtype: "Select",
				options: Object.keys(FB_NODE_TYPES).join("\n"),
				default: node.node_type, reqd: 1 },
			{ fieldtype: "Column Break" },
			{ label: "On Error",  fieldname: "on_error",  fieldtype: "Select",
				options: "stop\ncontinue\nretry\ndlq", default: node.on_error || "stop" },
			{ label: "Retries",   fieldname: "retry_count", fieldtype: "Int",
				default: node.retry_count || 0 },
			{ label: "Retry Delay (s)", fieldname: "retry_delay_seconds",
				fieldtype: "Int", default: node.retry_delay_seconds || 0 },
		];

		// Connector/Endpoint shown only for connector-style nodes
		fields.push(
			{ fieldtype: "Section Break", label: "Endpoint", collapsible: 1, collapsible_depends_on: "eval:!doc.connector && !doc.endpoint",
				depends_on: "eval:['action','http_request','connector','sub_flow','notify'].includes(doc.node_type)" },
			{ label: "Connector", fieldname: "connector", fieldtype: "Link",
				options: "FB Connector", default: node.connector || "",
				depends_on: "eval:['action','connector','http_request'].includes(doc.node_type)" },
			{ label: "Endpoint Slug", fieldname: "endpoint", fieldtype: "Data",
				default: node.endpoint || "",
				depends_on: "eval:['action','connector'].includes(doc.node_type)" },
		);

		// ── Type-specific section ─────────────────────────────────────────
		fields.push({ fieldtype: "Section Break", label: "Settings" });

		Object.entries(FB_NODE_SCHEMA).forEach(([type, schemaFields]) => {
			schemaFields.forEach(sf => {
				fields.push({
					...sf,
					default: cfg[sf.fieldname] !== undefined ? cfg[sf.fieldname] : sf.default,
					depends_on: `eval:doc.node_type === "${type}"`,
					mandatory_depends_on: sf.reqd ? `eval:doc.node_type === "${type}"` : undefined,
					reqd: 0, // Use mandatory_depends_on so it only applies when visible
				});
			});
		});

		const d = new frappe.ui.Dialog({
			title: __("Edit Node: ") + (node.node_name || node.node_id),
			size: "large",
			fields,
			primary_action_label: __("Save"),
			primary_action: async (vals) => {
				// Separate standard fields from type-specific config
				const standardKeys = ["node_name", "node_type", "connector", "endpoint",
					"on_error", "retry_count", "retry_delay_seconds"];
				const standardVals = {};
				const cfgVals = {};
				Object.entries(vals).forEach(([k, v]) => {
					if (v === undefined || v === null || v === "") return;
					if (standardKeys.includes(k)) standardVals[k] = v;
					else cfgVals[k] = v;
				});

				// Preserve _edges in config_json (set by canvas edges)
				const existing = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(node.config_json || "{}"); } catch(e){return {};} })();
				if (existing._edges) cfgVals._edges = existing._edges;
				standardVals.config_json = JSON.stringify(cfgVals);

				await frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow Node", node.name, standardVals);
				Object.assign(node, standardVals);
				node.def = FB_NODE_TYPES[standardVals.node_type] || node.def;
				node.extraEdges = cfgVals._edges || {};
				this._renderAll();
				this._openPanel(node);
				frappe.show_alert({ message: "Node updated", indicator: "green" });
				d.hide();
			},
		});
		d.show();
	}

	// ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async _save() {
		this._applyEdgesToNodes();
		if (this.opts.onSave) {
			await this.opts.onSave(this.nodes);
		}
		this.dirty = false;
	}

	// ── Undo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_snapshot() {
		this._history.push(this.nodes.map(n => ({ ...n })));
		if (this._history.length > 30) this._history.shift();
	}
	_undo() {
		if (!this._history.length) return;
		this.nodes = this._history.pop().map(n => this._hydrateNode(n));
		this.edges = this._extractEdges(this.nodes);
		this._renderAll();
	}

	// ── Zoom / Fit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	_setZoom(z) {
		const rect = this.canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
		const cx = rect.width/2, cy = rect.height/2;
		const nz = Math.min(2, Math.max(0.15, z));
		this.pan.x = cx - (cx-this.pan.x)*(nz/this.zoom);
		this.pan.y = cy - (cy-this.pan.y)*(nz/this.zoom);
		this.zoom  = nz;
		this._applyTransform(); this._renderEdges();
		if (this._zoomLabel) this._zoomLabel.textContent = Math.round(nz*100)+"%";
	}

	_fitToScreen() {
		if (!this.nodes.length) return;
		const rect = this.canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
		const xs = this.nodes.map(n=>n.x), ys = this.nodes.map(n=>n.y);
		const minX=Math.min(...xs), maxX=Math.max(...xs)+220;
		const minY=Math.min(...ys), maxY=Math.max(...ys)+80;
		const pad = 80;
		const z = Math.min(
			(rect.width -pad*2)/(maxX-minX||1),
			(rect.height-pad*2)/(maxY-minY||1), 1.5
		);
		this.zoom  = z;
		this.pan.x = pad - minX*z;
		this.pan.y = pad - minY*z;
		this._applyTransform(); this._renderEdges();
		if (this._zoomLabel) this._zoomLabel.textContent = Math.round(z*100)+"%";
	}

	_selectAll() {
		// Visual only — highlight all
		this.nodeLayer.querySelectorAll("[data-node-id]").forEach(el => {
			el.style.borderColor = "#6366f1";
		});
	}

	// ── Public setters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	setFlowName(name) { this._currentFlow = name; }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SVG helpers
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function _arrowMarker(name, col) {
	const mk = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","marker");
	mk.setAttribute("id",`arrow-${name}`);
	mk.setAttribute("markerWidth","8"); mk.setAttribute("markerHeight","6");
	mk.setAttribute("refX","7"); mk.setAttribute("refY","3");
	mk.setAttribute("orient","auto");
	const p = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","polygon");
	p.setAttribute("points","0 0, 8 3, 0 6"); p.setAttribute("fill",col);
	mk.appendChild(p); return mk;
}

function _handleLabel(h) {
	return { success:"✓", true:"T", false:"F", approved:"A", rejected:"R",
		error:"!", output:"→", loop:"↻", done:"✓" }[h] || h;
}

function _pf(label, val) {
	return `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px;">
		<span style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;">${label}</span>
		<span style="font-weight:600;font-size:11px;max-width:170px;overflow:hidden;
			text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${val}</span></div>`;
}

// Render type-specific config fields in the side panel
function _typeConfigSummary(node) {
	const schema = FB_NODE_SCHEMA[node.node_type] || [];
	if (!schema.length) return "";
	let cfg = {};
	try { cfg = JSON.parse(node.config_json || "{}"); } catch(e){}

	const rows = schema
		.filter(f => cfg[f.fieldname] !== undefined && cfg[f.fieldname] !== "")
		.map(f => {
			let val = cfg[f.fieldname];
			if (typeof val === "string" && val.length > 30) val = val.slice(0,30) + "…";
			if (f.fieldtype === "Password") val = "••••••";
			return _pf(f.label, val);
		});

	if (!rows.length) {
		return `<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;background:#fff7ed;
			border:1px solid #fed7aa;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;color:#9a3412;">
			⚠ Not configured — click Edit to set up.</div>`;
	}
	return `<div style="margin:12px 0 6px;font-weight:700;color:#374151;">Config</div>${rows.join("")}`;
}

//  Page entry-point  (guarded so this file is safe to load as a plain asset)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if (typeof frappe !== "undefined" && frappe.pages && frappe.pages["flowbridge-flow-builder"]) {
frappe.pages["flowbridge-flow-builder"].on_page_load = function (wrapper) {
	const page = frappe.ui.make_app_page({
		parent: wrapper,
		title: "Flow Builder",
		single_column: true,
	});

	page.set_secondary_action(__("New Flow"), () => frappe.new_doc("FB Flow"));

	// Top bar: flow selector + status
	const $bar = $(`<div style="padding:8px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;
		background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;z-index:200;position:relative;">
		<select id="fb-flow-sel" class="form-control"
			style="max-width:280px;display:inline-block;font-size:13px;">
			<option value="">— Select a Flow —</option>
		</select>
		<span id="fb-flow-status" style="font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;"></span>
		<span id="fb-dirty-flag" style="font-size:11px;color:#f59e0b;display:none;">● Unsaved changes</span>
	</div>`);
	$(page.main).before($bar);
	$(page.body).css({ padding: 0, height: "calc(100vh - 130px)", overflow: "hidden" });
	$(page.body).html(`<div id="fb-canvas-mount" style="width:100%;height:100%;"></div>`);

	// Load flow list
	frappe.db.get_list("FB Flow", { fields:["name","flow_name","status"], limit:100 })
		.then(rows => {
			rows.forEach(r =>
				$("#fb-flow-sel").append(
					`<option value="${r.name}">${r.flow_name||r.name} (${r.status||"Draft"})</option>`)
			);
		});

	// Pre-select from URL ?flow=
	const urlFlow = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("flow");
	if (urlFlow) setTimeout(() => { $("#fb-flow-sel").val(urlFlow).trigger("change"); }, 500);

	let canvas = null;

	$("#fb-flow-sel").on("change", async function () {
		const flowName = $(this).val();
		if (!flowName) { $("#fb-canvas-mount").html(""); canvas = null; return; }
		$("#fb-flow-status").text("Loading…");
		const nodes = await frappe.db.get_list("FB Flow Node", {
			filters: { parent: flowName, parenttype: "FB Flow" },
			fields: ["name","node_id","node_type","node_name","position_x","position_y",
				"next_node_id","true_next_node_id","false_next_node_id",
				"connector","endpoint","on_error","retry_count","config_json"],
			limit: 300,
		});
		$("#fb-canvas-mount").html("");
		canvas = new FlowCanvas(
			document.getElementById("fb-canvas-mount"),
			{ nodes },
			{
				flowName,
				onSave: async (nodes) => {
					const saves = nodes.map(n => frappe.db.set_value("FB Flow Node", n.name, {
						position_x: Math.round(n.x),
						position_y: Math.round(n.y),
						next_node_id:       n.next_node_id       || "",
						true_next_node_id:  n.true_next_node_id  || "",
						false_next_node_id: n.false_next_node_id || "",
						config_json: JSON.stringify({
							...((() => { try { return JSON.parse(n.config_json||"{}"); } catch(e){return {};} })()),
							_edges: n.extraEdges || {},
						}),
					}));
					await Promise.all(saves);
					frappe.show_alert({ message:"Flow saved", indicator:"green" });
					$("#fb-dirty-flag").hide();
				},
			}
		);
		// Auto-spread nodes that share positions (e.g., new flows with all at 0,0)
		canvas._autoSpreadStacked();
		canvas.render();
		canvas._fitToScreen();
		$("#fb-flow-status").text(`${nodes.length} node${nodes.length!==1?"s":""}`);

		// Dirty watcher
		const origSave = canvas._save.bind(canvas);
		canvas._save = async function() { await origSave(); $("#fb-dirty-flag").hide(); };
		Object.defineProperty(canvas, "dirty", {
			set(v) { this._dirty=v; if(v) $("#fb-dirty-flag").show(); else $("#fb-dirty-flag").hide(); },
			get()  { return this._dirty; },
		});
	});
}; // end on_page_load
} // end if frappe.pages guard

window.FlowCanvas = FlowCanvas;
window.FB_NODE_TYPES = FB_NODE_TYPES;
