				</select>
			</div>
			<div id="fb-mp-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:16px;">
				<div style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:13px;">Loading packages…</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	`);

	_loadPackages();

	$("#fb-mp-search, #fb-mp-category").on("input change", frappe.utils.debounce(() => _loadPackages(), 300));

function _loadPackages() {
	const q = $("#fb-mp-search").val();
	const cat = $("#fb-mp-category").val();

	frappe.model.is_custom_field = frappe.model.is_custom_field || function() { return false; };

	// Guard: DocType may not exist yet
	frappe.db.exists("DocType", "FB Flow Package").then(exists => {
		if (!exists) {
			$("#fb-mp-grid").html(`<em style="color:#9ca3af;">Marketplace coming soon — FB Flow Package module not yet enabled.</em>`);
			return;
		}
		const filters = {};
		if (cat) filters.category = cat;

		frappe.db.get_list("FB Flow Package", {
			fields: ["name", "package_name", "description", "category", "install_count", "rating", "author"],
			filters,
			order_by: "install_count desc",
			limit: 24,
		}).then(rows => {
			if (!rows.length) { $("#fb-mp-grid").html(`<em style="color:#9ca3af;">No packages found.</em>`); return; }
			const filtered = q ? rows.filter(r => (r.package_name + r.description).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())) : rows;
			$("#fb-mp-grid").html(filtered.map(r => `
				<div onclick="frappe.set_route('Form','FB Flow Package','${r.name}')"
					style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:10px;padding:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .15s;"
					onmouseover="this.style.boxShadow='0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1)'" onmouseout="this.style.boxShadow='none'">
					<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;">${r.package_name}</div>
					<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:10px;min-height:36px;">${r.description || ""}</div>
					<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;">
						<span>📦 ${r.install_count || 0} installs</span>
						<span style="background:#f3f4f6;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;">${r.category || "General"}</span>
					</div>
				</div>`).join(""));
		}).catch(() => {
			$("#fb-mp-grid").html(`<em style="color:#9ca3af;">Marketplace coming soon.</em>`);
		});
	});
}

"""
FlowBridge Python SDK — Phase 10 (10.9, 10.10)
PyPI package: flowbridge-sdk

Usage:
    from flowbridge_sdk import FlowBridgeClient, FlowTest, MockConnector

    client = FlowBridgeClient(site_url="https://mysite.erpnext.com", api_key="...", api_secret="...")
    run = client.run_flow("Shopify to ERPNext", payload={"order_id": 123})
    print(run.status)
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import hmac
import hashlib
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import urllib.error
from typing import Any


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.9 — Python SDK Core

class FlowBridgeError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status_code: int = 0, response: dict | None = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.response = response or {}


class FlowRunResult:
    def __init__(self, data: dict):
        self._data = data

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._data.get("run_name", self._data.get("name", ""))

    @property
    def status(self) -> str:
        return self._data.get("status", "")

    @property
    def output(self) -> dict:
        return self._data.get("output", {})

    @property
    def error(self) -> str:
        return self._data.get("error", "")

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<FlowRunResult name={self.name!r} status={self.status!r}>"


class FlowBridgeClient:
    """Main client for the FlowBridge API."""

    def __init__(self, site_url: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str = "",
                 timeout: int = 30):
        self.site_url = site_url.rstrip("/")
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.api_secret = api_secret
        self.timeout = timeout

    def _auth_headers(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "Authorization": f"token {self.api_key}:{self.api_secret}" if self.api_secret
                             else f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }

    def _request(self, method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        url = f"{self.site_url}/api/method/{path}"
        data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=self._auth_headers(), method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as resp:
                return json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            try:
                detail = json.loads(e.read())
            except Exception:
                detail = {}
            raise FlowBridgeError(str(e), e.code, detail) from e

    # Flow operations
    def run_flow(self, flow_name: str, payload: dict | None = None,
                 wait: bool = False, poll_interval: float = 1.0,
                 timeout: float = 60.0) -> FlowRunResult:
        result = self._request("POST",
                               "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.trigger_flow",
                               {"flow_name": flow_name, "payload": payload or {}})
        msg = result.get("message", {})
        run_name = msg.get("run_name", "")
        if wait and run_name:
            return self._poll_run(run_name, poll_interval, timeout)
        return FlowRunResult(msg)

    def _poll_run(self, run_name: str, interval: float, timeout: float) -> FlowRunResult:
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            status = self.get_run_status(run_name)
            if status.status in ("Success", "Failed", "Cancelled"):
                return status
            time.sleep(interval)
        raise FlowBridgeError(f"Timed out waiting for run {run_name}")

    def get_run_status(self, run_name: str) -> FlowRunResult:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.get_flow_run_status"
                               f"?run_name={urllib.parse.quote(run_name)}")
        return FlowRunResult(result.get("message", {}))

    def list_flows(self, active_only: bool = True) -> list[dict]:
        qs = "?active_only=1" if active_only else ""
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.list_flows{qs}")
        return result.get("message", [])

    def export_flow(self, flow_name: str) -> dict:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.export_flow"
                               f"?flow_name={urllib.parse.quote(flow_name)}")
        return result.get("message", {})

    def import_flow(self, flow_json: dict, overwrite: bool = False) -> dict:
        return self._request("POST",
                             "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow.import_flow",
                             {"flow_json": flow_json, "overwrite": overwrite}).get("message", {})

    # Connector operations
    def list_connectors(self) -> list[dict]:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.connector.list_connectors")
        return result.get("message", [])

    def get_connector_health(self, connector_name: str) -> dict:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.health_monitor.get_connector_health"
                               f"?connector_name={urllib.parse.quote(connector_name)}")
        return result.get("message", {})

    # DLQ operations
    def list_dlq(self, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue.list_dlq?limit={limit}")
        return result.get("message", [])

    def requeue_from_dlq(self, event_name: str) -> dict:
        return self._request("POST",
                             "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.event_queue.requeue_from_dlq",
                             {"event_name": event_name}).get("message", {})

    # Field mapping
    def suggest_field_mappings(self, source_fields: list[str],
                                target_fields: list[str],
                                threshold: float = 0.5) -> list[dict]:
        result = self._request("POST",
                               "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.default_engine.suggest_field_mappings",
                               {"source_fields": source_fields,
                                "target_fields": target_fields,
                                "threshold": threshold})
        return result.get("message", [])

    # Analytics
    def get_flow_analytics(self, flow_name: str, days: int = 7) -> dict:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               f"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.analytics.get_flow_analytics"
                               f"?flow_name={urllib.parse.quote(flow_name)}&days={days}")
        return result.get("message", {})

    # Cloud / tenant
    def get_cloud_dashboard(self) -> dict:
        result = self._request("GET",
                               "frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.cloud.get_cloud_dashboard")
        return result.get("message", {})

# 10.10 — Flow Testing Framework

class MockConnector:
    """Mock a connector's HTTP responses for unit testing flows."""

    def __init__(self, connector_name: str):
        self.connector_name = connector_name
        self._responses: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._call_log: list[dict] = []

    def mock_endpoint(self, endpoint_name: str, response: Any,
                      status_code: int = 200):
        self._responses[endpoint_name] = {"response": response, "status": status_code}
        return self

    def get_call_log(self) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self._call_log)

    def _handle(self, endpoint_name: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
        self._call_log.append({"endpoint": endpoint_name, "payload": payload,
                                "ts": time.time()})
        if endpoint_name in self._responses:
            entry = self._responses[endpoint_name]
            if entry["status"] >= 400:
                raise FlowBridgeError(
                    f"Mock {self.connector_name}.{endpoint_name} returned {entry['status']}",
                    entry["status"],
                )
            return entry["response"]
        raise FlowBridgeError(
            f"No mock for {self.connector_name}.{endpoint_name}. "
            f"Call mock_endpoint() first."
        )

    def assert_called(self, endpoint_name: str, times: int | None = None):
        calls = [c for c in self._call_log if c["endpoint"] == endpoint_name]
        if not calls:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected {self.connector_name}.{endpoint_name} to be called")
        if times is not None and len(calls) != times:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"Expected {self.connector_name}.{endpoint_name} to be called {times} time(s), "
                f"got {len(calls)}"
            )

    def assert_not_called(self, endpoint_name: str):
        calls = [c for c in self._call_log if c["endpoint"] == endpoint_name]
        if calls:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"Expected {self.connector_name}.{endpoint_name} NOT to be called, "
                f"but it was called {len(calls)} time(s)"
            )


class FlowTestContext:
    """Represents the execution context for a flow test run."""

    def __init__(self, initial_payload: dict | None = None):
        self.payload = initial_payload or {}
        self.context: dict = {}
        self._step_results: list[dict] = []
        self._errors: list[str] = []

    def set(self, key: str, value: Any):
        self.context[key] = value
        return self

    def get(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        return self.context.get(key, default)

    @property
    def step_results(self) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self._step_results)

    @property
    def errors(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self._errors)

    @property
    def passed(self) -> bool:
        return not self._errors


class FlowTest:
    """
    Lightweight unit-test harness for FlowBridge flows.

    Usage:
        test = (
            FlowTest("Shopify → ERPNext Orders")
            .with_payload({"order_id": 42, "total": 1000})
            .mock_connector("Shopify", MockConnector("Shopify")
                .mock_endpoint("get_order", {"id": 42, "line_items": [...]}))
            .expect_context("sales_order_name", lambda v: v.startswith("SAL-"))
            .expect_no_errors()
        )
        result = test.run_offline(flow_json)
        assert result.passed
    """

    def __init__(self, flow_name: str):
        self.flow_name = flow_name
        self._payload: dict = {}
        self._mocks: dict[str, MockConnector] = {}
        self._assertions: list[tuple] = []

    def with_payload(self, payload: dict) -> "FlowTest":
        self._payload = payload
        return self

    def mock_connector(self, name: str, mock: MockConnector) -> "FlowTest":
        self._mocks[name] = mock
        return self

    def expect_context(self, key: str, matcher) -> "FlowTest":
        self._assertions.append(("context_key", key, matcher))
        return self

    def expect_no_errors(self) -> "FlowTest":
        self._assertions.append(("no_errors",))
        return self

    def expect_run_count(self, connector: str, endpoint: str, times: int) -> "FlowTest":
        self._assertions.append(("call_count", connector, endpoint, times))
        return self

    def run_offline(self, flow_json: dict) -> FlowTestContext:
        """Execute the flow locally using the mock connectors (no HTTP calls)."""
        ctx = FlowTestContext(initial_payload=self._payload)
        ctx.context.update(self._payload)

        nodes = {n["node_id"]: n for n in flow_json.get("nodes", [])}
        # Find trigger node
        start = next((n for n in flow_json.get("nodes", [])
                      if n.get("node_type") == "trigger"), None)
        if not start:
            ctx._errors.append("No trigger node found in flow JSON")
            return ctx

        current_id = start.get("next_node_id")
        visited = set()
        while current_id and current_id not in visited:
            visited.add(current_id)
            node = nodes.get(current_id)
            if not node:
                break
            result = self._execute_node(node, ctx)
            ctx._step_results.append({"node_id": current_id, "result": result})
            if result.get("error"):
                ctx._errors.append(result["error"])
            current_id = result.get("next_node_id", node.get("next_node_id"))

        # Run assertions
        for assertion in self._assertions:
            kind = assertion[0]
            if kind == "context_key":
                _, key, matcher = assertion
                val = ctx.get(key)
                try:
                    ok = matcher(val) if callable(matcher) else val == matcher
                except Exception as e:
                    ok = False
                if not ok:
                    ctx._errors.append(f"Assertion failed: context[{key!r}] = {val!r}")
            elif kind == "no_errors":
                pass  # already captured above
            elif kind == "call_count":
                _, connector, endpoint, times = assertion
                mock = self._mocks.get(connector)
                if mock:
                    try:
                        mock.assert_called(endpoint, times)
                    except AssertionError as e:
                        ctx._errors.append(str(e))

        return ctx

    def _execute_node(self, node: dict, ctx: FlowTestContext) -> dict:
        node_type = node.get("node_type", "")
        config = node.get("config", {})

        if node_type == "action" and node.get("connector"):
            mock = self._mocks.get(node["connector"])
            if mock:
                try:
                    payload = {k: ctx.get(v, v) for k, v in config.get("request_body", {}).items()}
                    response = mock._handle(node.get("endpoint_name", ""), payload)
                    if config.get("output_key"):
                        ctx.set(config["output_key"], response)
                    return {"response": response}
                except FlowBridgeError as e:
                    return {"error": str(e)}
            return {"error": f"No mock for connector {node['connector']}"}

        elif node_type == "transform":
            # Apply simple field mappings from config
            for mapping in config.get("field_mappings", []):
                src = mapping.get("source_field", "")
                tgt = mapping.get("target_field", "")
                if src and tgt:
                    ctx.set(tgt, ctx.get(src))
            return {}

        elif node_type == "condition":
            # Evaluate condition (simplified — check equality)
            field = config.get("field", "")
            op = config.get("operator", "eq")
            value = config.get("value")
            actual = ctx.get(field)
            if op == "eq":
                result = actual == value
            elif op == "ne":
                result = actual != value
            elif op == "gt":
                result = (actual or 0) > (value or 0)
            elif op == "lt":
                result = (actual or 0) < (value or 0)
            else:
                result = bool(actual)
            next_id = node.get("true_next_node_id" if result else "false_next_node_id")
            return {"next_node_id": next_id, "condition_result": result}

        # Unknown / notify / delay — just pass through
        return {}

    def run_live(self, client: FlowBridgeClient, wait: bool = True) -> FlowRunResult:
        """Execute the flow against a real FlowBridge site."""
        return client.run_flow(self.flow_name, self._payload, wait=wait)

import frappe


def run():
	"""Purge old flow runs and webhook logs beyond retention window."""
	_purge_old_records("FB Flow Run", days=90)
	_purge_old_records("FB Webhook Log", days=30)


def _purge_old_records(doctype: str, days: int):
	cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -days)
	old = frappe.get_all(doctype, filters={"creation": ["<", cutoff]}, pluck="name", limit=500)
	for name in old:
		frappe.delete_doc(doctype, name, ignore_permissions=True, force=True)
	if old:
		frappe.db.commit()

import frappe


_INTERNAL_DOCTYPES = {
	"FB Flow", "FB Flow Run", "FB Flow Run Step",
	"FB Connector", "FB Connector Endpoint",
	"FB Credential", "FB Field Mapping", "FB Mapping Rule",
	"FB Webhook Log", "FB ERPNext Integration",
}


def _dispatch(doc, event: str):
	if doc.doctype in _INTERNAL_DOCTYPES:
		return
	# Guard: tables may not exist during initial migrate
	if not frappe.db.table_exists("FB Flow"):
		return

	# Invalidate FB API Endpoint caches whose primary_doctype matches this doc
	_invalidate_api_caches(doc.doctype)

	# Publish real-time event to Redis for SSE/WS subscribers (Phase 17-A)
	try:
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_rt import publish_doc_event
		publish_doc_event(doc, event)
	except Exception:
		pass

	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run
	payload = doc.as_dict()

	# 1. FB Flow DocType-event triggers
	flows = frappe.get_all(
		"FB Flow",
		filters={
			"trigger_type": "DocType Event",
			"doctype_trigger": doc.doctype,
			"doctype_event": event,
			"status": "Active",
		},
		pluck="flow_name",
	)
	for flow_name in flows:
		enqueue_flow_run(flow_name, payload, trigger="doctype_event")

	# 2. FB ERPNext Integration rules (fine-grained per-doctype routing)
	if not frappe.db.table_exists("FB ERPNext Integration"):
		return
	integrations = frappe.get_all(
		"FB ERPNext Integration",
		filters={
			"is_active": 1,
			"source_doctype": doc.doctype,
			"doctype_event": ["in", [event, "all"]],
		},
		pluck="name",
	)
	for iname in integrations:
		integration = frappe.get_doc("FB ERPNext Integration", iname)
		try:
			integration.dispatch(doc, event)
		except Exception:
			frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), f"FlowBridge ERPNext integration error: {iname}")


def _invalidate_api_caches(doctype: str):
	"""Delete Redis cache for any FB API Endpoint whose primary_doctype = doctype."""
	try:
		if not frappe.db.table_exists("FB API Endpoint"):
			return
		slugs = frappe.get_all(
			"FB API Endpoint",
			filters={"primary_doctype": doctype, "is_active": 1, "doc_event_invalidation": 1},
			pluck="endpoint_slug",
		)
		if not slugs:
			return
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.api_builder import invalidate_endpoint_cache
		for slug in slugs:
			invalidate_endpoint_cache(slug)
	except Exception:
		pass

@frappe.whitelist()
def dispatch_api_write(slug: str, method: str) -> dict:
	"""Called by the Go write worker after a successful DB write to fire flow triggers."""
	try:
		cfg = frappe.get_cached_doc("FB API Endpoint", {"slug": slug})
	except frappe.DoesNotExistError:
		return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "endpoint not found"}

	flow_field = {
		"POST": "on_create_flow",
		"PUT": "on_update_flow",
		"PATCH": "on_update_flow",
		"DELETE": "on_delete_flow",
	}.get(method)

	if not flow_field:
		return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "no trigger for method"}

	flow_name = cfg.get(flow_field)
	if not flow_name:
		return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "no flow configured"}

	frappe.enqueue(
		"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.api.flow_runner.run_flow",
		queue="short",
		flow_name=flow_name,
		context={"source": "api_write", "slug": slug, "method": method},
	)
	return {"status": "queued", "flow": flow_name}


# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/triggers/polling_trigger.py
"""
FlowBridge Polling Trigger — Phase 5.26–5.29
Watermark-based polling, deduplication via Redis seen-ID set,
jitter scheduling, and backfill on first run.
Called every minute by the scheduler; each config manages its own interval.
"""
import json
import random
import time
import re
import frappe
from frappe.utils import now_datetime, add_to_date, get_datetime


def tick():
	"""Scheduler entry — called every minute. Dispatches overdue polling configs."""
	configs = frappe.get_all("FB Polling Config",
	                         filters={"is_active": 1},
	                         fields=["name", "interval_seconds", "jitter_seconds",
	                                 "last_run_at", "last_run_status"])
	now = now_datetime()
	for cfg in configs:
		if _is_due(cfg, now):
			frappe.enqueue(
				"frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.triggers.polling_trigger.run_poll",
				queue="default",
				config_name=cfg.name,
				now=False,
			)


def _is_due(cfg, now) -> bool:
	if not cfg.last_run_at:
		return True
	interval = (cfg.interval_seconds or 300) + random.randint(0, cfg.jitter_seconds or 0)
	elapsed = (now - get_datetime(cfg.last_run_at)).total_seconds()
	return elapsed >= interval


@frappe.whitelist()
def run_poll(config_name: str):
	"""Execute one poll cycle for the given config."""
	cfg = frappe.get_doc("FB Polling Config", config_name)
	if not cfg.is_active:
		return

	frappe.db.set_value("FB Polling Config", config_name, {
		"last_run_at": now_datetime(),
		"last_run_status": "Running",
	})
	frappe.db.commit()

	try:
		records = _fetch_all_pages(cfg)
		new_records = _deduplicate(cfg, records)
		_dispatch(cfg, new_records)
		frappe.db.set_value("FB Polling Config", config_name, {
			"last_run_status": "Success",
			"last_error": "",
		})
	except Exception as e:
		frappe.log_error(f"Polling config {config_name} failed: {e}")
		frappe.db.set_value("FB Polling Config", config_name, {
			"last_run_status": "Failed",
			"last_error": str(e)[:500],
		})
	finally:
		frappe.db.commit()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pagination strategies (5.21–5.25)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fetch_all_pages(cfg) -> list:
	"""Fetch all pages from the connector endpoint using the configured strategy."""
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.node_handlers import _get_connector_session

	connector = frappe.get_doc("FB Connector", cfg.connector)
	endpoint_doc = frappe.get_doc("FB Connector Endpoint",
	                              {"connector": cfg.connector, "endpoint_name": cfg.endpoint})

	base_params = _build_watermark_params(cfg)
	strategy = cfg.pagination_strategy or "none"
	all_records = []

	if strategy == "none":
		resp = _call_endpoint(connector, endpoint_doc, base_params)
		all_records = _extract_records(resp)

	elif strategy == "page_number":
		# 5.21 — page number strategy
		page = 1
		while True:
			params = {**base_params, cfg.page_param or "page": page,
			          cfg.page_size_param or "per_page": cfg.page_size or 100}
			resp = _call_endpoint(connector, endpoint_doc, params)
			records = _extract_records(resp)
			if not records:
				break
			all_records.extend(records)
			if len(records) < (cfg.page_size or 100):
				break
			page += 1

	elif strategy == "offset_limit":
		# 5.23 — offset/limit strategy
		offset = 0
		limit = cfg.page_size or 100
		while True:
			params = {**base_params, "offset": offset, "limit": limit}
			resp = _call_endpoint(connector, endpoint_doc, params)
			records = _extract_records(resp)
			if not records:
				break
			all_records.extend(records)
			if len(records) < limit:
				break
			offset += limit

	elif strategy == "cursor":
		# 5.22 — cursor strategy
		cursor = None
		while True:
			params = {**base_params}
			if cursor:
				params["cursor"] = cursor
			resp = _call_endpoint(connector, endpoint_doc, params)
			records = _extract_records(resp)
			all_records.extend(records)
			cursor = _deep_get(resp, (cfg.cursor_field or "next_cursor").split("."))
			if not cursor or not records:
				break

	elif strategy == "link_header":
		# 5.24 — RFC 5988 Link header strategy
		url = None
		while True:
			resp, headers = _call_endpoint_with_headers(connector, endpoint_doc,
			                                            base_params if not url else {}, url)
			records = _extract_records(resp)
			if not records:
				break
			all_records.extend(records)
			url = _parse_link_header(headers.get("Link", ""), cfg.link_header_rel or "next")
			if not url:
				break

	# Update watermark
	_update_watermark(cfg, all_records)
	return all_records


def _build_watermark_params(cfg) -> dict:
	params = {}
	if cfg.watermark_field and cfg.watermark_param:
		if cfg.last_watermark:
			params[cfg.watermark_param] = cfg.last_watermark
		else:
			lookback = add_to_date(now_datetime(), days=-(cfg.lookback_days or 7))
			params[cfg.watermark_param] = str(lookback)
	return params


def _update_watermark(cfg, records: list):
	if not cfg.watermark_field or not records:
		return
	values = [_deep_get(r, cfg.watermark_field.split(".")) for r in records
	          if _deep_get(r, cfg.watermark_field.split("."))]
	if values:
		max_val = max(str(v) for v in values)
		frappe.db.set_value("FB Polling Config", cfg.name, "last_watermark", max_val)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deduplication (5.27) — Redis seen-ID set
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _deduplicate(cfg, records: list) -> list:
	if not cfg.dedup_id_field or not records:
		return records
	try:
		import redis as redis_lib
		r = redis_lib.from_url(frappe.conf.get("redis_cache") or "redis://localhost:6379")
		key = f"fb:poll:seen:{cfg.name}"
		window = cfg.dedup_window_seconds or 86400
		new_records = []
		pipe = r.pipeline()
		for record in records:
			rec_id = str(_deep_get(record, cfg.dedup_id_field.split(".")) or "")
			if not rec_id:
				new_records.append(record)
				continue
			member = f"{rec_id}"
			if not r.sismember(key, member):
				new_records.append(record)
				pipe.sadd(key, member)
		pipe.expire(key, window)
		pipe.execute()
		return new_records
	except Exception:
		return records


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dispatch — enqueue one flow run per record
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _dispatch(cfg, records: list):
	for record in records:
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow
		enqueue_flow(cfg.flow, record, trigger="poll")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _call_endpoint(connector, endpoint_doc, params: dict):
	import requests
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.node_handlers import _build_request_kwargs
	kwargs = _build_request_kwargs(connector, endpoint_doc, params)
	resp = requests.request(endpoint_doc.method or "GET",
	                        kwargs.pop("url"), **kwargs, timeout=endpoint_doc.timeout_seconds or 30)
	resp.raise_for_status()
	return resp.json()


def _call_endpoint_with_headers(connector, endpoint_doc, params: dict, url=None):
	import requests
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.node_handlers import _build_request_kwargs
	kwargs = _build_request_kwargs(connector, endpoint_doc, params)
	target_url = url or kwargs.pop("url")
	if "url" in kwargs:
		kwargs.pop("url")
	resp = requests.request(endpoint_doc.method or "GET", target_url,
	                        **kwargs, timeout=endpoint_doc.timeout_seconds or 30)
	resp.raise_for_status()
	return resp.json(), dict(resp.headers)


def _extract_records(resp) -> list:
	if isinstance(resp, list):
		return resp
	if isinstance(resp, dict):
		# Common patterns: {data: [...]} {results: [...]} {items: [...]}
		for key in ("data", "results", "items", "records", "orders", "list"):
			if key in resp and isinstance(resp[key], list):
				return resp[key]
	return []


def _parse_link_header(header: str, rel: str) -> str | None:
	"""Parse RFC 5988 Link header and return the URL for the given rel."""
	for part in header.split(","):
		url_match = re.search(r'<([^>]+)>', part)
		rel_match = re.search(r'rel="([^"]+)"', part)
		if url_match and rel_match and rel_match.group(1) == rel:
			return url_match.group(1)
	return None


def _deep_get(obj, parts: list):
	for p in parts:
		if isinstance(obj, dict):
			obj = obj.get(p)
		else:
			return None
	return obj

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/triggers/schedule_trigger.py
import frappe
from frappe.utils import now_datetime


def tick():
	"""Called every minute by the scheduler. Fires flows whose cron expression matches now."""
	from croniter import croniter
	from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.executor.runner import enqueue_flow_run

	now = now_datetime()
	flows = frappe.get_all(
		"FB Flow",
		filters={"trigger_type": "Schedule", "status": "Active"},
		fields=["flow_name", "schedule_cron"],
	)
	for flow in flows:
		cron = (flow.schedule_cron or "").strip()
		if not cron:
			continue
		try:
			if croniter.match(cron, now):
				enqueue_flow_run(flow.flow_name, {}, trigger="schedule")
		except Exception:
			pass

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/utils/ai_engine.py
"""
FlowBridge AI Engine — Phase AI-1 + Phase 3.
Provider-agnostic interface: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama providers
+ Default Engine (stdlib + scikit-learn) fallback.
AI-1.4: OpenAI, AI-1.5: Gemini, AI-1.6: Ollama, AI-1.9: health check, AI-1.11: cost tracking.
"""
import json
import time
import frappe


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Abstract interface
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AIEngine:
	"""Base class — all providers implement this."""

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		raise NotImplementedError

	def supported_features(self) -> list[str]:
		raise NotImplementedError

	@property
	def name(self) -> str:
		raise NotImplementedError

	def health_check(self) -> dict:
		"""AI-1.9: Return {"ok": bool, "latency_ms": float, "error": str}."""
		t0 = time.monotonic()
		try:
			result = self.complete("You are a test.", "Reply with OK.", max_tokens=10)
			return {"ok": True, "latency_ms": round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000, 1)}
		except Exception as e:
			return {"ok": False, "latency_ms": round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000, 1), "error": str(e)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Claude (Anthropic) provider
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ClaudeProvider(AIEngine):
	"""Anthropic Claude via the anthropic SDK."""

	def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "claude-sonnet-4-6"):
		self._api_key = api_key
		self._model = model

	@property
	def name(self):
		return f"Claude ({self._model})"

	def supported_features(self):
		return ["flow_builder", "connector_builder", "copilot", "field_mapper",
		        "error_explainer", "agent"]

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		try:
			import anthropic
		except ImportError:
			frappe.throw("anthropic package not installed. Run: pip install anthropic")

		client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=self._api_key)
		msg = client.messages.create(
			model=self._model,
			max_tokens=max_tokens,
			system=system,
			messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user}],
		)
		return msg.content[0].text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenAI provider (AI-1.4)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class OpenAIProvider(AIEngine):
	"""OpenAI GPT via the openai SDK."""

	def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "gpt-4o"):
		self._api_key = api_key
		self._model = model

	@property
	def name(self):
		return f"OpenAI ({self._model})"

	def supported_features(self):
		return ["flow_builder", "connector_builder", "copilot", "field_mapper",
		        "error_explainer", "agent"]

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		try:
			from openai import OpenAI
		except ImportError:
			frappe.throw("openai package not installed. Run: pip install openai")

		client = OpenAI(api_key=self._api_key)
		resp = client.chat.completions.create(
			model=self._model,
			max_tokens=max_tokens,
			messages=[
				{"role": "system", "content": system},
				{"role": "user", "content": user},
			],
		)
		text = resp.choices[0].message.content or ""
		_track_cost("openai", self._model, resp.usage.prompt_tokens, resp.usage.completion_tokens)
		return text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gemini (Google) provider (AI-1.5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class GeminiProvider(AIEngine):
	"""Google Gemini via the google-generativeai SDK."""

	def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "gemini-1.5-pro"):
		self._api_key = api_key
		self._model = model

	@property
	def name(self):
		return f"Gemini ({self._model})"

	def supported_features(self):
		return ["flow_builder", "connector_builder", "copilot", "field_mapper", "error_explainer"]

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		try:
			import google.generativeai as genai
		except ImportError:
			frappe.throw("google-generativeai not installed. Run: pip install google-generativeai")

		genai.configure(api_key=self._api_key)
		model = genai.GenerativeModel(
			model_name=self._model,
			system_instruction=system,
		)
		resp = model.generate_content(
			user,
			generation_config=genai.GenerationConfig(max_output_tokens=max_tokens),
		)
		text = resp.text or ""
		usage = getattr(resp, "usage_metadata", None)
		if usage:
			_track_cost("gemini", self._model,
			            getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0),
			            getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0))
		return text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ollama (self-hosted) provider (AI-1.6)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class OllamaProvider(AIEngine):
	"""Ollama local inference via its HTTP API."""

	def __init__(self, base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434", model: str = "llama3"):
		self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
		self._model = model

	@property
	def name(self):
		return f"Ollama ({self._model})"

	def supported_features(self):
		return ["flow_builder", "copilot", "field_mapper", "error_explainer"]

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		import requests
		payload = {
			"model": self._model,
			"messages": [
				{"role": "system", "content": system},
				{"role": "user", "content": user},
			],
			"stream": False,
			"options": {"num_predict": max_tokens},
		}
		resp = requests.post(f"{self._base_url}/api/chat", json=payload, timeout=120)
		resp.raise_for_status()
		return resp.json().get("message", {}).get("content", "")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default Engine (stdlib only — no LLM)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DefaultEngine(AIEngine):
	"""
	Heuristic / pattern-based fallback.
	Handles simple cases without any external AI provider.
	"""

	@property
	def name(self):
		return "Default Engine (rule-based)"

	def supported_features(self):
		return ["field_mapper", "error_explainer", "connector_suggest"]

	def complete(self, system: str, user: str, max_tokens: int = 4096) -> str:
		# Use pattern-based copilot for chat-style queries (AI-3.6)
		from frappe_flowbridge.flowbridge.utils.default_engine import pattern_copilot
		answer = pattern_copilot(user)
		return f"[Default Engine] {answer}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Router — selects provider based on FlowBridge Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_engine(feature: str = "") -> AIEngine:
	"""
	Return the configured AI engine for the given feature.
	Per-feature overrides take precedence over the global provider setting.
	Falls back to DefaultEngine if no provider is configured or available.
	"""
	try:
		settings = _get_settings()

		# AI-1.7: Per-feature provider lookup — feature_provider_<feature> overrides global
		feature_key = f"feature_provider_{feature}" if feature else ""
		provider = (settings.get(feature_key) or settings.get("ai_provider", "default")).strip()

		engine = _build_engine(provider, settings)

		# Check feature support — fall back to DefaultEngine if provider can't handle it
		if feature and feature not in engine.supported_features():
			return DefaultEngine()

		return engine

	except Exception:
		return DefaultEngine()


def _build_engine(provider: str, settings: dict) -> "AIEngine":
	"""Instantiate the named provider using settings. Returns DefaultEngine on any failure."""
	if provider == "claude":
		api_key = settings.get("anthropic_api_key") or ""
		if not api_key:
			return DefaultEngine()
		model = settings.get("claude_model", "claude-sonnet-4-6")
		return ClaudeProvider(api_key, model)

	elif provider == "openai":
		api_key = settings.get("openai_api_key") or ""
		if not api_key:
			return DefaultEngine()
		model = settings.get("openai_model", "gpt-4o")
		return OpenAIProvider(api_key, model)

	elif provider == "gemini":
		api_key = settings.get("gemini_api_key") or ""
		if not api_key:
			return DefaultEngine()
		model = settings.get("gemini_model", "gemini-1.5-pro")
		return GeminiProvider(api_key, model)

	elif provider == "ollama":
		base_url = settings.get("ollama_base_url", "http://localhost:11434")
		model = settings.get("ollama_model", "llama3")
		return OllamaProvider(base_url, model)

	return DefaultEngine()


def _get_settings() -> dict:
	"""Read AI settings — checks Single DocType first, falls back to site_config."""
	conf = frappe.conf
	def _conf_get(key, default=""):
		if hasattr(conf, "get"):
			return conf.get(key, default)
		return getattr(conf, key, default)

	def _decrypt(field: str) -> str:
		try:
			from frappe.utils.password import get_decrypted_password
			return get_decrypted_password("FB FlowBridge Settings", "FB FlowBridge Settings", field) or ""
		except Exception:
			return frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", field) or ""

	# Features that can have per-feature provider overrides (AI-1.7)
	_FEATURES = [
		"flow_builder", "field_mapper", "copilot", "connector_suggest",
		"error_explainer", "analytics", "agents", "field_extraction",
	]

	try:
		if frappe.db.table_exists("tabFB FlowBridge Settings"):
			def _sv(f):
				return frappe.db.get_single_value("FB FlowBridge Settings", f) or ""
			provider = _sv("ai_provider")
			if provider:
				out = {
					"ai_provider": provider or "default",
					# Claude
					"anthropic_api_key": _decrypt("anthropic_api_key"),
					"claude_model": _sv("claude_model") or "claude-sonnet-4-6",
					# OpenAI
					"openai_api_key": _decrypt("openai_api_key"),
					"openai_model": _sv("openai_model") or "gpt-4o",
					# Gemini
					"gemini_api_key": _decrypt("gemini_api_key"),
					"gemini_model": _sv("gemini_model") or "gemini-1.5-pro",
					# Ollama
					"ollama_base_url": _sv("ollama_base_url") or "http://localhost:11434",
					"ollama_model": _sv("ollama_model") or "llama3",
				}
				# Per-feature overrides — e.g. feature_provider_flow_builder = "claude"
				for feat in _FEATURES:
					val = _sv(f"feature_provider_{feat}")
					if val:
						out[f"feature_provider_{feat}"] = val
				return out
	except Exception:
		pass

	return {
		"ai_provider": _conf_get("flowbridge_ai_provider", "default"),
		"anthropic_api_key": _conf_get("flowbridge_anthropic_api_key", ""),
		"claude_model": _conf_get("flowbridge_claude_model", "claude-sonnet-4-6"),
		"openai_api_key": _conf_get("flowbridge_openai_api_key", ""),
		"openai_model": _conf_get("flowbridge_openai_model", "gpt-4o"),
		"gemini_api_key": _conf_get("flowbridge_gemini_api_key", ""),
		"gemini_model": _conf_get("flowbridge_gemini_model", "gemini-1.5-pro"),
		"ollama_base_url": _conf_get("flowbridge_ollama_base_url", "http://localhost:11434"),
		"ollama_model": _conf_get("flowbridge_ollama_model", "llama3"),
	}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-1.11: Cost tracking — Redis counters per provider per day
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Rough token prices per 1M tokens (input/output) — update as needed
_COST_TABLE = {
	"claude/claude-sonnet-4-6":   (3.00, 15.00),
	"claude/claude-opus-4-7":     (15.00, 75.00),
	"openai/gpt-4o":              (5.00, 15.00),
	"openai/gpt-4o-mini":         (0.15, 0.60),
	"gemini/gemini-1.5-pro":      (1.25, 5.00),
	"gemini/gemini-1.5-flash":    (0.075, 0.30),
}


def _track_cost(provider: str, model: str, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int):
	try:
		import redis as redis_lib
		from frappe.utils import today
		r = redis_lib.from_url(frappe.conf.get("redis_cache") or "redis://localhost:6379")
		key = f"fb:ai:cost:{today()}:{provider}"
		price_in, price_out = _COST_TABLE.get(f"{provider}/{model}", (0, 0))
		cost_usd = (input_tokens * price_in + output_tokens * price_out) / 1_000_000
		r.hincrbyfloat(key, "input_tokens", input_tokens)
		r.hincrbyfloat(key, "output_tokens", output_tokens)
		r.hincrbyfloat(key, "cost_usd", cost_usd)
		r.hincrby(key, "calls", 1)
		r.expire(key, 86400 * 90)  # 90-day history
	except Exception:
		pass


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_ai_cost_report(days: int = 30) -> list:
	"""AI-1.11: Return daily AI cost breakdown per provider."""
	frappe.only_for(["System Manager"])
	try:
		import redis as redis_lib
		from frappe.utils import add_to_date, today, getdate
		r = redis_lib.from_url(frappe.conf.get("redis_cache") or "redis://localhost:6379")
		rows = []
		for i in range(int(days)):
			date = str(add_to_date(today(), days=-i))
			cursor = 0
			while True:
				cursor, keys = r.scan(cursor, match=f"fb:ai:cost:{date}:*", count=100)
				for key in keys:
					data = r.hgetall(key)
					provider = key.decode().split(":")[-1]
					rows.append({
						"date": date,
						"provider": provider,
						"calls": int(data.get(b"calls", 0)),
						"input_tokens": int(float(data.get(b"input_tokens", 0))),
						"output_tokens": int(float(data.get(b"output_tokens", 0))),
						"cost_usd": round(float(data.get(b"cost_usd", 0)), 4),
					})
				if cursor == 0:
					break
		return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["date"], reverse=True)
	except Exception:
		return []

# FILE: /Users/bluephoenix/frappe-bench/bench-r2/apps/frappe_flowbridge/frappe_flowbridge/flowbridge/utils/default_engine.py
"""
FlowBridge Default Engine — AI-3.1 through AI-3.7 + AI-2.3 RapidFuzz
All implementations use stdlib + optional dependencies.
No external LLM required. Gracefully degrades if packages are absent.

AI-2.3: RapidFuzz fuzzy string matching (pip install rapidfuzz)
AI-3.1: Field Mapper (TF-IDF cosine similarity over field names)
AI-3.2: Flow Builder (pattern matching over connector/node catalogue)
AI-3.3: Connector Suggest (TF-IDF over connector descriptions)
AI-3.4: Error Categorizer (rule engine on HTTP codes + known patterns)
AI-3.5: Anomaly Detection (IsolationForest via sklearn, z-score fallback)
AI-3.6: Copilot (similarity over flow history + FAQ bank)
AI-3.7: FAQ Chatbot (TF-IDF vector search over ERPNext / FlowBridge docs)
"""
import re
import json
import difflib
import frappe


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-2.3 — RapidFuzz fuzzy matching helpers
# pip install rapidfuzz  (C++ backed, 10-100× faster than difflib)
# Falls back to difflib.SequenceMatcher when rapidfuzz is not installed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fuzzy_ratio(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    """Return similarity ratio [0, 1] between two strings."""
    try:
        from rapidfuzz import fuzz
        return fuzz.WRatio(a, b) / 100.0
    except ImportError:
        return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()


def _fuzzy_best_match(query: str, choices: list[str],
                      threshold: float = 0.4) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """
    Return (best_match, score) from choices for query.
    Uses rapidfuzz.process.extractOne when available — O(n) with C++ speed.
    """
    if not choices:
        return ("", 0.0)
    try:
        from rapidfuzz import process, fuzz
        result = process.extractOne(
            query, choices,
            scorer=fuzz.WRatio,
            score_cutoff=threshold * 100,
        )
        if result:
            return (result[0], result[1] / 100.0)
        return ("", 0.0)
    except ImportError:
        best, best_score = "", 0.0
        for choice in choices:
            s = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, query, choice).ratio()
            if s > best_score:
                best_score, best = s, choice
        return (best, best_score) if best_score >= threshold else ("", 0.0)


def _fuzzy_top_k(query: str, choices: list[str], k: int = 5,
                  threshold: float = 0.3) -> list[tuple[str, float]]:
    """
    Return top-k (match, score) pairs for query from choices.
    Uses rapidfuzz.process.extract when available.
    """
    if not choices:
        return []
    try:
        from rapidfuzz import process, fuzz
        results = process.extract(
            query, choices,
            scorer=fuzz.WRatio,
            limit=k,
            score_cutoff=threshold * 100,
        )
        return [(r[0], r[1] / 100.0) for r in results]
    except ImportError:
        scored = [(c, difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, query, c).ratio()) for c in choices]
        filtered = [(c, s) for c, s in scored if s >= threshold]
        return sorted(filtered, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:k]


def _rapidfuzz_available() -> bool:
    try:
        import rapidfuzz
        return True
    except ImportError:
        return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-3.1 — Field Mapper via TF-IDF cosine similarity
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def suggest_field_mappings(source_fields: list[str], target_fields: list[str],
                           threshold: float = 0.35) -> list[dict]:
	"""
	Return mapping suggestions [{source, target, score}] sorted by score desc.
	Uses TF-IDF if sklearn is available, difflib SequenceMatcher otherwise.
	"""
	if not source_fields or not target_fields:
		return []

	# Normalise: split camelCase/snake_case into words
	def _tokens(name: str) -> str:
		name = re.sub(r"([a-z])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
		return re.sub(r"[_\-.]", " ", name).lower()

	src_norm = [_tokens(f) for f in source_fields]
	tgt_norm = [_tokens(f) for f in target_fields]

	try:
		from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
		from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
		import numpy as np

		corpus = src_norm + tgt_norm
		vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4))
		X = vec.fit_transform(corpus)
		src_mat = X[:len(src_norm)]
		tgt_mat = X[len(src_norm):]
		sim = cosine_similarity(src_mat, tgt_mat)  # shape: (n_src, n_tgt)

		suggestions = []
		for i, src in enumerate(source_fields):
			best_idx = int(np.argmax(sim[i]))
			score = float(sim[i][best_idx])
			if score >= threshold:
				suggestions.append({"source": src, "target": target_fields[best_idx], "score": round(score, 3)})
		return sorted(suggestions, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)

	except ImportError:
		# AI-2.3: RapidFuzz middle tier — faster than difflib, no sklearn needed
		try:
			suggestions = []
			for src, sn in zip(source_fields, src_norm):
				match, score = _fuzzy_best_match(sn, tgt_norm, threshold=threshold)
				if match:
					idx = tgt_norm.index(match)
					suggestions.append({"source": src, "target": target_fields[idx], "score": round(score, 3)})
			return sorted(suggestions, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
		except Exception:
			pass
		# Final fallback: difflib SequenceMatcher
		suggestions = []
		for src, sn in zip(source_fields, src_norm):
			best_score = 0.0
			best_tgt = ""
			for tgt, tn in zip(target_fields, tgt_norm):
				score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, sn, tn).ratio()
				if score > best_score:
					best_score = score
					best_tgt = tgt
			if best_score >= threshold:
				suggestions.append({"source": src, "target": best_tgt, "score": round(best_score, 3)})
		return sorted(suggestions, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-3.3 — Connector Suggest via TF-IDF
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def suggest_connectors(query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> list[dict]:
	"""
	Return top-k connector suggestions for a plain-English query.
	Scores each connector by TF-IDF similarity of query vs description+name.
	"""
	connectors = frappe.get_all(
		"FB Connector",
		filters={"is_active": 1},
		fields=["name", "connector_name", "description", "category"],
	)
	if not connectors:
		return []

	docs = [f"{c.connector_name} {c.category or ''} {c.description or ''}" for c in connectors]

	try:
		from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
		from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
		import numpy as np

		vec = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words="english")
		X = vec.fit_transform(docs + [query])
		scores = cosine_similarity(X[-1:], X[:-1])[0]
		top_idx = np.argsort(scores)[::-1][:top_k]
		return [{"name": connectors[i].name,
		         "connector_name": connectors[i].connector_name,
		         "score": round(float(scores[i]), 3)} for i in top_idx if scores[i] > 0]

	except ImportError:
		results = []
		q = query.lower()
		for c in connectors:
			text = f"{c.connector_name} {c.description or ''}".lower()
			score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, q, text).ratio()
			results.append({"name": c.name, "connector_name": c.connector_name, "score": round(score, 3)})
		return sorted(results, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)[:top_k]

_FLOW_PATTERNS = [

		"description": "Triggered by incoming webhook",

		"trigger": "doctype_trigger",
		"description": "Triggered by ERPNext document events",
	},
	{
		"keywords": ["send email", "notify", "alert", "notification"],
		"action": "notify",
		"description": "Send email notification",
	},

		"action": "create_doc",
		"description": "Create an ERPNext document",
	},

		"action": "update_doc",
		"description": "Update an existing ERPNext document",

	},

		"action": "loop",
		"description": "Iterate over a list",
	},
	{
		"keywords": ["fetch", "get", "call api", "http", "request", "pull data"],
		"action": "http_request",
		"description": "HTTP API call",
	},
]


def suggest_flow_nodes(description: str) -> list[dict]:
	"""Return suggested node sequence for a plain-English flow description."""
	desc_lower = description.lower()
	matches = []
	for pattern in _FLOW_PATTERNS:
		kws = pattern.get("keywords", [])
		hit_count = sum(1 for kw in kws if kw in desc_lower)
		if hit_count > 0:
			matches.append({**pattern, "score": hit_count / len(kws)})
	matches.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
	return matches[:6]


def build_flow_skeleton(description: str) -> dict:
	"""Generate a basic flow skeleton JSON from a description using patterns."""
	nodes = suggest_flow_nodes(description)
	trigger = next((n for n in nodes if "trigger" in n), None)
	actions = [n for n in nodes if "action" in n]

	flow_nodes = []
	prev_id = None

	# Trigger node
	t_type = trigger["trigger"] if trigger else "webhook_trigger"
	t_node = {
		"node_id": "trigger_1",
		"node_type": t_type,
		"node_name": trigger["description"] if trigger else "Webhook Trigger",
		"config_json": {},
		"on_error": "stop",
		"next_node_id": None,
	}
	flow_nodes.append(t_node)
	prev_id = "trigger_1"

	for i, action in enumerate(actions[:5], 1):
		node_id = f"node_{i}"
		node = {
			"node_id": node_id,
			"node_type": action["action"],
			"node_name": action["description"],
			"config_json": {},
			"on_error": "continue",
			"next_node_id": None,
		}
		flow_nodes[-1]["next_node_id"] = node_id
		flow_nodes.append(node)

	import re as _re
	slug = _re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", description.lower())[:40].strip("_")
	return {
		"schema": "flowbridge/v1",
		"type": "Flow",
		"name": slug,
		"trigger_type": t_type.replace("_trigger", "").title(),
		"nodes": flow_nodes,
		"settings": {"dlq_enabled": 1},
		"_note": "Generated by Default Engine — review and configure each node before activating.",
	}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-3.4 — Error Categorizer (rule engine)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_HTTP_CATEGORIES = {
	400: ("client_error", "Bad request — check payload structure and required fields."),
	401: ("auth_error", "Authentication failed — verify API key or OAuth2 token."),
	403: ("auth_error", "Access denied — check permissions and scopes."),
	404: ("not_found", "Resource not found — verify endpoint URL and record ID."),
	408: ("timeout", "Request timed out — consider increasing timeout or reducing payload size."),
	409: ("conflict", "Conflict — resource already exists or version mismatch."),
	422: ("validation", "Validation failed — check field values and data types."),
	429: ("rate_limit", "Rate limit exceeded — back off and retry after the Retry-After interval."),
	500: ("server_error", "Remote server error — transient issue, retry with backoff."),
	502: ("server_error", "Bad gateway — upstream server is unreachable, retry."),
	503: ("server_error", "Service unavailable — retry after a short delay."),
	504: ("timeout", "Gateway timeout — remote server did not respond in time."),
}

_PATTERN_CATEGORIES = [
	(r"connect(ion)? (refused|timed? ?out|reset)", "network", "Network connectivity issue — check connector URL and firewall rules."),
	(r"ssl|certificate|tls|handshake", "ssl_error", "SSL/TLS error — check certificate validity and connector base URL (https vs http)."),
	(r"json decode|invalid json|not valid json", "parse_error", "Response parsing failed — the API returned non-JSON content."),
	(r"max retries|retry", "retry_exhausted", "All retry attempts failed — check connector health and logs."),
	(r"token expired|access token|refresh", "auth_error", "OAuth2 token expired — trigger a token refresh."),
	(r"quota|limit exceeded|too many", "rate_limit", "Quota exceeded — review usage limits in the API console."),
]


def categorize_error(error_message: str, status_code: int = 0) -> dict:
	"""
	Return {category, is_transient, suggestion, confidence} for an error.
	"""
	# HTTP status code takes priority
	if status_code and status_code in _HTTP_CATEGORIES:
		cat, suggestion = _HTTP_CATEGORIES[status_code]
		is_transient = status_code in (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504)
		return {"category": cat, "is_transient": is_transient,
		        "suggestion": suggestion, "confidence": 0.95, "matched_by": "http_status"}

	# Pattern matching on message
	msg = (error_message or "").lower()
	for pattern, cat, suggestion in _PATTERN_CATEGORIES:
		if re.search(pattern, msg):
			is_transient = cat in ("network", "server_error", "timeout", "retry_exhausted")
			return {"category": cat, "is_transient": is_transient,
			        "suggestion": suggestion, "confidence": 0.80, "matched_by": "pattern"}

	return {
		"category": "unknown",
		"is_transient": False,
		"suggestion": "Unknown error — check full logs and contact connector support.",
		"confidence": 0.20,
		"matched_by": "fallback",
	}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-3.5 — Anomaly Detection (IsolationForest + z-score fallback)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def detect_anomalies(time_series: list[float], contamination: float = 0.1) -> list[bool]:
	"""
	Return a boolean mask — True = anomaly.
	Uses IsolationForest if sklearn available, z-score otherwise.
	"""
	if not time_series:
		return []

	try:
		from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
		import numpy as np
		X = np.array(time_series).reshape(-1, 1)
		clf = IsolationForest(contamination=contamination, random_state=42)
		preds = clf.fit_predict(X)
		return [p == -1 for p in preds]

	except ImportError:
		# z-score: flag points > 2 std from mean
		import statistics
		if len(time_series) < 3:
			return [False] * len(time_series)
		mean = statistics.mean(time_series)
		stdev = statistics.stdev(time_series) or 1e-9
		return [abs(v - mean) / stdev > 2.0 for v in time_series]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI-3.6 — Pattern-based Copilot (similarity over flow history + FAQ bank)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_COPILOT_FAQ = [
	("how do i connect to shopify", "Add a Shopify connector from the Connector Library, configure your Shopify store URL and access token in Credentials, then use the 'http_request' node with the Shopify connector."),
	("webhook trigger", "Add a 'webhook_trigger' node as the first node. FlowBridge generates a unique webhook URL you can register in the external service."),
	("how to send email", "Use the 'notify' node with channel=email. Configure subject and message as Jinja2 templates — use {{payload.field}} to embed trigger data."),
	("retry failed requests", "Set on_error=retry on the node, configure retry_count (e.g. 3) and retry_delay_seconds (e.g. 2). The executor will back off exponentially."),
	("how to loop over list", "Add a 'loop' node. Set items_key to the context variable containing your list. Each item is passed as a child flow run."),
	("transform data", "Add a 'transform' node linked to an FB Field Mapping DocType. Use the '✨ Auto-suggest' button in the Studio to auto-map fields."),
	("api key", "Create an FB API Key in Settings > API Keys. Set scopes (flow names) and rate limits. Use the Bearer token in requests to /api/method/...run_flow_with_api_key."),
	("conditional branch", "Add a 'condition' node. Set config_json.expression to a Jinja2 boolean (e.g. {{ payload.amount > 1000 }}). Wire true_next_node_id and false_next_node_id."),
	("schedule flow", "Add a 'schedule_trigger' node. Set schedule_cron (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for 9 AM daily). The scheduler uses Frappe's background job system."),
	("rate limit", "Each FB Connector has a rate_limit_rpm field. The executor enforces a Redis sliding window and auto-waits if the limit is reached."),
	("oauth2", "Create an FB Credential with auth_type=OAuth2. Set client_id, client_secret, token_url. FlowBridge auto-refreshes tokens using the refresh_token grant."),
	("error in flow", "Check the FB Flow Run record — expand the Steps tab for per-node error messages. Use 'Explain Error' in the Debug Console for AI analysis."),
	("how to export flow", "Use flow.py export_flow(flow_name) to get portable flowbridge/v1 JSON. Or use the Studio → Export button."),
	("marketplace", "Browse the FlowBridge Marketplace for pre-built flows and connectors. Install with one click — credentials are configured post-install."),
	("circuit breaker", "FlowBridge auto-pauses connectors after 10 failures in 5 minutes. Check FB Connector > is_paused. Use circuit_breaker.reset() to re-enable."),
]


def pattern_copilot(question: str, context_type: str = "general") -> str:
	"""Return the best FAQ answer using TF-IDF or SequenceMatcher similarity."""
	q = question.lower()

	try:
		from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
		from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
		import numpy as np

		questions = [q for q, _ in _COPILOT_FAQ]
		vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4))
		X = vec.fit_transform(questions + [q])
		scores = cosine_similarity(X[-1:], X[:-1])[0]
		best_idx = int(np.argmax(scores))
		if scores[best_idx] > 0.25:
			return _COPILOT_FAQ[best_idx][1]

	except ImportError:
		# AI-2.3: RapidFuzz middle tier
		faq_questions = [fq for fq, _ in _COPILOT_FAQ]
		top = _fuzzy_top_k(q, faq_questions, k=1, threshold=0.3)
		if top:
			idx = faq_questions.index(top[0][0])
			return _COPILOT_FAQ[idx][1]
		best_score = 0.0
		best_answer = ""
		for faq_q, faq_a in _COPILOT_FAQ:
			score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, q, faq_q).ratio()
			if score > best_score:
				best_score = score
				best_answer = faq_a
		if best_score > 0.3:
			return best_answer

	return ("I don't have a specific answer for that. Try the FlowBridge docs or configure an "
	        "AI provider (Claude/OpenAI/Gemini) in Settings for full Copilot support.")

# AI-3.7 — FAQ Chatbot via TF-IDF vector search over ERPNext docs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_ERPNEXT_DOCS = [
	("sales order", "A Sales Order records a confirmed order from a customer. Fields: customer, delivery_date, items[]. Status: Draft → Submitted → Delivered."),
	("purchase order", "A Purchase Order records goods ordered from a supplier. Fields: supplier, schedule_date, items[]. Flows: PO → Purchase Receipt → Purchase Invoice."),
	("sales invoice", "A Sales Invoice is a bill issued to the customer. Linked to a Sales Order via Sales Invoice Item. Payment Entry records settlement."),
	("purchase invoice", "A Purchase Invoice records an incoming bill from the supplier. Can be linked to Purchase Order and Purchase Receipt."),
	("item", "An Item in ERPNext represents a product or service. Key fields: item_code (unique), item_name, item_group, stock_uom, valuation_rate."),
	("customer", "A Customer represents a buyer. Key fields: customer_name, customer_group, territory, default_currency. Linked to Contact and Address."),
	("supplier", "A Supplier represents a vendor. Key fields: supplier_name, supplier_group, country. Linked to Purchase Order and Purchase Invoice."),

	("journal entry", "A Journal Entry records accounting transactions. Uses debit/credit legs against GL accounts."),
